	public class PreloadProvider : IPreloadSupport
	{
		IEnumerable<FrameworkElement> IPreloadSupport.GetConfiguredTree()
		{
			RibbonControl ribbonControl = new RibbonControl();
			ribbonControl.BeginInit();
			RibbonPageCategory ribbonPageCategory = new RibbonPageCategory();
			RibbonPage ribbonPage = new RibbonPage();
			RibbonPageGroup ribbonPageGroup = new RibbonPageGroup();
			ribbonPage.Groups.Add(ribbonPageGroup);
			((Collection<IBarItem>)(object)ribbonPageGroup.Items).Add((IBarItem)new BarButtonItem
			{
				Glyph = (ImageSource)((MarkupExtension)new DXImageExtension("SvgImages/Outlook Inspired/AddFile.svg")).ProvideValue((IServiceProvider)null)
			});
			((Collection<IBarItem>)(object)ribbonPageGroup.Items).Add((IBarItem)new BarCheckItem
			{
				Glyph = (ImageSource)((MarkupExtension)new DXImageExtension("SvgImages/Outlook Inspired/AddFile.svg")).ProvideValue((IServiceProvider)null)
			});
			ribbonPageCategory.Pages.Add(ribbonPage);
			ribbonControl.Categories.Add(ribbonPageCategory);
			ribbonControl.EndInit();
			yield return ribbonControl;
		}
	}
}

		protected override void OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{

			((PopupMenuBase)this).OnOpened(e);
			UpdateApplicationButtonPosition();

		protected override void UpdatePlacement(UIElement control)
		{
			((BarPopupExpandable)this).UpdatePlacement(control);
			if (control is RibbonApplicationButtonControl ribbonApplicationButtonControl)
			{
				Point point = ribbonApplicationButtonControl.TranslatePoint(default(Point), Ribbon);
				((Popup)this).Placement = PlacementMode.Bottom;
				double num = (Ribbon.IsAeroMode ? Ribbon.ApplicationMenuHorizontalOffsetInAeroWindow : Ribbon.ApplicationMenuHorizontalOffset);
				double num2 = (Ribbon.IsAeroMode ? Ribbon.ApplicationMenuVerticalOffsetInAeroWindow : Ribbon.ApplicationMenuVerticalOffset);
				((Popup)this).HorizontalOffset = num - point.X;
				((Popup)this).VerticalOffset = ((RibbonStyle != RibbonStyle.Office2007) ? (0.0 - num2) : ((double)((int)ribbonApplicationButtonControl.ActualHeight / -2)));
			}
		}

		internal bool Show(RibbonApplicationButtonControl appButton)
		{
			Ribbon = appButton.Ribbon;
			((Popup)this).PlacementTarget = appButton;
			RibbonStyle = Ribbon.RibbonStyle;
			if (IsMenuEmpty)
			{
				return false;
			}
			((BarPopupBase)this).ShowPopup((UIElement)appButton);
			return ((Popup)this).IsOpen;
		}

		UIElement IApplicationMenu.GetRightPaneContainer()
		{
			if (!ShowRightPane || RightPaneWidth == 0.0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return (UIElement)(object)BarControl.RightPane;
		}

		protected override bool ShowDescriptionCore()
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000f: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if ((int)((PopupMenuBase)this).ItemsDisplayMode != 0)
			{
				return (int)((PopupMenuBase)this).ItemsDisplayMode == 3;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void UpdateApplicationButtonPosition()
		{
			ApplicationMenuPopupBorderControl applicationMenuPopupBorderControl = ((Popup)this).Child as ApplicationMenuPopupBorderControl;
			if (Ribbon != null && ((Popup)this).IsOpen && applicationMenuPopupBorderControl.ApplicationButton != null)
			{
				((BarPopupBase)this).UpdatePlacement(((Popup)this).PlacementTarget);
				applicationMenuPopupBorderControl.UpdateAppButtonProperties(((Popup)this).IsOpen);
				applicationMenuPopupBorderControl.UpdateAppButtonPosition(((Popup)this).PlacementTarget as FrameworkElement);
				UpdateVerticalOffset();
			}
		}

		protected internal void UpdateVerticalOffset()
		{
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = ((Popup)this).PlacementTarget as FrameworkElement;
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement2 = ((Popup)this).Child as FrameworkElement;
			if (frameworkElement != null && frameworkElement2 != null)
			{
				Point screenPoint = ScreenHelper.GetScreenPoint(frameworkElement, default(Point));
				Rect screenRect = ScreenHelper.GetScreenRect(frameworkElement2);
				Point screenPoint2 = ScreenHelper.GetScreenPoint(frameworkElement2, default(Point));
				if (screenPoint.Y + frameworkElement2.ActualHeight + frameworkElement.ActualHeight > screenRect.Height)
				{
					((Popup)this).VerticalOffset = 0.0;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			((FrameworkElement)this).OnApplyTemplate();
			UpdateApplicationButtonPosition();
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnShowRightPaneChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (BarControl != null)
			{
				BarControl.UpdateLeftPaneGridColumns((bool)e.NewValue);
			}
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			((SubMenuBarControl)this).OnApplyTemplate();
			DependencyObject templateChild = ((FrameworkElement)this).GetTemplateChild("PART_RightPanePresenter");
			RightPane = (DXContentPresenter)(object)((templateChild is DXContentPresenter) ? templateChild : null);
			UpdateActualRightPaneWidth();
			LeftPaneGrid = ((FrameworkElement)this).GetTemplateChild("PART_LeftPaneGrid") as Grid;
			UpdateLeftPaneGridColumns(ApplicationMenu != null && ApplicationMenu.ShowRightPane);
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateActualRightPaneWidth()
		{
			if (ApplicationMenu == null || double.IsNaN(ApplicationMenu.RightPaneWidth))
			{
				ActualRightPaneWidth = RightPaneWidth;
			}
			else
			{
				ActualRightPaneWidth = ApplicationMenu.RightPaneWidth;
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateLeftPaneGridColumns(bool newValue)
		{
			if (LeftPaneGrid != null)
			{
				LeftPaneGrid.ColumnDefinitions.Clear();
				if (newValue)
				{
					LeftPaneGrid.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition
					{
						Width = new GridLength(1.0, GridUnitType.Auto)
					});
					LeftPaneGrid.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition
					{
						Width = new GridLength(1.0, GridUnitType.Auto)
					});
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateActualBorderTemplate()
		{
			ActualBorderTemplate = ((RibbonStyle == RibbonStyle.Office2007) ? BorderTemplateForOffice2007Style : BorderTemplateForOffice2010Style);
		}
	}
	public class ApplicationMenuPopupBorderControl : PopupBorderControl
	{
		private RibbonApplicationButtonControl applicationButton;

		public RibbonApplicationButtonControl ApplicationButton
		{
			get
			{
				return applicationButton;
			}
			protected internal set
			{
				if (applicationButton != value)
				{
					RibbonApplicationButtonControl oldValue = applicationButton;
					applicationButton = value;
					OnApplicationButtonChanged(oldValue);
				}
			}
		}

		public ApplicationMenu ApplicationMenu { get; protected internal set; }

		public ApplicationMenuPopupBorderControl(ApplicationMenu owner)
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<ApplicationMenuPopupBorderControl>(this);
			ApplicationMenu = owner;
			((FrameworkElement)this).SizeChanged += OnSizeChanged;
		}

		public ApplicationMenuPopupBorderControl()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<ApplicationMenuPopupBorderControl>(this);
			((FrameworkElement)this).SizeChanged += OnSizeChanged;
		}

		public void OnSizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (ApplicationMenu != null)
			{
				ApplicationMenu.UpdateVerticalOffset();
			}
		}

		private void OnApplicationButtonChanged(RibbonApplicationButtonControl oldValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				oldValue.Click -= OnApplicationButtonClick;
			}
			if (ApplicationButton != null)
			{
				ApplicationButton.Click += OnApplicationButtonClick;
				if (ApplicationMenu != null && ApplicationMenu.Ribbon != null)
				{
					ApplicationButton.Ribbon = ApplicationMenu.Ribbon;
					ApplicationButton.Ribbon.SetCurrentValue(RibbonControl.RibbonStyleProperty, ApplicationMenu.RibbonStyle);
				}
				else
				{
					ApplicationButton.RibbonStyle = RibbonStyle.Office2010;
				}
				ApplicationButton.UpdateLayout();
			}
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			((PopupBorderControl)this).OnApplyTemplate();
			ApplicationButton = ((FrameworkElement)this).GetTemplateChild("PART_ApplicationButton") as RibbonApplicationButtonControl;
			if (ApplicationMenu != null && ((Popup)(object)ApplicationMenu).PlacementTarget is FrameworkElement target)
			{
				UpdateAppButtonPosition(target);
			}
		}

		public void UpdateAppButtonPosition(FrameworkElement target)
		{
			if (target != null && ApplicationButton != null)
			{
				TranslateTransform translateTransform = new TranslateTransform();
				((UIElement)this).UpdateLayout();
				int num = 1;
				if (((FrameworkElement)this).FlowDirection != FlowDirection.LeftToRight)
				{
					num = -1;
				}
				Point screenPoint = ScreenHelper.GetScreenPoint(target, default(Point));
				Point screenPoint2 = ScreenHelper.GetScreenPoint((FrameworkElement)(object)this, default(Point));
				translateTransform.X = (screenPoint.X - screenPoint2.X) * (double)num;
				translateTransform.Y = screenPoint.Y - screenPoint2.Y;
				ApplicationButton.RenderTransform = translateTransform;
			}
		}

		public void UpdateAppButtonProperties(bool isPressed)
		{
			if (ApplicationMenu != null && ApplicationButton != null)
			{
				ApplicationButton.IsChecked = isPressed;
				ApplicationButton.Ribbon = ApplicationMenu.Ribbon;
				ApplicationButton.RibbonStyle = ApplicationMenu.RibbonStyle;
				ApplicationButton.ApplyTemplate();
			}
		}

		private void OnApplicationButtonClick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (ApplicationMenu != null)
			{
				((Popup)(object)ApplicationMenu).IsOpen = false;
			}
		}
	}

		public BackstageButtonItem()
		{
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0012: Expected O, but got Unknown
			commandSourceHelper = new CommandSourceHelper((ICommandSource)this);
			commandSourceHelper.CanExecuteChanged += OnCommandCanExecuteChanged;
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<BackstageButtonItem>(this);
			if (DependencyObjectExtensions.IsInDesignTool((DependencyObject)this))
			{
				base.Content = "Button";
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnKeyGestureChanged(KeyGesture oldValue, KeyGesture newValue)
		{
			BarNameScope.GetService<ICommandSourceService>((object)this).KeyGestureChanged((ICommandSourceServiceSupport)(object)this, oldValue, newValue);
		}

		protected virtual void CommandChanged(ICommand oldValue)
		{
			BarNameScope.GetService<ICommandSourceService>((object)this).CommandChanged((ICommandSourceServiceSupport)(object)this, oldValue, Command);
		}

		protected virtual void CommandTargetChanged(IInputElement oldValue)
		{
			UpdateCanExecute();
		}

		protected virtual void CommandParameterChanged(object oldValue)
		{
			UpdateCanExecute();
		}

		protected virtual void OnCommandCanExecuteChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateActualIsEnabled();
		}

		private void UpdateCanExecute(bool shortcutRequest = false)
		{
			commandSourceHelper.Update(shortcutRequest);
			UpdateActualIsEnabled();
		}

		void ICommandSourceServiceSupport.UpdateCanExecute(bool shortcutRequest)
		{
			UpdateCanExecute(shortcutRequest);
		}

		void ICommandSourceServiceSupport.ExecuteCommand()
		{
			OnClick();
		}

		protected virtual void ExecuteCommand()
		{
			commandSourceHelper.Execute(Command, CommandParameter, CommandTarget);
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return NavigationAutomationPeersCreator.Default.Create((object)this);
		}

		protected override void UpdateActualIsEnabled()
		{
			CoerceValue(UIElement.IsEnabledProperty);
			base.ActualIsEnabled = base.IsEnabled;
		}

		protected internal override void OnClick()
		{
			base.OnClick();
			if (!base.ActualIsEnabled)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				ExecuteCommand();
			}, null);
			if (base.Backstage != null)
			{
				base.Backstage.Close();
				if (base.Backstage.MergedParent != null)
				{
					base.Backstage.MergedParent.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			IconContainer = GetTemplateChild("PART_Icon") as FrameworkElement;
		}

		protected override bool SelectOnKeyTip()
		{
			OnClick();
			NavigationTree.ExitMenuMode(true, false);
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool ProcessKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Key == Key.Space || e.Key == Key.Return)
			{
				OnClick();
				NavigationTree.ExitMenuMode(true, true, false);
				return true;
			}
			return base.ProcessKeyDown(e);
		}

		protected override void OnNameChanged(string oldValue, string newValue)
		{
			base.OnNameChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			BarNameScope.GetService<IElementRegistratorService>((object)this).NameChanged((IBarNameScopeSupport)(object)this, (object)typeof(ICommandSourceServiceSupport), (object)oldValue, (object)newValue, false);
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<object> GetRegistratorKeys()
		{
			foreach (object registratorKey in base.GetRegistratorKeys())
			{
				yield return registratorKey;
			}
			yield return typeof(ICommandSourceServiceSupport);
		}

		protected override object GetRegistratorName(object registratorKey)
		{
			if (object.Equals(registratorKey, typeof(ICommandSourceServiceSupport)))
			{
				return base.Name;
			}
			return base.GetRegistratorName(registratorKey);
		}
	}

		{

					if (num == -1)
					{
						return Backstage.MergeOrder;
					}
					num += Backstage.MergeOrder;

		protected virtual void RaiseClick()
		{
			RaiseEvent(clickEventHandler);
		}

		public BackstageItemBase()
		{
			Binding binding = new Binding("IsEnabled")
			{
				Source = this,
				Mode = BindingMode.TwoWay
			};
			Replaced = false;
			UpdateVisualState();
			base.Loaded += OnLoaded;
			base.Unloaded += OnUnloaded;
		}

		protected virtual void OnUnloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (backstageWasSetOnLoaded)
			{
				Backstage = null;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (Backstage != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			BackstageViewLeftPartContentControl backstageViewLeftPartContentControl = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<BackstageViewLeftPartContentControl>((DependencyObject)this);
			if (backstageViewLeftPartContentControl != null)
			{
				BackstageViewControl backstageViewControl = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<BackstageViewControl>((DependencyObject)backstageViewLeftPartContentControl);
				if (backstageViewControl != null)
				{
					Backstage = backstageViewControl;
					backstageWasSetOnLoaded = true;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			RootVisual = null;
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			RootVisual = VisualTreeExtensions.VisualChildren((DependencyObject)this, false).FirstOrDefault() as UIElement;
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnClick()
		{
			if (Backstage != null)
			{
				Backstage.OnItemClick(this);
			}
			RaiseClick();
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemChanged(BackstageItemBase oldValue)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnBackstageChanged(BackstageViewControl oldValue)
		{
			backstageWasSetOnLoaded = false;
		}

		protected virtual void OnContentChanged(object oldValue)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsEnabledChanged(bool oldValue)
		{
			UpdateActualIsEnabled();
		}

		protected virtual void OnHoverTextStyleChanged(Style oldValue)
		{
			UpdateActualTextStyle();
		}

		protected virtual void OnBackstageItemPlacementChanged(BackstageItemPlacement oldValue)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnNormalTextStyleChanged(Style oldValue)
		{
			UpdateActualTextStyle();
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeftButtonDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeftButtonDown(e);
			IsMouseLeftButtonDown = true;
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeave(e);
			IsMouseLeftButtonDown = false;
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeftButtonUp(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeftButtonUp(e);
			IsMouseLeftButtonDown = false;
		}

		protected void UpdateVisualState()
		{
			UpdateActualTextStyle();
			UpdateSvgPaletteState();
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateActualTextStyle()
		{
			ActualTextStyle = (IsRootVisualMouseOver ? HoverTextStyle : NormalTextStyle);
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateSvgPaletteState()
		{
			SvgImageHelper.SetState((DependencyObject)this, GetSvgPaletteState());
		}

		protected virtual string GetSvgPaletteState()
		{
			if (!IsRootVisualMouseOver)
			{
				return "Normal";
			}
			if (IsRootVisualMouseLeftButtonDown)
			{
				return "Pressed";
			}
			return "Hover";
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateActualIsEnabled()
		{
			ActualIsEnabled = base.IsEnabled;
		}

		protected virtual void OnRootVisualChanged(UIElement oldValue)
		{
			UnsubscribeRootVisualEvents(oldValue);
			SubscribeRootVisualEvents(RootVisual);
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsRootVisualMouseOverChanged(bool oldValue)
		{
			UpdateVisualState();
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsMouseLeftButtonDownChanged(bool oldValue)
		{
			UpdateVisualState();
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsRootVisualMouseLeftButtonDownChanged(bool oldValue)
		{
			UpdateVisualState();
		}

		protected virtual void SubscribeRootVisualEvents(UIElement rootVisual)
		{
			if (rootVisual != null)
			{
				rootVisual.MouseLeave += OnRootVisualMouseLeave;
				rootVisual.MouseEnter += OnRootVisualMouseEnter;
				rootVisual.MouseLeftButtonDown += OnRootVisualMouseLeftButtonDown;
				rootVisual.MouseLeftButtonUp += OnRootVisualMouseLeftButtonUp;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UnsubscribeRootVisualEvents(UIElement rootVisual)
		{
			if (rootVisual != null)
			{
				rootVisual.MouseLeave -= OnRootVisualMouseLeave;
				rootVisual.MouseEnter -= OnRootVisualMouseEnter;
				rootVisual.MouseLeftButtonDown -= OnRootVisualMouseLeftButtonDown;
				rootVisual.MouseLeftButtonUp -= OnRootVisualMouseLeftButtonUp;
			}
		}

		private void OnRootVisualMouseLeftButtonUp(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (IsRootVisualMouseLeftButtonDown)
			{
				OnClick();
				IsRootVisualMouseLeftButtonDown = false;
			}
		}

		private void OnRootVisualMouseLeftButtonDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			IsRootVisualMouseLeftButtonDown = true;
		}

		protected virtual void OnRootVisualMouseLeave(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			IsRootVisualMouseLeftButtonDown = false;
			IsRootVisualMouseOver = false;
		}

		protected virtual void OnRootVisualMouseEnter(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			IsRootVisualMouseOver = true;
		}

		bool INavigationElement.ProcessKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			return ProcessKeyDown(e);
		}

		protected virtual bool ProcessKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			return false;
		}

		bool IKeyTipNavigationElement.Select()
		{
			return SelectOnKeyTip();
		}

		protected virtual string GetKeyTip()
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected virtual string GetCaption()
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected virtual bool SelectOnKeyTip()
		{
			return false;
		}

		object IMultipleElementRegistratorSupport.GetName(object registratorKey)
		{
			if (object.Equals(registratorKey, typeof(IFrameworkInputElement)))
			{
				return base.Name;
			}
			return GetRegistratorName(registratorKey);
		}

		protected virtual object GetRegistratorName(object registratorKey)
		{
			throw new ArgumentException();
		}

		protected virtual IEnumerable<object> GetRegistratorKeys()
		{
			return Enumerable.Empty<object>();
		}

		protected virtual object GetContent()
		{
			return null;
		}

		void IRibbonMergingSupport.Merge(IRibbonMergingSupport second)
		{
		}

		void IRibbonMergingSupport.Unmerge(IRibbonMergingSupport second)
		{
		}

	[ContentProperty("ControlPane")]
	public class BackstageTabItem : BackstageItemWithImage, ICommandSourceServiceSupport, ICommandSource
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ControlPaneProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsSelectedProperty;

		protected internal static readonly DependencyPropertyKey IsSelectedPropertyKey;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty SelectedTextStyleProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty KeyGestureProperty;

		private readonly CommandSourceHelper commandSourceHelper;

		private readonly ICommand commandSourceCommand;

		public object ControlPane
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue(ControlPaneProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ControlPaneProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public KeyGesture KeyGesture
		{
			get
			{
				return (KeyGesture)GetValue(KeyGestureProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(KeyGestureProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public bool IsSelected
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(IsSelectedProperty);
			}
			protected internal set
			{
				SetValue(IsSelectedPropertyKey, value);
			}
		}

		public Style SelectedTextStyle
		{
			get
			{
				return (Style)GetValue(SelectedTextStyleProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(SelectedTextStyleProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected internal FrameworkElement ContentContainer { get; set; }

		protected override IEnumerator LogicalChildren => (IEnumerator)new MergedEnumerator(new IEnumerator[2]
		{
			base.LogicalChildren,
			(IEnumerator)new SingleLogicalChildEnumerator(ControlPane)
		});

		ICommand ICommandSource.Command => commandSourceCommand;

		object ICommandSource.CommandParameter => null;

		IInputElement ICommandSource.CommandTarget => null;

		CommandSourceHelper ICommandSourceServiceSupport.CommandSourceHelper => commandSourceHelper;

		static BackstageTabItem()
		{
			ControlPaneProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ControlPane", typeof(object), typeof(BackstageTabItem), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnControlPanePropertyChanged));
			IsSelectedPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("IsSelected", typeof(bool), typeof(BackstageTabItem), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(false, OnIsSelectedPropertyChanged));
			IsSelectedProperty = IsSelectedPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			SelectedTextStyleProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("SelectedTextStyle", typeof(Style), typeof(BackstageTabItem), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnSelectedTextStylePropertyChanged));
			KeyGestureProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("KeyGesture", typeof(KeyGesture), typeof(BackstageTabItem), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((BackstageTabItem)d).OnKeyGestureChanged((KeyGesture)e.OldValue, (KeyGesture)e.NewValue);
			}));
			NavigationAutomationPeersCreator.Default.RegisterObject(typeof(BackstageTabItem), typeof(BackstageTabItemControlAutomationPeer), (CreateObjectMethod<AutomationPeer>)((object owner) => (AutomationPeer)(object)new BackstageTabItemControlAutomationPeer((BackstageTabItem)owner)));
		}

		protected static void OnControlPanePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((BackstageTabItem)d).OnControlPaneChanged(e.OldValue);
		}

		protected static void OnSelectedTextStylePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((BackstageTabItem)d).OnSelectedTextStyleChanged(e.OldValue as Style);
		}

		protected static void OnIsSelectedPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((BackstageTabItem)d).OnIsSelectedChanged((bool)e.OldValue);
		}

		public BackstageTabItem()
		{
			//IL_0031: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			commandSourceCommand = new DelegateCommand(ExecuteOpenCommand, CanExecuteOpenCommand, true);
			commandSourceHelper = new CommandSourceHelper((ICommandSource)this);
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<BackstageTabItem>(this);
			MergingProperties.SetElementMergingBehavior((DependencyObject)this, (ElementMergingBehavior)3);
			BarNameScope.SetIsScopeOwner((DependencyObject)this, false);
			if (DependencyObjectExtensions.IsInDesignTool((DependencyObject)this))
			{
				base.Content = "Tab";
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnControlPaneChanged(object oldValue)
		{
			oldValue.Do(base.RemoveLogicalChild);
			ControlPane.IfNot(HasParent).Do(base.AddLogicalChild);
			(ControlPane as DependencyObject).Do(delegate(DependencyObject x)
			{
				BarNameScope.SetIsScopeOwner(x, true);
				SvgImageHelper.SetState(ControlPane as DependencyObject, "Normal");
			});
			if (base.Backstage != null && IsSelected)
			{
				base.Backstage.UpdateActualControlPane();
			}
		}

		private bool HasParent(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is FrameworkElement)
			{
				return ((FrameworkElement)obj).Parent != null;
			}
			if (obj is FrameworkContentElement)
			{
				return ((FrameworkContentElement)obj).Parent != null;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return NavigationAutomationPeersCreator.Default.Create((object)this);
		}

		protected override void UpdateActualTextStyle()
		{
			if (IsSelected)
			{
				base.ActualTextStyle = SelectedTextStyle;
			}
			else
			{
				base.UpdateActualTextStyle();
			}
		}

		protected internal override void OnClick()
		{
			if (base.Backstage != null)
			{
				base.Backstage.SetCurrentValue(BackstageViewControl.SelectedTabProperty, this);
			}
			base.OnClick();
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			ContentContainer = GetTemplateChild("PART_Content") as FrameworkElement;
		}

		protected virtual void OnSelectedTextStyleChanged(Style oldValue)
		{
			UpdateActualTextStyle();
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsSelectedChanged(bool oldValue)
		{
			UpdateVisualState();
		}

		protected override string GetSvgPaletteState()
		{
			string svgPaletteState = base.GetSvgPaletteState();
			if (!IsSelected)
			{
				return svgPaletteState;
			}
			if (!base.IsRootVisualMouseOver)
			{
				return "Checked";
			}
			return svgPaletteState + "Checked";
		}

		protected override bool SelectOnKeyTip()
		{
			OnClick();
			NavigationTree.ExitMenuMode(false, false);
			return true;
		}

		private bool CanExecuteOpenCommand()
		{
			if (base.IsEnabledCore && base.Backstage != null)
			{
				return base.Backstage.Ribbon != null;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void OnBackstageChanged(BackstageViewControl oldValue)
		{
			base.OnBackstageChanged(oldValue);
			commandSourceHelper.Update(false);
		}

		protected virtual void OnCommandCanExecuteChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			CoerceValue(UIElement.IsEnabledProperty);
			UpdateActualIsEnabled();
		}

		private void ExecuteOpenCommand()
		{
			base.Backstage.Ribbon.ShowApplicationMenu();
			base.Backstage.SelectedTab = this;
		}

		protected override void OnNameChanged(string oldValue, string newValue)
		{
			base.OnNameChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			BarNameScope.GetService<IElementRegistratorService>((object)this).NameChanged((IBarNameScopeSupport)(object)this, (object)typeof(ICommandSourceServiceSupport), (object)oldValue, (object)newValue, false);
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnKeyGestureChanged(KeyGesture oldValue, KeyGesture newValue)
		{
			BarNameScope.GetService<ICommandSourceService>((object)this).KeyGestureChanged((ICommandSourceServiceSupport)(object)this, oldValue, newValue);
		}

		void ICommandSourceServiceSupport.UpdateCanExecute(bool shorcutRequest)
		{
			commandSourceHelper.Update(shorcutRequest);
		}

		void ICommandSourceServiceSupport.ExecuteCommand()
		{
			commandSourceHelper.Execute();
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<object> GetRegistratorKeys()
		{
			foreach (object registratorKey in base.GetRegistratorKeys())
			{
				yield return registratorKey;
			}
			yield return typeof(ICommandSourceServiceSupport);
		}

		protected override object GetRegistratorName(object registratorKey)
		{
			if (object.Equals(registratorKey, typeof(ICommandSourceServiceSupport)))
			{
				return base.Name;
			}
			return base.GetRegistratorName(registratorKey);
		}
	}

		IList<INavigationElement> INavigationOwner.Elements
		{
			get
			{
				List<INavigationElement> list = new List<INavigationElement>();
				if (ItemContainerGenerator == null)
				{
					return list;
				}
				foreach (BackstageItemBase selfItem in SelfItems)
				{
					if (ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(selfItem) is BackstageItemBase backstageItemBase && !(backstageItemBase is BackstageSeparatorItem))
					{
						list.Add((INavigationElement)(object)backstageItemBase);
					}
				}
				return list;
			}
		}

		public BackstageViewControl()
		{

			if (e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset)
			{
				foreach (BackstageItemBase item in itemsList.ToList())
				{
					itemsList.RemoveAt(0);
					item.Backstage = null;
					RemoveLogicalChild(item);
				}
				foreach (BackstageItemBase item2 in (IList)sender)
				{
					itemsList.Add(item2);
					AddLogicalChild(item2);
					item2.Backstage = this;
				}
			}
			else if (e.NewItems != null && (e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add || e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace))
			{
				foreach (BackstageItemBase newItem in e.NewItems)
				{
					itemsList.Add(newItem);
					AddLogicalChild(newItem);
					newItem.Backstage = this;
				}
			}
			else if (e.OldItems != null && (e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove || e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace))
			{
				foreach (BackstageItemBase oldItem in e.OldItems)
				{
					itemsList.Remove(oldItem);
					RemoveLogicalChild(oldItem);
					oldItem.Backstage = null;
				}
			}
			HasItems = itemsList.Count != 0;
			UpdateItemsControlSource();
			UpdateSelectedTabAndIndex(allowSelectFirst: false);
		}

		protected internal void OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.LayoutUpdated += OnLayoutUpdated;
			RibbonControl ribbonControl = LayoutHelper.FindLayoutOrVisualParentObject<RibbonControl>((DependencyObject)this, true, (DependencyObject)null);
			if (ribbonControl != null)
			{
				SetBinding(RibbonStyleProperty, new Binding(RibbonStyleProperty.Name)
				{
					Source = ribbonControl
				});
			}
		}

		protected internal void UpdateSelectedTabAndIndex()
		{
			UpdateSelectedTabAndIndex(allowSelectFirst: true);
		}

		protected internal virtual void UpdateSelectedTabAndIndex(bool allowSelectFirst)
		{
			if (!IsMergedChild && !ActualItems.Contains(SelectedTab))
			{
				BackstageTabItem tabFromIndex = GetTabFromIndex(SelectedTabIndex);
				if (tabFromIndex != null)
				{
					SetCurrentValue(SelectedTabProperty, GetTabFromIndex(SelectedTabIndex));
				}
				else if (allowSelectFirst)
				{
					SetCurrentValue(SelectedTabProperty, GetFirstEnabledTab() ?? GetTabFromIndex(0));
				}
			}
		}

		private BackstageTabItem GetFirstEnabledTab()
		{
			foreach (BackstageItemBase actualItem in ActualItems)
			{
				if (actualItem is BackstageTabItem && actualItem.IsEnabled)
				{
					return (BackstageTabItem)actualItem;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void OnLayoutUpdated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if ((int)ComplexLayoutStateCore == 0 && RibbonSelectedPageControl.IsItemsControlFullyLoaded(ItemsControl))
			{
				SetComplexLayoutState((ComplexLayoutState)1);
			}
			ImmediateActionsManager.ExecuteActions();
		}

		private void OnUnloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.LayoutUpdated -= OnLayoutUpdated;
			SetComplexLayoutState((ComplexLayoutState)0);
			BindingOperations.ClearBinding(this, RibbonStyleProperty);
		}

		private BackstageTabItem CoerceSelectedTab(BackstageTabItem e)
		{
			if (IsSelectionSynchronizationActive)
			{
				return SelectedTab;
			}
			if (IsMergedChild && e == SelectedTab)
			{
				ActualMergedParent.SelectedTab = e;
			}
			return e;
		}

		private int CoerceSelectedTabIndex(int e)
		{
			if (IsSelectionSynchronizationActive && !IsUpdatingSelectedTabIndex)
			{
				return SelectedTabIndex;
			}
			return e;
		}

		protected virtual void OnSelectedTabChanged(BackstageTabItem oldValue)
		{
			ResetItemsFocus(ignoreTabItems: false);
			Locker val = updateSelectedTabIndexLocker.Lock();
			try
			{
				if (!object.Equals(SelectedTab, GetTabFromIndex(SelectedTabIndex)))
				{
					SetCurrentValue(SelectedTabIndexProperty, GetTabIndex(SelectedTab));
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
			}
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				oldValue.IsSelected = false;
			}
			if (SelectedTab != null)
			{
				SelectedTab.IsSelected = true;
			}
			if (IsMergedChild)
			{
				ActualMergedParent.SetCurrentValue(SelectedTabProperty, SelectedTab);
			}
			if (IsMergedParent)
			{
				foreach (BackstageViewControl actualMergedChild in ActualMergedChildren)
				{
					if (SelectedTab == null || !actualMergedChild.Items.Contains(SelectedTab))
					{
						actualMergedChild.SetCurrentValue(SelectedTabProperty, null);
					}
					else
					{
						actualMergedChild.SetCurrentValue(SelectedTabProperty, SelectedTab);
					}
				}
			}
			UpdateActualControlPane();
			RaiseSelectedTabChanged(new RibbonPropertyChangedEventArgs(oldValue, SelectedTab));
			FocusFirstAvailableDescendant();
		}

		protected void ResetItemsFocus(bool ignoreTabItems)
		{
			foreach (BackstageItemBase actualItem in ActualItems)
			{
				BackstageItemBase backstageItemFromItem = GetBackstageItemFromItem(actualItem);
				if (backstageItemFromItem != null && (!ignoreTabItems || !(backstageItemFromItem is BackstageTabItem)))
				{
					backstageItemFromItem.ActualIsFocused = false;
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnSelectedTabIndexChanged(int oldValue)
		{
			if (!IsSelectionSynchronizationActive)
			{
				SetCurrentValue(SelectedTabProperty, GetTabFromIndex(SelectedTabIndex));
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnIsFullScreenChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			CoerceValue(CloseButtonVisibilityProperty);
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnCloseButtonVisibilityChanged(Visibility oldValue, Visibility newValue)
		{
			UpdateCloseButtonVisibility();
		}

		private void UpdateCloseButtonVisibility()
		{
			if (Host != null)
			{
				Host.UpdateGlyphElementVisibility();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsOpenChanged(bool oldValue)
		{
			if (isOpenLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				return;
			}
			Locker val = isOpenLocker.Lock();
			try
			{
				UpdateOnIsOpenChanged();
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateOnIsOpenChanged()
		{
			if (DependencyObjectExtensions.IsInDesignTool((DependencyObject)this) || Ribbon == null || !FrameworkElementExtensions.IsInVisualTree((FrameworkElement)Ribbon))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (ActualMergedParent != null)
			{
				ActualMergedParent.IsOpen = IsOpen;
				return;
			}
			foreach (BackstageViewControl actualMergedChild in ActualMergedChildren)
			{
				actualMergedChild.IsOpen = IsOpen;
			}
			if (IsOpen)
			{
				if (!Ribbon.IsBackStageViewOpen)
				{
					Ribbon.ShowApplicationMenu();
				}
				UpdateSelectedTabAndIndex();
				FocusFirstAvailableDescendant();
			}
			if (!IsOpen)
			{
				Ribbon.CloseApplicationMenu();
			}
		}

		protected internal void UpdateFocus()
		{
			Focus();
			FocusFirstAvailableDescendant();
		}

		private void FocusFirstAvailableDescendant()
		{
			ImmediateActionsManager.EnqueueAction((Action)delegate
			{
				if (Host != null)
				{
					Host.FocusFirstAvailableDescendant();
				}
			});
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateActualBackgroundGlyph()
		{
			if (BackgroundGlyph != null)
			{
				ActualBackgroundGlyph = BackgroundGlyph;
				IsBackgroundGlyphVisible = true;
				return;
			}
			if (DisableDefaultBackgroundGlyph)
			{
				IsBackgroundGlyphVisible = false;
				ActualBackgroundGlyph = null;
				return;
			}
			if (CommonThemeHelper.UseLightweightThemes)
			{
				ImageSource themeImage = ImageHelper.GetThemeImage(CommonThemeHelper.ActualApplicationThemeName, "BackstageBackgroundGlyph");
				ActualBackgroundGlyph = themeImage;
				IsBackgroundGlyphVisible = ActualBackgroundGlyph != null;
				return;
			}
			ThemeTreeWalker treeWalker = ThemeManager.GetTreeWalker((DependencyObject)this);
			if (treeWalker != null)
			{
				ImageSource themeImage2 = ImageHelper.GetThemeImage(treeWalker.ThemeName, "BackstageBackgroundGlyph");
				if (themeImage2 != null)
				{
					ActualBackgroundGlyph = themeImage2;
					IsBackgroundGlyphVisible = true;
					return;
				}
			}
			ActualBackgroundGlyph = ImageHelper.GetImage("BackstageBackgroundGlyph.png");
			IsBackgroundGlyphVisible = ActualBackgroundGlyph != null;
		}

		protected int GetTabCount()
		{
			int num = 0;
			foreach (BackstageItemBase actualItem in ActualItems)
			{
				if (actualItem is BackstageTabItem)
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected List<BackstageTabItem> GetTabList()
		{
			return SelfItems.Cast<object>().OfType<BackstageTabItem>().ToList();
		}

		protected internal virtual void UpdateActualControlPane()
		{
			if (SelectedTab == null)
			{
				ActualControlPane = null;
				return;
			}
			ActualControlPane = SelectedTab.ControlPane;
			if (ActualMergedParent != null)
			{
				ActualMergedParent.ActualControlPane = ActualControlPane;
			}
		}

		public int GetTabIndex(BackstageTabItem tabItem)
		{
			int num = 0;
			foreach (BackstageItemBase actualItem in ActualItems)
			{
				if (actualItem is BackstageTabItem)
				{
					if (actualItem == tabItem)
					{
						return num;
					}
					num++;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		public BackstageTabItem GetTabFromIndex(int tabIndex)
		{
			if (tabIndex < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int num = 0;
			foreach (BackstageItemBase actualItem in ActualItems)
			{
				if (actualItem is BackstageTabItem)
				{
					if (num == tabIndex)
					{
						return actualItem as BackstageTabItem;
					}
					num++;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		}

		}

		public void Close()
		{
			if (Ribbon != null)
			{
				Ribbon.CloseApplicationMenu();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnKeyDown(e);
			if (!RibbonControl.UseOldNavigationManager)
			{
				if (e.Key == Key.Escape && !NavigationTree.IsMenuMode)
				{
					OnEscKeyDown();
				}
				return;
			}
			switch (e.Key)
			{
			case Key.Down:
				OnDownKeyDown();
				e.Handled = true;
				break;
			case Key.Up:
				OnUpKeyDown();
				e.Handled = true;
				break;
			case Key.Escape:
				OnEscKeyDown();
				e.Handled = true;
				break;
			case Key.Tab:
				if ((Keyboard.Modifiers & ModifierKeys.Control) == ModifierKeys.Control)
				{
					OnCtrlTabKeyDown((Keyboard.Modifiers & ModifierKeys.Shift) != ModifierKeys.Shift);
					e.Handled = true;
				}
				break;
			case Key.Space:
				e.Handled = OnSpaceKeyDown();
				break;
			case Key.Return:
				e.Handled = OnEnterKeyDown();
				break;
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnUpKeyDown()
		{
			NavigateToPriorFocusableItem();
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnDownKeyDown()
		{
			NavigateToNextFocusableItem();
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnEscKeyDown()
		{
			if (CloseButtonVisibility == Visibility.Visible || !IsFullScreen)
			{
				Close();
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnTabKeyDown()
		{
			NavigateToNextFocusableItem();
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnCtrlTabKeyDown(bool forward)
		{
			if (forward)
			{
				NavigateToNextFocusableItem();
			}
			else
			{
				NavigateToPriorFocusableItem();
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual bool OnSpaceKeyDown()
		{
			return ExecuteCurrentFocusedItemAction();
		}

		protected internal virtual bool OnEnterKeyDown()
		{
			return ExecuteCurrentFocusedItemAction();
		}

		protected virtual bool ExecuteCurrentFocusedItemAction()
		{
			BackstageItemBase currentFocusedItem = GetCurrentFocusedItem();
			if (currentFocusedItem == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (currentFocusedItem is BackstageButtonItem)
			{
				currentFocusedItem.OnClick();
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual void NavigateToNextFocusableItem()
		{
			SetCurrentFocusedItem(GetCurrentFocusedItem(), GetNextFocusableItem(GetCurrentFocusedItem()));
		}

		protected internal void SetCurrentFocusedItem(BackstageItemBase newFocusedItem)
		{
			SetCurrentFocusedItem(GetCurrentFocusedItem(), newFocusedItem);
		}

		protected void SetCurrentFocusedItem(BackstageItemBase oldFocusedItem, BackstageItemBase newFocusedItem)
		{
			if (oldFocusedItem == null && SelectedTab != null)
			{
				SelectedTab.ActualIsFocused = true;
			}
			if (newFocusedItem != null)
			{
				if (newFocusedItem is BackstageTabItem)
				{
					ResetItemsFocus(ignoreTabItems: false);
					SetCurrentValue(SelectedTabProperty, newFocusedItem);
				}
				else
				{
					ResetItemsFocus(ignoreTabItems: true);
				}
				newFocusedItem.ActualIsFocused = true;
				newFocusedItem.Focusable = true;
				newFocusedItem.Focus();
			}
			if (oldFocusedItem != null)
			{
				oldFocusedItem.Focusable = false;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnHostChanged(BackstageViewContentHost oldValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				oldValue.BackstageView = null;
			}
			if (Host != null)
			{
				Host.BackstageView = this;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void NavigateToPriorFocusableItem()
		{
			SetCurrentFocusedItem(GetCurrentFocusedItem(), GetPriorFocusableItem(GetCurrentFocusedItem()));
		}

		protected internal virtual BackstageItemBase GetCurrentFocusedItem()
		{
			List<BackstageItemBase> focusableItemList = GetFocusableItemList();
			BackstageItemBase backstageItemBase = null;
			foreach (BackstageItemBase item in focusableItemList)
			{
				if (item.ActualIsFocused)
				{
					if (!(item is BackstageTabItem))
					{
						backstageItemBase = item;
					}
					else if (backstageItemBase == null)
					{
						backstageItemBase = item;
					}
				}
			}
			return backstageItemBase;
		}

		private BackstageItemBase GetBackstageItemFromItem(object item)
		{
			if (item is BackstageItemBase result)
			{
				return result;
			}
			return ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(item) as BackstageItemBase;
		}

		private List<BackstageItemBase> GetFocusableItemList()
		{
			List<BackstageItemBase> list = new List<BackstageItemBase>();
			foreach (BackstageItemBase selfItem in SelfItems)
			{
				if (selfItem != null && selfItem.ActualIsEnabled && !(selfItem is BackstageSeparatorItem))
				{
					list.Add(selfItem);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private BackstageItemBase GetNextFocusableItem(BackstageItemBase item)
		{
			List<BackstageItemBase> focusableItemList = GetFocusableItemList();
			if (focusableItemList.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int num = 0;
			if (item == null)
			{
				if (SelectedTab != null)
				{
					num = focusableItemList.IndexOf(SelectedTab) + 1;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				num = focusableItemList.IndexOf(item) + 1;
			}
			if (num >= focusableItemList.Count)
			{
				num = 0;
			}
			return focusableItemList[num];
		}

		private BackstageItemBase GetPriorFocusableItem(BackstageItemBase item)
		{
			List<BackstageItemBase> focusableItemList = GetFocusableItemList();
			if (focusableItemList.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int num = focusableItemList.Count - 1;
			if (item == null)
			{
				if (SelectedTab != null)
				{
					num = focusableItemList.IndexOf(SelectedTab) - 1;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				num = focusableItemList.IndexOf(item) - 1;
			}
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = focusableItemList.Count - 1;
			}
			return focusableItemList[num];
		}

		internal double GetLeftPartActualWidth()
		{
			if (Host == null || Host.LeftElement == null)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return Host.LeftElement.ActualWidth;
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			ClearItemsControl();
			ItemsControl = GetTemplateChild("backstageViewItemsControl") as BackstageViewItemsControl;
			InitializeItemsControl();
			UpdateSelectedTabAndIndex();
			Host = GetTemplateChild("PART_ContentHost") as BackstageViewContentHost;
			UpdateActualBackgroundGlyph();
			UpdateCloseButtonVisibility();
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				AutomationPeer peer = Peer;
				if (peer != null)
				{
					peer.ResetChildrenCache();
					peer.RaiseAutomationEvent(AutomationEvents.StructureChanged);
				}
			});
			((IMutableNavigationSupport)this).RaiseChanged();
		}

		protected virtual void InitializeItemsControl()
		{
			if (ItemsControl != null)
			{
				ItemsControl.Owner = this;
				UpdateItemsControlSource();
				ItemContainerGenerator = ItemsControl.ItemContainerGenerator;
				ItemsControl.ItemsPanel = ItemsPanel;
				ItemsControl.ItemsPresenterStyle = ItemsPresenterStyle;
				HasItems = ItemsControl.HasItems;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateItemsControlSource()
		{
			if (ItemsControl != null)
			{
				if (MergedParent != null)
				{
					ItemsControl.ItemsSource = null;
				}
				else if (ActualMergedChildren.Count > 0)
				{
					ItemsControl.ItemsSource = MergedSource;
				}
				else
				{
					ItemsControl.ItemsSource = SelfItems;
				}
			}
		}

		private void ClearItemsControl()
		{
			if (ItemsControl != null)
			{
				ItemsControl.ItemsSource = null;
				ItemsControl.ItemsPanel = null;
				ItemsControl.ItemsPresenterStyle = null;
			}
		}

		void IHierarchicalMergingSupport<BackstageViewControl>.ReMerge()
		{
			List<BackstageViewControl> list = new List<BackstageViewControl>(ActualMergedChildren);
			while (ActualMergedChildren.Count > 0)
			{
				UnmergeImpl(ActualMergedChildren[0]);
			}
			foreach (BackstageViewControl compositeMergedChild in hierarchicalMergingHelper.CompositeMergedChildren)
			{
				MergeImpl(compositeMergedChild);
				list.Remove(compositeMergedChild);
			}
			MergedItemsCollection<BackstageItemBase> mergedItemsCollection = new MergedItemsCollection<BackstageItemBase>(SelfItems);
			mergedItemsCollection.Populate(ActualMergedChildren.Select((BackstageViewControl x) => x.SelfItems));
			MergedSource = mergedItemsCollection;
			UpdateItemsControlSource();
			UpdateSelectedTabAndIndex(IsOpen);
			EnsureSelection();
			foreach (BackstageViewControl item in list)
			{
				item.UpdateSelectedTabAndIndex();
				item.SelectedTab.Do(delegate(BackstageTabItem x)
				{
					x.IsSelected = true;
				});
			}
		}

		private void EnsureSelection()
		{
			if (!IsMergedParent)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			foreach (BackstageItemBase actualItem in ActualItems)
			{
				if (actualItem is BackstageTabItem { IsSelected: not false } backstageTabItem && backstageTabItem != SelectedTab)
				{
					flag = true;
					backstageTabItem.IsSelected = false;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				UpdateActualControlPane();
			}
		}

		private void MergeImpl(BackstageViewControl second)
		{
			if (second.ActualMergedParent != null)
			{
				second.ActualMergedParent.UnmergeImpl(second);
			}
			ActualMergedChildren.Add(second);
			second.ActualMergedParent = this;
		}

		private void UnmergeImpl(BackstageViewControl second)
		{
			if (second.ActualMergedParent == this)
			{
				ActualMergedChildren.Remove(second);
				second.ActualMergedParent = null;
			}
		}

		public virtual void Merge(BackstageViewControl second)
		{
			hierarchicalMergingHelper.Merge(second);
		}

		public virtual void Unmerge(BackstageViewControl second)
		{
			if (second == null)
			{
				hierarchicalMergingHelper.UnMerge();
			}
			else
			{
				hierarchicalMergingHelper.UnMerge(second);
			}
		}

		private void OnMergedParentChanged()
		{
			base.Visibility = ((MergedParent != null) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
			UpdateItemsControlSource();
		}

			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

	public class BackstageViewContentHost : Control
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty AnimationTimeProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("AnimationTime", typeof(TimeSpan), typeof(BackstageViewContentHost), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(new TimeSpan(0L)));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty RightContentProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("RightContent", typeof(object), typeof(BackstageViewContentHost), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty LeftContentProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("LeftContent", typeof(object), typeof(BackstageViewContentHost), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));

		private DispatcherTimer tickTimer;

		private BackstageViewControl backstageView;

		private RibbonCheckedBorderControl glyphElement;

		public object LeftContent
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue(LeftContentProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(LeftContentProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public object RightContent
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue(RightContentProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(RightContentProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public FrameworkElement LeftElement { get; set; }

		public FrameworkElement RightElement { get; set; }

		public RibbonCheckedBorderControl GlyphElement
		{
			get
			{
				return glyphElement;
			}
			set
			{
				if (glyphElement != value)
				{
					RibbonCheckedBorderControl oldValue = glyphElement;
					glyphElement = value;
					OnGlyphElementChanged(oldValue);
				}
			}
		}

		public BackstageViewControl BackstageView
		{
			get
			{
				return backstageView;
			}
			set
			{
				if (BackstageView != value)
				{
					OnBackstageViewChanging(value);
					BackstageViewControl oldValue = BackstageView;
					backstageView = value;
					OnBackstageViewChanged(oldValue);
				}
			}
		}

		public Panel Root { get; set; }

		public TimeSpan AnimationTime { get; set; }

		public RibbonControl Ribbon
		{
			get
			{
				if (BackstageView != null)
				{
					return BackstageView.Ribbon;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		private DispatcherTimer TickTimer
		{
			get
			{
				if (tickTimer == null)
				{
					tickTimer = new DispatcherTimer();
					tickTimer.Tick += delegate
					{
						tickTimer.Stop();
						OnAfterCloseAnimationFinished();
					};
				}
				return tickTimer;
			}
		}

		public static TimeSpan GetAnimationTime(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			return (TimeSpan)obj.GetValue(AnimationTimeProperty);
		}

		public static void SetAnimationTime(DependencyObject obj, TimeSpan value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(AnimationTimeProperty, value);
		}

		public BackstageViewContentHost()
		{
			base.Loaded += OnLoaded;
			base.Unloaded += OnUnloaded;
			base.SizeChanged += OnSizeChanged;
			base.ToolTip = new ToolTip
			{
				Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed
			};
		}

		private void OnSizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			_ = BackstageView.IsFullScreen;
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			LeftElement = GetTemplateChild("PART_Left") as FrameworkElement;
			RightElement = GetTemplateChild("PART_Right") as FrameworkElement;
			if (LeftElement != null)
			{
				LeftElement.Focusable = false;
				KeyboardNavigation.SetTabNavigation(LeftElement, KeyboardNavigationMode.None);
				KeyboardNavigation.SetControlTabNavigation(LeftElement, KeyboardNavigationMode.None);
				KeyboardNavigation.SetDirectionalNavigation(LeftElement, KeyboardNavigationMode.None);
			}
			if (RightElement != null)
			{
				RightElement.Focusable = false;
				KeyboardNavigation.SetTabNavigation(RightElement, KeyboardNavigationMode.Cycle);
				KeyboardNavigation.SetControlTabNavigation(RightElement, KeyboardNavigationMode.None);
				KeyboardNavigation.SetDirectionalNavigation(RightElement, KeyboardNavigationMode.Cycle);
			}
			GlyphElement = GetTemplateChild("PART_Glyph") as RibbonCheckedBorderControl;
			UpdateGlyphElementVisibility();
			Root = GetTemplateChild("PART_Root") as Panel;
			if (BackstageView != null)
			{
				BackstageView.ImmediateActionsManager.EnqueueAction((Action)delegate
				{
					FocusFirstAvailableDescendant();
				});
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnGlyphElementChanged(RibbonCheckedBorderControl oldValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				oldValue.MouseLeftButtonDown -= OnGlyphElementMouseLeftButtonDown;
			}
			if (GlyphElement != null)
			{
				GlyphElement.MouseLeftButtonDown += OnGlyphElementMouseLeftButtonDown;
			}
		}

		private void OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (BackstageView.IsOpen && BackstageView.IsFullScreen && GlyphElement != null)
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(GlyphElement, "Loading", useTransitions: false);
				PerformLoadingAnimation();
				if (Ribbon != null && Ribbon.TitlePanel != null)
				{
					Ribbon.TitlePanel.InvalidateMeasure();
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnUnloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (BackstageView != null && BackstageView.IsFullScreen)
			{
				if (GlyphElement != null)
				{
					VisualStateManager.GoToState(GlyphElement, "Intermediate", useTransitions: false);
				}
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Intermediate", useTransitions: false);
				if (Ribbon != null && Ribbon.TitlePanel != null)
				{
					Ribbon.TitlePanel.InvalidateMeasure();
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void FocusFirstAvailableDescendant()
		{
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0015: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (RightElement == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			VisualTreeEnumerator val = new VisualTreeEnumerator((DependencyObject)RightElement);
			while (((NestedObjectEnumeratorBase)val).MoveNext())
			{
				if (val.Current is FrameworkElement { IsVisible: not false, Focusable: not false } frameworkElement)
				{
					frameworkElement.Focus();
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnBackstageViewChanging(BackstageViewControl value)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnBackstageViewChanged(BackstageViewControl oldValue)
		{
			UpdateGlyphElementVisibility();
		}

		protected internal virtual void UpdateGlyphElementVisibility()
		{
			if (GlyphElement != null && BackstageView != null)
			{
				GlyphElement.Visibility = BackstageView.CloseButtonVisibility;
			}
		}

		private void OnGlyphElementMouseLeftButtonDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			OnCloseAnimationStarted();
			if (AnimationTime.TotalMilliseconds == 0.0)
			{
				OnAfterCloseAnimationFinished();
				return;
			}
			TickTimer.Interval = AnimationTime;
			TickTimer.Start();
		}

		private void OnCloseAnimationStarted()
		{
			if (BackstageView.IsFullScreen && Ribbon != null && BackstageView.CloseButtonVisibility == Visibility.Visible)
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(GlyphElement, "Unloading", useTransitions: false);
				PerformUnloadingAnimation();
			}
		}

		private void OnAfterCloseAnimationFinished()
		{
			if (BackstageView == null)
			{
				BackstageViewControl backstageViewControl = (BackstageView = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<BackstageViewControl>((DependencyObject)this));
				if (backstageViewControl == null)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			BackstageView.IsOpen = false;
			if (RightElement != null)
			{
				RightElement.BeginAnimation(UIElement.OpacityProperty, null);
			}
			if (Root != null && Root.RenderTransform != null && !Root.RenderTransform.IsFrozen)
			{
				Root.RenderTransform.BeginAnimation(TranslateTransform.XProperty, null);
			}
		}

		private void PerformUnloadingAnimation()
		{
			PerformFadeStoryboard(fadeout: true);
			PerformOpacityStoryboard(fadeout: true);
		}

		private void PerformLoadingAnimation()
		{
			if (Ribbon != null)
			{
				AnimationTime = GetAnimationTime(GlyphElement);
				PerformFadeStoryboard(fadeout: false);
				PerformOpacityStoryboard(fadeout: false);
			}
		}

		private void PerformFadeStoryboard(bool fadeout)
		{
			if (Root != null && AnimationTime.TotalMilliseconds != 0.0 && LeftElement != null)
			{
				Storyboard storyboard = new Storyboard();
				DoubleAnimation doubleAnimation = new DoubleAnimation();
				doubleAnimation.Duration = AnimationTime;
				doubleAnimation.From = (fadeout ? 0.0 : (0.0 - LeftElement.ActualWidth));
				doubleAnimation.To = (fadeout ? (0.0 - LeftElement.ActualWidth) : 0.0);
				doubleAnimation.EasingFunction = new ExponentialEase();
				Storyboard.SetTarget(doubleAnimation, Root);
				Storyboard.SetTargetProperty(doubleAnimation, new PropertyPath("(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TranslateTransform.X)"));
				storyboard.Children.Add(doubleAnimation);
				storyboard.Begin(this);
			}
		}

		private void OnFadeInStoryboardCompleted(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			((ClockGroup)sender).Completed -= OnFadeInStoryboardCompleted;
			((IMutableNavigationSupport)BackstageView).RaiseChanged();
		}

		private void OnFadeOutStoryboardCompleted(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			((ClockGroup)sender).Completed -= OnFadeOutStoryboardCompleted;
		}

		private void PerformOpacityStoryboard(bool fadeout)
		{
			if (AnimationTime.TotalMilliseconds != 0.0 && RightElement != null)
			{
				Storyboard storyboard = new Storyboard();
				DoubleAnimation doubleAnimation = new DoubleAnimation();
				doubleAnimation.Duration = AnimationTime;
				doubleAnimation.From = (fadeout ? 1.0 : 0.0);
				doubleAnimation.To = (fadeout ? 0.0 : 1.0);
				doubleAnimation.EasingFunction = new ExponentialEase();
				Storyboard.SetTarget(doubleAnimation, RightElement);
				Storyboard.SetTargetProperty(doubleAnimation, new PropertyPath("Opacity"));
				storyboard.Children.Add(doubleAnimation);
				if (fadeout)
				{
					storyboard.Completed += OnFadeOutStoryboardCompleted;
				}
				else
				{
					storyboard.Completed += OnFadeInStoryboardCompleted;
				}
				storyboard.Begin(this);
			}
		}
	}

			FirstControlPaneProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("FirstControlPane", typeof(UIElement), typeof(BackstageViewPanel), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnFirstControlPanePropertyChanged));
			SecondControlPaneProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("SecondControlPane", typeof(UIElement), typeof(BackstageViewPanel), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnSecondControlPanePropertyChanged));

		{
			((BackstageViewPanel)d).OnSecondControlPaneChanged(e.OldValue as UIElement);
		}

		protected virtual void OnTabPaneChanged(UIElement oldValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				base.Children.Remove(oldValue);
			}
			if (TabPane != null)
			{
				base.Children.Add(TabPane);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnFirstControlPaneChanged(UIElement oldValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				base.Children.Remove(oldValue);
			}
			if (FirstControlPane != null)
			{
				base.Children.Add(FirstControlPane);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnSecondControlPaneChanged(UIElement oldValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				base.Children.Remove(oldValue);
			}
			if (SecondControlPane != null)
			{
				base.Children.Add(SecondControlPane);
			}
		}

		protected override Size MeasureOverride(Size availableSize)
		{
			Size result = default(Size);
			if (TabPane != null)
			{
				TabPane.Measure(new Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity));
				result.Width = TabPane.DesiredSize.Width;
				result.Height = TabPane.DesiredSize.Height;
			}
			if (FirstControlPane != null && FirstControlPane.Visibility != Visibility.Collapsed)
			{
				FirstControlPane.Measure(new Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity));
				result.Width += FirstControlPane.DesiredSize.Width;
				result.Height = Math.Max(result.Height, FirstControlPane.DesiredSize.Height);
			}
			if (SecondControlPane != null && SecondControlPane.Visibility != Visibility.Collapsed)
			{
				SecondControlPane.Measure(new Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity));
				result.Width += SecondControlPane.DesiredSize.Width;
				result.Height = Math.Max(result.Height, SecondControlPane.DesiredSize.Height);
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override Size ArrangeOverride(Size finalSize)
		{
			Rect finalRect = default(Rect);
			double val = 0.0;
			if (TabPane != null)
			{
				finalRect.Width = TabPane.DesiredSize.Width;
				finalRect.Height = Math.Max(TabPane.DesiredSize.Height, finalSize.Height);
				TabPane.Arrange(finalRect);
				finalRect.X += finalRect.Width;
				val = finalRect.Height;
			}
			if (FirstControlPane != null && FirstControlPane.Visibility != Visibility.Collapsed)
			{
				finalRect.Width = FirstControlPane.DesiredSize.Width;
				finalRect.Height = Math.Max(FirstControlPane.DesiredSize.Height, finalSize.Height);
				FirstControlPane.Arrange(finalRect);
				finalRect.X += finalRect.Width;
				val = Math.Max(finalRect.Height, val);
			}
			if (SecondControlPane != null && SecondControlPane.Visibility != Visibility.Collapsed)
			{
				finalRect.Width = SecondControlPane.DesiredSize.Width;
				finalRect.Height = Math.Max(SecondControlPane.DesiredSize.Height, finalSize.Height);
				SecondControlPane.Arrange(finalRect);
				finalRect.X += finalRect.Width;
				val = Math.Max(finalRect.Height, val);
			}
			return finalSize;
		}
	}

	public class BarButtonGroupLayoutCalculator : RibbonLayoutCalculatorBase
	{
		public BarButtonGroupLayoutCalculator(RibbonItemsPanelBase panel)
			: base(panel)
		{
		}

		private IBarItemLinkControl GetFirstVisibleLinkControl()
		{
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Panel.Children)
			{
				if (((FrameworkElement)(object)GetLinkControl(child)).Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
				{
					return GetLinkControl(child);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private IBarItemLinkControl GetLastVisibleLinkControl()
		{
			for (int num = base.Panel.Children.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if (((FrameworkElement)(object)GetLinkControl(num)).Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
				{
					return GetLinkControl(num);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private bool IsBorderlessLinkControl(IBarItemLinkControl linkControl)
		{
			if (linkControl != null && !BarItemLinkControlChecker.Is<IBarEditItemLinkControl>(linkControl) && !BarItemLinkControlChecker.Is<BarItemLinkSeparatorControl>(linkControl))
			{
				return BarItemLinkControlChecker.Is<BarStaticItemLinkControl>(linkControl);
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateItemsPosition()
		{
			if (base.Panel == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (base.Panel.Children.Count == 1)
			{
				IBarItemLinkControl linkControl = GetLinkControl(0);
				if (linkControl != null)
				{
					ItemPositionTypeProvider.SetHorizontalItemPosition(linkControl as DependencyObject, (HorizontalItemPositionType)1);
				}
				return;
			}
			using List<IBarItemLinkControl>.Enumerator enumerator = (from x in (from x in base.Panel.Children.OfType<BarItemLinkInfo>()
					where !x.IsRemoved
					select x).Select((Func<BarItemLinkInfo, IBarItemLinkControl>)base.GetLinkControl)
				where x != null && ((FrameworkElement)(object)x).Visibility == Visibility.Visible
				select x).ToList().GetEnumerator();
			if (!enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				return;
			}
			IBarItemLinkControl val = null;
			IBarItemLinkControl val2 = enumerator.Current;
			if (!enumerator.MoveNext() && val2 != null)
			{
				ItemPositionTypeProvider.SetHorizontalItemPosition(val2 as DependencyObject, (HorizontalItemPositionType)1);
			}
			IBarItemLinkControl val3 = enumerator.Current;
			bool flag = true;
			do
			{
				val = val2;
				val2 = val3;
				flag = flag && enumerator.MoveNext();
				val3 = (flag ? enumerator.Current : null);
				bool flag2 = !IsBorderlessLinkControl(val);
				bool flag3 = !IsBorderlessLinkControl(val3);
				if (val2 != null)
				{
					if (flag2 && flag3)
					{
						ItemPositionTypeProvider.SetHorizontalItemPosition(val2 as DependencyObject, (HorizontalItemPositionType)3);
					}
					else if (flag2)
					{
						ItemPositionTypeProvider.SetHorizontalItemPosition(val2 as DependencyObject, (HorizontalItemPositionType)4);
					}
					else if (flag3)
					{
						ItemPositionTypeProvider.SetHorizontalItemPosition(val2 as DependencyObject, (HorizontalItemPositionType)2);
					}
					else
					{
						ItemPositionTypeProvider.SetHorizontalItemPosition(val2 as DependencyObject, (HorizontalItemPositionType)1);
					}
				}
			}
			while (flag || val3 != null);
		}

		public override Size MeasurePanel(Size availableSize)
		{
			UpdateItemsPosition();
			Size result = new Size(0.0, 0.0);
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Panel.Children)
			{
				child.Measure(new Size(double.PositiveInfinity, availableSize.Height));
				result.Height = Math.Max(result.Height, child.DesiredSize.Height);
				result.Width += child.DesiredSize.Width;
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected virtual double GetItemMaxHeight(double finalHeight)
		{
			if ((bool)base.Panel.GetValue(SimplifiedModeSettingsHelper.IsInSimplifiedRibbonProperty))
			{
				return finalHeight;
			}
			double num = 0.0;
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Panel.Children)
			{
				num = Math.Max(num, child.DesiredSize.Height);
			}
			return num;
		}

		public override Size ArrangePanel(Size finalSize)
		{
			Rect finalRect = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
			double itemMaxHeight = GetItemMaxHeight(finalSize.Height);
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Panel.Children)
			{
				finalRect.Width = child.DesiredSize.Width;
				finalRect.Height = itemMaxHeight;
				child.Arrange(finalRect);
				finalRect.X += child.DesiredSize.Width;
			}
			return new Size(finalRect.X, itemMaxHeight);
		}
	}
	public class ButtonGroupSetLayoutCalculator
	{
		[ThreadStatic]
		private static ButtonGroupSetLayoutCalculator instance;

		private static object lockObject;

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey RowCountPropertyKey;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty RowCountProperty;

		private double[] itemWidthArray;

		private int[] rowsConfig = new int[3];

		private int[] bestRowsConfig = new int[3];

		public static ButtonGroupSetLayoutCalculator Instance
		{
			get
			{
				if (instance == null)
				{
					lock (lockObject)
					{
						if (instance == null)
						{
							instance = new ButtonGroupSetLayoutCalculator();
						}
					}
				}
				return instance;
			}
		}

		protected int[] RowElementCountImpl => bestRowsConfig;

		public static int[] RowElementCount => Instance.RowElementCountImpl;

		static ButtonGroupSetLayoutCalculator()
		{
			lockObject = new object();
			RowCountPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttachedReadOnly("RowCount", typeof(int), typeof(ButtonGroupSetLayoutCalculator), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(2, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsParentMeasure));
			RowCountProperty = RowCountPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
		}

		internal static void SetRowCount(DependencyObject d, int value)
		{
			d.SetValue(RowCountPropertyKey, value);
		}

		public static int GetRowCount(DependencyObject d)
		{
			return (int)d.GetValue(RowCountProperty);
		}

		protected void CalcItemsWidth(BarItemLinkInfo[] children, int firstIndex, int lastIndex)
		{
			itemWidthArray = new double[lastIndex - firstIndex + 1];
			for (int i = firstIndex; i <= lastIndex; i++)
			{
				BarItemLinkInfo val = children[i];
				itemWidthArray[i - firstIndex] = ((UIElement)(object)val).DesiredSize.Width;
				if (val.LinkControl is BarButtonGroupLinkControl { Separator: not null } barButtonGroupLinkControl)
				{
					itemWidthArray[i - firstIndex] -= barButtonGroupLinkControl.Separator.DesiredSize.Width;
				}
			}
		}

		protected int GetFirstElementIndexOfRowImpl(int offset, int rowIndex)
		{
			int num = offset;
			for (int i = 0; i < rowIndex; i++)
			{
				num += bestRowsConfig[i];
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected int GetLastElementIndexOfRowImpl(int offset, int rowIndex)
		{
			return GetFirstElementIndexOfRow(offset, rowIndex) + bestRowsConfig[rowIndex] - 1;
		}

		protected void SaveRowsConfig()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
			{
				bestRowsConfig[i] = rowsConfig[i];
			}
		}

		protected int GetBeginIndex(int[] rowCfg, int row)
		{
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < row; i++)
			{
				num += rowCfg[i];
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected double GetRowWidth(int rowIndex)
		{
			int beginIndex = GetBeginIndex(rowsConfig, rowIndex);
			double num = 0.0;
			for (int i = beginIndex; i < beginIndex + rowsConfig[rowIndex]; i++)
			{
				num += itemWidthArray[i];
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected double GetColumnMaxWidth(int rowCount)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < rowCount; i++)
			{
				num = Math.Max(num, GetRowWidth(i));
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected double CheckCombination(double prevMaxWidth, int rowCount)
		{
			double columnMaxWidth = GetColumnMaxWidth(rowCount);
			if (prevMaxWidth > columnMaxWidth)
			{
				prevMaxWidth = columnMaxWidth;
				SaveRowsConfig();
			}
			return prevMaxWidth;
		}

		protected double FindOptimal3RowsConfiguration()
		{
			double num = double.MaxValue;
			int length = itemWidthArray.GetLength(0);
			rowsConfig[0] = 1;
			while (rowsConfig[0] <= length - 2)
			{
				rowsConfig[1] = 1;
				while (rowsConfig[1] <= length - 1 - rowsConfig[0])
				{
					rowsConfig[2] = length - rowsConfig[0] - rowsConfig[1];
					num = CheckCombination(num, 3);
					rowsConfig[1]++;
				}
				rowsConfig[0]++;
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected double FindOptimal2RowsConfiguration()
		{
			double num = double.MaxValue;
			int length = itemWidthArray.GetLength(0);
			rowsConfig[0] = 1;
			while (rowsConfig[0] <= length - 1)
			{
				rowsConfig[1] = length - rowsConfig[0];
				num = CheckCombination(num, 2);
				rowsConfig[0]++;
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected int CalcGroupsLayoutImpl(BarItemLinkInfo[] children, int firstIndex, int lastIndex, int rowCount)
		{
			CalcItemsWidth(children, firstIndex, lastIndex);
			bestRowsConfig[0] = 0;
			bestRowsConfig[1] = 0;
			bestRowsConfig[2] = 0;
			int num = lastIndex - firstIndex + 1;
			if (num == 1)
			{
				bestRowsConfig[0] = 1;
				return 1;
			}
			if (rowCount == 2)
			{
				FindOptimal2RowsConfiguration();
				return 2;
			}
			FindOptimal3RowsConfiguration();
			return 3;
		}

		public static int CalcGroupsLayout(BarItemLinkInfo[] children, int firstIndex, int lastIndex, int rowCount)
		{
			return Instance.CalcGroupsLayoutImpl(children, firstIndex, lastIndex, rowCount);
		}

		public static int GetFirstElementIndexOfRow(int offset, int rowIndex)
		{
			return Instance.GetFirstElementIndexOfRowImpl(offset, rowIndex);
		}

		public static int GetLastElementIndexOfRow(int offset, int rowIndex)
		{
			return Instance.GetLastElementIndexOfRowImpl(offset, rowIndex);
		}
	}

		{

		private void OnDropDownButtonMouseLeftButtonDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (DropDownButton.IsChecked != true)
			{
				ShowDropDownGallery();
				if (Mouse.Captured == null)
				{
					Mouse.Capture(DropDownButton);
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnDropDownButtonMouseLeftButtonUp(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (DropDownButton != null && Mouse.Captured == DropDownButton)
			{
				DropDownButton.ReleaseMouseCapture();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnPopupGalleryChanged(GalleryDropDownPopupMenu oldValue)

				UnsubscribeGalleryDropDownPopupMenuEvents(oldValue);
				oldValue.Gallery = null;
			}
			if (PopupGallery != null)
			{
				SubscribeGalleryDropDownPopupMenuEvents(PopupGallery);
			}
		}

		protected GalleryDropDownPopupMenu CreatePopupGallery()
		{

		private void OnGalleryDropDownMenuOpened(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (GalleryStrategy.openedWithKeyboard)
			{
				GalleryStrategy.openedWithKeyboard = false;
				(((PopupBase)PopupGallery).PopupContent as UIElement).Focus();
				object popupContent = ((PopupBase)PopupGallery).PopupContent;
				if (NavigationTree.SelectElement((IBarsNavigationSupport)((popupContent is IBarsNavigationSupport) ? popupContent : null)))
				{
					NavigationTree.SelectFirst();
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnGalleryDropDownMenuClosed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_006a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0070: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			GalleryStrategy.openedWithKeyboard = false;
			DropDownButton.IsChecked = false;
			((BarItemLinkControlBase)this).IsPressed = false;
			GalleryItem.OnDropDownGalleryClosed(PopupGallery);
			if (PopupGallery.Gallery != null && PopupGallery.Gallery.ClonedFrom == GalleryStrategy.GalleryValue && (int)PopupGallery.Gallery.ItemCheckMode == 1)
			{
				GalleryItem firstCheckedItem = GalleryStrategy.GalleryValue.GetFirstCheckedItem();
				ScrollToItem(firstCheckedItem);
			}
			((FrameworkElement)this).RemoveLogicalChild((object)PopupGallery);
		}

		private void InitDropDownGalleryBeforeOpening(Gallery dropDownGallery)
		{

			//IL_0015: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			dropDownGallery.IsGroupCaptionVisible = (DefaultBoolean)(((int)dropDownGallery.IsGroupCaptionVisible != 2) ? ((int)GalleryStrategy.GalleryValue.IsGroupCaptionVisible) : 0);
			dropDownGallery.IsItemCaptionVisible = true;
			dropDownGallery.IsItemDescriptionVisible = true;
			dropDownGallery.IsItemDescriptionVisible = true;
			dropDownGallery.SyncWithClone = true;
		}

		private Gallery CreateActualDropDownGallery()

		private void OnDownButtonClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			int firstVisibleRowIndex = GalleryControl.GetFirstVisibleRowIndex();
			if (firstVisibleRowIndex != -1)
			{
				GalleryControl.ScrollToRowByIndex(firstVisibleRowIndex + 1);
				UpdateUpAndDownButtonsState();
			}
		}

		protected virtual BarPopupExpandMode GetActualExpandMode()
		{
			RibbonControl ribbonControl = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<RibbonControl>((DependencyObject)(object)this);
			if (ribbonControl != null && (ribbonControl.RibbonStyle == RibbonStyle.TabletOffice || ribbonControl.RibbonStyle == RibbonStyle.OfficeSlim))
			{
				return (BarPopupExpandMode)1;
			}
			return (BarPopupExpandMode)0;
		}

		private void OnLayoutUpdated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateUpAndDownButtonsState();
		}

		private void OnUpButtonClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			int firstVisibleRowIndex = GalleryControl.GetFirstVisibleRowIndex();
			if (firstVisibleRowIndex != 0)
			{
				GalleryControl.ScrollToRowByIndex(firstVisibleRowIndex - 1);
			}
			else
			{
				GalleryControl.ScrollToVerticalOffset(0.0);
			}
			UpdateUpAndDownButtonsState();
		}

		private void UpdateUpAndDownButtonsState()
		{
			if (GalleryControl != null && UpButton != null && DownButton != null)
			{
				UpButton.IsEnabled = GalleryControl.ContentVerticalOffset != 0.0;
				DownButton.IsEnabled = GalleryControl.ScrollableSize.Height - GalleryControl.ViewportSize.Height > GalleryControl.ContentVerticalOffset;
			}
		}

		public bool CanReduce()
		{
			if (!IsGalleryVisible || GalleryControl == null || GalleryControl.Gallery == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (GalleryControl.DesiredColCount == 0)
			{
				return GalleryControl.DesiredColCount > GalleryControl.Gallery.MinColCount;
			}
			if (GalleryControl.Gallery.MinColCount == 0)
			{
				return GalleryControl.DesiredColCount > 1;
			}
			return GalleryControl.DesiredColCount > GalleryControl.Gallery.MinColCount;
		}

		public bool Reduce()
		{
			if (!CanReduce())
			{
				return false;
			}
			GalleryControl.DesiredColCount -= 1;
			return true;
		}

		public void ScrollToItem(GalleryItem item)
		{
			if (GalleryControl != null && item != null && IsGalleryVisible)
			{
				GalleryControl.ScrollToItem(item);
			}
		}

		}

		public RibbonSpacingSelectorItemLinkControl(RibbonSpacingSelectorItemLink link)
			: base((BarSubItemLink)(object)link)
		{
			CommonThemeHelper.AddThemeChangedHandler((DependencyObject)(object)this, (RoutedEventHandler)OnThemeChanged);
			ActivateMouseModeCommand = new DelegateCommand(ActivateMouseMode, useCommandManager: false);
			ActivateTouchModeCommand = new DelegateCommand(ActivateTouchMode, useCommandManager: false);
			UpdateActualRibbon();
		}

		private void OnThemeChanged(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			(((BarItemLinkControlBase)this).Strategy as RibbonSpacingSelectorItemLinkControlStrategy)?.UpdateModeChecks();

		}

			: this(null)
		{
		}

		{
		}

		{
			((RibbonSpacingSelectorItemLinkControlStrategy)(object)((BarItemLinkControlBase)this).Strategy).UpdateModeChecks();
		}

		{
			((BarItemLinkControlBase)this).OnLoaded(sender, e);
			UpdateVisibilityByThemeTreeWalker(CommonThemeHelper.GetTreeWalker((DependencyObject)(object)this));
			UpdateActualRibbon();
		}
