		{
			RibbonSpacingModeHelper.UpdateThemeName(CommonThemeHelper.GetTreeWalker((DependencyObject)ActualRibbon), (SpacingMode)0);
		}

		protected virtual void ActivateTouchMode()
		{
			RibbonSpacingModeHelper.UpdateThemeName(CommonThemeHelper.GetTreeWalker((DependencyObject)ActualRibbon), (SpacingMode)1);
		}

		public virtual void UpdateActualRibbon()
		{
			ActualRibbon = SpacingSelectorLink.With((RibbonSpacingSelectorItemLink x) => x.Ribbon ?? RibbonControl.GetRibbon((DependencyObject)(object)x)) ?? SpacingSelectorItem.With((RibbonSpacingSelectorItem x) => x.Ribbon ?? RibbonControl.GetRibbon((DependencyObject)(object)x)) ?? RibbonControl.GetRibbon((DependencyObject)(object)this) ?? LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<RibbonControl>((DependencyObject)(object)this) ?? ((RibbonControl)(object)((IRibbonWindow)/*isinst with value type is only supported in some contexts*/).With((IRibbonWindow x) => x.Ribbon));
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateVisibilityByThemeTreeWalker(CommonThemeTreeWalker themeTreeWalker)
		{
			bool isTouchSupported = RibbonSpacingModeHelper.GetIsTouchSupported(themeTreeWalker);
			if (((BarItemLinkControlBase)this).Item != null)
			{
				((BarItemLinkControlBase)this).Item.IsVisible = isTouchSupported;
			}
		}
	}
	public class BaseDependencyObjectCollection<T> : ObservableCollection<T> where T : FrameworkContentElement
	{
		public T this[string name]
		{
			get
			{
				using (IEnumerator<T> enumerator = GetEnumerator())
				{
					while (enumerator.MoveNext())
					{
						T current = enumerator.Current;
						if (current.Name == name)
						{
							return current;
						}
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		protected override void InsertItem(int index, T item)
		{
			if (!Contains(item))
			{
				base.InsertItem(index, item);
				OnInsertItem(index, item);
			}
		}

		protected override void RemoveItem(int index)
		{
			T removedItem = base[index];
			base.RemoveItem(index);
			OnRemoveItem(index, removedItem);
		}

		protected override void SetItem(int index, T newItem)
		{
			T oldItem = base[index];
			base.SetItem(index, newItem);
			OnReplaceItem(index, newItem, oldItem);
		}

		protected override void ClearItems()
		{
			List<T> list = new List<T>();
			using (IEnumerator<T> enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					T current = enumerator.Current;
					list.Add(current);
				}
			}
			base.ClearItems();
			foreach (T item in list)
			{
				OnRemoveItem(0, item);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnReplaceItem(int index, T newItem, T oldItem)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnRemoveItem(int index, T removedItem)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnInsertItem(int index, T insertedItem)
		{
		}
	}
	[TargetType(typeof(BarCheckItem))]
	public class RibbonAutoHideModeBehavior : Behavior<BarCheckItem>
	{
		private RibbonControl ribbon;

		protected object StyleKey { get; private set; }

		protected RibbonControl Ribbon
		{
			get
			{
				return ribbon;
			}
			set
			{
				if (ribbon != value)
				{
					RibbonControl oldValue = ribbon;
					ribbon = value;
					OnRibbonChanged(oldValue);
				}
			}
		}

		public RibbonAutoHideModeBehavior()
		{
			StyleKey = CreateStyleKey();
		}

		private void OnRibbonChanged(RibbonControl oldValue)
		{
			SetRibbonForCheckItem();
		}

		private void SetRibbonForCheckItem()
		{
			if (base.AssociatedObject != null)
			{
				((FrameworkContentElement)(object)base.AssociatedObject).Tag = Ribbon;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnAttached()
		{
			((AttachableObjectBase)this).OnAttached();
			SetRibbonForCheckItem();
			((FrameworkContentElement)(object)base.AssociatedObject).SetResourceReference(FrameworkContentElement.StyleProperty, StyleKey);
			((FrameworkContentElement)(object)base.AssociatedObject).Loaded += OnAssociatedObjectLoaded;
			if (((FrameworkContentElement)(object)base.AssociatedObject).IsLoaded)
			{
				UpdateRibbon();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDetaching()
		{
			((AttachableObjectBase)this).OnDetaching();
			((FrameworkContentElement)(object)base.AssociatedObject).Loaded -= OnAssociatedObjectLoaded;
			((DependencyObject)(object)base.AssociatedObject).ClearValue(FrameworkContentElement.StyleProperty);
			((FrameworkContentElement)(object)base.AssociatedObject).Tag = null;
			Ribbon = null;
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateRibbon()
		{
			Ribbon = RibbonControl.GetRibbon((DependencyObject)(object)base.AssociatedObject) ?? LayoutHelper.FindLayoutOrVisualParentObject<RibbonControl>((DependencyObject)(object)base.AssociatedObject, true, (DependencyObject)null);
		}

		protected virtual object CreateStyleKey()
		{
			return new RibbonAutoHideCheckItemBehaviorThemeKeyExtension
			{
				ResourceKey = RibbonAutoHideCheckItemBehaviorThemeKeys.Style,
				IsThemeIndependent = true
			};
		}

		protected virtual void OnAssociatedObjectLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateRibbon();
		}
	}

		}

		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]

			: this(null, null)

		}

		public CreateNewPageCustomization(RibbonPage target, RibbonPageCategoryBase container)
			: base((DependencyObject)target, (DependencyObject)container)
		{
		}

		protected override bool ApplyOverride(bool silent)
		{
			RibbonPageCategoryBase ribbonPageCategoryBase = ((RuntimeCollectionCustomization)this).FindContainer() as RibbonPageCategoryBase;
			RibbonPage ribbonPage = ((RuntimeCustomization)this).FindTarget() as RibbonPage;
			if (ribbonPage == null)
			{
				ribbonPage = new RibbonPage();
				ribbonPage.Name = ((RuntimeCustomization)this).TargetName;
				RibbonPageCategoryElementWrapper.ValidateIndices(((RuntimeCustomization)this).TargetName);
				ribbonPage.Caption = PageCaption;
				ribbonPage.CreatedByCustomizationDialog = true;
			}
			else
			{
				PageCaption = Convert.ToString(ribbonPage.Caption);
			}
			if (ribbonPageCategoryBase == null || ribbonPage == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ribbonPageCategoryBase.CustomPages.Add(ribbonPage);
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool UndoOverride()
		{
			RibbonPageCategoryBase ribbonPageCategoryBase = ((RuntimeCollectionCustomization)this).FindContainer() as RibbonPageCategoryBase;
			RibbonPage ribbonPage = ((RuntimeCustomization)this).FindTarget() as RibbonPage;
			if (ribbonPageCategoryBase == null || ribbonPage == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return ribbonPageCategoryBase.CustomPages.Remove(ribbonPage);
		}
	}
	public class ClonePageCustomization : RuntimeCollectionCustomization
	{
		private RibbonPage clone;

		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public string InsertAfter { get; set; }

		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public string ResultName { get; set; }

		public ClonePageCustomization()
			: this(null, null)
		{
		}

		public ClonePageCustomization(RibbonPage source, RibbonPageCategoryBase container)
			: this(source, container, null)
		{
		}

		public ClonePageCustomization(RibbonPage source, RibbonPageCategoryBase container, RibbonPage insertAfter)
			: base((DependencyObject)source, (DependencyObject)container)
		{
			InsertAfter = insertAfter.With((Func<RibbonPage, string>)BarManagerCustomizationHelper.GetSerializationName);
		}

		protected override bool ApplyOverride(bool silent)
		{
			RibbonPage ribbonPage = CreateClone();
			RibbonPageCategoryBase ribbonPageCategoryBase = ((RuntimeCollectionCustomization)this).FindContainer() as RibbonPageCategoryBase;
			if (ribbonPage == null || ribbonPageCategoryBase == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ribbonPageCategoryBase.CustomPages.Add(ribbonPage);
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool UndoOverride()
		{
			RibbonPageCategoryBase ribbonPageCategoryBase = ((RuntimeCollectionCustomization)this).FindContainer() as RibbonPageCategoryBase;
			RibbonPage ribbonPage = ((RuntimeCustomization)this).Host.FindTarget(ResultName) as RibbonPage;
			if (ribbonPageCategoryBase == null || ribbonPage == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ribbonPageCategoryBase.CustomPages.Remove(ribbonPage);
			return true;
		}

		public RibbonPage CreateClone()
		{
			if (clone != null)
			{
				return clone;
			}
			if (!(((RuntimeCustomization)this).FindTarget() is RibbonPage ribbonPage))
			{
				return null;
			}
			clone = new RibbonPage();
			clone.Name = CloneNameHelper.GetCloneName((IFrameworkInputElement)ribbonPage, (IFrameworkInputElement)clone);
			clone.Caption = ribbonPage.Caption;
			clone.CreatedByCustomizationDialog = true;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(ResultName))
			{
				ResultName = BarManagerCustomizationHelper.GetSerializationName((DependencyObject)clone);
			}
			else
			{
				clone.Name = ResultName;
				CloneNameHelper.Register(clone.Name);
			}
			return clone;
		}
	}
	public class CloneGroupCustomization : RuntimeCollectionCustomization
	{
		private RibbonPageGroup clone;

		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public string InsertAfter { get; set; }

		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public string ResultName { get; set; }

		public CloneGroupCustomization()
			: this(null, null)
		{
		}

		public CloneGroupCustomization(RibbonPageGroup source, RibbonPage container)
			: this(source, container, null)
		{
		}

		public CloneGroupCustomization(RibbonPageGroup source, RibbonPage container, RibbonPageGroup insertAfter)
			: base((DependencyObject)source, (DependencyObject)container)
		{
			InsertAfter = insertAfter.With((Func<RibbonPageGroup, string>)BarManagerCustomizationHelper.GetSerializationName);
		}

		protected override bool ApplyOverride(bool silent)
		{
			RibbonPageGroup ribbonPageGroup = CreateClone();
			RibbonPage container = ((RuntimeCollectionCustomization)this).FindContainer() as RibbonPage;
			if (ribbonPageGroup == null || container == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = (((RuntimeCustomization)this).Host.FindTarget(InsertAfter) as RibbonPageGroup).Return((RibbonPageGroup x) => container.ActualGroups.IndexOf(x) + 1, () => -1);
			int count = container.ActualGroups.Count;
			if (num == -1 || !IListExtensions.IsValidIndex<RibbonPageGroup>((IList<RibbonPageGroup>)container.CustomGroups, count - num))
			{
				container.CustomGroups.Add(ribbonPageGroup);
			}
			else
			{
				container.CustomGroups.Insert(count - num, ribbonPageGroup);
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool UndoOverride()
		{
			RibbonPage ribbonPage = ((RuntimeCollectionCustomization)this).FindContainer() as RibbonPage;
			RibbonPageGroup ribbonPageGroup = ((RuntimeCustomization)this).Host.FindTarget(ResultName) as RibbonPageGroup;
			if (ribbonPage == null || ribbonPageGroup == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return ribbonPage.CustomGroups.Remove(ribbonPageGroup);
		}

		public RibbonPageGroup CreateClone()
		{
			if (clone != null)
			{
				return clone;
			}
			if (!(((RuntimeCustomization)this).FindTarget() is RibbonPageGroup ribbonPageGroup))
			{
				return null;
			}
			clone = new RibbonPageGroup();
			clone.Name = CloneNameHelper.GetCloneName((IFrameworkInputElement)ribbonPageGroup, (IFrameworkInputElement)clone);
			clone.Caption = ribbonPageGroup.Caption;
			clone.CreatedByCustomizationDialog = true;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(ResultName))
			{
				ResultName = BarManagerCustomizationHelper.GetSerializationName((DependencyObject)clone);
			}
			else
			{
				clone.Name = ResultName;
				CloneNameHelper.Register(clone.Name);
			}
			return clone;
		}
	}

		public ElementWrapper(DependencyObject ownerObject, ElementWrapper parentWrapper, bool skipCustomizations, IRuntimeCustomizationHost customizationHost, DependencyObject inheritanceSource)
		{
			this.inheritanceSource = inheritanceSource;
			this.ownerObject = ownerObject;
			this.parentWrapper = parentWrapper;
			this.skipCustomizations = skipCustomizations;
			this.customizationHost = customizationHost;
			TempItems = new ObservableCollection<ElementWrapper>();
			SortItems = true;
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			ResetOverride();
		}

		protected ElementWrapper FindRootWrapper(ElementWrapper newWrapper)
		{
			ElementWrapper elementWrapper = newWrapper;
			while (elementWrapper.ParentWrapper.ParentWrapper != null)
			{
				elementWrapper = elementWrapper.ParentWrapper;
			}
			return elementWrapper;
		}

		protected virtual void ResetOverride()
		{
			TempItems.Clear();
		}

		private void Remove()
		{
			//IL_0037: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0047: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0064: Expected O, but got Unknown
			int childIndex = ParentWrapper.Items.IndexOf(this);
			GetBackAndForwardItem(childIndex, out var backItem, out var forwardItem);
			ElementWrapper elementWrapper = FindRootWrapper(this);
			if (!CreatedByCustomizationDialog)
			{
				AddCustomization((RuntimeCustomization)(object)MayBe.Do(new RuntimePropertyCustomization(OwnerObject)
				{
					PropertyName = "IsRemoved",
					NewValue = true
				}, delegate(RuntimePropertyCustomization x)
				{
					((RuntimeCustomization)x).AffectedTargets.AddRange(GetAffectedTargetsOnRemove());
				}));
				IsRemoved = true;
				ParentWrapper.Items.Do(delegate(ListCollectionView x)
				{
					x.Refresh();
				});
				elementWrapper.OnRemoveItem(new RemoveWrapperItemEventArgs
				{
					BackItem = backItem,
					RemoveItem = this,
					ForwardItem = forwardItem,
					ParentWrapper = ParentWrapper
				});
			}
			else
			{
				ParentWrapper.RemoveChild(this);
				elementWrapper.OnRemoveItem(new RemoveWrapperItemEventArgs
				{
					BackItem = backItem,
					RemoveItem = this,
					ForwardItem = forwardItem,
					ParentWrapper = ParentWrapper
				});
			}
		}

		private void GetBackAndForwardItem(int childIndex, out ElementWrapper backItem, out ElementWrapper forwardItem)
		{
			if (childIndex - 1 >= 0)
			{
				backItem = (ElementWrapper)ParentWrapper.Items.GetItemAt(childIndex - 1);
			}
			else
			{
				backItem = null;
			}
			if (childIndex + 1 < ParentWrapper.Items.Count)
			{
				forwardItem = (ElementWrapper)ParentWrapper.Items.GetItemAt(childIndex + 1);
			}
			else
			{
				forwardItem = null;
			}
		}

		protected virtual IEnumerable<string> GetAffectedTargetsOnRemove()
		{
			return GetParentSerializationNames();
		}

		protected virtual IEnumerable<string> GetParentSerializationNames()
		{
			if (ParentWrapper != null)
			{
				foreach (string parentSerializationName in ParentWrapper.GetParentSerializationNames())
				{
					yield return parentSerializationName;
				}
			}
			yield return OwnerObject.With((Func<DependencyObject, string>)BarManagerCustomizationHelper.GetSerializationName);
		}

		protected void AddCustomization(RuntimeCustomization customization)
		{
			if (CustomizationHost != null)
			{
				((Collection<RuntimeCustomization>)(object)CustomizationHost.RuntimeCustomizations).Add(customization);
			}
		}

		protected void RemoveCustomization(RuntimeCustomization customization)
		{
			if (CustomizationHost != null)
			{
				((Collection<RuntimeCustomization>)(object)CustomizationHost.RuntimeCustomizations).Remove(customization);
			}
		}

		public void Add(ElementWrapper second)
		{
			if (CanAddOverride(second))
			{
				AddOverride(second);
			}
			else
			{
				ParentWrapper?.Add(second);
			}
		}

		}

		protected bool CanAdd(ElementWrapper second)
		{
			ElementWrapper elementWrapper = ParentWrapper;
			if (elementWrapper == null || !elementWrapper.CanAdd(second))
			{
				if (CanAddOverride(second))
				{
					return !ContainsItem(second);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected bool ContainsItem(ElementWrapper second)
		{
			if (Items != null && second != null)
			{
				return ContainsItemOverride(second);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual bool ContainsItemOverride(ElementWrapper second)
		{
			return Items.OfType<ElementWrapper>().Any((ElementWrapper x) => x.OwnerObject == second?.OwnerObject);
		}

		}

		protected virtual bool CanMoveChildUp(ElementWrapper elementWrapper)

		protected virtual void MoveChild(ElementWrapper elementWrapper, bool up)
		{
			//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0060: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			//IL_00aa: Expected O, but got Unknown
			int altitude = ((IAltitudeSupport)elementWrapper.OwnerObject).Altitude;
			int altitude2 = elementWrapper.Altitude;
			elementWrapper.Altitude += ((!up) ? 1 : (-1));
			AddCustomization((RuntimeCustomization)(object)MayBe.Do(new RuntimePropertyCustomization(elementWrapper.OwnerObject)
			{
				PropertyName = GetAltitudePropertyName(),
				NewValue = altitude + elementWrapper.Altitude,
				OldValue = altitude + altitude2,
				Overwrite = true
			}, delegate(RuntimePropertyCustomization x)
			{
				((RuntimeCustomization)x).AffectedTargets.AddRange(GetAffectedTargetsOnMoveChild(elementWrapper));
			}));
		}

		}

		protected virtual void MoveChildDown(ElementWrapper elementWrapper)
		{
			ElementWrapper elementWrapper2 = Items.GetItemAt(Items.IndexOf(elementWrapper) + 1) as ElementWrapper;
			MoveChild(elementWrapper, up: false);
			MoveChild(elementWrapper2, up: true);
			Items.Do(delegate(ListCollectionView x)
			{
				x.Refresh();
			});
		}

		protected virtual void MoveChildUp(ElementWrapper elementWrapper)
		{
			ElementWrapper elementWrapper2 = Items.GetItemAt(Items.IndexOf(elementWrapper) - 1) as ElementWrapper;
			MoveChild(elementWrapper, up: true);
			MoveChild(elementWrapper2, up: false);
			Items.Do(delegate(ListCollectionView x)
			{
				x.Refresh();
			});
		}

		protected virtual void RemoveChild(ElementWrapper child)
		{
			if (child.OwnerObject is RibbonPage)
			{
				AddCustomization((RuntimeCustomization)(object)new RuntimeRemoveRibbonPageCustomization(child.OwnerObject as RibbonPage).Do(delegate(RuntimeRemoveRibbonPageCustomization x)
				{
					((RuntimeCustomization)x).AffectedTargets.AddRange(GetAffectedTargetsOnRemove());
				}));
			}
			if (child.OwnerObject is RibbonPageGroup)
			{
				AddCustomization((RuntimeCustomization)(object)new RuntimeRemoveRibbonPageGroupCustomization(child.OwnerObject as RibbonPageGroup).Do(delegate(RuntimeRemoveRibbonPageGroupCustomization x)
				{
					((RuntimeCustomization)x).AffectedTargets.AddRange(GetAffectedTargetsOnRemove());
				}));
			}
			if (child.OwnerObject is BarItemLink)
			{
				object forcedTarget = (object)/*isinst with value type is only supported in some contexts*/;
				DependencyObject dependencyObject = child.ParentWrapper.OwnerObject;
				AddCustomization((RuntimeCustomization)(object)new RemoveRibbonLinkCustomization((BarItemLinkBase)forcedTarget, (ILinksHolder)(object)((dependencyObject is ILinksHolder) ? dependencyObject : null)).Do(delegate(RemoveRibbonLinkCustomization x)
				{
					((RuntimeCustomization)x).AffectedTargets.AddRange(GetAffectedTargetsOnRemove());
				}));
			}
			child.IsRemoved = true;
		}

		protected internal virtual bool Rename()
		{
			//IL_0028: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0039: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0040: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0047: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			string result = Convert.ToString(Content);
			string oldValue = result;
			if (!GetCaption(ref result))
			{
				return false;
			}
			Content = result;
			AddCustomization((RuntimeCustomization)(object)MayBe.Do(new RuntimePropertyCustomization(OwnerObject)
			{
				PropertyName = GetCaptionPropertyName(),
				NewValue = result,
				OldValue = oldValue,
				Overwrite = true
			}, delegate(RuntimePropertyCustomization x)
			{
				((RuntimeCustomization)x).AffectedTargets.AddRange(GetAffectedTargetsOnRename());
			}));
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual IEnumerable<string> GetAffectedTargetsOnRename()
		{
			return GetParentSerializationNames();
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateItems()
		{
			if (SkipCustomizations)
			{
				if (InternalItems != null)
				{
					Items = new ListCollectionView(InternalItems);
					Items.Filter = (object x) => !((ElementWrapper)x).CreatedByCustomizationDialog;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				SortedItems.Dispose();
				sortedItems = null;
				Items = new ListCollectionView(SortedItems.Items);
			}
		}

		private ObservableCollectionConverter<ElementWrapper, ElementWrapper> CreateView(IList items)
		{
			if (items == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ListCollectionView source = new ListCollectionView(items).Do(delegate(ListCollectionView x)
			{
				x.Filter = (object f) => !((ElementWrapper)f).IsRemoved;
			});
			return new ObservableCollectionConverter<ElementWrapper, ElementWrapper>
			{
				Source = source,
				Selector = (ElementWrapper x) => x
			};
		}
	}
	public class RibbonElementWrapper : ElementWrapper
	{
		private RibbonControl owner;

		private bool showMainTabs = true;

		private bool showToolTabs = true;

		public bool ShowMainTabs
		{
			get
			{
				return showMainTabs;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != showMainTabs)
				{
					bool flag = showMainTabs;
					showMainTabs = value;
					UpdateTabsVisibility();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool ShowToolTabs
		{
			get
			{
				return showToolTabs;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != showToolTabs)
				{
					bool flag = showToolTabs;
					showToolTabs = value;
					UpdateTabsVisibility();
				}
			}
		}

		public RibbonElementWrapper(RibbonControl owner, DependencyObject inheritanceSource)
			: this(owner, skipCustomizations: false, inheritanceSource)
		{
		}

		public RibbonElementWrapper(RibbonControl owner, bool skipCustomizations, DependencyObject inheritanceSource)
			: this(owner, skipCustomizations, showMainTabs: true, showToolTabs: true, inheritanceSource)
		{
		}

		public RibbonElementWrapper(RibbonControl owner, bool skipCustomizations, bool showMainTabs, bool showToolTabs, DependencyObject inheritanceSource)
			: base(owner, null, skipCustomizations, (IRuntimeCustomizationHost)(object)owner, inheritanceSource)
		{
			this.owner = owner;
			Reset();
		}

		protected override void ResetOverride()
		{
			base.CreatedByCustomizationDialog = false;
			base.SortItems = false;
			base.InternalItems = (IList)new ObservableCollectionConverter<RibbonPageCategoryBase, RibbonPageCategoryElementWrapper>
			{
				Source = owner.ActualCategories,
				Selector = (RibbonPageCategoryBase x) => new RibbonPageCategoryElementWrapper(x, this, base.SkipCustomizations, showMainTabs, showToolTabs, base.CustomizationHost, base.InheritanceSource)
			};
			if (base.SkipCustomizations)
			{
				base.CanChangeContent = false;
				base.CanHide = false;
				base.CanMoveInternal = false;
				base.Content = null;
				base.ContentTemplate = null;
				base.Glyph = null;
				base.GlyphTemplate = null;
				base.HasGlyph = false;
				base.HasGlyphTemplate = false;
				base.Altitude = 0;
				base.IsDropDown = false;
				base.IsEditor = false;
				base.IsMenu = false;
				base.IsVisible = true;
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateTabsVisibility()
		{
			foreach (RibbonPageCategoryElementWrapper internalItem in base.InternalItems)
			{
				if (internalItem.Owner.IsDefault)
				{
					internalItem.IsRemoved = !ShowMainTabs;
				}
				else
				{
					internalItem.IsRemoved = !ShowToolTabs;
				}
			}
		}
	}

		protected override void CreateNew(string param)
		{
			RibbonPage page = new RibbonPage
			{
				CreatedByCustomizationDialog = true,
				Caption = RibbonControlLocalizer.GetString(RibbonControlStringId.RibbonCustomizationStrings_NewPageCaption),
				Name = "guidD45041CD530241E8B0B3BA7794F805C2" + index++
			};
			RibbonPageElementWrapper ribbonPageElementWrapper = new RibbonPageElementWrapper(page, this, skipCustomizations: false, base.CustomizationHost, base.InheritanceSource);
			base.TempItems.Add(ribbonPageElementWrapper);
			CreateNewPageCustomization customization = new CreateNewPageCustomization(page, Owner).Do(delegate(CreateNewPageCustomization x)
			{
				((RuntimeCustomization)x).AffectedTargets.AddRange(GetAffectedTargetsOnCreateNewPage(page));

			AddCustomization((RuntimeCustomization)(object)customization);
			if (ribbonPageElementWrapper.CanRename() && !ribbonPageElementWrapper.Rename())
			{
				base.TempItems.Remove(ribbonPageElementWrapper);
				RemoveCustomization((RuntimeCustomization)(object)customization);
				return;
			}
			ElementWrapper elementWrapper = FindRootWrapper(ribbonPageElementWrapper);
			elementWrapper.OnAddInItems(new AddWrapperItemEventArgs
			{
				NewWrapper = ribbonPageElementWrapper,
				ParentWrapper = null
			});
		}

		public override void AddOverride(ElementWrapper second)
		{
			RibbonPage source = second.OwnerObject as RibbonPage;
			ClonePageCustomization clonePageCustomization = new ClonePageCustomization(source, base.OwnerObject as RibbonPageCategoryBase, base.Items.OfType<ElementWrapper>().LastOrDefault().With((ElementWrapper x) => x.OwnerObject as RibbonPage));
			RibbonPage clone = clonePageCustomization.CreateClone();
			AddCustomization((RuntimeCustomization)(object)clonePageCustomization.Do(delegate(ClonePageCustomization x)
			{
				((RuntimeCustomization)x).AffectedTargets.AddRange(GetAffectedTargetsOnClonePage(clone));
			}));
			RibbonPageElementWrapper ribbonPageElementWrapper = new RibbonPageElementWrapper(clone, this, base.CustomizationHost, base.InheritanceSource);
			base.TempItems.Add(ribbonPageElementWrapper);

		public BarItemLinkElementWrapper(BarItemLink owner, ElementWrapper parent, bool skipCustomizations, IRuntimeCustomizationHost customizationHost, DependencyObject inheritanceSource)
			: base((DependencyObject)(object)owner, parent, skipCustomizations, customizationHost, inheritanceSource)
		{
			this.owner = (BarItemLinkBase)(object)owner;
			this.parent = parent;
			base.CreatedByCustomizationDialog = ((BarItemLinkBase)owner).CreatedByCustomizationDialog;
			Reset();
		}

		protected override void ResetOverride()
		{
			base.ResetOverride();
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = base.OwnerObject;
			BarItemLink val = (BarItemLink)(object)((dependencyObject is BarItemLink) ? dependencyObject : null);
			BarItem item = ((BarItemLinkBase)val).Item;
			ILinksHolder val2 = (ILinksHolder)(object)((item is ILinksHolder) ? item : null);
			if (val2 != null)
			{
				base.InternalItems = (IList)new ObservableCollectionConverter<BarItemLinkBase, BarItemLinkElementWrapper>
				{
					Source = (IEnumerable)val2.Links,
					Selector = (BarItemLinkBase x) => new BarItemLinkElementWrapper((BarItemLink)x, this, base.SkipCustomizations, base.CustomizationHost, base.InheritanceSource)
				};
			}
			BarItem item2 = ((BarItemLinkBase)val).Item;
			if (item2 == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CanChangeContent = false;
			base.CanHide = false;
			base.CanMoveInternal = false;
			base.Content = item2.ActualCustomizationContent;
			if (base.Content == null && item2 is BarButtonGroup)
			{
				base.Content = RibbonControlLocalizer.GetString(RibbonControlStringId.RibbonCustomizationStrings_BarButtonGroupString);
			}
			base.ContentTemplate = item2.ContentTemplate;
			base.Glyph = item2.Glyph ?? item2.ActualCustomizationGlyph ?? item2.LargeGlyph ?? ((BarItemLinkBase)val).LinkControl.With((IBarItemLinkControl x) => x.ActualGlyph) ?? BarItemElementWrapper.DefaultGlyph;
			base.GlyphTemplate = item2.GlyphTemplate;
			base.HasGlyph = base.GlyphTemplate == null;
			base.HasGlyphTemplate = base.GlyphTemplate != null;
			base.Altitude = 0;
			base.IsDropDown = item2 is BarSplitButtonItem || item2 is BarSplitCheckItem;
			base.IsEditor = item2 is BarEditItem;
			base.IsMenu = item2 is BarSubItem;
			base.IsVisible = true;
			if (!base.SkipCustomizations)
			{
				base.CanChangeContent = true;
				base.CanMoveInternal = Parent is RibbonPageGroupElementWrapper;
				base.Altitude = 0;
				base.Content = ((BarItemLinkBase)val).UserContent.With(Convert.ToString).IfNot(string.IsNullOrEmpty) ?? item2.ActualCustomizationContent;
				if (base.Content == null && item2 is BarButtonGroup)
				{
					base.Content = RibbonControlLocalizer.GetString(RibbonControlStringId.RibbonCustomizationStrings_BarButtonGroupString);
				}
				base.IsRemoved = ((BarItemLinkBase)val).IsRemoved;
			}
		}

		protected override bool CanRemove()
		{
			return ParentGroup != null;
		}

		protected override string GetCaptionPropertyName()
		{
			return BarItemLinkBase.UserContentProperty.Name;
		}

		public Type GetItemType()
		{
			BarItemLinkBase obj = owner;
			BarItem val = ((obj != null) ? obj.Item : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				return ((object)val).GetType();
			}
			if (owner is BarItemLinkSeparator)
			{
				return typeof(BarItemSeparator);
			}
			if (owner is BarItemLinkMenuHeader)
			{
				return typeof(BarItemMenuHeader);
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

	internal class HierarchicalMergingHelper<TElement> : DispatcherObject where TElement : UIElement, IHierarchicalMergingSupport<TElement>
	{
		private TElement owner;

		private ObservableCollection<TElement> actualMergedChildren = new ObservableCollection<TElement>();

		private ObservableCollection<TElement> mergedChildren;

		private ReadOnlyObservableCollection<TElement> readonlyMergedChildren;

		private ReadOnlyObservableCollection<TElement> compositeMergedChildren;

		private CompositeCollection compositeMergedChildrenInternal;

		private ICollectionView compositeMergedChildrenViewInternal;

		private TElement mergedParent;

		private TElement actualMergedParent;

		private IDisposable linkLock;

		private IDisposable suspendLayout;

		private bool skipChildrenCheck;

		private DispatcherOperation remergeForceOperation;

		public TElement ActualMergedParent
		{
			get
			{
				return actualMergedParent;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!object.Equals(value, actualMergedParent))
				{
					TElement oldValue = actualMergedParent;
					actualMergedParent = value;
					OnActualMergedParentChanged(oldValue);
				}
			}
		}

		public TElement MergedParent
		{
			get
			{
				return mergedParent;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!object.Equals(value, mergedParent))
				{
					TElement oldValue = mergedParent;
					mergedParent = value;
					OnMergedParentChanged(oldValue);
				}
			}
		}

		public ObservableCollection<TElement> ActualMergedChildren => actualMergedChildren;

		public ReadOnlyObservableCollection<TElement> CompositeMergedChildren => compositeMergedChildren;

		public ReadOnlyObservableCollection<TElement> MergedChildren => readonlyMergedChildren;

		private ICollectionView CompositeMergedChildrenInternal => compositeMergedChildrenViewInternal;

		public HierarchicalMergingHelper(TElement owner)
		{
			this.owner = owner;
			mergedChildren = new ObservableCollection<TElement>();
			readonlyMergedChildren = new ReadOnlyObservableCollection<TElement>(mergedChildren);
			compositeMergedChildrenInternal = new CompositeCollection();
			compositeMergedChildrenViewInternal = ((ICollectionViewFactory)compositeMergedChildrenInternal).CreateView();
			ObservableCollectionConverter<TElement, TElement> list = new ObservableCollectionConverter<TElement, TElement>
			{
				Selector = SelectorFunc,
				Source = CompositeMergedChildrenInternal
			};
			compositeMergedChildren = new ReadOnlyObservableCollection<TElement>((ObservableCollection<TElement>)(object)list);
			((INotifyCollectionChanged)MergedChildren).CollectionChanged += OnMergedChildrenCollectionChanged;
			((INotifyCollectionChanged)CompositeMergedChildren).CollectionChanged += OnCompositeMergedChildrenCollectionChanged;
		}

		private TElement SelectorFunc(TElement source)
		{
			return source;
		}

		private void OnMergedParentChanged(TElement oldValue)
		{
			owner.MergedParent = MergedParent;
			ReMergeAsync();
		}

		protected virtual void OnActualMergedParentChanged(TElement oldValue)
		{
			if (linkLock != null)
			{
				linkLock.Dispose();
			}
			if (ActualMergedParent != null)
			{
				linkLock = BarNameScope.GetService<IItemToLinkBinderService>((object)owner).Lock();
			}
			else
			{
				linkLock = null;
			}
		}

		public void Merge(TElement child)
		{
			if (child != null && !MergedChildren.Contains(child) && child.MergedParent == null)
			{
				suspendLayout = suspendLayout ?? ContextLayoutManagerHelper.SuspendLayout((UIElement)owner);
				mergedChildren.Add(child);
			}
		}

		public void UnMerge(TElement child)
		{
			if (child != null && MergedChildren.Contains(child))
			{
				suspendLayout = suspendLayout ?? ContextLayoutManagerHelper.SuspendLayout((UIElement)owner);
				mergedChildren.Remove(child);
			}
		}

		public void UnMerge()
		{
			while (mergedChildren.Count > 0)
			{
				mergedChildren.RemoveAt(0);
			}
		}

		public void ReMergeAsync()
		{
			ReMergeAsync(skipChildrenCheck: false);
		}

		public void ReMergeAsync(bool skipChildrenCheck)
		{
			RibbonControlHelper.SetMergingStatus(owner, MergingStatus.Pending);
			this.skipChildrenCheck = skipChildrenCheck;
			if (owner.AsyncMergingEnabled)
			{
				DispatcherPriority priority = DispatcherPriority.Render;
				WeakReference wr = new WeakReference(this);
				remergeForceOperation = remergeForceOperation ?? base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
				{
					(wr.Target as HierarchicalMergingHelper<TElement>).Do(ReMergeForceStatic);
				}, priority);
			}
			else
			{
				ReMergeForce();
			}
			owner.InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		private void ReMerge()
		{
			try
			{
				if (skipChildrenCheck || !ActualMergedChildren.All(CompositeMergedChildren.Contains) || !CompositeMergedChildren.All(ActualMergedChildren.Contains) || MergedParent != null)
				{
					owner.ReMerge();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (suspendLayout != null)
				{
					suspendLayout.Dispose();
					suspendLayout = null;
				}
				skipChildrenCheck = false;
			}
		}

		private static void ReMergeForceStatic(HierarchicalMergingHelper<TElement> target)
		{
			target.ReMergeForce();
		}

		public void ReMergeForce()
		{
			remergeForceOperation = null;
			TElement[] array = ActualMergedChildren.ToArray();
			TElement[] array2 = MergedChildren.ToArray();
			foreach (TElement val in array2)
			{
				val.Helper.ReMergeForce();
			}
			ReMerge();
			TElement[] array3 = array.Except(ActualMergedChildren).ToArray();
			TElement[] array4 = ActualMergedChildren.Except(array).ToArray();
			TElement[] array5 = array3;
			foreach (TElement val2 in array5)
			{
				val2.Helper.ReMergeForce();
			}
			TElement[] array6 = array4;
			foreach (TElement val3 in array6)
			{
				val3.Helper.ReMergeForce();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnMergedChildrenCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_004b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0050: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (e.NewItems != null)
			{
				foreach (TElement newItem in e.NewItems)
				{
					newItem.Helper.MergedParent = owner;
					if (newItem is IMergingSupport)
					{
						IMergingSupport val2 = (IMergingSupport)newItem;
						val2.IsAutomaticallyMerged &= MergingPropertiesHelper.IsAutomaticMergingInProcess((object)newItem);
					}
				}
			}
			if (e.OldItems != null)
			{
				foreach (TElement oldItem in e.OldItems)
				{
					oldItem.Helper.MergedParent = null;
					IMergingSupport val4 = (IMergingSupport)(object)((oldItem is IMergingSupport) ? oldItem : null);
					if (val4 != null)
					{
						if (!MergingPropertiesHelper.IsAutomaticUnMergingInProcess((object)val4) && val4.IsAutomaticallyMerged)
						{
							? val5 = BarNameScope.GetService<IMergingService>((object)owner);
							TElement val6 = owner;
							((IMergingService)val5).RemoveMergingRecord((IMergingSupport)(object)((val6 is IMergingSupport) ? val6 : null), val4);
							? val7 = BarNameScope.GetService<IMergingService>((object)val4);
							TElement val8 = owner;
							((IMergingService)val7).RemoveMergingRecord((IMergingSupport)(object)((val8 is IMergingSupport) ? val8 : null), val4);
						}
						val4.IsAutomaticallyMerged = true;
					}
				}
			}
			if (compositeMergedChildren.Count > 0)
			{
				compositeMergedChildrenInternal.Clear();
			}
			foreach (TElement mergedChild in MergedChildren)
			{
				compositeMergedChildrenInternal.Add(mergedChild);
				ReadOnlyObservableCollection<TElement> collection = mergedChild.Helper.CompositeMergedChildren;
				compositeMergedChildrenInternal.Add(new CollectionContainer
				{
					Collection = collection
				});
			}
			CompositeMergedChildrenInternal.Refresh();
		}

		protected virtual void OnCompositeMergedChildrenCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ReMergeAsync();
		}
	}
	public class ImageHelper
	{
		private static Dictionary<int, Dictionary<string, BitmapImage>> images = new Dictionary<int, Dictionary<string, BitmapImage>>();

		private static object olock = new object();

		private const string themeAssemblyPath = "/DevExpress.Xpf.Ribbon/Images/";

		private static Dictionary<string, BitmapImage> Images
		{
			get
			{
				lock (olock)
				{
					if (!images.ContainsKey(Thread.CurrentThread.ManagedThreadId))
					{
						images[Thread.CurrentThread.ManagedThreadId] = new Dictionary<string, BitmapImage>();
					}
				}
				return images[Thread.CurrentThread.ManagedThreadId];
			}
		}

		private static BitmapImage LoadImage(string imageName)
		{
			string name = $"DevExpress.Xpf.Ribbon.Images.{imageName}";
			using Stream stream = Assembly.GetExecutingAssembly().GetManifestResourceStream(name);
			return ImageHelper.CreateImageFromStream(stream);
		}

		public static BitmapImage GetImage(string imageName)
		{
			if (!Images.TryGetValue(imageName, out var value))
			{
				value = LoadImage(imageName);
				Images.Add(imageName, value);
			}
			return value;
		}

		public static BitmapImage GetThemeImage(string themeName, string imageName)
		{
			if (CommonThemeHelper.UseLightweightThemes)
			{
				Uri uri = ResourceDictionaryCache.GetUri(LightweightThemeManager.CurrentTheme.Assembly.Name, $"Images/{imageName}", false);
				return new BitmapImage(uri);
			}
			if (themeName == null || themeName.Length == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (themeName == "DeepBlue")
			{
				return null;
			}
			string themeAssemblyName = GetThemeAssemblyName(themeName);
			if (themeAssemblyName == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new BitmapImage(new Uri("/" + themeAssemblyName + ";component/DevExpress.Xpf.Ribbon/Images/" + imageName + ".png", UriKind.Relative));
		}

		private static string GetThemeAssemblyName(string themeName)
		{
			Theme val = Theme.FindTheme(themeName);
			if (val != null)
			{
				return val.AssemblyName;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static ImageSource GetSmallIcon(ImageSource originalImage)
		{
			BitmapFrame bitmapFrame = originalImage as BitmapFrame;
			BitmapDecoder bitmapDecoder = null;
			if (bitmapFrame == null)
			{
				if (!(originalImage is BitmapImage bitmapImage) || bitmapImage.UriSource == null || bitmapImage.BaseUri == null)
				{
					return originalImage;
				}
				bitmapDecoder = BitmapDecoder.Create(new Uri(bitmapImage.ToString()), BitmapCreateOptions.DelayCreation, BitmapCacheOption.Default);
			}
			else
			{
				bitmapDecoder = bitmapFrame.Decoder;
			}
			if (bitmapDecoder == null)
			{
				return originalImage;
			}
			BitmapFrame bitmapFrame2 = bitmapDecoder.Frames.FirstOrDefault((BitmapFrame f) => f.Width == 16.0);
			if (bitmapFrame2 == null)
			{
				bitmapFrame2 = bitmapDecoder.Frames.OrderBy((BitmapFrame f) => f.Width).First();
			}
			return bitmapFrame2;
		}
	}
	internal class RibbonSelectionHelper
	{
		internal static RibbonPage GetFirstVisiblePage(RibbonControl ribbon)
		{
			return ribbon.ActualCategories.Where((RibbonPageCategoryBase x) => x.ActualIsVisible).SelectMany((RibbonPageCategoryBase category) => category.ActualPages.Where((RibbonPage x) => !x.ShouldHide() && x.ActualIsVisible)).FirstOrDefault();
		}

		protected internal static RibbonPage SwitchPagesSelection(RibbonPage oldSelectedPage, int oldIndex)
		{
			oldSelectedPage = oldSelectedPage.With((RibbonPage x) => x.MergedParent ?? x);
			if (oldSelectedPage.PageCategory == null || oldIndex == -1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<RibbonPage> list = new List<RibbonPage>();
			RibbonPageCategoryBase oldSelectedCategory = oldSelectedPage.PageCategory.With((RibbonPageCategoryBase x) => x.MergedParent ?? x);
			oldIndex -= oldSelectedCategory.ActualPages.Count((RibbonPage i) => !i.IsVisible && (oldSelectedCategory.Pages.IndexOf(i) < oldIndex || oldSelectedCategory.CustomPages.IndexOf(i) + oldSelectedCategory.Pages.Count < oldIndex));
			if (oldSelectedPage.Ribbon == null)
			{
				list.AddRange(oldSelectedPage.PageCategory.ActualPages.Where((RibbonPage i) => i.IsVisible));
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (RibbonPageCategoryBase actualCategory in oldSelectedPage.Ribbon.ActualCategories)
				{
					list.AddRange(actualCategory.ActualPages.Where((RibbonPage i) => i.IsVisible));
					oldIndex += ((oldSelectedPage.Ribbon.ActualCategories.IndexOf(actualCategory) < oldSelectedPage.Ribbon.ActualCategories.IndexOf(oldSelectedPage.PageCategory)) ? actualCategory.ActualPages.Count((RibbonPage i) => i.IsVisible) : 0);
				}
			}
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			bool flag = list.Contains(oldSelectedPage);
			if (!flag && list.Count > oldIndex)
			{
				return list[Math.Max(0, oldIndex)];
			}
			if (flag && list.Count > oldIndex + 1)
			{
				return list[oldIndex + 1];
			}
			if (oldIndex > 0)
			{
				return list[oldIndex - 1];
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public interface IRibbonMergingSupport
	{
		object Content { get; }

		RibbonMergeType MergeType { get; }

		int? MergeOrder { get; }

		IRibbonMergingSupport MergedParent { get; }

		void Merge(IRibbonMergingSupport second);

		void Unmerge(IRibbonMergingSupport second);
	}
	public class MergedItemsCollection<TItem> : ObservableCollection<TItem> where TItem : class, IRibbonMergingSupport
	{
		private ObservableCollection<TItem> originItems;

		private readonly MultiDictionary<TItem, TItem> mergedItems;

		private readonly Locker updateLocker;

		private bool isMerged;

		public MergedItemsCollection(ObservableCollection<TItem> originItems)
		{
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0023: Expected O, but got Unknown
			this.originItems = originItems;
			mergedItems = new MultiDictionary<TItem, TItem>();
			updateLocker = new Locker();
			this.originItems.CollectionChanged += OnOriginItemsCollectionChanged;
			updateLocker.Unlocked += OnUpdateLockerUnlocked;
			SyncCollectionHelper.PopulateCore(this, originItems, (object x) => x);
		}

		private void OnOriginItemsCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!isMerged)
			{
				SyncCollectionHelper.SyncCollection(e, this, originItems, (object x) => x);
			}
		}

		public void Populate(IEnumerable<IList<TItem>> children)
		{
			Locker val = updateLocker.Lock();
			try
			{
				isMerged = false;
				Clear();
				foreach (TItem key in mergedItems.Keys)
				{
					foreach (TItem item in mergedItems[key].Reverse())
					{
						key.Unmerge(item);
					}
				}
				mergedItems.Clear();
				IList<TItem>[] array = (children as IList<TItem>[]) ?? children.ToArray();
				if (children == null || !array.Any())
				{
					foreach (TItem originItem in originItems)
					{
						Add(originItem);
					}
					return;
				}
				isMerged = true;
				List<TItem> list = new List<TItem>();
				foreach (TItem originItem2 in originItems)
				{
					list.Add(originItem2);
				}
				IList<TItem>[] array2 = array;
				foreach (IList<TItem> list2 in array2)
				{
					foreach (TItem item2 in list2)
					{
						list.Add(item2);
					}
				}
				for (int num = list.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					if (list[num].MergeType == RibbonMergeType.Remove || list[num].MergedParent != null)
					{
						list.RemoveAt(num);
					}
				}
				List<TItem> list3 = new List<TItem>();
				for (int num2 = list.Count - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
				{
					TItem val2 = list[num2];
					if (val2.MergeType == RibbonMergeType.Add)
					{
						list3.Add(val2);
					}
					else if (val2.MergeType == RibbonMergeType.Replace)
					{
						for (int num3 = num2 - 1; num3 >= 0; num3--)
						{
							TItem val3 = list[num3];
							if (object.Equals(val2.Content, val3.Content))
							{
								list.RemoveAt(num2);
								list.RemoveAt(num3);
								list.Insert(num3, val2);
								break;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < list.Count; j++)
				{
					TItem val4 = list[j];
					for (int k = j + 1; k < list.Count; k++)
					{
						TItem val5 = list[k];
						if (val5.MergeType == RibbonMergeType.MergeItems && !list3.Contains(val5) && object.Equals(val4.Content, val5.Content))
						{
							list.RemoveAt(k);
							k--;
							val4.Merge(val5);
							mergedItems.Add(val4, val5);
						}
					}
				}
				foreach (TItem item3 in from x in RibbonOrderedItemsHelper.SortByOrder(list.Select((TItem x, int index) => new RibbonOrderedItemInfo(index, x.MergeOrder, x)).ToArray())
					select x.Item as TItem)
				{
					Add(item3);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!updateLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				base.OnCollectionChanged(e);
			}
		}

		private void OnUpdateLockerUnlocked(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			OnCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset));
		}
	}

		protected override IEnumerator LogicalChildren
		{
			get
			{
				List<object> list = new List<object>();
				if (ApplicationMenu != null)
				{
					list.Add(ApplicationMenu);
				}
				if (RibbonPopupMenu != null)
				{
					list.Add(RibbonPopupMenu);
				}
				if (selectedPagePopup != null)
				{
					list.Add(selectedPagePopup);
				}
				foreach (RibbonPageCategoryBase selfCategory in SelfCategories)
				{
					list.Add(selfCategory);
				}
				if (PageHeaderLinksControl != null)
				{
					list.Add(PageHeaderLinksControl);
				}
				if (Toolbar != null)
				{
					list.Add(Toolbar);
				}
				list.AddRange(logicalChildrenContainerItems);
				return list.GetEnumerator();
			}
		}

		private void CheckContextualCategory()
		{
			foreach (RibbonPageCategoryBase actualCategory in ActualCategories)
			{
				if (!actualCategory.IsDefault && actualCategory.IsVisible)
				{
					isContextualCategoryExist = true;
					break;
				}
				isContextualCategoryExist = false;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnWindowServiceChanged(object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			WindowHelper.UpdateRibbonWindow();
			if (IsInRibbonWindow)
			{
				UpdateToolbarPlacement();
			}
			UpdateActualVisibility();
			UpdateActualApplicationIcon();
		}

		protected internal void UpdateWindow()
		{
			Window window = Window.GetWindow(this);
			OnWindowServiceChanged(window, window);
			if (window is IRibbonWindow && ((IRibbonWindow)((window is IRibbonWindow) ? window : null)).Ribbon != null)
			{
				RibbonControl obj = ((IRibbonWindow)((window is IRibbonWindow) ? window : null)).Ribbon as RibbonControl;
				if (obj != null && obj.RibbonStyle == RibbonStyle.Office2007)
				{
					((IRibbonWindow)((window is IRibbonWindow) ? window : null)).HideWindowIcon();
				}
				else
				{
					((IRibbonWindow)((window is IRibbonWindow) ? window : null)).ShowWindowIcon();
				}
				UpdateApplicationIconVisibility();
			}
		}

		private static object CoerceAutoHideMode(DependencyObject d, object baseValue)
		{
			RibbonControl ribbonControl = (RibbonControl)d;
			if (ribbonControl.IsInRibbonWindow && ribbonControl.IsAeroMode)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return baseValue;
		}

		{
			if (menuItems == null)
			{
				return false;

				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal bool RecalcNonForcedVisibility()
		{
			Locker val = recalcVisibilityLocker.Lock();
			try
			{
				Visibility? forcedVisibility = ForcedVisibility;
				ForcedVisibility = null;
				CoerceValue(UIElement.VisibilityProperty);
				try
				{
					return base.IsVisible;
				}
				finally
				{
					ForcedVisibility = forcedVisibility;
					CoerceValue(UIElement.VisibilityProperty);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		protected virtual object CoerceVisibility(object value)
		{
			//IL_0025: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002b: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0052: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0058: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (ForcedVisibility.HasValue)
			{
				return ForcedVisibility;
			}
			if (MergingProperties.GetHideElements((DependencyObject)this) && (int)MDIMergeStyle != 3 && HasMergingCandidates())
			{
				return Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			bool flag = MDIChildHost != null && !MDIChildHost.IsChildMenuVisible && (int)MDIMergeStyle != 3;
			if ((!IsInRibbonWindow && flag) || MergedParent != null)
			{
				return Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			return value;
		}

		private bool HasMergingCandidates()
		{
			object baseValue = msNameStorage.BaseValue;
			return (from x in BarNameScope.GetService<IElementRegistratorService>((object)this).GetElements<IMergingSupport>(baseValue, (ScopeSearchSettings)1)
				where BarNameScope.GetService<IMergingService>((object)x).CanMerge(x, (IMergingSupport)(object)this)
				select x).Any();
		}

		private void OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateIsInRibbonWindow();
			ExecuteControllers();
			if (Application.Current != null)
			{
				Application.Current.Deactivated -= applicationDeactivatedWeakEventHandler.Handler;
				Application.Current.Deactivated += applicationDeactivatedWeakEventHandler.Handler;
			}
			root = LayoutHelper.GetRoot((FrameworkElement)this);
			root.PreviewKeyDown -= OnPreviewKeyDown;
			root.PreviewKeyDown += OnPreviewKeyDown;
			root.PreviewTextInput -= OnPreviewTextInput;
			root.PreviewTextInput += OnPreviewTextInput;
			UpdateActualHeaderBorderTemplate();
			base.LayoutUpdated += OnLayoutUpdatedCore;
			IsFirstLayoutUptated = true;
			if (SelectedPage == null && ActualMergedParent == null && MergedParent == null)
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(SelectedPageName))
				{
					SelectedPage = GetFirstSelectablePage();
				}
				else
				{
					SelectedPage = FindPageByName(SelectedPageName);
				}
			}
			UpdateActualVisibility();
			MenuModeHelper.EnterMenuMode += onEnterMenuMode ?? (onEnterMenuMode = OnEnterMenuMode);
			UpdateWindow();
		}

		private void OnUnloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			ClearValue(IsInRibbonWindowPropertyKey);
			base.LayoutUpdated -= OnLayoutUpdatedCore;
			if (Application.Current != null)
			{
				Application.Current.Deactivated -= applicationDeactivatedWeakEventHandler.Handler;
			}
			if (root != null)
			{
				root.PreviewKeyDown -= OnPreviewKeyDown;
				root.PreviewTextInput -= OnPreviewTextInput;
				root = null;
			}
			KeyboardNavigationManager.IsNavigationMode = false;
			if (onEnterMenuMode != null)
			{
				MenuModeHelper.EnterMenuMode -= onEnterMenuMode;
			}
		}

		private double GetAeroContentOffset()
		{
			if (AeroBorderRibbonStyle == RibbonStyle.Office2007)
			{
				return Math.Round(HeaderBorder.RenderSize.Height + AeroBorderTopOffset);
			}
			if (IsMinimized && GetToolbarMode() != RibbonQuickAccessToolbarShowMode.ShowBelow)
			{
				return Math.Round(HeaderAndTabsGrid.RenderSize.Height + CollapsedRibbonAeroBorderTopOffset);
			}
			return Math.Round(HeaderAndTabsGrid.RenderSize.Height + AeroBorderTopOffset);
		}

		private void OnLayoutUpdatedCore(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_00be: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c4: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (IsFirstLayoutUptated)
			{
				IsFirstLayoutUptated = false;
				if (!DependencyObjectExtensions.IsInDesignTool((DependencyObject)this) && ApplicationMenu is BackstageViewControl && (ApplicationMenu as BackstageViewControl).IsOpen)
				{
					ShowApplicationMenu();
				}
			}
			if (TitlePanel != null && !TitlePanel.CheckWindowStateForMeasureAndArrange())
			{
				return;
			}
			UpdateActualWindowTitle();
			UpdateRibbonTitleBarVisibility();
			UpdateHeaderControlLocation();
			UpdateToolbarWidth();
			UpdateToolbarOffset();
			WindowHelper.UpdateRibbonVisibility();
			if (MergedParent != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (IsAeroMode)
			{
				double aeroContentHorizontalOffset = ((base.Visibility == Visibility.Collapsed) ? 0.0 : GetAeroContentOffset());
				WindowHelper.SetAeroContentHorizontalOffset(aeroContentHorizontalOffset);
			}
			else if (IsInRibbonWindow && (int)RibbonHeaderVisibility != 1 && HeaderBorder != null)
			{
				double num = ((base.Visibility == Visibility.Collapsed) ? 0.0 : HeaderBorder.RenderSize.Height);
				FrameworkElement controlBoxContainer = WindowHelper.GetControlBoxContainer();
				if (controlBoxContainer != null)
				{
					num = Math.Max(controlBoxContainer.DesiredSize.Height, num);
				}
				if (MergedParent != null)
				{
					WindowHelper.SetRibbonHeaderBorderHeight(num);
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateHeaderControlLocation()
		{
			if (CategoriesPane != null)
			{
				if (!ShowApplicationButton && (RibbonStyle == RibbonStyle.Office2007 || RibbonStyle == RibbonStyle.Office2010 || RibbonStyle == RibbonStyle.Office2019))
				{
					CategoriesPane.SetCurrentValue(Grid.ColumnProperty, 0);
					CategoriesPane.SetCurrentValue(Grid.ColumnSpanProperty, 3);
				}
				else
				{
					CategoriesPane.ClearValue(Grid.ColumnProperty);
					CategoriesPane.ClearValue(Grid.ColumnSpanProperty);
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateToolbarOffset()
		{
			if (HeaderToolbarContainer == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (ApplicationIconContainer != null && IsApplicationIconVisible && RibbonStyle != RibbonStyle.TabletOffice)
			{
				if (DXWindowsHelper.GetWindowKind((DependencyObject)this) == "ThemedWindow")
				{
					SetToolbarMargin();
				}
				else
				{
					HeaderToolbarContainer.SetCurrentValue(FrameworkElement.MarginProperty, new Thickness(ApplicationIconContainer.DesiredSize.Width, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				HeaderToolbarContainer.ClearValue(FrameworkElement.MarginProperty);
			}
		}

		private void SetToolbarMargin()
		{
			ContentControl contentControl = Icon;
			Window window = WindowHelper.Window;
			Window obj = ((window is IRibbonWindow) ? window : null);
			double num = contentControl.TranslatePoint(default(Point), (obj != null) ? ((IRibbonWindow)obj).GetWindowHeaderElement() : null).X;
			if (base.FlowDirection == FlowDirection.RightToLeft)
			{
				num = WindowHelper.Window.ActualWidth - num;
			}
			if (Icon != null)
			{
				double num2 = Icon.ActualWidth + num * 2.0 - WindowHelper.Window.Padding.Left + ((FirstSeparator != null) ? ((0.0 - FirstSeparator.ActualWidth) / 2.0) : 0.0);
				if (num2 < Icon.ActualWidth * 5.0)
				{
					HeaderToolbarContainer.SetCurrentValue(FrameworkElement.MarginProperty, new Thickness(num2, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0));
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateToolbarWidth()
		{
			if (HeaderToolbarContainer == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (RibbonStyle != RibbonStyle.TabletOffice && CategoriesPane != null && IsRibbonTitleBarActualVisible)
			{
				IEnumerable<RibbonPageCategoryBase> source = ActualCategories.Where((RibbonPageCategoryBase cat) => cat != DefaultCategory && cat.IsVisible);
				RibbonPageCategoryBase item = (IsMerged ? source.OrderBy((RibbonPageCategoryBase cat) => cat.MergeOrder).FirstOrDefault() : source.FirstOrDefault());
				RibbonPageCategoryControl ribbonPageCategoryControl = CategoriesPane.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(item) as RibbonPageCategoryControl;
				double minDesiredWidth = Toolbar.GetMinDesiredWidth();
				double val = double.PositiveInfinity;
				if (ribbonPageCategoryControl != null && ribbonPageCategoryControl.PageCategoryHeaderControl != null && (RibbonTitleBarVisibility != RibbonTitleBarVisibility.Collapsed || ribbonPageCategoryControl.PageCategoryHeaderControl.IsVisible))
				{
					val = ribbonPageCategoryControl.TranslatePoint(default(Point), HeaderToolbarContainer).X;
				}
				HeaderToolbarContainer.MaxWidth = Math.Max(val, minDesiredWidth);
			}
			else
			{
				HeaderToolbarContainer.ClearValue(FrameworkElement.MaxWidthProperty);
			}
		}
