		protected virtual void OnManagerChanged(BarManager oldManager, BarManager newManager)
		{
			if (Manager != null)
			{
				if (BarManagerHelper.GetChildRibbonControl(Manager) == null)
				{
					BarManagerHelper.SetChildRibbonControl(Manager, (object)this);
				}
				RaiseManagerChanged();
			}
		}

		internal FrameworkElement GetApplicationMenu()
		{
			if (ApplicationMenu is ApplicationMenu)
			{
				return (FrameworkElement)(object)(ApplicationMenu as ApplicationMenu);
			}
			if (ApplicationMenu is BackstageViewControl)
			{
				return ApplicationMenu as BackstageViewControl;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public bool IsMergedChild(RibbonControl item)
		{
			return ActualMergedChildren.Contains(item);
		}

		private RibbonPageCategoryBase FindCategoryByCaption(string caption)
		{
			return ActualCategories.FirstOrDefault((RibbonPageCategoryBase cat) => string.Equals(cat.Caption, caption));
		}

		protected virtual void MergeChild(RibbonControl childRibbon)
		{
			ActualMergedChildren.Add(childRibbon);
		}

		public void Merge(RibbonControl childRibbon)
		{
			HierarchicalMergingHelper.Merge(childRibbon);
		}

		public void UnMerge(RibbonControl childRibbon)
		{
			HierarchicalMergingHelper.UnMerge(childRibbon);
		}

		public void UnMerge()
		{
			while (MergedChildren.Count > 0)
			{
				UnMerge(MergedChildren[MergedChildren.Count - 1]);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnMergedParentChanged(RibbonControl oldValue)
		{
			CoerceValue(UIElement.VisibilityProperty);
			UpdateMergedParentPostponedActions(oldValue);
		}

		private void UpdateMergedParentPostponedActions(RibbonControl oldValue)
		{
			Queue<Action> postponedActions = CollectionActionHelper.GetPostponedActions((DependencyObject)this);
			if (postponedActions == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Queue<Action> resultQueue = new Queue<Action>();
			if (MergedParent == null)
			{
				List<Action> parentPostponedActions = CollectionActionHelper.GetPostponedActions((DependencyObject)oldValue)?.ToList();
				if (parentPostponedActions != null && postponedActions.Aggregate(seed: false, (bool cur, Action action) => cur | parentPostponedActions.Remove(action)))
				{
					parentPostponedActions.ForEach(resultQueue.Enqueue);
					CollectionActionHelper.SetPostponedActions((DependencyObject)oldValue, resultQueue);
				}
				return;
			}
			Queue<Action> queue = ((oldValue != null) ? CollectionActionHelper.GetPostponedActions((DependencyObject)oldValue) : null);
			if (queue != null)
			{
				queue.ForEach(resultQueue.Enqueue);
				postponedActions.Where((Action postponedAction) => !resultQueue.Contains(postponedAction)).ForEach(resultQueue.Enqueue);
			}
			else
			{
				postponedActions.ForEach(resultQueue.Enqueue);
			}
			CollectionActionHelper.SetPostponedActions((DependencyObject)MergedParent, resultQueue);
		}

		protected virtual void MergeCore(RibbonControl childRibbon, bool isNewChild, ref RibbonPage selectedPage, ref object selectedPageCaption, RibbonPage unmergedSelectedPage, object unmergedSelectedPageCaption)
		{
			if (MergedParent != null || childRibbon.ActualMergedParent != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			CheckMergingUniqueItems(childRibbon);
			childRibbon.ExecuteControllers();
			childRibbon.SelectedPageBeforeMerging = childRibbon.SelectedPage;
			if (childRibbon.SelectedPageOnMerging != SelectedPageOnMerging.SelectedPage)
			{
				object currentSelectedPageCaption = SelectedPage.With((RibbonPage x) => x.Caption);
				string currentCategoryCaption = SelectedPage.With((RibbonPage x) => x.PageCategory).With((RibbonPageCategoryBase x) => x.Caption);
				bool currentCategoryIsDefault = SelectedPage.With((RibbonPage x) => x.PageCategory).Return((RibbonPageCategoryBase x) => x.IsDefault, () => false);
				if (!UseCaptionToIdentifyPagesOnMerging)
				{
					_ = SelectedPage;
					_ = childRibbon.SelectedPage;
				}
				if (UseCaptionToIdentifyPagesOnMerging)
				{
					RibbonPage ribbonPage = (from x in (from x in childRibbon.ActualCategories
							where x.MergeType != RibbonMergeType.Remove
							where (x.IsDefault && currentCategoryIsDefault) || currentCategoryCaption == x.Caption
							select x).SelectMany((RibbonPageCategoryBase x) => x.ActualPages)
						where x.MergeType != RibbonMergeType.Remove
						select x).FirstOrDefault((RibbonPage x) => object.Equals(x.Caption, currentSelectedPageCaption));
					if (ribbonPage == null)
					{
						childRibbon.SelectedPage = null;
						childRibbon.SelectedPage.With((RibbonPage x) => x.PageCategory as RibbonPageCategory).Do(delegate(RibbonPageCategory x)
						{
							x.IsSelected = false;
						});
					}
					else
					{
						childRibbon.SelectedPage = ribbonPage;
						selectedPageCaption = currentSelectedPageCaption;
						ribbonPage.IsSelected = true;
					}
				}
				else if (SelectedPage != childRibbon.SelectedPage)
				{
					childRibbon.SelectedPage = null;
					childRibbon.SelectedPage.With((RibbonPage x) => x.PageCategory as RibbonPageCategory).Do(delegate(RibbonPageCategory x)
					{
						x.IsSelected = false;
					});
				}
			}
			childRibbon.MergedParentSelectedPage = unmergedSelectedPage;
			childRibbon.MergedParentSelectedPageCaption = unmergedSelectedPageCaption;
			MergeChild(childRibbon);
			childRibbon.ActualMergedParent = this;
			((ILinksHolder)Toolbar).Merge((ILinksHolder)(object)childRibbon.Toolbar);
			((ILinksHolder)PageHeaderLinksControl).Merge((ILinksHolder)(object)childRibbon.PageHeaderLinksControl);
			childRibbon.ApplicationMenuChanged += OnChildRibbonApplicationMenuChanged;
			MergeApplicationMenu(childRibbon);
			IsMerged = true;
			if (!base.IsLoaded && SelectedPageControl.GetPageGroupCount() != 0)
			{
				RibbonPageGroupControl pageGroupControlFromIndex = SelectedPageControl.GetPageGroupControlFromIndex(0);
				DependencyObject dependencyObject = (DependencyObject)(object)pageGroupControlFromIndex;
				while (dependencyObject is UIElement && !(dependencyObject is RibbonPagesControl))
				{
					((UIElement)dependencyObject).InvalidateMeasure();
					dependencyObject = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject);
				}
			}
			if (isNewChild && childRibbon.SelectedPageOnMerging == SelectedPageOnMerging.SelectedPage)
			{
				selectedPage = childRibbon.SelectedPage.With((RibbonPage x) => x.MergedParent ?? x);
				selectedPageCaption = selectedPage.With((RibbonPage x) => x.Caption);
			}
		}

		private void CheckMergingUniqueItems(RibbonControl childRibbon)
		{
			if (!Debugger.IsAttached)
			{
				return;
			}
			BarManager barManager = BarManager.GetBarManager((DependencyObject)this);
			BarManager childBarManager = BarManager.GetBarManager((DependencyObject)childRibbon);
			if (barManager == null || childBarManager == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			string text = ((string.IsNullOrEmpty(base.Name) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(childRibbon.Name)) ? "RibbonControl instances contain the duplication {0} item. This may lead to memory leaks. \r\nChange the item's x:Name (or BarItemName) property value in one of these Ribbon instances." : $"{base.Name} and {childRibbon.Name} RibbonControl instances contain duplicated {{0}} items. This may lead to memory leaks. \r\nChange the item's x:Name (or BarItemName) property value in one of these Ribbon instances.");
			((IEnumerable<BarItem>)barManager.Items).ForEach(delegate(BarItem x)
			{
				((IEnumerable<BarItem>)childBarManager.Items).Any((BarItem y) => y.BarItemName.Equals(x.BarItemName));
			});
		}

		protected virtual void UnMergeCore(RibbonControl childRibbon, ref RibbonPage selectedPage, ref object selectedPageCaption, bool skipUpdateSelection)
		{
			if (childRibbon.ActualMergedParent != this)
			{
				return;
			}
			childRibbon.ActualMergedParent = null;
			((ILinksHolder)Toolbar).UnMerge((ILinksHolder)(object)childRibbon.Toolbar);
			((ILinksHolder)PageHeaderLinksControl).UnMerge((ILinksHolder)(object)childRibbon.PageHeaderLinksControl);
			childRibbon.ApplicationMenuChanged -= OnChildRibbonApplicationMenuChanged;
			UnMergeApplicationMenu(childRibbon);
			UnMergeChild(childRibbon, ref selectedPage, ref selectedPageCaption, skipUpdateSelection);
			if (ActualMergedChildren.Count == 0)
			{
				FrameworkElement applicationMenu = GetApplicationMenu();
				if (applicationMenu is ApplicationMenu && ((ApplicationMenu)(object)applicationMenu).isFake)
				{
					SetCurrentValue(ApplicationMenuProperty, null);
				}
				if (applicationMenu is BackstageViewControl && ((BackstageViewControl)applicationMenu).isFake)
				{
					SetCurrentValue(ApplicationMenuProperty, null);
				}
				IsMerged = false;
			}
			childRibbon.UpdateActualVisibility();
		}

		protected virtual void OnChildRibbonApplicationMenuChanged(object sender, RoutedValueChangedEventArgs<DependencyObject> args)
		{
			UnMergeApplicationMenu((FrameworkElement)(object)(args.OldValue as ApplicationMenu));
			MergeApplicationMenu((FrameworkElement)(object)(args.NewValue as ApplicationMenu));
		}

		void IHierarchicalMergingSupport<RibbonControl>.ReMerge()
		{
			try
			{
				RibbonControlHelper.SetMergingStatus(this, MergingStatus.Executing);
				ReMerge();
			}
			finally
			{
				RibbonControlHelper.SetMergingStatus(this, MergingStatus.Completed);
			}
		}

		void IRibbonControl.ReMerge()
		{
			RequestReMerge(force: false);
		}

		public virtual void RequestReMerge()
		{
			RequestReMerge(force: true);
		}

		protected virtual void RequestReMerge(bool force)
		{
			HierarchicalMergingHelper.ReMergeAsync(force);
		}

		protected virtual void ReMerge()
		{
			object selectedPageCaption = SelectedPage.With((RibbonPage x) => x.Caption);
			RibbonPage selectedPage = SelectedPage;
			List<RibbonControl> list = ActualMergedChildren.AsEnumerable().Reverse().ToList();
			foreach (RibbonControl item in list)
			{
				UnMergeCore(item, ref selectedPage, ref selectedPageCaption, CompositeMergedChildren.Contains(item));
			}
			foreach (RibbonControl item2 in CompositeMergedChildren.ToList())
			{
				MergeCore(item2, !list.Contains(item2), ref selectedPage, ref selectedPageCaption, selectedPage, selectedPageCaption);
			}
			actualCategoriesCore.Populate(ActualMergedChildren.Select((RibbonControl x) => x.SelfCategories).ToList());
			DefaultCategory = actualCategoriesCore.OfType<RibbonDefaultPageCategory>().SingleOrDefault();
			if (CategoriesPane != null && CategoriesPane.RibbonItemsPanel != null)
			{
				CategoriesPane.RibbonItemsPanel.InvalidateMeasure();
			}
			UpdateSelectedPageAfterMerging(selectedPageCaption, selectedPage, UseCaptionToIdentifyPagesOnMerging ? (selectedPageCaption != SelectedPage.With((RibbonPage x) => x.Caption)) : (selectedPage != SelectedPage));
			foreach (RibbonControl item3 in list)
			{
				if (item3.ActualMergedParent != null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				bool flag = item3.SelectedPageBeforeMerging.Return((RibbonPage x) => x.IsSelected, () => false);
				RibbonPage selectedPage2 = SelectedPage;
				item3.SelectedPage = item3.SelectedPageBeforeMerging;
				if (flag)
				{
					RibbonPage selectedPage3 = item3.SelectedPage;
					if (selectedPage3 != null)
					{
						selectedPage3.SetCurrentValue(RibbonPage.IsSelectedProperty, false);
						selectedPage3.SetCurrentValue(RibbonPage.IsSelectedProperty, true);
					}
				}
				item3.SelectedPageBeforeMerging = null;
				if (item3.SelectedPage == null || item3.SelectedPage.Ribbon != item3)
				{
					item3.SelectFirstVisiblePage(ignoreSelectedPageValue: true);
				}
				item3.HierarchicalMergingHelper.ReMergeAsync();
				if (SelectedPage == null)
				{
					SetCurrentValue(SelectedPageProperty, selectedPage2);
				}
			}
			InvalidateAutomationTree();
			if (IsChild)
			{
				IsBackStageViewOpen = false;
			}
			UpdateCustomizations();
			GlobalRecyclingCacheCleaner.RequestCleanup();
		}

		protected internal void InvalidateAutomationTree()
		{
			try
			{
				RibbonTabsAutomationPeer tabsScrollViewer = RibbonControlAutomationPeer.GetTabsScrollViewer(this);
				if (tabsScrollViewer != null)
				{
					((AutomationPeer)(object)tabsScrollViewer).ResetChildrenCache();
					RaiseAutomationStructureChanged((AutomationPeer)(object)tabsScrollViewer);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (ActualMergedParent != null)
				{
					ActualMergedParent.InvalidateAutomationTree();
				}
			}
		}

		protected void RaiseAutomationStructureChanged(AutomationPeer peer)
		{
			if (AutomationPeer.ListenerExists(AutomationEvents.StructureChanged))
			{
				peer.RaiseAutomationEvent(AutomationEvents.StructureChanged);
				BarsAutomationHelper.RaiseAutomationStructureChanged((UIElement)this);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateSelectedPageAfterMerging(object selectedPageCaption, RibbonPage selectedPage, bool force)
		{
			if (MergedParent != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			RibbonPage ribbonPage = SelectedPage;
			if (UseCaptionToIdentifyPagesOnMerging)
			{
				selectedPage = FindPageByCaption(selectedPageCaption);
				ribbonPage = FindPageByCaption(SelectedPage.With((RibbonPage x) => x.Caption));
			}
			if (!CanSelectPage(SelectedPage) || force)
			{
				if (CanSelectPage(ribbonPage) && !force)
				{
					selectedPage = ribbonPage;
				}
				SetCurrentValue(SelectedPageProperty, selectedPage);
			}
			if (SelectedPage == null || !SelectedPage.IsSelectable)
			{
				SelectedPage = GetFirstSelectablePage();
			}
			SelectedPage.Do(delegate(RibbonPage x)
			{
				x.SetCurrentValue(RibbonPage.IsSelectedProperty, true);
			});
		}

		private RibbonPage FindPageByCaption(object caption)
		{
			return ActualCategories.SelectMany((RibbonPageCategoryBase x) => x.ActualPages).FirstOrDefault((RibbonPage x) => object.Equals(x.Caption, caption));
		}

		protected virtual void UnMergeChild(RibbonControl childRibbon, ref RibbonPage selectedPage, ref object selectedPageName, bool skipUpdateSelection)
		{
			if (!skipUpdateSelection && (selectedPage == null || selectedPage.Ribbon != this))
			{
				selectedPage = childRibbon.MergedParentSelectedPage;
				selectedPageName = childRibbon.MergedParentSelectedPageCaption;
			}
			childRibbon.MergedParentSelectedPage = null;
			childRibbon.MergedParentSelectedPageCaption = null;
			ActualMergedChildren.Remove(childRibbon);
		}

		private bool CanSelectPage(RibbonPage page)
		{
			if (page == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return ActualCategories.SelectMany((RibbonPageCategoryBase x) => x.ActualPages).Contains(page);
		}

		private bool CanSelectPage(object pageCaption)
		{
			return CanSelectPage(FindPageByCaption(pageCaption));
		}

		private bool CanSelectPage(RibbonPage page, object caption)
		{
			if (UseCaptionToIdentifyPagesOnMerging)
			{
				return CanSelectPage(caption);
			}
			return CanSelectPage(page);
		}

		protected virtual void MergeApplicationMenu(FrameworkElement childMenu)
		{
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = GetApplicationMenu();
			if (frameworkElement == null)
			{
				if (childMenu is BackstageViewControl)
				{
					frameworkElement = new BackstageViewControl();
					((BackstageViewControl)frameworkElement).isFake = true;
				}
				if (childMenu is ApplicationMenu)
				{
					frameworkElement = (FrameworkElement)(object)new ApplicationMenu();
					((ApplicationMenu)(object)frameworkElement).isFake = true;
				}
				SetCurrentValue(ApplicationMenuProperty, frameworkElement);
			}
			if (frameworkElement is ApplicationMenu && frameworkElement is ApplicationMenu applicationMenu && childMenu is ApplicationMenu)
			{
				((ILinksHolder)applicationMenu).Merge((ILinksHolder)(object)(childMenu as ApplicationMenu));
			}
			if (frameworkElement is BackstageViewControl && frameworkElement is BackstageViewControl backstageViewControl && childMenu is BackstageViewControl)
			{
				backstageViewControl.Merge(childMenu as BackstageViewControl);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UnMergeApplicationMenu(FrameworkElement childMenu)
		{
			FrameworkElement applicationMenu = GetApplicationMenu();
			if (applicationMenu is ApplicationMenu)
			{
				if (applicationMenu is ApplicationMenu applicationMenu2 && childMenu is ApplicationMenu)
				{
					((ILinksHolder)applicationMenu2).UnMerge((ILinksHolder)(object)(childMenu as ApplicationMenu));
				}
			}
			else if (applicationMenu is BackstageViewControl && applicationMenu is BackstageViewControl backstageViewControl && childMenu is BackstageViewControl)
			{
				backstageViewControl.Unmerge(childMenu as BackstageViewControl);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void MergeApplicationMenu(RibbonControl childRibbon)
		{
			MergeApplicationMenu(childRibbon.GetApplicationMenu());
		}

		protected virtual void UnMergeApplicationMenu(RibbonControl childRibbon)
		{
			UnMergeApplicationMenu(childRibbon.GetApplicationMenu());
		}

		private void ExecuteControllers()
		{
			if (!controllersExecuted)
			{
				ControllerBehavior.Execute((DependencyObject)null);
			}
			controllersExecuted = true;
		}

		public virtual void SaveDefaultLayout()
		{
			RuntimeCustomizations.Save();
		}

		public void RestoreDefaultLayout()
		{
			RuntimeCustomizations.Undo(true, false);
		}

		protected internal virtual string GetSerializationAppName()
		{
			return typeof(RibbonControl).Name;
		}

		private RibbonSerializationCompatibilityHelper CreateSerializationCompatibilityHelper()
		{
			return new RibbonSerializationCompatibilityHelper();
		}

		public virtual void RestoreLayout(object path)
		{
			try
			{
				if (!SerializationCompatibilityHelper.RestoreLayout(this, path))
				{
					DXSerializer.Deserialize((DependencyObject)this, path, GetSerializationAppName(), (DXOptionsLayout)null);
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				RaiseRestoreLayoutException(ex);
			}
		}

		public virtual void SaveLayout(object path)
		{
			try
			{
				DXSerializer.Serialize((DependencyObject)this, path, GetSerializationAppName(), (DXOptionsLayout)null);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				RaiseSaveLayoutException(ex);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void SubscribeTemplateEvents()
		{
			if (ApplicationButton != null)
			{
				ApplicationButton.Ribbon = this;
				ApplicationButton.Click += OnApplicationButtonClick;
			}
			if (ApplicationIconContainer != null)
			{
				ApplicationIconContainer.MouseLeftButtonDown += OnApplicationIconContainerMouseLeftButtonDown;
				ApplicationIconContainer.MouseDoubleClick += OnApplicationIconContainerMouseDoubleClick;
			}
			if (HeaderBorder != null)
			{
				HeaderBorder.PreviewMouseDown += OnHeaderBorderPreviewMouseDown;
			}
			if (HeaderToolbarContainer != null)
			{
				HeaderToolbarContainer.SizeChanged += OnHeaderToolbarContainerSizeChanged;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UnsubscribeTemplateEvents()
		{
			if (ApplicationButton != null)
			{
				ApplicationButton.Ribbon = null;
				ApplicationButton.Click -= OnApplicationButtonClick;
			}
			if (ApplicationIconContainer != null)
			{
				ApplicationIconContainer.MouseLeftButtonDown -= OnApplicationIconContainerMouseLeftButtonDown;
				ApplicationIconContainer.MouseDoubleClick -= OnApplicationIconContainerMouseDoubleClick;
			}
			if (HeaderBorder != null)
			{
				HeaderBorder.PreviewMouseDown -= OnHeaderBorderPreviewMouseDown;
			}
			if (HeaderToolbarContainer != null)
			{
				HeaderToolbarContainer.SizeChanged -= OnHeaderToolbarContainerSizeChanged;
			}
		}

		private void OnHeaderToolbarContainerSizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (CategoriesPane != null && CategoriesPane.RibbonItemsPanel != null)
			{
				CategoriesPane.RibbonItemsPanel.InvalidateMeasure();
			}
		}

		private void OnApplicationIconContainerMouseDoubleClick(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			WindowHelper.Close();
		}

		private void OnHeaderBorderPreviewMouseDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (CanDragRibbonWindow())
			{
				WindowHelper.DragOrMaximizeWindow(sender, e);
			}
		}

		private void OnApplicationIconContainerMouseLeftButtonDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.IsVisible)
			{
				WindowHelper.ShowSystemMenu(HeaderBorder, new Point(0.0, HeaderBorder.RenderSize.Height));
			}
		}

		private RibbonSelectedPagePopup CreateSelectedPagePopup()
		{
			RibbonSelectedPagePopup ribbonSelectedPagePopup = new RibbonSelectedPagePopup();
			ribbonSelectedPagePopup.Ribbon = this;
			BarManager.SetSkipMeasureByDockPanelLayoutHelper((DependencyObject)(object)ribbonSelectedPagePopup, true);
			AddLogicalChild(ribbonSelectedPagePopup);
			return ribbonSelectedPagePopup;
		}

		protected internal bool ApplicationMenuIsPopupMenu()
		{
			return ApplicationMenu is ApplicationMenu;
		}

		public virtual void CloseApplicationMenu()
		{
			if (ApplicationMenuStrategy != null)
			{
				ApplicationMenuStrategy.Close();
			}
		}

		protected internal bool ShowApplicationMenu()
		{
			if (ApplicationMenuStrategy == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ApplicationMenuStrategy.Open();
			return ApplicationMenuStrategy.IsMenuOpened;
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnApplicationButtonClick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (ApplicationButton.IsChecked)
			{
				CloseApplicationMenu();
			}
			else
			{
				ShowApplicationMenu();
			}
		}

		protected virtual object OnIsMinimizedCoerce(object baseValue)
		{
			if (!AllowMinimizeRibbon || AutoHideMode)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return baseValue;
		}

		protected virtual object OnAllowSimplifiedRibbonCoerce(object baseValue)
		{
			if (RibbonStyle == RibbonStyle.TabletOffice || RibbonStyle == RibbonStyle.OfficeSlim)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return baseValue;
		}

		protected virtual object OnIsSimplifiedCoerce(object baseValue)
		{
			if (!AllowSimplifiedRibbon)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return baseValue;
		}

		private void UpdateSelectedPageControlPlacement()
		{
			if (IsMinimized)
			{
				if (SelectedPageControlContainer != null)
				{
					SelectedPageControlContainer.Content = null;
				}
				((RibbonSelectedPageContentPresenter)((PopupBase)SelectedPagePopup).PopupContent).Content = SelectedPageControl;
				SelectedPageControl.IsPopup = true;
			}
			else
			{
				((RibbonSelectedPageContentPresenter)((PopupBase)SelectedPagePopup).PopupContent).Content = null;
				SelectedPageControl.IsPopup = false;
				if (SelectedPageControlContainer != null)
				{
					SelectedPageControlContainer.Content = SelectedPageControl;
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsMinimizedChanged(bool oldValue)
		{
			if (!IsMinimized)
			{
				ClosePopup();
			}
			UpdateSelectedPageControlPlacement();
			if (SelectedPageControl != null)
			{
				SelectedPageControl.Reset();
				SelectedPageControl.RecreateEditors();
			}
			else
			{
				UpdateSelectedPageControlPlacement();
				SelectedPagePopup.RecreateEditors();
				IsMinimizedRibbonCollapsed = true;
				CloseAllPageGroupPopups();
			}
			UpdateCollapsedSelectedPageBorderVisibility();
			BarsAutomationHelper.RaiseAutomationStructureChanged((UIElement)this);
			BarsAutomationHelper.RaiseAutomationStructureChanged((UIElement)SelectedPageControl);
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsSimplifiedChanged(bool oldValue)
		{
			UpdateActualMinimizationButtonVisibility();
			if (!IsSimplified && SelectedPageControl != null)
			{
				SelectedPageControl.Reset();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateCollapsedSelectedPageBorderVisibility()
		{
			if (CollapsedSelectedPageBorder != null)
			{
				CollapsedSelectedPageBorder.Visibility = ((!IsMinimized || GetToolbarMode() == RibbonQuickAccessToolbarShowMode.ShowBelow) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnPageCategoryIsVisibleChanged(RibbonPageCategoryBase category)
		{
			if (!category.IsVisible && category.MergedParent == null)
			{
				if (ActualMergedParent != null)
				{
					ActualMergedParent.OnPageCategoryIsVisibleChanged(category);
				}
				else if (ActualCategories.Contains(category) && SelectedPage.With((RibbonPage x) => x.PageCategory) == category)
				{
					SelectFirstVisiblePage(ignoreSelectedPageValue: true);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnPageNameChanged(RibbonPage page)
		{
			if (SelectedPage == page)
			{
				Locker val = selectedPageNameLocker.Lock();
				try
				{
					SelectedPageName = page.Name;
				}
				finally
				{
					((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
				}
				if (MergedParent != null)
				{
					MergedParent.OnPageNameChanged(page);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnPageCaptionChanged(RibbonPage page)
		{
			if (MergedParent != null)
			{
				MergedParent.OnPageCaptionChanged(page);
			}
			else
			{
				RequestReMerge(force: true);
			}
		}

		private void OnSelectedPageChangedLocked(RibbonPage oldValue)
		{
			//IL_001d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0023: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (oldValue == SelectedPage)
			{
				return;
			}
			if ((int)RibbonHeaderVisibility == 1)
			{
				((IMutableNavigationSupport)this).RaiseChanged();
			}
			selectedPageNameLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
			{
				if (SelectedPage != null)
				{
					bool isSelected = SelectedPage.IsSelected;
					SelectedPage.SetCurrentValue(RibbonPage.IsSelectedProperty, true);
					if (isSelected)
					{
						OnPageIsSelectedChanged(SelectedPage, EventArgs.Empty);
					}
					SetCurrentValue(SelectedPageNameProperty, SelectedPage.Name);
				}
				else
				{
					SetCurrentValue(SelectedPageNameProperty, null);
				}
			});
			selectedPageChangedLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
			{
				if (oldValue != null)
				{
					oldValue.SetCurrentValue(RibbonPage.IsSelectedProperty, false);
				}
			});
			RaisePropertyChanged(selectedPageChangedEventHandler, new RibbonPropertyChangedEventArgs(oldValue, SelectedPage));
		}

		{
			if (Toolbar != null)
			{
				((ContentElement)(object)Toolbar).IsEnabled = !IsBackStageViewOpen;
			}
			if (IsBackStageViewOpen)
			{
				if (AutoHideControl != null)
				{
					AutoHideControl.SetCurrentValue(RibbonAutoHideControl.IsRibbonShownProperty, false);
				}
				ShowApplicationMenu();
				RaiseBackstageOpened();
				FocusObserver.SaveFocus(true);
			}
			else
			{
				CloseApplicationMenu();
				RaiseBackstageClosed();
				FocusObserver.RestoreFocus(false, (Func<bool>)null);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnSelectedPageNameChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			selectedPageNameLocker.DoIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
			{
				if (SelectedPageName == null && SelectedPage != null && !string.Equals(SelectedPage.Name, SelectedPageName))
				{
					SetCurrentValue(SelectedPageProperty, null);
				}
				else if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(SelectedPageName))
				{
					SetCurrentValue(SelectedPageProperty, FindPageByName(SelectedPageName));
				}
			});
		}

		protected RibbonPage FindPageByName(string pageName)
		{
			return ActualCategories.SelectMany((RibbonPageCategoryBase x) => x.ActualPages).FirstOrDefault((RibbonPage x) => x.Name == pageName);
		}

		protected internal virtual void OpenPopup()
		{
			if (((Popup)(object)SelectedPagePopup).Child is Control control)
			{
				control.FontSize = base.FontSize;
				control.FontWeight = base.FontWeight;
				control.FontStretch = base.FontStretch;
				control.FontStyle = base.FontStyle;
				control.FontFamily = base.FontFamily;
			}
			((Popup)(object)SelectedPagePopup).HorizontalOffset = SelectedPagePopupMargin.Left;
			((Popup)(object)SelectedPagePopup).VerticalOffset = SelectedPagePopupMargin.Top;
			((FrameworkElement)(object)SelectedPagePopup).Width = GetPopupWidth();
			((BarPopupBase)SelectedPagePopup).ShowPopup((UIElement)HeaderAndTabsGrid);
			SelectedPageControl.InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateToolbarPlacement()
		{
			if (FooterToolbarContainer != null && HeaderToolbarContainer != null)
			{
				ClearToolbarContainers();
				switch (GetToolbarMode())
				{
				case RibbonQuickAccessToolbarShowMode.Default:
					HeaderToolbarContainer.Content = Toolbar.Control;
					UpdateAboveToolbarByRibbonStyle();
					FooterToolbarContainer.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
					break;
				case RibbonQuickAccessToolbarShowMode.ShowBelow:
					FooterToolbarContainer.Content = Toolbar.Control;
					Toolbar.SetPlacement(RibbonQuckAccessToolbarPlacement.Footer);
					FooterToolbarContainer.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
					break;
				default:
					FooterToolbarContainer.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
					break;
				}
				UpdateCollapsedSelectedPageBorderVisibility();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateAboveToolbarByRibbonStyle()
		{
			ActualHeaderQuickAccessToolbarContainerStyle = GetHeaderQuickAccessToolbarContainerStyle(RibbonStyle);
			Toolbar.SetPlacement(GetRibbonQuickAccessToolbarPlacement(RibbonStyle));
		}

		private RibbonQuckAccessToolbarPlacement GetRibbonQuickAccessToolbarPlacement(RibbonStyle style)
		{
			RibbonQuckAccessToolbarPlacement result = ((!IsAeroMode) ? RibbonQuckAccessToolbarPlacement.Header : RibbonQuckAccessToolbarPlacement.AeroHeader);
			if (RibbonStyle == RibbonStyle.Office2007)
			{
				result = (ShowApplicationButton ? ((!IsAeroMode) ? RibbonQuckAccessToolbarPlacement.Header : RibbonQuckAccessToolbarPlacement.AeroHeader) : RibbonQuckAccessToolbarPlacement.Title);
			}
			else if (IsInRibbonWindow && RibbonStyle != RibbonStyle.TabletOffice)
			{
				result = RibbonQuckAccessToolbarPlacement.Title;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private Style GetHeaderQuickAccessToolbarContainerStyle(RibbonStyle ribbonStyle)
		{
			switch (ribbonStyle)
			{
			case RibbonStyle.Office2007:
				return HeaderQuickAccessToolbarContainerOffice2007Style();
			case RibbonStyle.Office2010:
			case RibbonStyle.TabletOffice:
			case RibbonStyle.OfficeSlim:
			case RibbonStyle.Office2019:
				return HeaderQuickAccessToolbarContainerOffice2010Style();
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		private Style HeaderQuickAccessToolbarContainerOffice2007Style()
		{
			if (ShowApplicationButton)
			{
				if (IsInRibbonWindow)
				{
					if (!IsAeroMode)
					{
						return HeaderQAT2007ContainerStyleInRibbonWindow;
					}
					return HeaderQAT2007ContainerStyleInAeroWindow;
				}
				return HeaderQAT2007ContainerStyle;
			}
			if (IsInRibbonWindow)
			{
				if (!IsAeroMode)
				{
					return HeaderQATContainerStyleWithoutApplicationIcon;
				}
				return HeaderQATContainerStyleWithoutAppIconInAeroWindow;
			}
			return HeaderQAT2010ContainerStyle;
		}

		private Style HeaderQuickAccessToolbarContainerOffice2010Style()
		{
			if (IsInRibbonWindow)
			{
				if (!IsAeroMode)
				{
					return HeaderQAT2010ContainerStyleInRibbonWindow;
				}
				return HeaderQAT2010ContainerStyleInAeroWindow;
			}
			return HeaderQAT2010ContainerStyle;
		}

		protected virtual bool CalculateIsMinimizationButtonVisible()
		{
			bool flag = true;
			flag = ((MinimizationButtonVisibility != RibbonMinimizationButtonVisibility.Auto) ? (MinimizationButtonVisibility == RibbonMinimizationButtonVisibility.Visible) : ((RibbonStyle != RibbonStyle.Office2007 && AllowMinimizeRibbon) || AllowSimplifiedRibbon));
			if (!AutoHideMode || !flag)
			{
				return flag;
			}
			if (AutoHideMode && MinimizationButtonPosition == MinimizationButtonPosition.PageContent)
			{
				return AllowSimplifiedRibbon;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsAllCategoriesHidden()
		{
			return !ActualCategories.Where((RibbonPageCategoryBase cat) => !cat.IsDefault).Any((RibbonPageCategoryBase cat) => cat.IsVisible);
		}

		private bool CanCollapseRibbonHeader()
		{
			if (IsInRibbonWindow)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (RibbonStyle == RibbonStyle.Office2007 && ShowApplicationButton)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateRibbonTitleBarVisibility()
		{
			if (CanCollapseRibbonHeader() && (RibbonTitleBarVisibility == RibbonTitleBarVisibility.Collapsed || (RibbonTitleBarVisibility == RibbonTitleBarVisibility.Auto && IsAllCategoriesHidden() && ToolbarShowMode != RibbonQuickAccessToolbarShowMode.Default)))
			{
				if (IsRibbonTitleBarActualVisible)
				{
					IsRibbonTitleBarActualVisible = false;
				}
			}
			else if (!IsRibbonTitleBarActualVisible)
			{
				IsRibbonTitleBarActualVisible = true;
			}
		}

		private Rect GetScreen(Point point)
		{
			foreach (Rect screenRect in ScreenHelper.GetScreenRects())
			{
				if (new Rect(screenRect.X, screenRect.Y, screenRect.Width - 1.0, screenRect.Height - 1.0).Contains(point))
				{
					return screenRect;
				}
			}
			return Rect.Empty;
		}

		public Rect GetMostAppropriateScreenRect()
		{
			Rect rect = new Rect(ScreenHelper.GetScreenPoint((FrameworkElement)this, default(Point)), ScreenHelper.GetScreenPoint((FrameworkElement)this, SizeHelper.ToPoint(base.RenderSize)));
			Rect result = default(Rect);
			Rect rect2 = default(Rect);
			foreach (Rect screenRect in ScreenHelper.GetScreenRects())
			{
				Rect rect3 = new Rect(screenRect.X, screenRect.Y, screenRect.Width - 1.0, screenRect.Height - 1.0);
				rect3.Intersect(rect);
				if (!rect3.IsEmpty && rect3.Width * rect3.Height > rect2.Width * rect2.Height)
				{
					rect2 = rect3;
					result = screenRect;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private double GetPopupWidth()
		{
			Thickness selectedPagePopupMargin = SelectedPagePopupMargin;
			Point screenPoint = ScreenHelper.GetScreenPoint((FrameworkElement)this, default(Point));
			Rect rect = GetMostAppropriateScreenRect();
			if (rect.Height * rect.Width == 0.0)
			{
				rect = ScreenHelper.GetScreenRects()[0];
			}
			if (base.FlowDirection == FlowDirection.RightToLeft)
			{
				screenPoint.X -= base.ActualWidth;
			}
			double num = screenPoint.X - rect.X;
			if (num < 0.0)
			{
				num = base.ActualWidth + num;
				selectedPagePopupMargin.Left = 0.0;
			}
			else if (num >= 0.0 && base.ActualWidth + num <= rect.Width)
			{
				num = base.ActualWidth;
			}
			else if (num + base.ActualWidth / 2.0 > rect.Width)
			{
				Rect screen = GetScreen(new Point(screenPoint.X + base.ActualWidth, screenPoint.Y));
				num = ((screen == Rect.Empty) ? (rect.Width - num) : ((num + base.ActualWidth) % rect.Width));
				selectedPagePopupMargin.Right = 0.0;
			}
			else
			{
				num = rect.Width - num;
			}
			return Math.Max(num - selectedPagePopupMargin.Left - selectedPagePopupMargin.Right, 0.0);
		}

		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			//IL_0180: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_018a: Expected O, but got Unknown
			UnsubscribeTemplateEvents();
			ClearToolbarContainers();
			if (PageHeaderLinksControlContainer != null)
			{
				PageHeaderLinksControlContainer.Content = null;
			}
			if (SelectedPageControlContainer != null)
			{
				SelectedPageControlContainer.Content = null;
			}
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			SelectedPageControlContainer = GetTemplateChild("PART_SelectedPageControlContainer") as ContentControl;
			CollapsedSelectedPageBorder = (ContentControl)GetTemplateChild("PART_CollapsedSelectedPageBorder");
			TitlePanel = GetTemplateChild("PART_TitlePanel") as DXRibbonWindowTitlePanel;
			UpdateSelectedPageControlPlacement();
			HeaderToolbarContainer = (ContentControl)GetTemplateChild("PART_ToolbarContainer");
			FooterToolbarContainer = (ContentControl)GetTemplateChild("PART_FooterToolbarContainer");
			ApplicationButton = (RibbonApplicationButtonControl)GetTemplateChild("PART_ApplicationButton");
			CategoriesPane = (RibbonPageCategoriesPane)GetTemplateChild("PART_PageCategoriesPane");
			HeaderBorder = (UIElement)GetTemplateChild("PART_HeaderBorder");
			ApplicationIconContainer = (ContentControl)GetTemplateChild("PART_ApplicationIconContainer");
			MainGrid = GetTemplateChild("PART_MainLayout") as Grid;
			TabBackground = GetTemplateChild("PART_TabBackground") as ContentControl;
			BackgroundBorder = GetTemplateChild("PART_Background") as ContentControl;
			HeaderAndTabsGrid = GetTemplateChild("PART_HeaderAndTabsLayout") as Grid;
			MinimizationButtonInPageHeader = GetTemplateChild("PART_MinimizationButton") as RibbonMinimizationButton;
			PageHeaderLinksControlContainer = (DXContentPresenter)GetTemplateChild("PART_PageHeaderLinksControlContainer");
			ControlBoxContainer = GetTemplateChild("PART_ControlBoxContainer") as FrameworkElement;
			if (PageHeaderLinksControlContainer != null)
			{
				PageHeaderLinksControlContainer.Content = PageHeaderLinksControl;
			}
			UpdateLayoutByRibbonHeaderVisibility();
			SubscribeTemplateEvents();
			UpdateToolbarPlacement();
			UpdateCollapsedSelectedPageBorderVisibility();
			AutoHideControl = GetTemplateChild("PART_AutoHideControl") as RibbonAutoHideControl;
			ApplicationMenuStrategy.Do(delegate(ApplicationMenuStrategyBase x)
			{
				x.Close();
			});
			UpdateWindow();
		}

		internal DependencyObject GetTemplateChildInternal(string name)
		{
			return GetTemplateChild(name);
		}

		protected void UpdateLayoutByRibbonHeaderVisibility()
		{
			WindowHelper.UpdateRibbonVisibility();
		}

		protected internal virtual void SelectFirstVisiblePage()
		{
			SelectFirstVisiblePage(ignoreSelectedPageValue: false);
		}

		protected internal virtual void SelectFirstVisiblePage(bool ignoreSelectedPageValue)
		{
			if (SelectedPage != null || ignoreSelectedPageValue)
			{
				SelectedPage = GetFirstSelectablePage();
			}
		}

		public RibbonPage GetFirstSelectablePage()
		{
			return (from cat in ActualCategories
				where cat.IsVisible
				select cat.GetFirstSelectablePage() into page
				where page != null
				select page).FirstOrDefault();
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnPageCategoryInserted(RibbonPageCategoryBase pageCategory, int index)
		{
			if (pageCategory.IsDefault)
			{
				if (DefaultCategory != null && !((RibbonDefaultPageCategory)DefaultCategory).IsAutogenerated)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException("Ribbon control must have only one DefaultRibbonPageCategory.");
				}
				DefaultCategory = pageCategory;
			}
			pageCategory.Ribbon = this;
			pageCategory.PageIsSelectedChanged += OnPageIsSelectedChanged;
			pageCategory.PageInserted += OnPageInserted;
			pageCategory.PageRemoved += OnPageRemoved;
			pageCategory.PageGroupInserted += OnPageGroupInserted;
			pageCategory.PageGroupRemoved += OnPageGroupRemoved;
			if (pageCategory.Parent == null)
			{
				AddLogicalChild(pageCategory);
			}
			if (SelectedPage == null)
			{
				SelectedPage = pageCategory.GetFirstSelectablePage();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnPageGroupRemoved(object sender, RibbonPageGroupRemovedEventArgs e)
		{
			RaiseRibbonPageGroupRemoved(e.RibbonPageGroup, e.Index);
		}

		protected virtual void OnPageGroupInserted(object sender, RibbonPageGroupInsertedEventArgs e)
		{
			RaiseRibbonPageGroupInserted(e.RibbonPageGroup, e.Index);
			RibbonPageGroup ribbonPageGroup = sender as RibbonPageGroup;
		}

		protected virtual void OnPageRemoved(object sender, RibbonPageRemovedEventArgs e)
		{
			RaiseRibbonPageRemoved(e.RibbonPage, e.Index);
			InvalidateAutomationTree();
		}

		protected virtual void OnPageInserted(object sender, RibbonPageInsertedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (CategoriesPane != null)
			{
				CategoriesPane.InvalidateMeasure();
			}
			if (SelectedPage == null)
			{
				SetCurrentValue(SelectedPageProperty, sender);
			}
			RaiseRibbonPageInserted(e.RibbonPage, e.Index);
			RibbonPage ribbonPage = sender as RibbonPage;
			InvalidateAutomationTree();
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnPageCategoryRemoved(RibbonPageCategoryBase pageCategory, int index)
		{
			if (pageCategory == DefaultCategory)
			{
				DefaultCategory = null;
			}
			pageCategory.PageIsSelectedChanged -= OnPageIsSelectedChanged;
			pageCategory.Ribbon = null;
			pageCategory.PageInserted -= OnPageInserted;
			pageCategory.PageRemoved -= OnPageRemoved;
			pageCategory.PageGroupInserted -= OnPageGroupInserted;
			pageCategory.PageGroupRemoved -= OnPageGroupRemoved;
			if (pageCategory.Parent == this)
			{
				RemoveLogicalChild(pageCategory);
			}
			if (pageCategory.Pages.Contains(SelectedPage) || pageCategory.CustomPages.Contains(SelectedPage))
			{
				SelectedPage = GetFirstSelectablePage();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPreviewMouseUp(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.ChangedButton == MouseButton.Right && (ApplicationMenuStrategy == null || !ApplicationMenuStrategy.IsMenuOpened) && TreeHelper.GetParent<GalleryControlInDropDown>((DependencyObject)(e.OriginalSource as FrameworkElement), (Func<GalleryControlInDropDown, bool>)null, true, true) == null)
			{
				e.Handled = ShowRibbonPopupMenu(e.OriginalSource as DependencyObject);
			}
			base.OnPreviewMouseUp(e);
		}

		protected virtual void UpdatePagesIsSelectedCore(RibbonPage basePage)
		{
			if (basePage != null && !basePage.IsSelected)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (RibbonPageCategoryBase actualCategory in ActualCategories)
			{
				bool isSelected = false;
				actualCategory.RaisePageIsSelectedChanged = false;
				foreach (RibbonPage actualPage in actualCategory.ActualPages)
				{
					if (actualPage != basePage && basePage.With((RibbonPage x) => x.MergedParent) != actualPage && (!actualPage.IsSelectedChangedProcessing || actualPage.MergedParentCategory == null || !actualPage.IsSelected))
					{
						actualPage.SetCurrentValue(RibbonPage.IsSelectedProperty, false);
					}
					if (actualPage.IsSelected)
					{
						isSelected = true;
					}
				}
				actualCategory.IsSelected = isSelected;
				actualCategory.RaisePageIsSelectedChanged = true;
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnPageIsSelectedChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			RibbonPage ribbonPage = sender as RibbonPage;
			if (!ribbonPage.IsSelected)
			{
				ribbonPage = GetSelectedPage();
			}
			UpdateRibbonSelectedPage(ribbonPage, this);
			UpdateRibbonSelectedPage(ribbonPage, ActualMergedParent);
		}

		private static void UpdateRibbonSelectedPage(RibbonPage page, RibbonControl ribbon)
		{
			if (ribbon != null && (page != null || ribbon.SelectedPage.If((RibbonPage x) => x.IsSelected) == null))
			{
				ribbon.UpdatePagesIsSelectedCore(page);
				ribbon.SetCurrentValue(SelectedPageProperty, page);
			}
		}

		private RibbonPage GetSelectedPage()
		{
			RibbonPage ribbonPage = ActualCategories.FirstOrDefault((RibbonPageCategoryBase cat) => cat.IsSelected).With((RibbonPageCategoryBase cat) => cat.GetSelectedPage());
			return ribbonPage ?? ActualMergedParent.With((RibbonControl x) => x.GetSelectedPage());
		}

		internal void SwitchSelectedPageOnHideWhenEmpty()
		{
			if (SelectedPage.ShouldHide())
			{
				SelectedPage = RibbonSelectionHelper.GetFirstVisiblePage(this);
			}
		}

		protected internal void OnPreviewTextInput(object sender, TextCompositionEventArgs e)
		{
			if (KeyboardNavigationManager.IsNavigationMode)
			{
				e.Handled = KeyboardNavigationManager.ProcessChar(e.Text);
			}
		}

		protected void OnPreviewKeyDown(object sender, KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (KeyboardNavigationManager.IsNavigationMode)
			{
				e.Handled = KeyboardNavigationManager.Navigate(RightToLeftHelper.TransposeKey(e.Key, (FrameworkElement)this), 0);
			}
			else if (base.IsKeyboardFocusWithin && e.Key == Key.Escape)
			{
				KeyboardNavigationManager.RestoreFocus();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnInitialized(EventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnInitialized(e);
			AddLogicalChild(Toolbar);
			AddLogicalChild(PageHeaderLinksControl);
			AddLogicalChild(RibbonPopupMenu);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(SelectedPageName))
			{
				SelectedPage = FindPageByName(SelectedPageName);
			}
			if (SelectedPage == null)
			{
				SelectedPage = GetFirstSelectablePage();
			}
			if (ActualMergedParent == null || ActualMergedParent.AsyncMergingEnabled)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				if (ActualMergedParent != null)
				{
					ActualMergedParent.ReMerge();
				}
			}, DispatcherPriority.Loaded);
		}

		internal void UpdateIsInRibbonWindow()
		{
			IsInRibbonWindow = WindowHelper.HasRibbonWindowAsParent;
		}

		internal void UpdateTitleAlignment()
		{
			if (TitlePanel != null)
			{
				TitlePanel.InvalidateMeasure();
			}
		}

		protected virtual IBarItemLinkControl GetParentLinkControl(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			if (obj is BarItemLinkInfo)
			{
				return ((BarItemLinkInfo)((obj is BarItemLinkInfo) ? obj : null)).LinkControl;
			}
			return LayoutHelper.FindLayoutOrVisualParentObject<IBarItemLinkControl>(obj, true, (DependencyObject)null);
		}

		protected virtual void InitializePopupMenu(IBarItemLinkControl targetLinkControl, BarItemLinkBase targetLink, BarItem targetItem, bool isLinkControlInToolbar)
		{
			//IL_015b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0076: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0190: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_019a: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_024d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0257: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_01c6: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01d0: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0150: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_015a: Expected O, but got Unknown
			((Popup)(object)RibbonPopupMenu).PlacementTarget = this;
			((Popup)(object)RibbonPopupMenu).StaysOpen = true;
			((Popup)(object)RibbonPopupMenu).Placement = PlacementMode.MousePoint;
			if (isLinkControlInToolbar)
			{
				if (targetLinkControl != null)
				{
					((BarItem)RemoveFromToolbarMenuItem).Glyph = targetLinkControl.ActualGlyph;
				}
				RemoveFromToolbarMenuItem.TargetItemLink = targetLink;
				AddRibbonPopupMenuItem((BarItem)(object)RemoveFromToolbarMenuItem);
				((Collection<BarItemLinkBase>)(object)((PopupMenu)RibbonPopupMenu).ItemLinks).Add((BarItemLinkBase)new BarItemLinkSeparator());
			}
			else if (targetLinkControl != null && !(targetLinkControl is RibbonGalleryBarItemLinkControl) && ToolbarShowMode != RibbonQuickAccessToolbarShowMode.Hide)
			{
				((BarItem)AddToToolbarMenuItem).Glyph = targetLinkControl.ActualGlyph;
				AddToToolbarMenuItem.TargetItem = targetItem;
				AddToToolbarMenuItem.TargetItemLink = targetLink;
				((ContentElement)(object)AddToToolbarMenuItem).IsEnabled = !((IEnumerable)((ILinksHolder)Toolbar).ActualLinks).OfType<BarItemLink>().Any((BarItemLink x) => ((BarItemLinkBase)x).Item == targetItem && ((BarItemLinkBase)x).IsVisible) && !(from x in ((IEnumerable)((ILinksHolder)Toolbar).CustomizedItems).OfType<BarItemLink>()
					select ((BarItemLinkBase)x).Item).Contains(targetItem);
				AddRibbonPopupMenuItem((BarItem)(object)AddToToolbarMenuItem);
				((Collection<BarItemLinkBase>)(object)((PopupMenu)RibbonPopupMenu).ItemLinks).Add((BarItemLinkBase)new BarItemLinkSeparator());
			}
			if ((int)RibbonHeaderVisibility == 0)
			{
				if (ToolbarShowMode == RibbonQuickAccessToolbarShowMode.Default)
				{
					((BarItem)ShowToolbarBelowRibbonMenuItem).IsPrivate = true;
					AddRibbonPopupMenuItem((BarItem)(object)ShowToolbarBelowRibbonMenuItem);
					((Collection<BarItemLinkBase>)(object)((PopupMenu)RibbonPopupMenu).ItemLinks).Add((BarItemLinkBase)new BarItemLinkSeparator());
				}
				if (ToolbarShowMode == RibbonQuickAccessToolbarShowMode.ShowBelow)
				{
					((BarItem)ShowToolbarAboveRibbonMenuItem).IsPrivate = true;
					AddRibbonPopupMenuItem((BarItem)(object)ShowToolbarAboveRibbonMenuItem);
					((Collection<BarItemLinkBase>)(object)((PopupMenu)RibbonPopupMenu).ItemLinks).Add((BarItemLinkBase)new BarItemLinkSeparator());
				}
				if (!IsMinimized && AllowMinimizeRibbon)
				{
					MinimizeRibbonMenuItem.IsChecked = false;
					((BarItem)MinimizeRibbonMenuItem).IsPrivate = true;
					AddRibbonPopupMenuItem((BarItem)(object)MinimizeRibbonMenuItem);
				}
			}
			if (IsMinimized)
			{
				MinimizeRibbonMenuItem.IsChecked = true;
				((BarItem)MinimizeRibbonMenuItem).IsPrivate = true;
				AddRibbonPopupMenuItem((BarItem)(object)MinimizeRibbonMenuItem);
			}
			if (AllowCustomization)
			{
				((Collection<BarItemLinkBase>)(object)((PopupMenu)RibbonPopupMenu).ItemLinks).Add((BarItemLinkBase)new BarItemLinkSeparator());
				((BarItem)CustomizeRibbonMenuItem).IsPrivate = true;
				AddRibbonPopupMenuItem((BarItem)(object)CustomizeRibbonMenuItem);
			}
			if (AllowSimplifiedRibbon)
			{
				if (IsSimplified)
				{
					((BarItem)UseClassicRibbonMenuItem).IsPrivate = true;
					AddRibbonPopupMenuItem((BarItem)(object)UseClassicRibbonMenuItem);
				}
				else
				{
					((BarItem)UseSimplifiedRibbonMenuItem).IsPrivate = true;
					AddRibbonPopupMenuItem((BarItem)(object)UseSimplifiedRibbonMenuItem);
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void RemoveRibbonPopupMenuItems()

			RemoveRibbonPopupMenuItem((BarItem)(object)AddToToolbarMenuItem);
			RemoveRibbonPopupMenuItem((BarItem)(object)RemoveFromToolbarMenuItem);

			RemoveRibbonPopupMenuItem((BarItem)(object)ShowToolbarAboveRibbonMenuItem);
			RemoveRibbonPopupMenuItem((BarItem)(object)ShowToolbarBelowRibbonMenuItem);
			RemoveRibbonPopupMenuItem((BarItem)(object)CustomizeRibbonMenuItem);
			RemoveRibbonPopupMenuItem((BarItem)(object)UseSimplifiedRibbonMenuItem);
			RemoveRibbonPopupMenuItem((BarItem)(object)UseClassicRibbonMenuItem);
		}

		}

		private void OnRibbonPopupMenuClosed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			((Popup)(object)RibbonPopupMenu).Closed -= OnRibbonPopupMenuClosed;
			ClearRibbonPopupMenu();
			RibbonPopupMenuIsOpening = false;
		}

		protected virtual bool IsLinkControlInToolbar(IBarItemLinkControl linkControl)
		{
			if (linkControl == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			RibbonQuickAccessToolbarPopupBorderControl ribbonQuickAccessToolbarPopupBorderControl = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<RibbonQuickAccessToolbarPopupBorderControl>(linkControl as DependencyObject);
			if (ribbonQuickAccessToolbarPopupBorderControl != null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			RibbonQuickAccessToolbarControl ribbonQuickAccessToolbarControl = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<RibbonQuickAccessToolbarControl>(linkControl as DependencyObject);
			if (ribbonQuickAccessToolbarControl != null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal virtual bool ShowRibbonPopupMenu(DependencyObject targetControl)
		{
			if (RibbonPopupMenu != null && targetControl != null && LayoutHelper.IsChildElement((DependencyObject)((Popup)(object)RibbonPopupMenu).Child, targetControl))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (LayoutHelper.GetRootPath((DependencyObject)this, targetControl).OfType<UIElement>().Any((UIElement x) => BarManager.GetDXContextMenu(x) != null))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (RibbonPopupMenuIsOpening)
			{
				((Popup)(object)RibbonPopupMenu).Closed -= OnRibbonPopupMenuClosed;
				ClearRibbonPopupMenu();
			}
			IBarItemLinkControl targetLinkControlForRibbonPopupMenu = GetTargetLinkControlForRibbonPopupMenu(targetControl);
			BarItem val = null;
			BarItemLinkBase val2 = null;
			bool flag = false;
			if (targetLinkControlForRibbonPopupMenu != null)
			{
				if (BarItemLinkControlChecker.Is<IBarEditItemLinkControl>(targetLinkControlForRibbonPopupMenu) || targetLinkControlForRibbonPopupMenu is BarButtonGroupLinkControl || targetLinkControlForRibbonPopupMenu is BarItemLinkMenuHeaderControl)
				{
					return false;
				}
				flag = IsLinkControlInToolbar(targetLinkControlForRibbonPopupMenu);
				val2 = targetLinkControlForRibbonPopupMenu.LinkBase;
				if (targetLinkControlForRibbonPopupMenu.LinkInfo != null)
				{
					val = targetLinkControlForRibbonPopupMenu.LinkInfo.Item;
				}
			}
			InitializePopupMenu(targetLinkControlForRibbonPopupMenu, val2, val, flag);
			RibbonPopupMenuIsOpening = true;
			RibbonPopupMenuShowingEventArgs e = new RibbonPopupMenuShowingEventArgs(RibbonPopupMenu, val, val2, flag);
			RaiseRibbonPopupMenuShowing(e);
			if (!e.Cancel && ((Collection<BarItemLinkBase>)(object)((PopupMenu)RibbonPopupMenu).ItemLinks).Count != 0)
			{
				((BarPopupBase)RibbonPopupMenu).ShowPopup(((Popup)(object)RibbonPopupMenu).PlacementTarget);
				if (((Popup)(object)RibbonPopupMenu).IsOpen)
				{
					((Popup)(object)RibbonPopupMenu).Closed += OnRibbonPopupMenuClosed;
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual IBarItemLinkControl GetTargetLinkControlForRibbonPopupMenu(DependencyObject targetControl)
		{
			IBarItemLinkControl val = GetParentLinkControl(targetControl);
			if (val == null || val.LinkInfo == null || val.LinkInfo.Item == null || !GetAllowAddingToToolbar((DependencyObject)(object)val.LinkInfo.Item))
			{
				val = null;
			}
			return val;
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateActualApplicationButtonStyle()
		{
			IsOffice2010Style = RibbonStyle == RibbonStyle.Office2010 || RibbonStyle == RibbonStyle.OfficeSlim || RibbonStyle == RibbonStyle.Office2019;
			ActualApplicationButtonStyle = GetApplicationButtonStyle(RibbonStyle);
		}

		protected virtual Style GetApplicationButtonStyle(RibbonStyle RibbonStyle)
		{
			switch (RibbonStyle)
			{
			case RibbonStyle.Office2010:
			case RibbonStyle.Office2019:
				return ApplicationButton2010Style;
			case RibbonStyle.TabletOffice:
				return ApplicationButtonTabletOfficeStyle;
			case RibbonStyle.OfficeSlim:
				return ApplicationButtonOfficeSlimStyle;
			case RibbonStyle.Office2007:
				if (!IsAeroMode)
				{
					return ApplicationButton2007Style;
				}
				return ApplicationButton2007StyleInAeroWindow;
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateApplicationIconVisibility()
		{
			if (ActualApplicationIcon == null || !IsInRibbonWindow || (WindowHelper.RibbonWindow != null && !WindowHelper.RibbonWindow.ShowIcon))
			{
				IsApplicationIconVisible = false;
			}
			else if (RibbonStyle == RibbonStyle.Office2007)
			{
				IsApplicationIconVisible = !ShowApplicationButton;
			}
			else
			{
				IsApplicationIconVisible = true;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void IsInRibbonWindowChanged(bool oldValue)
		{
			CoerceValue(AutoHideModeProperty);
			IsAeroMode = WindowHelper.IsAeroMode;
			UpdateApplicationIconVisibility();
			UpdateAboveToolbarByRibbonStyle();
			base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				TitlePanel.Do(delegate(DXRibbonWindowTitlePanel x)
				{
					x.InvalidateMeasure();
				});
			}, DispatcherPriority.Loaded);
		}

		}

		protected virtual bool OnEnterMenuMode(object sender, EventArgs args)
		{
			return ToggleMenuMode();
		}

		protected virtual bool ToggleMenuMode()
		{
			if (!UseOldNavigationManager)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (KeyboardNavigationManager.IsNavigationMode)
			{
				KeyboardNavigationManager.IsNavigationMode = false;
				return true;
			}
			if (Window.GetWindow(this).Return((Window x) => x.IsActive, () => false) && AllowKeyTips && base.IsVisible && !DependencyObjectExtensions.IsInDesignTool((DependencyObject)this))
			{
				if (PopupMenuManager.IsAnyPopupOpened)
				{
					PopupMenuManager.CloseAllPopups((object)null, (MouseEventArgs)null);
					return true;
				}
				KeyboardNavigationManager.IsNavigationMode = true;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool CanDragRibbonWindow()
		{
			if (IsInRibbonWindow && ApplicationIconContainer != null)
			{
				return !ApplicationIconContainer.IsMouseOver;
			}
			return false;
		}

		void IRibbonControl.Merge(object child, ILinksHolder extraItems)
		{
			Merge((RibbonControl)child);
			if (extraItems != null)
			{
				((ILinksHolder)PageHeaderLinksControl).Merge(extraItems);
			}
		}

		void IRibbonControl.UnMerge(object child, ILinksHolder extraItems)
		{
			if (extraItems != null)
			{
				((ILinksHolder)PageHeaderLinksControl).UnMerge(extraItems);
			}
			UnMerge((RibbonControl)child);
		}

		protected virtual void OnNameChanged(string oldValue, string newValue)
		{
		}

		protected virtual object GetNameCore(object registratorKey)
		{
			if (object.Equals(registratorKey, typeof(IFrameworkInputElement)))
			{
				return base.Name;
			}
			if (object.Equals(registratorKey, typeof(IThemedWindowSupport)))
			{
				return base.IsVisible;
			}
			if (object.Equals(typeof(IMergingSupport), registratorKey))
			{
				return ((IMergingSupport)this).NameStorage.CurrentValue;
			}
			if (object.Equals(typeof(IEventListenerClient), registratorKey))
			{
				return base.Name;
			}
			throw new ArgumentException();
		}

		protected virtual IEnumerable<object> GetRegistratorKeysCore()
		{
			return new object[4]
			{
				typeof(IFrameworkInputElement),
				typeof(IMergingSupport),
				typeof(IEventListenerClient),
				typeof(IThemedWindowSupport)
			};
		}

		void ILogicalChildrenContainer.AddLogicalChild(object child)
		{
			logicalChildrenContainerItems.Add(child);
			AddLogicalChild(child);
		}

		void ILogicalChildrenContainer.RemoveLogicalChild(object child)
		{

		bool IEventListenerClient.ReceiveEvent(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(e is RoutedEventArgs e2))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (e2.RoutedEvent == MenuModeHelper.EnterMenuModeEvent)
			{
				return OnEnterMenuMode(sender, e);
			}
			if (!(e2.Source is RibbonSelectedPageControl))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (e2.OriginalSource is Visual || e2.OriginalSource is Visual3D)
			{
				return VisualTreeHelper.GetParent((DependencyObject)e2.OriginalSource) is ComboBoxItem;
			}
			if (e2.OriginalSource is FrameworkContentElement)
			{
				return LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent((DependencyObject)e2.OriginalSource) is ComboBoxItem;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void OnExecutingPostponedActions()
		{
			Queue<Action> queue = CollectionActionHelper.GetPostponedActions((DependencyObject)this);
			if (queue == null)
			{
				queue = new Queue<Action>();
				CollectionActionHelper.SetPostponedActions((DependencyObject)this, queue);
			}
			if (MergedParent != null)
			{
				CollectionActionHelper.GetPostponedActions((DependencyObject)MergedParent)?.ForEach(queue.Enqueue);
			}
			MergedChildren.SelectMany((RibbonControl c) => CollectionActionHelper.GetPostponedActions((DependencyObject)c) ?? new Queue<Action>()).ForEach(queue.Enqueue);
			CollectionActionHelper.ExecutePostponedActions((DependencyObject)this);
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateCustomizations()
		{
			if (!CustomizationHelper.IsCustomizationMode)
			{
				customizationsUpdatePending = true;
				updateCustomizationsPostponed.PerformPostpone((Action)UpdateCustomizationsPostponed);
				base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(new Action(updateCustomizationsPostponed.PerformForce), DispatcherPriority.Loaded);
				if (ActualMergedParent != null)
				{
					ActualMergedParent.UpdateCustomizations();
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateCustomizationsPostponed()
		{
			if (runtimeCustomizations == null || !((IEnumerable<RuntimeCustomization>)runtimeCustomizations).Any())
			{
				GetDescendants().ForEach(delegate(DependencyObject x)
				{
					BarManagerCustomizationHelper.GetSerializationName(x);
				});
				customizationsUpdatePending = false;
				return;
			}
			int num = 0;
			while (customizationsUpdatePending)
			{
				customizationsUpdatePending = false;
				HashSet<string> hashSet = new HashSet<string>(GetDescendants().Select((Func<DependencyObject, string>)BarManagerCustomizationHelper.GetSerializationName));
				runtimeCustomizations.OverwriteCustomizations(0);
				runtimeCustomizations.RemoveUninformativeCustomizations();
				RuntimeCustomization[] array = ((IEnumerable<RuntimeCustomization>)runtimeCustomizations).ToArray();
				foreach (RuntimeCustomization val in array)
				{
					if (customizationsUpdatePending)
					{
						break;
					}
					if (!val.Applied && hashSet.Contains(val.TargetName))
					{
						val.Apply(false);
						num++;
					}
					if (!(val is IRemoveRuntimeCustomization) && val.Applied && !hashSet.Contains(val.TargetName))
					{
						val.Undo();
					}
				}
			}
			if (num > 0 && IsMerged)
			{
				Toolbar.Remerge();
			}
		}

		private IEnumerable<DependencyObject> GetDescendants()
		{
			return GetDescendants((ScopeSearchSettings)7).Concat(ActualMergedChildren.SelectMany((RibbonControl x) => x.GetDescendants((ScopeSearchSettings)2))).Distinct();
		}

		private IEnumerable<DependencyObject> GetDescendants(ScopeSearchSettings settings)
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return from x in BarNameScope.GetService<IElementRegistratorService>((object)this).GetElements<IFrameworkInputElement>(settings).OfType<DependencyObject>()
				where x is RibbonPageCategoryBase || x is RibbonPage || x is RibbonPageGroup || x is IBarItem
				select x;
		}

		DependencyObject IRuntimeCustomizationHost.FindTarget(string targetName)
		{
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = BarNameScope.GetService<IElementRegistratorService>((object)this).GetElements<IFrameworkInputElement>((ScopeSearchSettings)6).OfType<DependencyObject>()
				.FirstOrDefault((DependencyObject x) => BarManagerCustomizationHelper.GetSerializationName(x) == targetName);
			if (dependencyObject == null)
			{
				dependencyObject = GetDescendants().FirstOrDefault((DependencyObject x) => BarManagerCustomizationHelper.GetSerializationName(x) == targetName);
			}
			return dependencyObject;
		}

		void IRuntimeCustomizationHost.CustomizationApplyingSkipped(RuntimeCustomization customization)
		{
			customization.Undo();
		}

		void INavigationOwner.OnAddedToSelection()
		{
			FocusManager.SetIsFocusScope(this, value: true);

			SetCurrentValue(IsHiddenRibbonCollapsedProperty, false);
			FocusManager.SetFocusedElement(this, null);
		}

		void INavigationOwner.OnRemovedFromSelection(bool destroying)
		{
			base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action<WeakReference<RibbonControl>>)delegate(WeakReference<RibbonControl> wr)
			{
				if (wr.TryGetTarget(out var target))
				{
					target.Focusable = false;
					target.ClearValue(IsHiddenRibbonCollapsedProperty);
					FocusManager.SetIsFocusScope(target, value: false);
					CommandManager.InvalidateRequerySuggested();
				}
			}, DispatcherPriority.ContextIdle, new WeakReference<RibbonControl>(this)).Do(delegate(DispatcherOperation x)
			{
				x.Priority = DispatcherPriority.ContextIdle;
			});
		}

	public static class RibbonMergingHelper
	{
		private class RibbonMergingHelperInternal : MergingHelperInternal<RibbonControl>
		{
			public RibbonMergingHelperInternal(RibbonControl ribbon)
				: base(ribbon)
			{
			}

			protected override void Merge(RibbonControl parent, RibbonControl child)
			{
				parent.Merge(child);
			}

			protected override void Unmerge(RibbonControl child)
			{
				child.MergedParent.Do(delegate(RibbonControl p)
				{
					p.UnMerge(child);
				});
			}

			protected override RibbonControl GetParent(RibbonControl child)
			{
				return GetMergeWith(child);
			}

			protected override RibbonControl GetMergedParent(RibbonControl child)
			{
				return child.MergedParent;
			}

			protected override MDIMergeStyle GetMergeStyle(RibbonControl child)
			{
				//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				return child.MDIMergeStyle;
			}
		}

		private class StatusBarMergingHelperInternal : MergingHelperInternal<RibbonStatusBarControl>
		{
			public StatusBarMergingHelperInternal(RibbonStatusBarControl statusBar)
				: base(statusBar)
			{
			}

			protected override void Merge(RibbonStatusBarControl parent, RibbonStatusBarControl child)
			{
				parent.Merge(child);

			}

			protected override RibbonStatusBarControl GetMergedParent(RibbonStatusBarControl child)

				return child.MergedParent;
			}

			protected override MDIMergeStyle GetMergeStyle(RibbonStatusBarControl child)

			}
		}

		private abstract class MergingHelperInternalBase
		{
		}

		private abstract class MergingHelperInternal<T> : MergingHelperInternalBase where T : FrameworkElement
		{
			private readonly T control;

			public MergingHelperInternal(T control)
			{
				this.control = control;
			}

			protected abstract void Merge(T parent, T child);

			protected abstract void Unmerge(T child);

			protected abstract T GetParent(T child);

			protected abstract T GetMergedParent(T child);

			protected abstract MDIMergeStyle GetMergeStyle(T child);

			public void OnMergeWithChanged(T control, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0016: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				if (DesignerProperties.GetIsInDesignMode(control) || (int)GetMergeStyle(control) == 3)
				{
					return;
				}
				control.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				T val = (T)e.OldValue;
				T val2 = (T)e.NewValue;
				if (val != null)
				{
					control.Loaded -= OnRibbonLoaded;
					control.Unloaded -= OnRibbonUnloaded;
					OnRibbonUnloadedCore(control, val);
					UnsubscribeRibbonVisibility();
				}
				if (val2 != null)
				{
					control.Loaded += OnRibbonLoaded;
					control.Unloaded += OnRibbonUnloaded;
					if (control.IsLoaded)
					{
						OnRibbonLoaded(control, null);
					}
					SubscribeRibbonVisibilityIfNeeded();
				}
			}

			private bool IsRibbonVisible()
			{
				if (control.Parent is FrameworkElement)
				{
					return ((FrameworkElement)control.Parent).IsVisible;
				}
				return true;
			}

			private void UnsubscribeRibbonVisibility()
			{
				if (control.Parent is FrameworkElement)
				{
					((FrameworkElement)control.Parent).IsVisibleChanged -= OnRibbonIsVisibleChanged;
				}
			}

			private void SubscribeRibbonVisibilityIfNeeded()
			{
				//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0015: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_001b: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				if (((int)GetMergeStyle(control) == 0 || (int)GetMergeStyle(control) == 1) && control.Parent is FrameworkElement)
				{
					UnsubscribeRibbonVisibility();
					((FrameworkElement)control.Parent).IsVisibleChanged += OnRibbonIsVisibleChanged;
				}
			}

			private void OnRibbonIsVisibleChanged(object sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				if (!(bool)e.NewValue)
				{
					Unmerge(control);
				}
				else
				{
					Merge(GetParent(control), control);
				}
			}

			private void OnRibbonLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
			{
				T val = (T)sender;
				T parent = GetParent(control);
				parent.Loaded += OnParentLoaded;
				parent.Unloaded += OnParentUnloaded;
				if (parent.IsLoaded)
				{
					OnParentLoaded(parent, null);
				}
				SubscribeRibbonVisibilityIfNeeded();
			}

			private void OnRibbonUnloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
			{
				T ribbon = (T)sender;
				OnRibbonUnloadedCore(ribbon, GetParent(control));
			}

			private void OnRibbonUnloadedCore(T ribbon, T parent)
			{
				parent.Loaded -= OnParentLoaded;
				parent.Unloaded -= OnParentUnloaded;
				OnParentUnloaded(parent, null);
			}

			private void OnParentLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
			{
				//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0028: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_002e: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				T parent = (T)sender;
				Unmerge(control);
				if ((int)GetMergeStyle(control) == 0 || (int)GetMergeStyle(control) == 1)
				{
					if (IsRibbonVisible())
					{
						Merge(parent, control);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					Merge(parent, control);
				}
			}

			private void OnParentUnloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
			{
				T val = (T)sender;
				if (GetMergedParent(control) == val)
				{
					Unmerge(control);
				}
			}
		}

		public static readonly DependencyProperty MergeWithProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty MergeStatusBarWithProperty;

		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		private static readonly DependencyProperty MergingHelperInternalBaseProperty;

		static RibbonMergingHelper()
		{
			MergingHelperInternalBaseProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("MergingHelperInternalBase", typeof(MergingHelperInternalBase), typeof(RibbonMergingHelper), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			MergeStatusBarWithProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("MergeStatusBarWith", typeof(RibbonStatusBarControl), typeof(RibbonMergingHelper), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.Inherits, OnMergeStatusBarWithChanged));
			MergeWithProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("MergeWith", typeof(RibbonControl), typeof(RibbonMergingHelper), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.Inherits, OnMergeWithChanged));
		}

		public static RibbonControl GetMergeWith(FrameworkElement d)
		{
			return (RibbonControl)d.GetValue(MergeWithProperty);
		}

		public static void SetMergeWith(FrameworkElement d, RibbonControl parentRibbon)
		{
			d.SetValue(MergeWithProperty, parentRibbon);
		}

		public static RibbonStatusBarControl GetMergeStatusBarWith(FrameworkElement d)
		{
			return (RibbonStatusBarControl)d.GetValue(MergeStatusBarWithProperty);
		}

		public static void SetMergeStatusBarWith(FrameworkElement d, RibbonStatusBarControl parentStatusBar)
		{
			d.SetValue(MergeStatusBarWithProperty, parentStatusBar);
		}

		private static MergingHelperInternalBase GetMergingHelperInternalBase(FrameworkElement d)
		{
			return (MergingHelperInternalBase)d.GetValue(MergingHelperInternalBaseProperty);
		}

		private static void SetMergingHelperInternalBase(FrameworkElement d, MergingHelperInternalBase h)
		{
			d.SetValue(MergingHelperInternalBaseProperty, h);
		}

		private static MergingHelperInternal<TControl> GetMergingHelperInternal<TControl>(TControl control, Func<MergingHelperInternal<TControl>> createFunc) where TControl : FrameworkElement
		{
			MergingHelperInternal<TControl> mergingHelperInternal = (MergingHelperInternal<TControl>)GetMergingHelperInternalBase(control);
			if (mergingHelperInternal == null)
			{
				mergingHelperInternal = createFunc();
				SetMergingHelperInternalBase(control, mergingHelperInternal);
			}
			return mergingHelperInternal;
		}

		private static void OnMergeWithChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			RibbonControl ribbon = d as RibbonControl;
			if (ribbon != null)
			{
				GetMergingHelperInternal(ribbon, () => new RibbonMergingHelperInternal(ribbon)).OnMergeWithChanged(ribbon, e);
			}
		}

		private static void OnMergeStatusBarWithChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			RibbonStatusBarControl statusBar = d as RibbonStatusBarControl;
			if (statusBar != null)
			{
				GetMergingHelperInternal(statusBar, () => new StatusBarMergingHelperInternal(statusBar)).OnMergeWithChanged(statusBar, e);
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class RibbonPageGroupLayoutCalculator
	{
		private readonly RibbonPageGroupItemsPanel owner;

		private readonly RibbonStyle ribbonStyle;

		public BarItemLinkInfo[] Children => owner.EnumerateLinkInfos().ToArray();

		public bool IsSimplified { get; set; }

		public RibbonStyle RibbonStyle => ribbonStyle;

		protected RibbonControl Ribbon => owner.Ribbon;

		protected RibbonPageGroupControl PageGroupControl => owner.PageGroupControl;

		protected bool IsOrigin
		{
			get
			{
				if (PageGroupControl != null)
				{
					return PageGroupControl.IsOrigin;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public static RibbonPageGroupLayoutCalculator CreateLayoutCalculator(RibbonPageGroupItemsPanel owner, bool isSimplified)
		{
			if (isSimplified)
			{
				return new SimplifiedRibbonPageGroupLayoutCalculator(owner);
			}
			if (owner.RibbonStyle != RibbonStyle.Office2007 && owner.RibbonStyle != RibbonStyle.Office2010 && owner.RibbonStyle != RibbonStyle.Office2019)
			{
				return new OfficeTabletRibbonPageGroupLayoutCalculator(owner);
			}
			return new DefaultRibbonPageGroupLayoutCalculator(owner);
		}

		protected RibbonPageGroupLayoutCalculator(RibbonPageGroupItemsPanel owner, bool isSimplified)
		{
			if (owner == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("owner");
			}
			this.owner = owner;
			ribbonStyle = owner.RibbonStyle;
			IsSimplified = isSimplified;
		}

		public abstract Size MeasureOverride(Size availableSize);

		public abstract Size ArrangeOverride(Size finalSize);

		protected IBarItemLinkControl GetLinkControl(BarItemLinkInfo child)
		{
			return child.LinkControl;
		}

		protected MeasureType GetMeasureType()
		{
			return RibbonPageGroupsItemsPanel.GetMeasureType((DependencyObject)(object)owner);
		}
	}
	public class DefaultRibbonPageGroupLayoutCalculator : RibbonPageGroupLayoutCalculator
	{
		public DefaultRibbonPageGroupLayoutCalculator(RibbonPageGroupItemsPanel owner)
			: base(owner, isSimplified: false)
		{
		}

		protected double CalcBestHeight(UIElement[] children)
		{
			if (base.Ribbon == null)
			{

			return ((UIElement)(object)collapseItem).DesiredSize;
		}

		private BarItemLinkInfo GetCollapseItem(BarItemLinkInfo[] children)
		{
			if (base.PageGroupControl == null || base.PageGroupControl.IsOrigin || ((BarItemLinkBase)base.PageGroupControl.CollapseButtonInfo.Link).LinkControl == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return children.OfType<BarItemLinkInfo>().FirstOrDefault((BarItemLinkInfo linkInfo) => (object)linkInfo.Link == base.PageGroupControl.CollapseButtonInfo.Link);
		}
	}
	public class SimplifiedRibbonPageGroupLayoutCalculator : RibbonPageGroupLayoutCalculator
	{
		public SimplifiedRibbonPageGroupLayoutCalculator(RibbonPageGroupItemsPanel owner)
			: base(owner, isSimplified: true)
		{
		}

		protected double CalcBestHeight()
		{
			if (base.Ribbon != null)
			{
				return base.Ribbon.OriginButtonHeight;
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		private bool IsOverflowButton(BarItemLinkInfo linkInfo)
		{
			if (base.PageGroupControl.CollapseButtonInfo != null)
			{
				return (object)base.PageGroupControl.CollapseButtonInfo.Link == linkInfo.Link;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override Size MeasureOverride(Size availableSize)
		{
			availableSize.Height = (base.IsOrigin ? double.PositiveInfinity : Math.Min(CalcBestHeight(), availableSize.Height));
			Size result = new Size(0.0, base.IsOrigin ? 0.0 : availableSize.Height);
			BarItemLinkInfo[] children = base.Children;
			foreach (BarItemLinkInfo val in children)
			{
				RibbonPageGroupItemsPanel.SetRow((DependencyObject)(object)val, 0);
				((UIElement)(object)val).Measure(new Size(double.PositiveInfinity, availableSize.Height));
				result.Width += ((UIElement)(object)val).DesiredSize.Width;
				result.Height = Math.Max(result.Height, ((UIElement)(object)val).DesiredSize.Height);
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override Size ArrangeOverride(Size finalSize)
		{
			Rect finalRect = new Rect(new Size(0.0, finalSize.Height));
			BarItemLinkInfo[] children = base.Children;
			for (int i = 0; i < children.Length; i++)
			{
				UIElement uIElement = (UIElement)(object)children[i];
				finalRect.Width = uIElement.DesiredSize.Width;
				uIElement.Arrange(finalRect);
				finalRect.X += uIElement.RenderSize.Width;
			}
			return finalSize;
		}
	}
	public class RibbonPageHeadersPanel : Panel
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ToolbarProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Toolbar", typeof(UIElement), typeof(RibbonPageHeadersPanel), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty PageHeadersContainerProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("PageHeadersContainer", typeof(UIElement), typeof(RibbonPageHeadersPanel), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty RibbonProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Ribbon", typeof(RibbonControl), typeof(RibbonPageHeadersPanel), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure));

		public UIElement PageHeadersContainer
		{
			get
			{
				return (UIElement)GetValue(PageHeadersContainerProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(PageHeadersContainerProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public UIElement Toolbar
		{
			get
			{
				return (UIElement)GetValue(ToolbarProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ToolbarProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public RibbonControl Ribbon
		{
			get
			{
				return (RibbonControl)GetValue(RibbonProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(RibbonProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected override Size MeasureOverride(Size availableSize)
		{
			Size result = default(Size);
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				child.Measure(availableSize);
				result.Height = Math.Max(result.Height, child.DesiredSize.Height);
				result.Width += child.DesiredSize.Width;
			}
			if (result.Width > availableSize.Width && Toolbar != null)
			{
				result.Width -= Toolbar.DesiredSize.Width;
				Toolbar.Measure(new Size(Math.Max(Ribbon.Toolbar.GetMinDesiredWidth(), availableSize.Width - PageHeadersContainer.DesiredSize.Width), result.Height));
				result.Width += Toolbar.DesiredSize.Width;
				result.Width -= PageHeadersContainer.DesiredSize.Width;
				PageHeadersContainer.Measure(new Size(Math.Max(0.0, availableSize.Width - Toolbar.DesiredSize.Width), result.Height));
				result.Width += PageHeadersContainer.DesiredSize.Width;
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override Size ArrangeOverride(Size finalSize)
		{
			if (Toolbar == null || PageHeadersContainer == null)
			{
				Point location = default(Point);
				foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
				{
					child.Arrange(new Rect(location, new Size(child.DesiredSize.Width, finalSize.Height)));
					location.X += child.RenderSize.Width;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				Size size = new Size(Toolbar.DesiredSize.Width, finalSize.Height);
				Toolbar.Arrange(new Rect(size));
				PageHeadersContainer.Arrange(new Rect(new Point(size.Width, 0.0), new Size(finalSize.Width - size.Width, finalSize.Height)));
			}
			return finalSize;
		}
	}
