			BackgroundBorderProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("BackgroundBorder", typeof(UIElement), typeof(DXRibbonWindowPanel), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnBackgroundBorderPropertyChanged));
			ContentBackgroundBorderProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ContentBackgroundBorder", typeof(UIElement), typeof(DXRibbonWindowPanel), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnContentBackgroundBorderPropertyChanged));
			ContentBackgroundBorderMarginProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ContentBackgroundBorderMargin", typeof(Thickness), typeof(DXRibbonWindowPanel), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(default(Thickness), FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure, OnContentBackgroundBorderMarginPropertyChanged));
			StatusBarContainerProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("StatusBarContainer", typeof(UIElement), typeof(DXRibbonWindowPanel), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnStatusBarContainerPropertyChanged));
			BackgroundBorderPaddingProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("BackgroundBorderPadding", typeof(Thickness), typeof(DXRibbonWindowPanel), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(default(Thickness), FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure, OnBackgroundBorderPaddingPropertyChanged));
			IsAeroModeProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("IsAeroMode", typeof(bool), typeof(DXRibbonWindowPanel), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(false, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure, OnIsAeroModePropertyChanged));
			ContentBackgroundBorderInAeroModeProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ContentBackgroundBorderInAeroMode", typeof(UIElement), typeof(DXRibbonWindowPanel), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnContentBackgroundBorderInAeroModePropertyChanged));
			ContentBackgroundBorderMarginInAeroModeProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ContentBackgroundBorderMarginInAeroMode", typeof(Thickness), typeof(DXRibbonWindowPanel), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(default(Thickness), OnContentBackgroundBorderMarginInAeroModePropertyChanged));

		protected virtual void OnControlBoxChanged(UIElement oldValue)
		{
			OnChildChanged(oldValue, ControlBox);
		}

		protected virtual void OnContentChanged(UIElement oldValue)
		{
			OnChildChanged(oldValue, Content);
		}

		protected virtual void OnIconContainerChanged(UIElement oldValue)
		{
			OnChildChanged(oldValue, IconContainer);
		}

		protected virtual void OnTitleContainerChanged(UIElement oldValue)
		{
			OnChildChanged(oldValue, TitleContainer);
		}

		protected virtual void OnHeaderBackgroundBorderChanged(UIElement oldValue)
		{
			OnChildChanged(oldValue, HeaderBackgroundBorder);
		}

		protected virtual void OnBackgroundBorderChanged(UIElement oldValue)
		{
			OnChildChanged(oldValue, BackgroundBorder);
		}

		protected virtual void OnContentBackgroundBorderChanged(UIElement oldValue)
		{
			OnChildChanged(oldValue, ContentBackgroundBorder);
		}

		protected virtual void OnContentBackgroundBorderMarginChanged(Thickness oldValue)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnStatusBarContainerChanged(UIElement oldValue)
		{
			OnChildChanged(oldValue, StatusBarContainer);
		}

		protected virtual void OnContentBackgroundBorderInAeroModeChanged(UIElement oldValue)
		{
			OnChildChanged(oldValue, ContentBackgroundBorderInAeroMode);
		}

		protected virtual void OnContentBackgroundBorderMarginInAeroModeChanged(Thickness oldValue)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnContentBackgroundBorderPaddingChanged(Thickness oldValue)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnBackgroundBorderPaddingChanged(Thickness oldValue)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsAeroModeChanged(bool oldValue)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsRibbonModeChanged(bool oldValue)
		{
			SetVisibility(TitleContainer, !IsRibbonMode);
			SetVisibility(IconContainer, !IsRibbonMode);
		}

		private void SetVisibility(UIElement element, bool isVisible)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				element.Visibility = ((!isVisible) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
			}
		}

		private void OnChildChanged(UIElement oldElement, UIElement newElement)
		{
			if (oldElement != null)
			{
				base.Children.Remove(oldElement);
			}
			if (newElement != null)
			{
				base.Children.Add(newElement);
			}
		}

		protected override Size MeasureOverride(Size availableSize)
		{
			if (BackgroundBorder != null)
			{
				BackgroundBorder.Measure(availableSize);
			}
			availableSize = SubstractHorizontalPadding(availableSize, BackgroundBorderPadding);
			availableSize = SubstractVerticalPadding(availableSize, BackgroundBorderPadding);
			MeasureHeader(availableSize);
			if (!double.IsPositiveInfinity(availableSize.Height))
			{
				availableSize.Height = Math.Max(0.0, availableSize.Height - GetHeaderDesiredSize().Height);
			}
			availableSize = SubstractHorizontalPadding(availableSize, ContentBackgroundBorderMargin);
			availableSize = SubstractVerticalPadding(availableSize, ContentBackgroundBorderMargin);
			MeasureElement(ContentBackgroundBorder, availableSize);
			availableSize = SubstractHorizontalPadding(availableSize, ContentBackgroundBorderPadding);
			availableSize = SubstractVerticalPadding(availableSize, ContentBackgroundBorderPadding);
			MeasureElement(StatusBarContainer, availableSize);
			if (!double.IsPositiveInfinity(availableSize.Height))
			{
				availableSize.Height = Math.Max(0.0, availableSize.Height - GetDesiredSize(StatusBarContainer).Height);
			}
			MeasureElement(Content, availableSize);
			Size result = CalcDesiredSize();
			if (!double.IsPositiveInfinity(availableSize.Width))
			{
				result.Width = Math.Min(result.Width, availableSize.Width);
			}
			if (!double.IsPositiveInfinity(availableSize.Height))
			{
				result.Height = Math.Min(result.Height, availableSize.Height);
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override Size ArrangeOverride(Size finalSize)
		{
			Rect rect = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, finalSize.Width, finalSize.Height);
			if (BackgroundBorder != null)
			{
				BackgroundBorder.Arrange(rect);
			}
			rect = SubstractPadding(rect, BackgroundBorderPadding);
			Size headerDesiredSize = GetHeaderDesiredSize();
			ArrangeHeader(new Rect(rect.X, rect.Y, rect.Width, headerDesiredSize.Height));
			rect = SubstractPadding(rect, new Thickness(0.0, headerDesiredSize.Height, 0.0, 0.0));
			rect = SubstractPadding(rect, ContentBackgroundBorderMargin);
			ArrangeElement(ContentBackgroundBorder, rect);
			rect = SubstractPadding(rect, ContentBackgroundBorderPadding);
			headerDesiredSize = GetDesiredSize(StatusBarContainer);
			ArrangeElement(StatusBarContainer, new Rect(rect.X, rect.Bottom - headerDesiredSize.Height, rect.Width, headerDesiredSize.Height));
			rect = SubstractPadding(rect, new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, headerDesiredSize.Height));
			ArrangeElement(Content, rect);
			return finalSize;
		}

		private Size CalcDesiredSize()
		{
			Size headerDesiredSize = GetHeaderDesiredSize();
			headerDesiredSize = GetMaxWidthAndSumOfHeight(headerDesiredSize, GetDesiredSize(StatusBarContainer));
			headerDesiredSize = GetMaxWidthAndSumOfHeight(headerDesiredSize, GetDesiredSize(Content));
			headerDesiredSize = AddVerticalPadding(headerDesiredSize, BackgroundBorderPadding);
			headerDesiredSize = AddVerticalPadding(headerDesiredSize, ContentBackgroundBorderMargin);
			headerDesiredSize = AddVerticalPadding(headerDesiredSize, ContentBackgroundBorderPadding);
			headerDesiredSize = AddHorizontalPadding(headerDesiredSize, BackgroundBorderPadding);
			headerDesiredSize = AddHorizontalPadding(headerDesiredSize, ContentBackgroundBorderMargin);
			return AddHorizontalPadding(headerDesiredSize, ContentBackgroundBorderPadding);
		}

		protected virtual void MeasureHeader(Size availableSize)
		{
			MeasureElement(HeaderBackgroundBorder, availableSize);
			MeasureElement(ControlBox, availableSize);
			if (ControlBox != null && !double.IsPositiveInfinity(availableSize.Width))
			{
				availableSize.Width = Math.Max(0.0, availableSize.Width - ControlBox.DesiredSize.Width);
			}
			MeasureElement(IconContainer, availableSize);
			if (IconContainer != null && !double.IsPositiveInfinity(availableSize.Width))
			{
				availableSize.Width = Math.Max(0.0, availableSize.Width - IconContainer.DesiredSize.Width);
			}
			MeasureElement(TitleContainer, availableSize);
		}

		protected virtual Size GetHeaderDesiredSize()
		{
			Size size = default(Size);
			if (HeaderBackgroundBorder != null)
			{
				size.Height = HeaderBackgroundBorder.DesiredSize.Height;
			}
			size = GetMaxHeightAndSumOfWidth(size, GetDesiredSize(ControlBox));
			size = GetMaxHeightAndSumOfWidth(size, GetDesiredSize(TitleContainer));
			return GetMaxHeightAndSumOfWidth(size, GetDesiredSize(IconContainer));
		}

		protected virtual void ArrangeHeader(Rect finalRect)
		{
			Rect rect = new Rect(finalRect.X, finalRect.Y, finalRect.Width, finalRect.Height);
			ArrangeElement(HeaderBackgroundBorder, rect);
			Size desiredSize = GetDesiredSize(ControlBox);
			ArrangeElement(ControlBox, new Rect(rect.Right - desiredSize.Width, rect.Y, desiredSize.Width, rect.Height));
			rect = SubstractPadding(rect, new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, desiredSize.Width, 0.0));
			desiredSize = GetDesiredSize(IconContainer);
			ArrangeElement(IconContainer, new Rect(rect.X, rect.Y, desiredSize.Width, rect.Height));
			rect = SubstractPadding(rect, new Thickness(desiredSize.Width, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0));
			ArrangeElement(TitleContainer, rect);
		}

		private Size GetDesiredSize(UIElement element)
		{
			return element?.DesiredSize ?? default(Size);
		}

		private Size GetMaxHeightAndSumOfWidth(Size size1, Size size2)
		{
			return new Size(size1.Width + size2.Width, Math.Max(size1.Height, size2.Height));
		}

		private Size GetMaxWidthAndSumOfHeight(Size size1, Size size2)
		{
			return new Size(Math.Max(size1.Width, size2.Width), size1.Height + size2.Height);
		}

		private Size SubstractHorizontalPadding(Size size, Thickness padding)
		{
			if (double.IsPositiveInfinity(size.Width))
			{
				return size;
			}
			return new Size(Math.Max(0.0, size.Width) - padding.Left - padding.Right, size.Height);
		}

		private Rect SubstractPadding(Rect rect, Thickness padding)
		{
			return new Rect(rect.X + padding.Left, rect.Y + padding.Top, Math.Max(0.0, rect.Width - padding.Left - padding.Right), Math.Max(0.0, rect.Height - padding.Top - padding.Bottom));
		}

		private Size AddHorizontalPadding(Size size, Thickness padding)
		{
			if (double.IsPositiveInfinity(size.Width))
			{
				return size;
			}
			return new Size(size.Width + padding.Left + padding.Right, size.Height);
		}

		private Size AddVerticalPadding(Size size, Thickness padding)
		{
			if (double.IsPositiveInfinity(size.Width))
			{
				return size;
			}
			return new Size(size.Width, size.Height + padding.Top + padding.Bottom);
		}

		private Size SubstractVerticalPadding(Size size, Thickness padding)
		{
			if (double.IsPositiveInfinity(size.Height))
			{
				return size;
			}
			return new Size(size.Width, Math.Max(0.0, size.Height) - padding.Top - padding.Bottom);
		}

		private void MeasureElement(UIElement element, Size availableSize)
		{
			element?.Measure(availableSize);
		}

		private void ArrangeElement(UIElement element, Rect finalRect)
		{
			element?.Arrange(finalRect);
		}
	}

					RibbonControl oldValue = ribbon;
					ribbon = value;
					OnRibbonChanged(oldValue);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override bool CanResizeOrMaximize
		{

				{
					return !RibbonAutoHideMode;
				}
				return false;

		private UIElement RootContentPresenter { get; set; }

		static DXRibbonWindow()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<DXRibbonWindow>();
			IsRibbonCaptionVisibleProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("IsRibbonCaptionVisible", typeof(bool), typeof(DXRibbonWindow), new PropertyMetadata(false));
			IsCaptionVisibleProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("IsCaptionVisible", typeof(bool), typeof(DXRibbonWindow), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(true, OnIsCaptionVisiblePropertyChanged));
			ContentPresenterMarginPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttachedReadOnly("ContentPresenterMargin", typeof(Thickness), typeof(DXRibbonWindow), (PropertyMetadata)new UIPropertyMetadata(default(Thickness)));
			ContentPresenterMarginProperty = ContentPresenterMarginPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			AeroContentMarginPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttachedReadOnly("AeroContentMargin", typeof(Thickness), typeof(DXRibbonWindow), new PropertyMetadata(new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0), OnAeroContentMarginPropertyChanged));
			AeroContentMarginProperty = AeroContentMarginPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			RibbonHeaderBorderHeightPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttachedReadOnly("RibbonHeaderBorderHeight", typeof(double), typeof(DXRibbonWindow), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(double.NaN));
			RibbonHeaderBorderHeightProperty = RibbonHeaderBorderHeightPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			RibbonAutoHideModeProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("RibbonAutoHideMode", typeof(bool), typeof(DXRibbonWindow), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(false, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((DXRibbonWindow)(object)d).OnRibbonAutoHideModeChanged((bool)e.OldValue);
			}));
			DisplayShowModeSelectorProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("DisplayShowModeSelector", typeof(bool), typeof(DXRibbonWindow), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(false));
			ActualRibbonPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("ActualRibbon", typeof(RibbonControl), typeof(DXRibbonWindow), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));
			ActualRibbonProperty = ActualRibbonPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			FrameworkElement.MinWidthProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(DXRibbonWindow), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));
		}

		public static Thickness GetAeroContentMargin(DependencyObject obj)

		{
			((DXRibbonWindow)(object)sender).OnIsCaptionVisibleChanged((bool)e.OldValue);
		}

		protected internal static void OnAeroContentMarginPropertyChanged(DependencyObject sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender is DXRibbonWindow)
			{
				((DXRibbonWindow)(object)sender).OnAeroContentMarginChanged((Thickness)e.OldValue);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnRibbonAutoHideModeChanged(bool oldValue)
		{
			if (RibbonAutoHideMode)
			{
				((DependencyObject)this).SetCurrentValue(Window.WindowStateProperty, (object)WindowState.Maximized);
			}
			else
			{
				((DependencyObject)this).SetCurrentValue(Window.WindowStateProperty, (object)previousState);
			}
		}

		public DXRibbonWindow()
		{
			DXWindowsHelper.SetWindowKind((DependencyObject)(object)this, "DXRibbonWindow");
			DXWindowsHelper.SetWindow((DependencyObject)(object)this, (Window)(object)this);
			((UIElement)this).LayoutUpdated += OnLayoutUpdated;
			((FrameworkElement)this).Loaded += OnLoaded;
			((FrameworkElement)this).SizeChanged += OnSizeChanged;
			((DependencyObject)this).CoerceValue(FrameworkElement.MinWidthProperty);
		}

		protected virtual void GetMinHeaderWidth()
		{
			if (ActualRibbon.ApplicationButton != null)
			{
				switch (ActualRibbon.RibbonStyle)
				{
				case RibbonStyle.Office2007:
				case RibbonStyle.TabletOffice:
				case RibbonStyle.OfficeSlim:
					MinHeaderWidth = ActualRibbon.ApplicationButton.DesiredSize.Width + ActualRibbon.HeaderToolbarContainer.DesiredSize.Width + ActualRibbon.ControlBoxContainer.DesiredSize.Width - 10.0;
					break;
				case RibbonStyle.Office2010:
				case RibbonStyle.Office2019:
					MinHeaderWidth = ActualRibbon.HeaderToolbarContainer.DesiredSize.Width + ActualRibbon.ControlBoxContainer.DesiredSize.Width - 10.0;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnSizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
		}

		private void OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnRibbonChanged(RibbonControl oldValue)
		{
			Ribbon.Do(delegate(RibbonControl ribbon)
			{
				ribbon.UpdateIsInRibbonWindow();
			});
			((DependencyObject)this).SetValue(ActualRibbonPropertyKey, (object)Ribbon);
		}

		protected override void ShowSystemMenuOnRightClick(Point pos)
		{
			if (ActualRibbon == null || !BarManager.GetDXContextMenu((UIElement)ActualRibbon).ReturnSuccess<IPopupControl>())
			{
				((DXWindow)this).ShowSystemMenuOnRightClick(pos);
			}
		}

		protected override Thickness GetAeroBorderThickness()
		{
			Thickness result = new Thickness(-1.0);
			if (((Window)this).WindowState == WindowState.Maximized && Ribbon != null && Ribbon.HeaderBorder != null)
			{
				result.Top = Ribbon.HeaderBorder.RenderSize.Height;
			}
			else
			{
				result.Top = ((DXWindow)this).HeaderSize.Height;
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override void OnIsAeroModeChanged(bool oldValue)
		{
			((DXWindow)this).OnIsAeroModeChanged(oldValue);
			if (IsAeroModeChanged != null)
			{
				IsAeroModeChanged(this, new EventArgs());
			}
		}

		private void OnIsMinimizedHeaderVisibleChanged(bool oldValue)
		{
			FrameworkElement minimizedHeaderContainer = GetMinimizedHeaderContainer();
			if (minimizedHeaderContainer != null)
			{
				minimizedHeaderContainer.Visibility = ((!IsMinimizedHeaderVisible) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual FrameworkElement GetMinimizedHeaderContainer()
		{
			return ((DXWindow)this).GetVisualByName("MinimizedHeader") as FrameworkElement;
		}

		protected internal virtual FrameworkElement GetControlBoxContainer()
		{
			return ((DXWindow)this).GetVisualByName("PART_ControlBoxContainer") as FrameworkElement;
		}

		protected internal virtual UIElement GetContentContainer()
		{
			return LayoutHelper.FindElementByName((FrameworkElement)(object)this, "PART_ContainerContent");
		}

		internal void DragOrMaximizeWindow(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!RibbonAutoHideMode)
			{
				((DXWindow)this).DragWindowOrMaximizeWindow(sender, e);
			}
		}

		internal void ShowSystemMenu(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			Point position = e.GetPosition((IInputElement)this);
			position.X += ((Window)this).Left;
			position.Y += ((Window)this).Top;
			((DXWindow)this).ShowSystemMenu(position);
		}

		internal void ShowSystemMenu(UIElement relativeObject, Point relativeOffset)
		{
			if (relativeObject != null)
			{
				Point truePos = ((DXWindow)this).GetTruePos();
				Point point = relativeObject.TransformToAncestor(UIElementExtensions.GetRootVisual(relativeObject)).Transform(new Point(0.0, 0.0));
				point.X += truePos.X + relativeOffset.X;
				point.Y += truePos.Y + relativeOffset.Y;
				((DXWindow)this).ShowSystemMenu(point);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnLayoutUpdated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
		}

		protected internal void ResizeWindow(DXWindowActiveResizeParts resizeMode)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			((DXWindow)this).ResizeWindow(resizeMode);
		}

		protected internal void SetAeroContentHorizontalOffset(double offset)
		{
			SetAeroContentMargin((DependencyObject)(object)this, new Thickness(0.0, offset, 0.0, 0.0));
			SetContentPresenterMargin((DependencyObject)(object)this, new Thickness(0.0, 0.0 - offset, 0.0, 0.0));
		}

		protected internal void SetRibbonHeaderBorderHeight(double height)
		{
			SetRibbonHeaderBorderHeight((DependencyObject)(object)this, height);
			SetContentPresenterMargin((DependencyObject)(object)this, new Thickness(0.0, 0.0 - height, 0.0, 0.0));
		}

		protected override void UpdateHeaderWidth()
		{
		}

		private void OnIsCaptionVisibleChanged(bool oldValue)
		{
			if (IsCaptionVisible)
			{
				SetRibbonHeaderBorderHeight(0.0);
			}
			if (((DXWindow)this).IsAeroMode)
			{
				((DXWindow)this).ProcessDWM();
				((UIElement)this).UpdateLayout();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnAeroContentMarginChanged(Thickness oldValue)
		{
			if (((DXWindow)this).IsAeroMode)
			{
				((DXWindow)this).ProcessDWM();
				((UIElement)this).UpdateLayout();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnStateChanged(EventArgs e)
		{
			((DXWindow)this).OnStateChanged(e);
			if (!RibbonAutoHideMode)
			{
				previousState = ((Window)this).WindowState;
			}
			IsMinimizedHeaderVisible = ((Window)this).WindowState == WindowState.Minimized && !((Window)this).ShowInTaskbar;
			if (((Window)this).WindowState == WindowState.Normal)
			{
				((DependencyObject)this).SetCurrentValue(RibbonAutoHideModeProperty, (object)false);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnClose()
		{
		}

		protected override void OnMinimize()
		{
		}

		protected override void OnMaximize()
		{
		}

		protected override void OnRestore()
		{
		}

		protected override bool AllowOptimizeUpdateRootMargins()
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeftButtonDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			((UIElement)this).OnMouseLeftButtonDown(e);
			if (Ribbon != null && ((Window)this).WindowState == WindowState.Maximized)
			{
				Point position = e.GetPosition(Ribbon);
				if (position.X > 0.0 && position.X < Ribbon.ActualWidth && position.Y < 0.0)
				{
					DragOrMaximizeWindow(this, e);
				}
			}
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			((DXWindow)this).OnApplyTemplate();
			RootContentPresenter = ((FrameworkElement)this).GetTemplateChild("PART_RootContentPresenter") as UIElement;
			DXWindow.SetIsMaximized((DependencyObject)(object)this, ((Window)this).WindowState == WindowState.Maximized);
		}

		protected override Rect GetClientArea()
		{
			Rect result = ((DXWindow)this).GetClientArea();
			if (!result.Equals(Rect.Empty) && Ribbon != null && Ribbon.HeaderBorder != null)
			{
				double height = Ribbon.HeaderBorder.RenderSize.Height;
				result = new Rect(new Point(result.Left, result.Top + height), result.Size);
			}
			return result;
		}

		FrameworkElement IRibbonWindow.GetControlBoxContainer()
		{
			return GetControlBoxContainer();
		}

		Rect IRibbonWindow.GetControlBoxRect()
		{
			return ((DXWindow)this).GetControlBoxRect();
		}

		UIElement IRibbonWindow.GetContentContainer()
		{
			return GetContentContainer();
		}

		UIElement IRibbonWindow.GetWindowHeaderElement()
		{
			return Ribbon.With((RibbonControl x) => x.HeaderBorder);
		}

		public void DragOrMaximizeWindow(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			DragOrMaximizeWindow(e);
		}

		void IRibbonWindow.ApplyWindowKind()
		{
		}

		void IRibbonWindow.ShowWindowIcon()
		{
		}

		void IRibbonWindow.HideWindowIcon()
		{
		}

		[SpecialName]
		bool IRibbonWindow.get_ShowIcon()
		{
			return ((DXWindow)this).ShowIcon;
		}
	}

		static DXRibbonWindowContainer()
		{
			IsAeroModeProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("IsAeroMode", typeof(bool), typeof(DXRibbonWindowContainer), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(false, OnIsAeroModePropertyChanged));
			AeroTemplateProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("AeroTemplate", typeof(ControlTemplate), typeof(DXRibbonWindowContainer), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnAeroTemplatePropertyChanged));
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<DXRibbonWindowContainer>();
			IsActiveProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("IsActive", typeof(bool), typeof(DXRibbonWindowContainer), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(true, OnIsActivePropertyChanged));
			IsStatusBarVisibleProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("IsStatusBarVisible", typeof(bool), typeof(DXRibbonWindowContainer), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(true, OnIsStatusBarVisiblePropertyChanged));
			IsHeaderVisibleProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("IsHeaderVisible", typeof(bool), typeof(DXRibbonWindowContainer), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(true, OnIsHeaderVisiblePropertyChanged));
			IconProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Icon", typeof(ImageSource), typeof(DXRibbonWindowContainer), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnIconPropertyChanged));
			CaptionProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Caption", typeof(string), typeof(DXRibbonWindowContainer), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(string.Empty, OnCaptionPropertyChanged));
			IsMaximizeButtonVisibleProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("IsMaximizeButtonVisible", typeof(bool), typeof(DXRibbonWindowContainer), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(true, OnIsMaximizeButtonVisiblePropertyChanged));
			IsMinimizeButtonVisibleProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("IsMinimizeButtonVisible", typeof(bool), typeof(DXRibbonWindowContainer), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(true, OnIsMinimizeButtonVisiblePropertyChanged));
			IsRestoreButtonVisibleProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("IsRestoreButtonVisible", typeof(bool), typeof(DXRibbonWindowContainer), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(false, OnIsRestoreButtonVisiblePropertyChanged));
			IsCloseButtonVisibleProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("IsCloseButtonVisible", typeof(bool), typeof(DXRibbonWindowContainer), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(true, OnIsCloseButtonVisiblePropertyChanged));
		}

		static DXTreeView()
		{
			selectedItemChanged = new object();
			selectedItemRightMouseButtonClick = new object();
			selectedItemLeftMouseButtonClick = new object();
			selectedItemRemoved = new object();
			AllowAnimationProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("AllowAnimation", typeof(bool), typeof(DXTreeView), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(true));
			HorizontalScrollBarVisibilityProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("HorizontalScrollBarVisibility", typeof(ScrollBarVisibility), typeof(DXTreeView), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(ScrollBarVisibility.Auto));
			VerticalScrollBarVisibilityProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("VerticalScrollBarVisibility", typeof(ScrollBarVisibility), typeof(DXTreeView), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(ScrollBarVisibility.Auto));
			SelectedItemProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("SelectedItem", typeof(DXTreeViewItemBase), typeof(DXTreeView), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnSelectedItemPropertyChanged));
			BackgroundStyleProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("BackgroundStyle", typeof(Style), typeof(DXTreeView), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));
			BackgroundTemplateProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("BackgroundTemplate", typeof(ControlTemplate), typeof(DXTreeView), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));
		}

		protected static void OnSelectedItemPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((DXTreeView)d).OnSelectedItemChanged((DXTreeViewItemBase)e.OldValue);
		}

		public DXTreeView()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<DXTreeView>(this);
			base.Loaded += OnLoaded;
			base.Unloaded += OnUnLoaded;
		}

		private void OnUnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			UnSubscribeFromTopElementsEvents();
		}

		private void OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			SubscribeToTopElementsEvents();
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			scrViewer = GetTemplateChild("PART_ScrollViewer") as ScrollViewer;
		}

		protected override void OnItemsChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove)
			{
				foreach (object oldItem in e.OldItems)
				{
					DXTreeViewItemBase dXTreeViewItemBase = (IsItemItsOwnContainerOverride(oldItem) ? ((DXTreeViewItemBase)oldItem) : ((DXTreeViewItemBase)base.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(oldItem)));
					if (dXTreeViewItemBase == SelectedItem)
					{
						SelectedItem = null;
					}
				}
			}
			if (e.NewItems == null && e.Action != NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset)
			{
				SelectedItem = null;
			}
			IList list;
			if (e.Action != NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset)
			{
				list = e.NewItems;
			}
			else
			{
				IList items = base.Items;
				list = items;
			}
			IList list2 = list;
			if (base.Items.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (object item in list2)
			{
				if (item is DXTreeViewItemBase)
				{
					(item as DXTreeViewItemBase).TreeView = this;
					SubscribeToItemEvents(item as DXTreeViewItemBase);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnItemsSourceChanged(IEnumerable oldValue, IEnumerable newValue)
		{
			indexOfSelectedItem = -1;
			SelectedItem = null;
			OnItemsChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset));
			base.OnItemsSourceChanged(oldValue, newValue);
		}

		protected override DependencyObject GetContainerForItemOverride()
		{
			return new DXTreeViewItem();
		}

		protected override bool IsItemItsOwnContainerOverride(object item)
		{
			return item is DXTreeViewItemBase;
		}

		protected override void PrepareContainerForItemOverride(DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			if (!IsItemItsOwnContainerOverride(item))
			{
				(element as DXTreeViewItemBase).Content = item;
			}
			(element as DXTreeViewItemBase).TreeView = this;
			BindingOperations.SetBinding(element, DXTreeViewItemBase.AllowAnimationProperty, new Binding
			{
				Source = this,
				Path = new PropertyPath("AllowAnimation")
			});
			SubscribeToItemEvents(element as DXTreeViewItemBase);
			base.PrepareContainerForItemOverride(element, item);
		}

		protected override void ClearContainerForItemOverride(DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			(element as DXTreeViewItemBase).TreeView = null;
			(element as DXTreeViewItemBase).ParentTreeViewItem = null;
			UnSubscribeFromItemEvents(element as DXTreeViewItemBase);
			base.ClearContainerForItemOverride(element, item);
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnSelectedItemChanged(DXTreeViewItemBase oldValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				oldValue.IsSelected = false;
			}
			else
			{
				indexOfSelectedItem = -1;
			}
			if (SelectedItem != null)
			{
				SelectedItem.IsSelected = true;
				indexOfSelectedItem = ItemsToArray(onlySelectable: true).IndexOf(SelectedItem);
			}
			else if (!skipMoveSelection)
			{
				MoveSelectionDown(round: false);
			}
			if (scrViewer != null)
			{
				scrViewer.Focus();
			}
			RaiseSelectedItemChanged();
			if (SelectedItem != null)
			{
				FrameworkElement frameworkElement = null;
				frameworkElement = ((SelectedItem.ExpandButton != null) ? SelectedItem.ExpandButton : ((SelectedItem.CheckedBorder == null) ? ((FrameworkElement)SelectedItem) : ((FrameworkElement)SelectedItem.CheckedBorder)));
				Rect bounds = FrameworkElementExtensions.GetBounds(frameworkElement);
				Rect targetRectangle = new Rect(bounds.Left, bounds.Top - 7.0, bounds.Width, bounds.Height + 9.0);
				frameworkElement.BringIntoView(targetRectangle);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnItemMouseLeftButtonUp(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender is DXTreeViewItemBase)
			{
				SelectedItem = sender as DXTreeViewItemBase;
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void SubscribeToItemEvents(DXTreeViewItemBase dXTreeViewItemBase)
		{
			UnSubscribeFromItemEvents(dXTreeViewItemBase);
			dXTreeViewItemBase.MouseLeftButtonDown += OnItemMouseLeftButtonUp;
			dXTreeViewItemBase.MouseRightButtonDown += dXTreeViewItemBase_MouseRightButtonUp;
			dXTreeViewItemBase.MouseDoubleClick += OnPreviewItemMouseDoubleClick;
		}

		protected internal virtual void dXTreeViewItemBase_MouseRightButtonUp(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			SelectedItem = sender as DXTreeViewItemBase;
			RaiseSelectedItemRightMouseButtonClick();
			e.Handled = true;
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnPreviewItemMouseDoubleClick(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (SelectedItem != null && SelectedItem.CanExpand && (DXTreeViewItemBase)sender == SelectedItem)
			{
				SelectedItem.IsExpanded = !SelectedItem.IsExpanded;
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void UnSubscribeFromItemEvents(DXTreeViewItemBase dXTreeViewItemBase)
		{
			dXTreeViewItemBase.MouseLeftButtonDown -= OnItemMouseLeftButtonUp;
			dXTreeViewItemBase.MouseRightButtonDown -= dXTreeViewItemBase_MouseRightButtonUp;
			dXTreeViewItemBase.MouseDoubleClick -= OnPreviewItemMouseDoubleClick;
		}

		protected internal virtual void SubscribeToTopElementsEvents()
		{
			if (TopElement == null)
			{
				TopElement = LayoutHelper.GetTopLevelVisual((DependencyObject)this);
			}
			else
			{
				TopElement.RemoveHandler(UIElement.PreviewMouseDownEvent, new MouseButtonEventHandler(OnPreviewOwnerMouseDown));
			}
			TopElement.AddHandler(UIElement.PreviewMouseDownEvent, new MouseButtonEventHandler(OnPreviewOwnerMouseDown));
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnPreviewOwnerMouseDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
		}

		protected internal virtual void UnSubscribeFromTopElementsEvents()
		{
			if (TopElement != null)
			{
				TopElement.RemoveHandler(UIElement.PreviewMouseDownEvent, new MouseButtonEventHandler(OnPreviewOwnerMouseDown));
			}
			TopElement = null;
		}

		protected override void OnPreviewKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (SelectedItem != null)
			{
				if (e.Key == Key.Down)
				{
					MoveSelectionDown(round: true);
					e.Handled = true;
				}
				if (e.Key == Key.Up)
				{
					MoveSelectionUp();
					e.Handled = true;
				}
				if (e.Key == Key.Left)
				{
					CollapseSelectedItem();
					e.Handled = true;
				}
				if (e.Key == Key.Right)
				{
					ExpandSelectedItem();
					e.Handled = true;
				}
				if (e.Key == Key.Space && SelectedItem.Content is DependencyObject)
				{
					SetFocusToFirstFocusable(SelectedItem.Content as DependencyObject);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				SelectedItem = FindFirstSelectableItem(base.Items);
			}
			base.OnPreviewKeyDown(e);
		}

		protected internal virtual void SetFocusToFirstFocusable(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			int childrenCount = VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(obj);
			for (int i = 0; i < childrenCount; i++)
			{
				IInputElement inputElement = VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(obj, i) as IInputElement;
				if (inputElement.Focusable)
				{
					inputElement.Focus();
					return;
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < childrenCount; j++)
			{
				SetFocusToFirstFocusable(VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(obj, j));
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void ExpandSelectedItem()
		{
			if (SelectedItem.CanExpand && !SelectedItem.IsExpanded)
			{
				SelectedItem.IsExpanded = true;
			}
			MoveSelectionDown(round: true);
		}

		protected internal virtual void CollapseSelectedItem()
		{
			if (SelectedItem.IsExpanded)
			{
				SelectedItem.IsExpanded = false;
			}
			else if (SelectedItem.ParentTreeViewItem != null && !(SelectedItem.ParentTreeViewItem is DXTreeViewGroupItem))
			{
				SelectedItem = SelectedItem.ParentTreeViewItem;
				SelectedItem.IsExpanded = false;
			}
			else
			{
				MoveSelectionUp();
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual List<DXTreeViewItemBase> ItemsToArray(bool onlySelectable, bool invisibleToo = false)
		{
			List<DXTreeViewItemBase> list = new List<DXTreeViewItemBase>();
			foreach (object item in (IEnumerable)base.Items)
			{
				if (item is DXTreeViewItemBase)
				{
					DXTreeViewItemBase dXTreeViewItemBase = item as DXTreeViewItemBase;
					list.AddRange(dXTreeViewItemBase.GetDXTreeViewItems(onlySelectable));
				}
				else
				{
					list.Add(base.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(item) as DXTreeViewItemBase);
				}
			}
			if (!invisibleToo)
			{
				list.RemoveAll((DXTreeViewItemBase i) => !FrameworkElementExtensions.IsVisible((FrameworkElement)i));
			}
			if (onlySelectable)
			{
				list.RemoveAll((DXTreeViewItemBase i) => i is DXTreeViewGroupItem);
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected internal virtual void MoveSelectionUp()
		{
			if (indexOfSelectedItem == -1)
			{
				SelectedItem = FindFirstSelectableItem(base.Items);
			}
			else if (base.Items.Count != 0)
			{
				List<DXTreeViewItemBase> list = ItemsToArray(onlySelectable: true);
				SelectedItem = ((indexOfSelectedItem == 0) ? list[list.Count - 1] : list[indexOfSelectedItem - 1]);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void MoveSelectionDown(bool round)
		{
			if (indexOfSelectedItem == -1)
			{
				SelectedItem = FindFirstSelectableItem();
				return;
			}
			List<DXTreeViewItemBase> list = ItemsToArray(onlySelectable: true);
			if (list.Count != 0 && indexOfSelectedItem + 1 <= list.Count)
			{
				SelectedItem = ((indexOfSelectedItem != list.Count - 1) ? list[indexOfSelectedItem + 1] : (round ? list[0] : list[indexOfSelectedItem]));
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual DXTreeViewItemBase FindFirstSelectableItem(ItemCollection collection)
		{
			foreach (DXTreeViewItemBase item in (IEnumerable)collection)
			{
				if (item is DXTreeViewItem)
				{
					return item;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected internal virtual DXTreeViewItemBase FindFirstSelectableItem()
		{
			List<DXTreeViewItemBase> source = ItemsToArray(onlySelectable: true);
			if (source.Count((DXTreeViewItemBase i) => i is DXTreeViewItem) != 0)
			{
				return source.First((DXTreeViewItemBase i) => i is DXTreeViewItem);
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected internal virtual DXTreeViewItemBase FindLastSelectableItem(ItemCollection collection)
		{
			for (int num = collection.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				object obj = collection[num];
				if (obj is DXTreeViewItem)
				{
					return obj as DXTreeViewItemBase;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected internal virtual DXTreeViewItemBase FindItem(Predicate<DXTreeViewItemBase> predicate)
		{
			foreach (DXTreeViewItemBase item in (IEnumerable)base.Items)
			{
				if (predicate(item))
				{
					return item;
				}
			}
			DXTreeViewItemBase dXTreeViewItemBase2 = null;
			foreach (DXTreeViewItemBase item2 in (IEnumerable)base.Items)
			{
				dXTreeViewItemBase2 = item2.FindItem(predicate);
				if (dXTreeViewItemBase2 != null)
				{
					return dXTreeViewItemBase2;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			return Clone();
		}

		public virtual DXTreeView Clone()
		{
			DXTreeView dXTreeView = new DXTreeView();
			dXTreeView.ItemTemplate = base.ItemTemplate;
			dXTreeView.ItemTemplateSelector = base.ItemTemplateSelector;
			CloneItems(this, dXTreeView);
			return dXTreeView;
		}

		internal static void CloneItems(ItemsControl source, ItemsControl target)
		{
			if (source.ItemsSource != null)
			{
				if (source.ItemsSource.OfType<DXTreeViewItemBase>().Count() != source.ItemsSource.OfType<object>().Count())
				{
					target.ItemsSource = source.ItemsSource;
					return;
				}
				ObservableCollection<DXTreeViewItemBase> observableCollection = new ObservableCollection<DXTreeViewItemBase>();
				foreach (DXTreeViewItemBase item in source.ItemsSource)
				{
					observableCollection.Add(item.Clone());
				}
				target.ItemsSource = observableCollection;
				return;
			}
			if (source.Items.OfType<DXTreeViewItemBase>().Count() != source.Items.OfType<object>().Count())
			{
				foreach (object item2 in (IEnumerable)source.Items)
				{
					if (item2 is ICloneable)
					{
						target.Items.Add(((ICloneable)item2).Clone());
					}
					else
					{
						target.Items.Add(item2);
					}
				}
				return;
			}
			foreach (DXTreeViewItemBase item3 in (IEnumerable)source.Items)
			{
				target.Items.Add(item3.Clone());
			}
		}
	}

		static DXTreeViewItem()
		{
			GlyphStyleProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("GlyphStyle", typeof(Style), typeof(DXTreeViewItem), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));

		protected internal virtual void Collapse()
		{
			foreach (object item in (IEnumerable)base.Items)
			{
				if (item is DXTreeViewItemBase)
				{
					(item as DXTreeViewItemBase).IsExpanded = false;
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual DXTreeViewItemBase FindItem(Predicate<DXTreeViewItemBase> predicate)
		{
			foreach (DXTreeViewItemBase item in (IEnumerable)base.Items)
			{
				if (predicate(item))
				{
					return item;
				}
			}
			DXTreeViewItemBase dXTreeViewItemBase2 = null;
			foreach (DXTreeViewItemBase item2 in (IEnumerable)base.Items)
			{
				dXTreeViewItemBase2 = item2.FindItem(predicate);
				if (dXTreeViewItemBase2 != null)
				{
					return dXTreeViewItemBase2;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected internal virtual void Remove()
		{
			ItemsControl itemsControl = ((ParentTreeViewItem == null) ? ((ItemsControl)TreeView) : ((ItemsControl)ParentTreeViewItem));
			object obj;
			if (itemsControl.ItemsSource != null)
			{
				obj = itemsControl.ItemsSource as IList;
			}
			else
			{
				IList items = itemsControl.Items;
				obj = items;
			}
			IList list = (IList)obj;
			list.Remove(this);
		}

		protected internal virtual List<DXTreeViewItemBase> GetDXTreeViewItems(bool onlyIfIsExpanded)
		{
			List<DXTreeViewItemBase> list = new List<DXTreeViewItemBase>();
			list.Add(this);
			if (IsExpanded || !onlyIfIsExpanded)
			{
				foreach (object item in (IEnumerable)base.Items)
				{
					if (item is DXTreeViewItemBase dXTreeViewItemBase)
					{
						list.AddRange(dXTreeViewItemBase.GetDXTreeViewItems(onlyIfIsExpanded));
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		}

		protected override void OnItemsChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove && TreeView != null)
			{
				foreach (object oldItem in e.OldItems)
				{
					DXTreeViewItemBase dXTreeViewItemBase = (IsItemItsOwnContainerOverride(oldItem) ? ((DXTreeViewItemBase)oldItem) : ((DXTreeViewItemBase)base.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(oldItem)));
					if (dXTreeViewItemBase == TreeView.SelectedItem)
					{
						LastRemovedItem = dXTreeViewItemBase;
						TreeView.SelectedItem = null;
						if (TreeView.SelectedItem == null)
						{
							TreeView.SelectedItem = this;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (e.NewItems == null && e.Action != NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset)
			{
				return;
			}
			IList list;
			if (e.Action != NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset)
			{
				list = e.NewItems;
			}
			else
			{
				IList items = base.Items;
				list = items;
			}
			IList list2 = list;
			foreach (object item in list2)
			{
				if (item is DXTreeViewItem)
				{
					(item as DXTreeViewItemBase).ParentTreeViewItem = this;
					(item as DXTreeViewItemBase).TreeView = TreeView;
				}
				if (item == LastRemovedItem)
				{
					TreeView.SelectedItem = (DXTreeViewItemBase)item;
					LastRemovedItem = null;
				}
			}
			if (base.Items.Count != 0)
			{
				CanExpand = true;
			}
			else
			{
				CanExpand = false;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnItemsSourceChanged(IEnumerable oldValue, IEnumerable newValue)
		{
			OnItemsChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset));
		}

		protected override DependencyObject GetContainerForItemOverride()
		{
			return new DXTreeViewItem();
		}

		protected override bool IsItemItsOwnContainerOverride(object item)
		{
			return item is DXTreeViewItemBase;
		}

		protected override void PrepareContainerForItemOverride(DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			if (!IsItemItsOwnContainerOverride(item))
			{
				(element as DXTreeViewItemBase).Content = item;
			}
			(element as DXTreeViewItemBase).TreeView = TreeView;
			BindingOperations.SetBinding(element, AllowAnimationProperty, new Binding
			{
				Source = this,
				Path = new PropertyPath("AllowAnimation")
			});
			TreeView.SubscribeToItemEvents(element as DXTreeViewItemBase);
			base.PrepareContainerForItemOverride(element, item);
		}

		protected override void ClearContainerForItemOverride(DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			if (TreeView != null)
			{
				TreeView.UnSubscribeFromItemEvents(element as DXTreeViewItemBase);
			}
			(element as DXTreeViewItemBase).TreeView = null;
			(element as DXTreeViewItemBase).ParentTreeViewItem = null;
			base.ClearContainerForItemOverride(element, item);
			if (base.Items.Count == 0)
			{
				CanExpand = false;
			}
		}

		private void SubscribeEventHandlers()
		{
			if (ExpandButton != null)
			{
				ExpandButton.Click += OnExpandButtonClick;
			}
		}

		private void UnSubscribeEventHandlers()
		{
			if (ExpandButton != null)
			{
				ExpandButton.Click -= OnExpandButtonClick;
			}
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			return Clone();
		}

		protected virtual DXTreeViewItemBase CreateClone()
		{
			return new DXTreeViewItem();
		}

		public virtual DXTreeViewItemBase Clone()
		{
			DXTreeViewItemBase dXTreeViewItemBase = CreateClone();
			dXTreeViewItemBase.ItemTemplate = base.ItemTemplate;
			dXTreeViewItemBase.ItemTemplateSelector = base.ItemTemplateSelector;
			DXTreeView.CloneItems(this, dXTreeViewItemBase);
			return dXTreeViewItemBase;
		}

			return galleryDropDownControl;
		}

		protected internal void CloseWithTimer()
		{
			DispatcherTimer dispatcherTimer = new DispatcherTimer();
			dispatcherTimer.Interval = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(400.0);
			dispatcherTimer.Tick += OnCloseTimerTick;
			dispatcherTimer.Start();
		}

		private void OnCloseTimerTick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender is DispatcherTimer dispatcherTimer)
			{
				dispatcherTimer.Tick -= OnCloseTimerTick;
			}
			((BarPopupBase)this).ClosePopup();
		}

		protected override bool HasVisibleItems()
		{
			if (!((PopupMenuBase)this).HasVisibleItems())
			{
				return Gallery != null;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void UpdatePlacement()
		{
			if (((Popup)this).PlacementTarget != null)
			{
				((BarPopupBase)this).UpdatePlacement(((Popup)this).PlacementTarget);
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdatePlacement(UIElement control)
		{
			((Popup)this).Placement = PlacementMode.Bottom;
			((DispatcherObject)this).Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (SystemParameters.MenuDropAlignment)
				{
					if (((BarPopupBase)this).OwnerLinkControl != null && (int)((BarPopupExpandable)this).ExpandMode != 0)
					{
						((Popup)this).HorizontalOffset = ((FrameworkElement)(object)DropDownControl).ActualWidth / 2.0;
					}
					else if (control != null)
					{
						((Popup)this).HorizontalOffset = ((Popup)this).Child.RenderSize.Width - control.RenderSize.Width;
					}
				}
			}, DispatcherPriority.Render);
		}

		protected override void FillAutomationChildren(List<AutomationPeer> children)
		{
			((PopupMenuBase)this).FillAutomationChildren(children);
			BarsAutomationHelper.GetChildrenRecursive(children, (DependencyObject)(object)DropDownControl);
		}

		protected virtual void OnGalleryChanged(Gallery oldValue)

			if (Gallery != null)

		protected virtual void UpdateResizeMode()
		{
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0021: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0022: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0034: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			if (Gallery == null)
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState((FrameworkElement)(object)this, "NoneResizeMode", useTransitions: false);
				return;
			}
			GallerySizeMode sizeMode = Gallery.SizeMode;
			switch ((int)sizeMode)
			{
			case 2:
				VisualStateManager.GoToState((FrameworkElement)(object)this, "BothResizeMode", useTransitions: false);
				break;
			case 0:
				VisualStateManager.GoToState((FrameworkElement)(object)this, "NoneResizeMode", useTransitions: false);
				break;
			case 1:
				VisualStateManager.GoToState((FrameworkElement)(object)this, "VerticalResizeMode", useTransitions: false);
				break;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateDragCursor()
		{
			if (ThumbForBothResize != null)

		protected virtual Size GetMinScrollHostSize()
		{
			Size popupActualSize = GetPopupActualSize();
			Size scrollHostRenderSize = GalleryControl.GetScrollHostRenderSize();
			Size minScrollHostSize = GalleryControl.GetMinScrollHostSize();
			Size popupMinSize = GetPopupMinSize();
			if (popupActualSize.Width - popupMinSize.Width < scrollHostRenderSize.Width - minScrollHostSize.Width)
			{
				minScrollHostSize.Width = scrollHostRenderSize.Width - popupActualSize.Width + popupMinSize.Width;
			}
			if (popupActualSize.Height - popupMinSize.Height < scrollHostRenderSize.Height - minScrollHostSize.Height)
			{
				minScrollHostSize.Height = scrollHostRenderSize.Height - popupActualSize.Height + popupMinSize.Height;
			}
			return minScrollHostSize;
		}

		protected virtual Size GetMaxScrollHostSize()
		{
			return new Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity);
		}

		protected virtual void OnDragStarted()
		{
			OriginScrollHostSize = GalleryControl.GetScrollHostRenderSize();
			MinScrollHostSize = GetMinScrollHostSize();
			MaxScrollHostSize = GetMaxScrollHostSize();
			DragOffset = default(Point);
		}

		private void OnThumbForVertResizeDragStarted(object sender, DragStartedEventArgs e)

		private void OnThumbForBothResizeDragStarted(object sender, DragStartedEventArgs e)

		private void OnThumbForBothResizeDragDelta(object sender, DragDeltaEventArgs e)

		}

		private Size GetPopupMinSize()
		{
			if (((SubMenuBarControl)this).Popup == null)
			{
				return default(Size);
			}
			return new Size(((FrameworkElement)(object)((SubMenuBarControl)this).Popup).MinWidth, ((FrameworkElement)(object)((SubMenuBarControl)this).Popup).MinHeight);
		}

		private Size GetPopupActualSize()
		{
			Size result = new Size(((FrameworkElement)this).Width, ((FrameworkElement)this).Height);
			if (((SubMenuBarControl)this).Popup == null)
			{
				return result;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(result.Width))
			{
				if (((Popup)(object)((SubMenuBarControl)this).Popup).Child != null)
				{
					result.Width = ((Popup)(object)((SubMenuBarControl)this).Popup).Child.RenderSize.Width;
				}
				else
				{
					result.Width = 0.0;
				}
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(result.Height))
			{
				if (((Popup)(object)((SubMenuBarControl)this).Popup).Child != null)
				{
					result.Height = ((Popup)(object)((SubMenuBarControl)this).Popup).Child.RenderSize.Height;
				}
				else
				{
					result.Height = 0.0;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void CorrectByScreenBounds(ref double horizontalChange, ref double verticalChange)
		{
			if (((SubMenuBarControl)this).Popup == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Point screenPoint = ScreenHelper.GetScreenPoint(((Popup)(object)((SubMenuBarControl)this).Popup).PlacementTarget as FrameworkElement, default(Point));
			Rect screenRect = ScreenHelper.GetScreenRect(((Popup)(object)((SubMenuBarControl)this).Popup).Child as FrameworkElement);
			Point screenPoint2 = ScreenHelper.GetScreenPoint(((Popup)(object)((SubMenuBarControl)this).Popup).Child as FrameworkElement, default(Point));
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = ((Popup)(object)((SubMenuBarControl)this).Popup).Child as FrameworkElement;
			if (((FrameworkElement)this).FlowDirection == FlowDirection.LeftToRight)
			{
				if (screenPoint2.X + frameworkElement.ActualWidth + horizontalChange > screenRect.X + screenRect.Width)
				{
					horizontalChange = screenRect.X + screenRect.Width - screenPoint2.X - frameworkElement.ActualWidth;
				}
				if (screenPoint.Y > screenPoint2.Y)
				{
					verticalChange = 0.0;
				}
				else if (screenPoint2.Y + frameworkElement.ActualHeight + verticalChange > screenRect.Y + screenRect.Height)
				{
					verticalChange = screenRect.Y + screenRect.Height - screenPoint2.Y - frameworkElement.ActualHeight;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (screenPoint2.X - frameworkElement.ActualWidth - horizontalChange < screenRect.X)
				{
					horizontalChange = screenPoint2.X - frameworkElement.ActualWidth - screenRect.X;
				}
				if (screenPoint.Y > screenPoint2.Y)
				{
					verticalChange = 0.0;
				}
			}
		}

		private void ChangeSize(double horizontalChange, double verticalChange)
		{
			if (((GalleryControl)GalleryControl).Gallery != null)
			{
				CorrectByScreenBounds(ref horizontalChange, ref verticalChange);
				Size scrollHostRenderSize = GalleryControl.GetScrollHostRenderSize();
				DragOffset = new Point(scrollHostRenderSize.Width - OriginScrollHostSize.Width + horizontalChange, scrollHostRenderSize.Height - OriginScrollHostSize.Height + verticalChange);
				Size scrollHostSize = new Size(Math.Max(MinScrollHostSize.Width, OriginScrollHostSize.Width + DragOffset.X), Math.Max(MinScrollHostSize.Height, OriginScrollHostSize.Height + DragOffset.Y));
				if (!double.IsPositiveInfinity(MaxScrollHostSize.Width))
				{
					scrollHostSize.Width = Math.Min(scrollHostSize.Width, MaxScrollHostSize.Width);
				}
				if (!double.IsPositiveInfinity(MaxScrollHostSize.Height))
				{
					scrollHostSize.Height = Math.Min(scrollHostSize.Height, MaxScrollHostSize.Height);
				}
				GalleryControl.SetScrollHostSize(scrollHostSize);
			}
		}

		protected override IList<INavigationElement> GetNavigationElements()
		{
			List<INavigationElement> list = new List<INavigationElement>(((LinksControl)this).GetNavigationElements());
			if (GalleryControl != null)
			{
				list.Insert(0, (INavigationElement)(object)GalleryControl);
			}
			return list;
		}
	}

	public class RibbonOrderedItemInfo
	{
		public int Index { get; set; }

		public int? Order { get; set; }

		public object Item { get; set; }

		public RibbonOrderedItemInfo(int index, int? order, object item)
		{
			Index = index;
			Order = order;
			Item = item;
		}
	}
	public class RibbonOrderedItemsHelper
	{
		public static RibbonOrderedItemInfo[] SortByOrder(RibbonOrderedItemInfo[] items)
		{
			int num = 0;
			RibbonOrderedItemInfo[] array = new RibbonOrderedItemInfo[items.Length];
			IEnumerable<RibbonOrderedItemInfo> enumerable = items.Where((RibbonOrderedItemInfo x) => x.Order.HasValue);
			IOrderedEnumerable<RibbonOrderedItemInfo> orderedEnumerable = from x in enumerable
				where x.Order.Value < 0
				orderby x.Order.Value, x.Index
				select x;
			foreach (RibbonOrderedItemInfo item in orderedEnumerable)
			{
				array[num++] = item;
			}
			num = array.Length - 1;
			IOrderedEnumerable<RibbonOrderedItemInfo> orderedEnumerable2 = from x in enumerable
				where x.Order.Value >= items.Length
				orderby x.Order.Value descending, x.Index descending
				select x;
			foreach (RibbonOrderedItemInfo item2 in orderedEnumerable2)
			{
				array[num--] = item2;
			}
			IEnumerator<RibbonOrderedItemInfo> enumerator3 = (from x in enumerable.Except(orderedEnumerable).Except(orderedEnumerable2)
				orderby x.Order.Value descending, x.Index descending
				select x).GetEnumerator();
			if (enumerator3.MoveNext())
			{
				for (num = array.Length - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					if (array[num] == null)
					{
						RibbonOrderedItemInfo current3 = enumerator3.Current;
						if (num <= current3.Order.Value)
						{
							array[num] = current3;
							if (!enumerator3.MoveNext())
							{
								break;
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			IEnumerator<RibbonOrderedItemInfo> enumerator4 = (from x in items.Except(array)
				orderby x.Index
				select x).GetEnumerator();
			if (enumerator4.MoveNext())
			{
				for (num = 0; num < array.Length; num++)
				{
					if (array[num] == null)
					{
						RibbonOrderedItemInfo current4 = enumerator4.Current;
						array[num] = current4;
						if (!enumerator4.MoveNext())
						{
							break;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return array;
		}
	}
	public class RibbonQuickAccessToolbar : BarItemLinkHolderBase, ILinksHolder, IMultipleElementRegistratorSupport, IBarNameScopeSupport, IInputElement, ILogicalChildrenContainer
	{
		private RibbonControl ribbon;

		private RibbonQuickAccessToolbarControl control;

		public RibbonControl Ribbon
		{
			get
			{
				return ribbon;
			}
			protected internal set
			{
				if (Ribbon != value)
				{
					RibbonControl oldValue = ribbon;
					ribbon = value;
					OnRibbonChanged(oldValue);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal RibbonQuickAccessToolbarControl Control
		{
			get
			{
				if (control == null)
				{
					control = CreateControl();
				}
				return control;
			}
		}

		LinksHolderType ILinksHolder.HolderType => (LinksHolderType)11;

		static RibbonQuickAccessToolbar()
		{
			EventManager.RegisterClassHandler(typeof(RibbonQuickAccessToolbar), DXSerializer.StartDeserializingEvent, new RoutedEventHandler(OnStartDeserializingEvent));
		}

		private static void OnStartDeserializingEvent(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			((Collection<BarItemLinkBase>)(object)((BarItemLinkHolderBase)(RibbonQuickAccessToolbar)sender).ItemLinks).Clear();
		}

		protected virtual void OnRibbonChanged(RibbonControl oldValue)
		{
		}

		protected internal virtual RibbonQuickAccessToolbarControl CreateControl()
		{
			return new RibbonQuickAccessToolbarControl(this);
		}

		protected internal virtual void Remerge()
		{
			((ILinksHolder)this).MergedChildren.Remerge();
		}

		internal void SetRibbonStyle(RibbonStyle ribbonStyle)
		{
			if (Control != null)
			{
				Control.RibbonStyle = ribbonStyle;
			}
		}

		internal void SetPlacement(RibbonQuckAccessToolbarPlacement placement)
		{
			if (Control != null)
			{
				Control.Placement = placement;
			}
		}

		internal double GetMinDesiredWidth()
		{
			if (Control == null)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return Control.GetMinDesiredWidth();
		}
	}

	public abstract class RibbonLinksControl : LinksControl
	{
		public RibbonLinksControl()
		{
			((UIElement)this).IsEnabledChanged += OnIsEnabledChanged;
		}

		protected override bool GetCanEnterMenuMode()
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected override IList<INavigationElement> GetNavigationElements()
		{
			return new List<INavigationElement>();
		}

		protected override IBarsNavigationSupport GetNavigationParent()
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected override int GetNavigationID()
		{
			return ((object)this).GetHashCode();
		}

		protected override NavigationKeys GetNavigationKeys()
		{
			return (NavigationKeys)11;
		}

		protected override KeyboardNavigationMode GetNavigationMode()
		{
			return KeyboardNavigationMode.Cycle;
		}

		protected override Orientation GetNavigationOrientation()
		{
			return Orientation.Vertical;
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsEnabledChanged(object sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (((LinksControl)this).ItemLinks == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (BarItemLinkBase item in (Collection<BarItemLinkBase>)(object)((LinksControl)this).ItemLinks)
			{
				((DependencyObject)(object)item).CoerceValue(ContentElement.IsEnabledProperty);
			}
		}

		protected override void PrepareContainerForItemOverride(DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			((LinksControl)this).PrepareContainerForItemOverride(element, item);
			RibbonControl ribbonControl = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<RibbonControl>((DependencyObject)(object)this);
			BarItemLinkInfo val = (BarItemLinkInfo)(object)((element is BarItemLinkInfo) ? element : null);
			if (ribbonControl != null && val != null)
			{
				val.BarPopupExpandMode = (BarPopupExpandMode)(IsRibbonTablet(ribbonControl.RibbonStyle) ? 1 : 0);
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool IsRibbonTablet(RibbonStyle ribbonStyle)
		{
			if (ribbonStyle != RibbonStyle.TabletOffice)
			{
				return ribbonStyle == RibbonStyle.OfficeSlim;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

			((LinksControl)this).UpdateItemsSource();
			UpdateBorderTemplates();

		protected virtual LinkContainerType GetContainerTypeByPlacement()
		{
			RibbonQuckAccessToolbarPlacement placement = Placement;
			if (placement != RibbonQuckAccessToolbarPlacement.Footer && placement != RibbonQuckAccessToolbarPlacement.Popup)
			{
				return (LinkContainerType)5;
			}
			return (LinkContainerType)13;
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateContainerTypeByPlacement()
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			((LinksControl)this).ContainerType = GetContainerTypeByPlacement();
		}

		protected virtual void ShowPopup()
		{
			((Popup)(object)Popup).Placement = PlacementMode.Bottom;
			((PopupBase)Popup).PopupContent = PopupControl;
			PopupControl.ShowCustomizationButton = ShowCustomizationButton;
			if (((LinksControl)PopupControl).ItemsPresenter != null)
			{
				((LinksControl)PopupControl).ItemsPresenter.InvalidateMeasure();
			}
			((BarPopupBase)Popup).ShowPopup((UIElement)DropDownButton);
		}

		protected override IList<INavigationElement> GetNavigationElements()
		{
			//IL_0057: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (((ItemsControl)(object)this).ItemsSource == null)
			{
				return (from x in ((ItemsControl)(object)this).Items.OfType<INavigationElement>()
					where ((IBarsNavigationSupport)x).IsSelectable
					select x).ToList();
			}
			List<INavigationElement> list = new List<INavigationElement>();
			foreach (INavigationElement item in ((ItemsControl)(object)this).ItemsSource)
			{
				INavigationElement val = item;
				if (((IBarsNavigationSupport)val).IsSelectable)
				{
					list.Add(val);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		}

				((Popup)(object)Toolbar.Control.Popup).IsOpen = false;

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			UnsubscribeTemplateEvents();
			((LinksControl)this).OnApplyTemplate();
			CustomizationButton = (RibbonCheckedBorderControl)((FrameworkElement)(object)this).GetTemplateChild("PART_ToolbarCustomizationButton");
			DropDownButton = (RibbonCheckedBorderControl)((FrameworkElement)(object)this).GetTemplateChild("PART_ToolbarDropDownButton");
			RightContentControl = (ContentControl)((FrameworkElement)(object)this).GetTemplateChild("PART_RightContentControl");
			LeftContentControl = (ContentControl)((FrameworkElement)(object)this).GetTemplateChild("PART_LeftContentControl");
			OriginItemContainer = (ContentControl)((FrameworkElement)(object)this).GetTemplateChild("PART_OriginItemContainer");
			UpdateButtonsTemplate();
			UpdateBorderTemplates();
			UpdateButtonsVisibility();
			SubscribeTemplateEvents();
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateButtonsTemplate()
		{
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0016: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_003a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0041: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (DropDownButton != null)
			{
				DropDownButton.Template = (((int)GetContainerTypeByPlacement() == 13) ? DropDownButtonTemplateInFooter : DropDownButtonTemplateInHeader);
			}
			if (CustomizationButton != null)
			{
				CustomizationButton.Template = (((int)GetContainerTypeByPlacement() == 13) ? CustomizationButtonTemplateInFooter : CustomizationButtonTemplateInHeader);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void SubscribeTemplateEvents()
		{
			if (DropDownButton != null)
			{
				DropDownButton.MouseLeftButtonDown += OnDropDownButtonMouseLeftButtonDown;
			}
			if (CustomizationButton != null)
			{
				CustomizationButton.Click += OnCustomizationButtonClick;
			}
			if (Popup != null)
			{
				((Popup)(object)Popup).Closed += OnPopupClosed;
			}
			if (OriginItemContainer != null)
			{
				OriginItemContainer.Content = CreateOriginItemControl();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UnsubscribeTemplateEvents()
		{
			if (DropDownButton != null)
			{
				DropDownButton.MouseLeftButtonDown -= OnDropDownButtonMouseLeftButtonDown;
			}
			if (CustomizationButton != null)
			{
				CustomizationButton.Click -= OnCustomizationButtonClick;
			}
			if (Popup != null)
			{
				((Popup)(object)Popup).Closed -= OnPopupClosed;
			}
			if (OriginItemContainer != null)
			{
				OriginItemContainer.Content = null;
			}
		}

		protected virtual IBarItemLinkControl CreateOriginItemControl()
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0005: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0018: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			BarStaticItemLinkControl val = new BarStaticItemLinkControl

				CurrentRibbonStyle = (RibbonItemStyles)2

		}

		private void OnPopupClosed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			((PopupBase)Popup).PopupContent = null;
			popupControlCore = null;
			DropDownButton.IsChecked = false;
			IsPopupOpened = false;
		}

		protected internal virtual void ShowCustomizationMenu()
		{
			InitializeCustomizationMenu();
			ToolbarCustomizationMenuShowingEventArgs e = new ToolbarCustomizationMenuShowingEventArgs(CustomizationMenu);
			Toolbar.Ribbon.RaiseToolbarCustomizationMenuShowing(e);
			if (!e.Cancel && ((Collection<BarItemLinkBase>)(object)((PopupMenu)CustomizationMenu).ItemLinks).Count != 0)
			{
				((Popup)(object)CustomizationMenu).Closed -= OnCustomizationMenuClosed;
				((Popup)(object)CustomizationMenu).Closed += OnCustomizationMenuClosed;
				((BarPopupBase)CustomizationMenu).ShowPopup(((Popup)(object)CustomizationMenu).PlacementTarget);
				CustomizationButton.IsChecked = true;
			}
		}

		private void OnCustomizationMenuClosed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			ClearCustomizationMenu();
			CustomizationButton.IsChecked = false;
			Toolbar.Ribbon.RaiseToolbarCustomizationMenuClosed(new ToolbarCustomizationMenuClosedEventArgs(CustomizationMenu));
		}

		protected void OnDropDownButtonMouseLeftButtonDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			IsPopupOpened = DropDownButton.IsChecked != true;
		}

		protected internal virtual void CloseCustomizationMenu()
		{
			if (CustomizationMenu != null)
			{
				((BarPopupBase)CustomizationMenu).ClosePopup();
			}
			if (CustomizationButton != null)
			{
				CustomizationButton.IsChecked = false;
			}
		}

		protected void OnCustomizationButtonClick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (CustomizationButton.IsChecked == true)
			{
				CloseCustomizationMenu();
			}
			else
			{
				ShowCustomizationMenu();
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void UpdateButtonsVisibility()
		{
			bool flag = VisibleItemsCount == ((ItemsControl)(object)this).Items.Count - FirstVisibleItemIndex;
			if (DropDownButton == null || CustomizationButton == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				DropDownButton.Opacity = 1.0;
				DropDownButton.IsHitTestVisible = true;
				IsDropDownButtonVisible = true;
				CustomizationButton.Opacity = 0.0;
				CustomizationButton.IsHitTestVisible = false;
				IsCustomizationButtonVisible = false;
				return;
			}
			if (ShowCustomizationButton)
			{
				CustomizationButton.Opacity = 1.0;
				CustomizationButton.IsHitTestVisible = true;
				IsCustomizationButtonVisible = true;
			}
			else
			{
				CustomizationButton.Opacity = 0.0;
				CustomizationButton.IsHitTestVisible = false;
				IsCustomizationButtonVisible = false;
			}
			DropDownButton.Opacity = 0.0;
			DropDownButton.IsHitTestVisible = false;
			IsDropDownButtonVisible = false;
		}

		private RibbonQuickAccessToolbarControl CreatePopupControl()
		{
			//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			RibbonQuickAccessToolbarControl obj = new RibbonQuickAccessToolbarControl(Toolbar, VisibleItemsCount)
			{
				Placement = RibbonQuckAccessToolbarPlacement.Popup
			};
			((LinksControl)obj).SpacingMode = ((LinksControl)this).SpacingMode;
			return obj;
		}

		private void UpdateBorderTemplates()
		{
			if (RightContentControl == null || LeftContentControl == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			switch (Placement)
			{
			case RibbonQuckAccessToolbarPlacement.Footer:
				LeftContentControl.Template = LeftContentTemplateInFooterForOffice2007RibbonStyle;
				RightContentControl.Template = RightContentTemplateInFooterForOffice2007RibbonStyle;
				break;
			case RibbonQuckAccessToolbarPlacement.Header:
				switch (RibbonStyle)
				{
				case RibbonStyle.Office2007:
					LeftContentControl.Template = LeftContentTemplateInHeaderForOffice2007RibbonStyle;
					RightContentControl.Template = RightContentTemplateInHeaderForOffice2007RibbonStyle;
					break;
				case RibbonStyle.Office2010:
				case RibbonStyle.TabletOffice:
				case RibbonStyle.OfficeSlim:
				case RibbonStyle.Office2019:
					LeftContentControl.Template = LeftContentTemplateInHeaderForOffice2010RibbonStyle;
					RightContentControl.Template = RightContentTemplateInHeaderForOffice2010RibbonStyle;
					break;
				}
				break;
			case RibbonQuckAccessToolbarPlacement.AeroHeader:
				switch (RibbonStyle)
				{
				case RibbonStyle.Office2007:
					LeftContentControl.Template = LeftContentTemplateInAeroHeaderForOffice2007RibbonStyle;
					RightContentControl.Template = RightContentTemplateInAeroHeaderForOffice2007RibbonStyle;
					break;
				case RibbonStyle.Office2010:
				case RibbonStyle.TabletOffice:
				case RibbonStyle.OfficeSlim:
				case RibbonStyle.Office2019:
					LeftContentControl.Template = LeftContentTemplateInAeroHeaderForOffice2010RibbonStyle;
					RightContentControl.Template = RightContentTemplateInAeroHeaderForOffice2010RibbonStyle;
					break;
				}
				break;
			case RibbonQuckAccessToolbarPlacement.Popup:
				LeftContentControl.Template = LeftContentTemplateInPopup;
				RightContentControl.Template = RightContentTemplateInPopup;
				break;
			case RibbonQuckAccessToolbarPlacement.Title:
				LeftContentControl.Template = LeftContentTemplateInTitle;
				RightContentControl.Template = RightContentTemplateInTitle;
				break;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPreviewMouseUp(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.ChangedButton == MouseButton.Right && Placement == RibbonQuckAccessToolbarPlacement.Popup && Toolbar.Ribbon.ShowRibbonPopupMenu(Mouse.DirectlyOver as DependencyObject))
			{
				e.Handled = true;
			}
			((UIElement)(object)this).OnPreviewMouseUp(e);
		}

		protected virtual void SubscribeContainerEvents(IBarItemLinkControl linkControl)
		{
			if (linkControl != null)
			{
				linkControl.Click += OnItemClick;
			}
		}

		private void OnItemClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			CloseCustomizationMenu();
			((Popup)(object)Toolbar.Control.Popup).IsOpen = false;
		}

		protected virtual void UnsubscribeContainerEvents(IBarItemLinkControl linkControl)
		{
			if (linkControl != null)
			{
				linkControl.Click -= OnItemClick;
			}
		}

		internal double GetMinDesiredWidth()
		{
			if (!((UIElement)(object)this).IsVisible || ((ItemsControl)(object)this).ItemContainerGenerator.Status != GeneratorStatus.ContainersGenerated)
			{
				return ((UIElement)(object)this).DesiredSize.Width;
			}
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			if (((ItemsControl)(object)this).Items.Count > 0)
			{
				if (((ItemsControl)(object)this).ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromIndex(0) is UIElement { DesiredSize: var desiredSize })
				{
					num = desiredSize.Width;
				}
				num2 = (from child in ((ItemsControl)(object)this).Items.OfType<object>().Take(VisibleItemsCount)
					select (UIElement)((ItemsControl)(object)this).ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(child)).Sum((UIElement child) => child.DesiredSize.Width);
			}
			double value = LeftContentControl.DesiredSize.Width - (LeftContentControl.Content as UIElement).Return((UIElement x) => x.DesiredSize.Width, () => 0.0);
			if (Math.Abs(value) < 0.0001)
			{
				value = lastKnownSeparatorWidth;
			}
			else
			{
				lastKnownSeparatorWidth = value;
				value = 0.0;
			}
			return ((UIElement)(object)this).DesiredSize.Width - num2 + num + value + 1.0;
		}
	}

	public class RibbonQuickAccessToolbarLayoutCalculator : RibbonLayoutCalculatorBase
	{
		private int FirstVisibleItemIndex => base.Panel.ToolbarControl.FirstVisibleItemIndex;

		private int VisibleItemsCount
		{
			get
			{
				return base.Panel.ToolbarControl.VisibleItemsCount;
			}
			set
			{
				base.Panel.ToolbarControl.VisibleItemsCount = value;
			}
		}

		private UIElementCollection Children => base.Panel.Children;

		public RibbonQuickAccessToolbarLayoutCalculator(RibbonItemsPanelBase panel)
			: base(panel)
		{
		}

		public override Size MeasurePanel(Size availableSize)
		{
			Size bestSize = new Size(0.0, 0.0);
			Size result = new Size(0.0, 0.0);
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			bool flag = true;
			foreach (UIElement child in Children)
			{
				child.Measure(new Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity));
				bestSize.Width += child.DesiredSize.Width;
				bestSize.Height = Math.Max(child.DesiredSize.Height, bestSize.Height);
				if (num < FirstVisibleItemIndex)
				{
					child.Opacity = 0.0;
					child.IsHitTestVisible = false;
				}
				else if (flag && ((!double.IsPositiveInfinity(availableSize.Width) && result.Width + child.DesiredSize.Width < availableSize.Width) || double.IsPositiveInfinity(availableSize.Width)))
				{
					result.Width += child.DesiredSize.Width;
					result.Height = Math.Max(child.DesiredSize.Height, result.Height);
					num2++;
					child.Opacity = 1.0;
					child.IsHitTestVisible = true;
				}
				else
				{
					flag = false;
					child.Opacity = 0.0;
					child.IsHitTestVisible = false;
				}
				num++;
			}
			VisibleItemsCount = num2;
			base.Panel.ToolbarControl.BestSize = bestSize;
			base.Panel.ToolbarControl.UpdateButtonsVisibility();
			return result;
		}

		public override Size ArrangePanel(Size finalSize)
		{
			Rect finalRect = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, finalSize.Height);
			for (int i = FirstVisibleItemIndex; i < Children.Count; i++)
			{
				UIElement uIElement = Children[i];
				if (finalRect.X + uIElement.DesiredSize.Width - finalSize.Width > 0.1)
				{
					break;
				}
				finalRect.Width = uIElement.DesiredSize.Width;
				uIElement.Arrange(finalRect);
				finalRect.X += finalRect.Width;
			}
			return finalSize;
		}
	}

		protected virtual void OnIsCheckedChanged(bool oldValue)
		{
			if (IsChecked)
			{
				if (this.Checked != null)
				{
					this.Checked(this, new EventArgs());
				}
			}
			else if (this.Unchecked != null)
			{
				this.Unchecked(this, new EventArgs());
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateActualBorderTemplate()
		{
			switch (RibbonStyle)
			{
			case RibbonStyle.TabletOffice:
				ActualBorderTemplate = (IsPopup ? BorderTemplateInPopupForTabletOfficeRibbonStyle : BorderTemplateForTabletOfficeRibbonStyle);
				break;
			case RibbonStyle.Office2007:
				ActualBorderTemplate = (IsPopup ? BorderTemplateInPopupForOffice2007RibbonStyle : BorderTemplateForOffice2007RibbonStyle);
				break;
			case RibbonStyle.Office2010:
			case RibbonStyle.Office2019:
				ActualBorderTemplate = (IsPopup ? BorderTemplateInPopupForOffice2010RibbonStyle : BorderTemplateForOffice2010RibbonStyle);
				break;
			case RibbonStyle.OfficeSlim:
				ActualBorderTemplate = (IsPopup ? BorderTemplateInPopupForOfficeSlimRibbonStyle : BorderTemplateForOfficeSlimRibbonStyle);
				break;
			default:
				ActualBorderTemplate = null;
				break;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnRibbonStyleChanged(RibbonStyle oldValue)
		{
			UpdateActualBorderTemplate();
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return NavigationAutomationPeersCreator.Default.Create((object)this);
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			UpdateActualBorderTemplate();
			if (Ribbon != null && Ribbon.IsBackStageViewOpen)
			{
				IsChecked = true;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeftButtonDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (Mouse.Capture(this))
			{
				NavigationTree.Lock();
			}
			base.OnMouseLeftButtonDown(e);
			OnClick();
		}

		protected override void OnLostMouseCapture(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnLostMouseCapture(e);
			NavigationTree.Unlock();
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeftButtonUp(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeftButtonUp(e);
			ReleaseMouseCapture();
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnClick()
		{
			if (ToggleOnClick)
			{
				IsChecked = !IsChecked;
			}
			if (this.Click != null)
			{
				this.Click(this, new EventArgs());
			}
		}

		bool INavigationElement.ProcessKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Key == Key.Return || e.Key == Key.Space)
			{
				((IKeyTipNavigationElement)this).Select();
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		bool IKeyTipNavigationElement.Select()
		{
			OnClick();
			DispatcherHelper.DoEvents(1);
			NavigationTree.SelectElement((IBarsNavigationSupport)(object)((INavigationElement)this).BoundOwner);
			return true;
		}
	}
