		protected virtual void OnIsLeftButtonPressedChanged(bool oldValue)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnUseAppFocusValueChanged(bool oldValue)
		{
			UpdateVisualStates();
		}

		protected virtual void OnAppFocusValueChanged(bool oldValue)
		{
			UpdateVisualStates();
		}

		protected virtual void IsInRibbonWindowChanged(bool oldValue)
		{
			UpdateVisualStates();
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsEnabledChanged(bool oldValue)
		{
			UpdateVisualStates();
		}

		private void UpdateVisualStates()
		{
			string text = "Normal";
			string text2 = "Unchecked";
			if (base.IsMouseOver)
			{
				text = ((!IsLeftButtonPressed) ? "Hover" : "Pressed");
			}
			if (IsChecked == true)
			{
				text2 = "Checked";
			}
			if (!IsChecked.HasValue && !MergeCheckedStates)
			{
				text2 = "Indeterminate";
			}
			if (MergeCheckedStates)
			{
				SetVisualState(text + text2);
			}
			else
			{
				SetVisualState(text);
				SetVisualState(text2);
			}
			if (UseAppFocusValue)
			{
				if (AppFocusValue)
				{
					SetVisualState("Focused");
				}
				else
				{
					SetVisualState("Unfocused");
				}
			}
			else if (base.IsFocused)
			{
				SetVisualState("Focused");
			}
			else
			{
				SetVisualState("Unfocused");
			}
			if (base.IsEnabled)
			{
				SetVisualState("Enabled");
			}
			else
			{
				SetVisualState("Disabled");
			}
			if (IsInRibbonWindow)
			{
				SetVisualState("RibbonWindow");
			}
			else
			{
				SetVisualState("Standalone");
			}
		}

		protected virtual void SetVisualState(string state)
		{
			VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, state, useTransitions: false);
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return NavigationAutomationPeersCreator.Default.Create((object)this);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeftButtonDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeftButtonDown(e);
			IsLeftButtonPressed = true;
			UpdateVisualStates();
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeftButtonUp(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeftButtonUp(e);
			if (IsLeftButtonPressed)
			{
				RaiseClickEvent();
			}
			IsLeftButtonPressed = false;
			UpdateVisualStates();
		}

		protected internal virtual void RaiseClickEvent()
		{
			if (ToggleIsCheckedOnClick && IsChecked.HasValue)
			{
				SetCurrentValue(IsCheckedProperty, !IsChecked.Value);
			}
			if (this.Click != null)
			{
				this.Click(this, new EventArgs());
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeave(e);
			IsLeftButtonPressed = false;
			UpdateVisualStates();
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnter(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseEnter(e);
			UpdateVisualStates();
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			UpdateVisualStates();
		}

		protected override void OnGotFocus(RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnGotFocus(e);
			UpdateVisualStates();
		}

		protected override void OnLostFocus(RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnLostFocus(e);
			UpdateVisualStates();
		}

		protected override void OnGotKeyboardFocus(KeyboardFocusChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnGotKeyboardFocus(e);
			UpdateVisualStates();
		}

		protected override void OnLostKeyboardFocus(KeyboardFocusChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnLostKeyboardFocus(e);
			UpdateVisualStates();
		}
	}

		internal static int CalcRecycleScore<TContainer, TChildContainer>(TContainer owner, object item, object previousItem, Func<object, IEnumerable<object>> itemsSelector) where TContainer : ItemsControl where TChildContainer : UIElement, IRecyclableContainer
		{
			if (item != null && previousItem != null)
			{
				RecyclingPanel<TChildContainer> rPanel = ItemsControlHelper.GetItemsHost((ItemsControl)owner) as RecyclingPanel<TChildContainer>;
				if (rPanel != null)
				{
					return (from x in itemsSelector(item)
						select new
						{
							A = (IRecyclableContainer)(object)((RecyclingPanelBase<TChildContainer>)(object)rPanel).SelectContainerForReuse(x),
							B = x
						} into x
						where x.A != null
						select x.A.CalcRecycleScore(x.B)).Sum();
				}
			}
			return 1;
		}

	public class RibbonControllerActionBase : DependencyObject, IBarManagerControllerAction, IControllerAction
	{
		private DependencyObject context;

		public RibbonControl Ribbon => RibbonControl.GetRibbon(this) ?? context.With(RibbonControl.GetRibbon) ?? (((IControllerAction)this).Container as DependencyObject).With(RibbonControl.GetRibbon) ?? ((IControllerAction)this).Container.AssociatedObject.With(RibbonControl.GetRibbon) ?? FindRibbonInNamescope(context) ?? FindRibbonInNamescope(((IControllerAction)this).Container as DependencyObject) ?? FindRibbonInNamescope(((IControllerAction)this).Container.AssociatedObject);

		IActionContainer IControllerAction.Container { get; set; }

		bool IBarManagerControllerAction.PostponeActions { get; }

		private static RibbonControl FindRibbonInNamescope(DependencyObject node)
		{
			if (node == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return BarNameScope.GetService<IElementRegistratorService>((object)node).GetElements<IFrameworkInputElement>((ScopeSearchSettings)6).OfType<RibbonControl>()
				.FirstOrDefault();
		}

		void IControllerAction.Execute(DependencyObject context)
		{
			try
			{
				this.context = context;
				ExecuteCore();
			}
			finally
			{
				this.context = null;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void ExecuteCore()
		{
		}

		object IBarManagerControllerAction.GetObject()
		{
			return GetObjectCore();
		}

		protected virtual object GetObjectCore()
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected RibbonPage FindRibbonPage(string name)
		{
			foreach (RibbonPageCategoryBase actualCategory in Ribbon.ActualCategories)
			{
				RibbonPage ribbonPage = actualCategory.Pages[name];
				if (ribbonPage != null)
				{
					return ribbonPage;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected RibbonPageGroup FindRibbonPageGroup(string name)
		{
			foreach (RibbonPageCategoryBase actualCategory in Ribbon.ActualCategories)
			{
				foreach (RibbonPage page in actualCategory.Pages)
				{
					RibbonPageGroup ribbonPageGroup = page.Groups[name];
					if (ribbonPageGroup != null)
					{
						return ribbonPageGroup;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected RibbonPageCategoryBase FindRibbonPageCategory(string name)
		{
			return Ribbon.ActualCategories.FirstOrDefault((RibbonPageCategoryBase x) => x.Name == name);
		}

		protected virtual BarItemLinkBase AddItemAndCreateLink(BarItem item)
		{
			if (!((Collection<BarItem>)(object)Ribbon.Manager.Items).Contains(item))
			{
				((Collection<BarItem>)(object)Ribbon.Manager.Items).Add(item);
			}
			return CreateLink(item);
		}

		protected virtual BarItemLinkBase CreateLink(BarItem item)
		{
			BarItemLinkBase val = (BarItemLinkBase)(object)item.CreateLink();
			((FrameworkContentElement)(object)val).Name = ((FrameworkContentElement)(object)item).Name + "Link";
			return val;
		}
	}
	public class TemplatedRibbonController : RibbonController

		private static void TemplatePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
		}

		protected override BarManagerActionContainer CreateActionContainer()
		{
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0024: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (Template == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("TemplateProperty");
			}
			BarManagerActionContainer val = (BarManagerActionContainer)Template.LoadContent();
			val.Controller = (BarManagerController)(object)this;
			return val;
		}

		public void GetActionController()
		{
		}

		public override void Execute(DependencyObject context = null)
		{
			if (((BarManagerController)this).ActionContainer == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("ActionContainer");
			}
			((BarManagerController)this).ActionContainer.Controller = (BarManagerController)(object)this;
			((BarManagerController)this).ActionContainer.Execute(context);
		}
	}

	public class RemoveRibbonPageCategoryAction : RibbonControllerActionBase
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty CategoryNameProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("CategoryName", typeof(string), typeof(RemoveRibbonPageCategoryAction), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IndexProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Index", typeof(int), typeof(RemoveRibbonPageCategoryAction), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(-1));

		public string CategoryName
		{
			get
			{
				return (string)GetValue(CategoryNameProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(CategoryNameProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public int Index
		{
			get
			{
				return (int)GetValue(IndexProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(IndexProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected override void ExecuteCore()
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(CategoryName))
			{
				RemoveByName();
			}
			else
			{
				RemoveByIndex();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void RemoveByIndex()
		{
			if (Index != -1)
			{
				base.Ribbon.Categories.RemoveAt(Index);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void RemoveByName()
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(CategoryName))
			{
				RibbonPageCategoryBase ribbonPageCategoryBase = base.Ribbon.Categories[CategoryName];
				if (ribbonPageCategoryBase != null)
				{
					base.Ribbon.Categories.Remove(ribbonPageCategoryBase);
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public class RemoveRibbonPageAction : RemoveRibbonPageCategoryAction
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty PageNameProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("PageName", typeof(string), typeof(RemoveRibbonPageAction), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));

		public string PageName
		{
			get
			{
				return (string)GetValue(PageNameProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(PageNameProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected override void ExecuteCore()
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(base.CategoryName))
			{
				return;
			}
			RibbonPageCategoryBase ribbonPageCategoryBase = FindRibbonPageCategory(base.CategoryName);
			if (ribbonPageCategoryBase != null)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(PageName))
				{
					RemoveByName(ribbonPageCategoryBase);
				}
				else
				{
					RemoveByIndex(ribbonPageCategoryBase);
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void RemoveByIndex(RibbonPageCategoryBase category)
		{
			if (base.Index != -1)
			{
				category.Pages.RemoveAt(base.Index);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void RemoveByName(RibbonPageCategoryBase category)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(PageName))
			{
				RibbonPage ribbonPage = category.Pages[PageName];
				if (ribbonPage != null)
				{
					category.Pages.Remove(ribbonPage);
				}
			}
		}
	}

		protected override void ExecuteCore()
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(PageName) && Group != null)
			{
				FindRibbonPage(PageName)?.Groups.Add(Group);
			}
		}
	}

	public class RemoveRibbonPageGroupAction : RibbonControllerActionBase
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty PageNameProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("PageName", typeof(string), typeof(RemoveRibbonPageGroupAction), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty GroupNameProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("GroupName", typeof(string), typeof(RemoveRibbonPageGroupAction), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IndexProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Index", typeof(int), typeof(RemoveRibbonPageGroupAction), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));

		public string PageName
		{
			get
			{
				return (string)GetValue(PageNameProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(PageNameProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public string GroupName
		{
			get
			{
				return (string)GetValue(GroupNameProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(GroupNameProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public int Index
		{
			get
			{
				return (int)GetValue(IndexProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(IndexProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected override void ExecuteCore()
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(PageName))
			{
				return;
			}
			RibbonPage ribbonPage = FindRibbonPage(PageName);
			if (ribbonPage != null)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(GroupName))
				{
					RemoveByName(ribbonPage);
				}
				else
				{
					RemoveByIndex(ribbonPage);
				}
			}
		}

		protected void RemoveByIndex(RibbonPage page)
		{
			if (Index != -1)
			{
				page.Groups.RemoveAt(Index);
			}
		}

		protected void RemoveByName(RibbonPage page)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(GroupName))
			{
				RibbonPageGroup ribbonPageGroup = page.Groups[GroupName];
				if (ribbonPageGroup != null)
				{
					page.Groups.Remove(ribbonPageGroup);
				}
			}
		}
	}

		protected override void ExecuteCore()
		{
			if (base.Ribbon.Toolbar != null)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(base.ItemName))
				{
					AddByName(base.ItemName);
				}
				else if (base.Item != null)
				{
					((Collection<BarItemLinkBase>)(object)((BarItemLinkHolderBase)base.Ribbon.Toolbar).ItemLinks).Add(AddItemAndCreateLink(base.Item));
				}
				else if (base.ItemLink != null)
				{
					((Collection<BarItemLinkBase>)(object)((BarItemLinkHolderBase)base.Ribbon.Toolbar).ItemLinks).Add((BarItemLinkBase)(object)base.ItemLink);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void AddByName(string itemName)
		{
			BarItem val = base.Ribbon.Manager.Items[itemName];
			if (val != null)
			{
				((Collection<BarItemLinkBase>)(object)((BarItemLinkHolderBase)base.Ribbon.Toolbar).ItemLinks).Add(CreateLink(val));
			}
		}
	}

	public class InsertRibbonPageGroupItemLinkAction : InsertRibbonItemLinkActionBase
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty GroupNameProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("GroupName", typeof(string), typeof(InsertRibbonPageGroupItemLinkAction), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));

		public string GroupName
		{
			get
			{
				return (string)GetValue(GroupNameProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(GroupNameProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private RibbonPageGroup group { get; set; }

		protected override void ExecuteCore()
		{
			if (base.Index < 0 || string.IsNullOrEmpty(GroupName))
			{
				return;
			}
			group = FindRibbonPageGroup(GroupName);
			if (group == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(base.ItemName))
			{
				BarItem val = base.Ribbon.Manager.Items[base.ItemName];
				if (val != null)
				{
					((Collection<BarItemLinkBase>)(object)group.ItemLinks).Insert(base.Index, CreateLink(val));
				}
			}
			else if (base.Item != null)
			{
				((Collection<BarItemLinkBase>)(object)group.ItemLinks).Insert(base.Index, AddItemAndCreateLink(base.Item));
			}
			else if (base.ItemLink != null)
			{
				((Collection<BarItemLinkBase>)(object)group.ItemLinks).Insert(base.Index, (BarItemLinkBase)(object)base.ItemLink);
			}
		}

		protected override void InsertByName(string itemName)
		{
			BarItem val = base.Ribbon.Manager.Items[base.ItemName];
			if (val != null)
			{
				((Collection<BarItemLinkBase>)(object)group.ItemLinks).Insert(base.Index, CreateLink(val));
			}
		}
	}
	public class RemoveRibbonPageGroupItemLinkAction : RemoveRibbonItemLinkActionBase

				if (val != null)
				{
					((Collection<BarItemLinkBase>)(object)group.ItemLinks).Remove((BarItemLinkBase)(object)val);

	public interface IRibbonControllerAction : IBarManagerControllerAction, IControllerAction
	{
	}
	public enum RibbonCollections
	{
		ToolbarItems,
		ToolbarItemLinks,
		PageHeaderItems,
		PageHeaderItemLinks,
		Categories,
		LeftStatusBarItems,
		RightStatusBarItems,
		LeftStatusBarItemLinks,
		RightStatusBarItemLinks
	}
	internal static class RibbonControlCollectionActionHelper
	{
		public static void RegisterDefaultGetters()
		{
			CollectionActionHelper.Instance.RegisterCollectionGetter<RibbonControl, RibbonPageCategoryBase>((Func<IBarManagerControllerAction, object, object, IList>)((IBarManagerControllerAction action, object ribbon, object category) => (!(category as IRibbonItem).Return((IRibbonItem x) => x.IsInItems, () => false)) ? ((IList)((RibbonControl)ribbon).Categories) : ((IList)((RibbonControl)ribbon).Items)));
			CollectionActionHelper.Instance.RegisterCollectionGetter<RibbonPageCategoryBase, RibbonPage>((Func<IBarManagerControllerAction, object, object, IList>)((IBarManagerControllerAction action, object category, object page) => ((RibbonPageCategoryBase)category).Pages));
			CollectionActionHelper.Instance.RegisterCollectionGetter<RibbonPage, RibbonPageGroup>((Func<IBarManagerControllerAction, object, object, IList>)((IBarManagerControllerAction action, object page, object pageGroup) => ((RibbonPage)page).Groups));
			CollectionActionHelper.Instance.RegisterCollectionGetter<RibbonControl, IBarItem>((Func<IBarManagerControllerAction, object, object, IList>)((IBarManagerControllerAction action, object ribbon, object iBarItem) => GetCorrectCollection(action, (RibbonControl)ribbon)));
			CollectionActionHelper.Instance.RegisterCollectionGetter<RibbonStatusBarControl, IBarItem>((Func<IBarManagerControllerAction, object, object, IList>)((IBarManagerControllerAction action, object ribbon, object iBarItem) => GetCorrectCollection(action, (RibbonStatusBarControl)ribbon)));
			CollectionActionHelper.Instance.RegisterDefaultContainerGetter<RibbonPageCategoryBase>((Func<IBarManagerControllerAction, object, object>)((IBarManagerControllerAction action, object category) => GetDefaultPageCategoryContainer(action)));
			CollectionActionHelper.Instance.RegisterDefaultContainerGetter<RibbonPage>((Func<IBarManagerControllerAction, object, object>)((IBarManagerControllerAction action, object page) => GetDefaultPageContainer(action, (RibbonPage)page)));
			CollectionActionHelper.Instance.RegisterDefaultContainerGetter<RibbonPageGroup>((Func<IBarManagerControllerAction, object, object>)((IBarManagerControllerAction action, object group) => GetDefaultPageGroupContainer(action, (RibbonPageGroup)group)));
			CollectionActionHelper.Instance.RegisterDefaultContainerGetter<IBarItem>((Func<IBarManagerControllerAction, object, object>)((IBarManagerControllerAction action, object item) => GetDefaultItemContainer(action, (IBarItem)item)));
		}

		private static RibbonCollections? GetTag(DependencyObject dObj)
		{
			if (dObj == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			object collectionTag = CollectionAction.GetCollectionTag(dObj);
			if (collectionTag is RibbonCollections)
			{
				return (RibbonCollections)collectionTag;
			}
			if (collectionTag is string)
			{
				string value = (string)collectionTag;
				if (Enum.TryParse<RibbonCollections>(value, out var result))
				{
					return result;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static object GetDefaultItemContainer(IBarManagerControllerAction action, IBarItem item)
		{
			RibbonCollections? tag = GetTag(action as DependencyObject);
			if (!tag.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			switch (tag.Value)
			{
			case RibbonCollections.ToolbarItems:
			case RibbonCollections.ToolbarItemLinks:
			case RibbonCollections.PageHeaderItems:
			case RibbonCollections.PageHeaderItemLinks:
				return GetDefaultPageCategoryContainer(action);
			case RibbonCollections.LeftStatusBarItems:
			case RibbonCollections.RightStatusBarItems:
			case RibbonCollections.LeftStatusBarItemLinks:
			case RibbonCollections.RightStatusBarItemLinks:
				return GetContainer(action, RibbonStatusBarControl.GetRibbonStatusBar);
			case RibbonCollections.Categories:
				return null;
			default:
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
			}
		}

		private static object GetDefaultPageGroupContainer(IBarManagerControllerAction action, RibbonPageGroup group)
		{
			if (group != null && group.Page != null)
			{
				return group.Page;
			}
			return GetDefaultPageContainer(action, null)?.Pages.FirstOrDefault();
		}

		private static RibbonPageCategoryBase GetDefaultPageContainer(IBarManagerControllerAction action, RibbonPage page)
		{
			if (page != null && page.PageCategory != null)
			{
				return page.PageCategory;
			}
			RibbonControl defaultPageCategoryContainer = GetDefaultPageCategoryContainer(action);
			if (defaultPageCategoryContainer == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return defaultPageCategoryContainer.DefaultCategory ?? defaultPageCategoryContainer.Categories.FirstOrDefault();
		}

		private static RibbonControl GetDefaultPageCategoryContainer(IBarManagerControllerAction action)
		{
			return GetContainer(action, RibbonControl.GetRibbon);
		}

		private static TContainer Get<TContainer>(IBarManagerControllerAction action, Func<DependencyObject, TContainer> getter) where TContainer : class
		{
			TContainer val = (action as DependencyObject).With(getter);
			if (val == null)
			{
				val = (((action != null) ? ((IControllerAction)action).Container : null) as DependencyObject).With(getter);
				if (val == null)
				{
					object input;
					if (action == null)
					{
						input = null;
					}
					else
					{
						IActionContainer container = ((IControllerAction)action).Container;
						input = ((container != null) ? container.AssociatedObject : null);
					}
					val = ((DependencyObject)input).With(getter);
				}
			}
			return val;
		}

		private static TContainer GetContainer<TContainer>(IBarManagerControllerAction action, Func<DependencyObject, TContainer> getter) where TContainer : class
		{
			return Get(action, getter) ?? BarNameScope.GetService<IElementRegistratorService>((object)((action != null) ? ((IControllerAction)action).Container : null)).GetElements<IFrameworkInputElement>((ScopeSearchSettings)2).OfType<TContainer>()
				.FirstOrDefault();
		}

		private static IList GetCorrectCollection(IBarManagerControllerAction action, RibbonControl ribbon)
		{
			RibbonCollections? tag = GetTag((DependencyObject)(object)action);
			if (!tag.HasValue)
			{
				return (IList)ribbon.ToolbarItems;
			}
			return tag.Value switch
			{
				RibbonCollections.ToolbarItems => (IList)ribbon.ToolbarItems, 
				RibbonCollections.PageHeaderItems => (IList)ribbon.PageHeaderItems, 
				RibbonCollections.ToolbarItemLinks => (IList)ribbon.ToolbarItemLinks, 
				RibbonCollections.PageHeaderItemLinks => (IList)ribbon.PageHeaderItemLinks, 
				RibbonCollections.Categories => ribbon.Categories, 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		private static IList GetCorrectCollection(IBarManagerControllerAction action, RibbonStatusBarControl statusBar)
		{
			RibbonCollections? tag = GetTag((DependencyObject)(object)action);
			if (!tag.HasValue)
			{
				return (IList)statusBar.LeftItems;
			}
			return tag.Value switch
			{
				RibbonCollections.LeftStatusBarItems => (IList)statusBar.LeftItems, 
				RibbonCollections.LeftStatusBarItemLinks => (IList)statusBar.LeftItemLinks, 
				RibbonCollections.RightStatusBarItemLinks => (IList)statusBar.RightItemLinks, 
				RibbonCollections.RightStatusBarItems => (IList)statusBar.RightItems, 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}
	}
	public class RibbonCustomizationHelper : DependencyObject
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsCustomizationModeProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty RibbonProperty;

		public RibbonControl Ribbon
		{
			get
			{
				return (RibbonControl)GetValue(RibbonProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(RibbonProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public bool IsCustomizationMode
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(IsCustomizationModeProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(IsCustomizationModeProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected internal FloatingContainer CustomizationForm { get; set; }

		internal Window CustomizationWindow { get; private set; }

		public RibbonCustomizationHelper(RibbonControl ribbon)
		{
			Ribbon = ribbon;
		}

		private void OnIsCustomizationModeChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (IsCustomizationMode)
			{
				ShowCustomizationForm();
			}
			else if (Ribbon != null && Ribbon.CategoriesPane != null && Ribbon.CategoriesPane.RibbonItemsPanel != null)
			{
				Ribbon.CategoriesPane.RibbonItemsPanel.InvalidateMeasure();
			}
		}

		private object OnIsCustomizationModeChangingCoerce(object o)
		{
			if (Ribbon == null || !Ribbon.AllowCustomization)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return (bool)o;
		}

		static RibbonCustomizationHelper()
		{
			IsCustomizationModeProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("IsCustomizationMode", typeof(bool), typeof(RibbonCustomizationHelper), new PropertyMetadata(false, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((RibbonCustomizationHelper)d).OnIsCustomizationModeChanged(e);
			}, (DependencyObject d, object o) => ((RibbonCustomizationHelper)d).OnIsCustomizationModeChangingCoerce(o)));
			RibbonProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Ribbon", typeof(RibbonControl), typeof(RibbonCustomizationHelper), new PropertyMetadata(null));
		}

		public void ShowCustomizationForm()
		{
			Ribbon.ForceLoadGroupCollectionTemplates();
			if (CompatibilitySettings.UseLegacyWindowForRibbonCustomization)
			{
				ShowFloatingWindow();
			}
			else
			{
				ShowThemedWindow();
			}
		}

		private void ShowThemedWindow()
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Expected O, but got Unknown
			ThemedWindow val = (ThemedWindow)(object)(CustomizationWindow = (Window)new ThemedWindow());
			((Window)(object)val).Owner = Window.GetWindow(Ribbon);
			((ContentControl)(object)val).Content = Ribbon.CreateCustomizationControl();
			((Window)(object)val).ResizeMode = ResizeMode.CanResizeWithGrip;
			((Window)(object)val).WindowStartupLocation = WindowStartupLocation.CenterOwner;
			((Window)(object)val).Title = RibbonControlLocalizer.GetString(RibbonControlStringId.RibbonCustomizationStrings_CustomizationFormCaption);
			val.TitleAlignment = (WindowTitleAlignment)1;
			double width = (((FrameworkElement)(object)val).MinWidth = 750.0);
			((FrameworkElement)(object)val).Width = width;
			width = (((FrameworkElement)(object)val).MinHeight = 500.0);
			((FrameworkElement)(object)val).Height = width;
			val.ShowDialog();
		}

		internal void CloseCustomizationForm()
		{
			FloatingContainer customizationForm = CustomizationForm;
			if (customizationForm != null)
			{
				customizationForm.Close();
			}
			CustomizationWindow?.Close();
		}

		private void ShowFloatingWindow()
		{
			CustomizationForm = CreateCustomizationForm();
			if (CustomizationForm != null)
			{
				CustomizeCustomizationForm();
				CustomizationForm.Hidden += OnCustomizationFormHidden;
				((BaseFloatingContainer)CustomizationForm).IsOpen = true;
				IsCustomizationMode = true;
				FloatingContainer.SetIsActive((DependencyObject)(object)CustomizationForm, true);
			}
		}

		private FloatingContainer CreateCustomizationForm()
		{
			FloatingContainer val = FloatingContainerFactory.Create((FloatingMode)1);
			((BaseFloatingContainer)val).BeginUpdate();
			Ribbon.AddLogicalChildCore(val);
			if (Ribbon == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			((BaseFloatingContainer)val).Owner = GetWindowOwner();
			val.ShowModal = true;
			((BaseFloatingContainer)val).Content = Ribbon.CreateCustomizationControl();
			((BaseFloatingContainer)val).EndUpdate();
			return val;
		}

		private FrameworkElement GetWindowOwner()
		{
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = null;
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = LayoutHelper.FindRoot((DependencyObject)Ribbon, false);
			if (dependencyObject is Window)
			{
				Window window = (Window)dependencyObject;
				if (window.Content is FrameworkElement)
				{
					frameworkElement = (FrameworkElement)window.Content;
				}
				else if (VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(window) > 0)
				{
					frameworkElement = VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(window, 0) as FrameworkElement;
				}
			}
			else if (dependencyObject is FrameworkElement)
			{
				frameworkElement = (FrameworkElement)dependencyObject;
			}
			return (FrameworkElement)(frameworkElement ?? ((object)Ribbon.With((RibbonControl x) => x.Manager)) ?? ((object)Ribbon));
		}

		private void CustomizeCustomizationForm()
		{
			CustomizationForm.AllowSizing = true;
			CustomizationForm.CloseOnEscape = true;
			CustomizationForm.ContainerStartupLocation = WindowStartupLocation.CenterOwner;
			CustomizationForm.Caption = RibbonControlLocalizer.GetString(RibbonControlStringId.RibbonCustomizationStrings_CustomizationFormCaption);
			((BaseFloatingContainer)CustomizationForm).FloatSize = new Size(750.0, 500.0);
			((FrameworkElement)(object)CustomizationForm).MinHeight = 500.0;
			((FrameworkElement)(object)CustomizationForm).MinWidth = 750.0;
			if (Ribbon != null)
			{
				Ribbon.AdjustCustomizationForm(CustomizationForm);
			}
		}

		private void OnCustomizationFormHidden(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			CustomizationForm.Hidden -= OnCustomizationFormHidden;
			((BaseFloatingContainer)CustomizationForm).BeginUpdate();
			((BaseFloatingContainer)CustomizationForm).Content = null;
			((BaseFloatingContainer)CustomizationForm).EndUpdate();
			if (((BaseFloatingContainer)CustomizationForm).Owner != null)
			{
				LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<Window>((DependencyObject)((BaseFloatingContainer)CustomizationForm).Owner)?.Activate();
			}
			CustomizationForm = null;
		}

		protected internal static void SetCurrentValueForProperty(PropertyDescriptor prop, object value, DependencyObject target)
		{
			string name = prop.Name;
			FieldInfo field = target.GetType().GetField(name + "Property", BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.FlattenHierarchy);
			if (field == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			object obj = null;
			if ((field.GetValue(target) as DependencyProperty).PropertyType == typeof(string) || (field.GetValue(target) as DependencyProperty).PropertyType == typeof(object))
			{
				obj = value;
			}
			else
			{
				MethodInfo method = (field.GetValue(target) as DependencyProperty).PropertyType.GetMethod("Parse", BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.FlattenHierarchy);
				if (method != null)
				{
					obj = method.Invoke(null, new object[1] { value });
				}
			}
			if (obj != null)
			{
				target.SetCurrentValue(field.GetValue(target) as DependencyProperty, obj);
			}
		}
	}

	internal class DelegateConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		private Func<object, Type, object, CultureInfo, object> convert;

		private Func<object, Type, object, CultureInfo, object> convertBack;

		public DelegateConverter(Func<object, Type, object, CultureInfo, object> convert)
			: this(convert, null)
		{
		}

		public DelegateConverter(Func<object, Type, object, CultureInfo, object> convert, Func<object, Type, object, CultureInfo, object> convertBack)
		{
			this.convert = convert;
			this.convertBack = convertBack;
		}

		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (convert == null)
			{
				return value;
			}
			return convert(value, targetType, parameter, culture);
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (convertBack == null)
			{
				return value;
			}
			return convertBack(value, targetType, parameter, culture);
		}
	}

	{
		protected override Size ArrangeOverride(Size finalSize)
		{
			RibbonControl ribbonControl = base.Ribbon ?? RibbonControl.GetRibbon(this);
			RibbonPageCategoryCaptionAlignment ribbonPageCategoryCaptionAlignment = RibbonPageCategoryCaptionAlignment.Default;
			if (ribbonControl != null)

				ribbonPageCategoryCaptionAlignment = ribbonControl.PageCategoryAlignment;
			}
			List<RibbonPageCategoryHeaderControl> list = new List<RibbonPageCategoryHeaderControl>();
			RibbonPageCategoryHeaderControl ribbonPageCategoryHeaderControl = null;
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Children.Count; i++)

				RibbonPageCategoryHeaderControl ribbonPageCategoryHeaderControl2 = base.Children[i] as RibbonPageCategoryHeaderControl;
				if (ribbonPageCategoryHeaderControl2.Category != null && ribbonPageCategoryHeaderControl2.Category.IsDefault)
				{
					ribbonPageCategoryHeaderControl = ribbonPageCategoryHeaderControl2;

			{
				ribbonPageCategoryHeaderControl.Arrange(new Rect(default(Point), ribbonPageCategoryHeaderControl.DesiredSize));
				base.DefaultHeaderWidth = Math.Max(base.DefaultHeaderWidth, ribbonPageCategoryHeaderControl.RenderSize.Width);
			}
			UpdateControlBoxWidth(finalSize.Width);
			double num = ((base.Ribbon == null || !base.Ribbon.IsInRibbonWindow) ? 0.0 : Math.Max(0.0, base.ControlBoxWidth));
			double num2 = base.DefaultHeaderWidth;
			if (ribbonPageCategoryCaptionAlignment == RibbonPageCategoryCaptionAlignment.Right)
			{
				double num3 = list.Sum((RibbonPageCategoryHeaderControl header) => header.DesiredSize.Width);
				num2 = Math.Max(num2, finalSize.Width - num - num3);
			}
			list = list.OrderBy((RibbonPageCategoryHeaderControl header) => GetChildOrder(header)).ToList();
			for (int num4 = 0; num4 < list.Count; num4++)
			{
				Size desiredSize = list[num4].DesiredSize;
				desiredSize.Width = Math.Max(0.0, Math.Min(desiredSize.Width, base.ActualWidth - num2 - num));
				desiredSize.Height = Math.Max(desiredSize.Height, finalSize.Height);
				list[num4].Arrange(new Rect(new Point(num2, 0.0), desiredSize));
				num2 += list[num4].DesiredSize.Width;
			}
			return finalSize;
		}

		protected override Size MeasureOverride(Size availableSize)
		{
			Size result = new Size(0.0, 0.0);
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				(child as RibbonPageCategoryHeaderControl).Do(delegate(RibbonPageCategoryHeaderControl x)
				{
					x.UpdateSizeInfo(isasync: false);
				});
				child.Measure(SizeHelper.Infinite);
				result.Width += child.DesiredSize.Width;
				result.Height = Math.Max(result.Height, child.DesiredSize.Height);
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override int? GetChildOrder(UIElement child)
		{
			if (!(child is RibbonPageCategoryHeaderControl { Ribbon: not null } ribbonPageCategoryHeaderControl) || (!ribbonPageCategoryHeaderControl.Ribbon.IsMerged && ribbonPageCategoryHeaderControl.Ribbon.ActualMergedParent == null))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return ribbonPageCategoryHeaderControl.Category.ActualMergeOrder;
		}
	}
	public class RibbonItemsPanel : Panel
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ControlBoxWidthProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty DefaultHeaderWidthProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty OffsetProperty;

		public double Offset
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(OffsetProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(OffsetProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public double ControlBoxWidth
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(ControlBoxWidthProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ControlBoxWidthProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public double DefaultHeaderWidth
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(DefaultHeaderWidthProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(DefaultHeaderWidthProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public RibbonControl Ribbon => Owner.With((RibbonPageCategoriesPane x) => x.Ribbon);

		public RibbonPageCategoriesPane Owner => ItemsControl.GetItemsOwner(this) as RibbonPageCategoriesPane;

		public ScrollViewer ScrollHost => Owner.With((RibbonPageCategoriesPane owner) => owner.ScrollHost);

		static RibbonItemsPanel()
		{
			ControlBoxWidthProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ControlBoxWidth", typeof(double), typeof(RibbonItemsPanel), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0.0, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure));
			DefaultHeaderWidthProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("DefaultHeaderWidth", typeof(double), typeof(RibbonItemsPanel), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0.0));
			OffsetProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Offset", typeof(double), typeof(RibbonItemsPanel), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0.0, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsArrange));
		}

		protected virtual IEnumerable<RibbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo> GetInfos(Size availableSize, ref RibbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo defaultInfo)
		{
			List<RibbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo> list = new List<RibbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo>();
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				child.Measure(availableSize);
				if (child is RibbonPageCategoryControl ribbonPageCategoryControl)
				{
					if (ribbonPageCategoryControl.PageCategory.IsDefault)
					{
						defaultInfo = ribbonPageCategoryControl.SizeInfo ?? new RibbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo
						{
							Owner = ribbonPageCategoryControl
						};
					}
					else
					{
						list.Add(ribbonPageCategoryControl.SizeInfo ?? new RibbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo
						{
							Owner = ribbonPageCategoryControl
						});
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected bool Reduce(Size availableSize, IEnumerable<RibbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo> infos, RibbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo defaultInfo)
		{
			RibbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo commonInfo = new RibbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo();
			double defaultInfoMinWidth = GetDefaultInfoMinWidth();
			defaultInfo.MinWidth = Math.Max(defaultInfo.MinWidth, defaultInfoMinWidth);
			defaultInfo.MaxWidth = Math.Max(defaultInfo.MaxWidth, defaultInfoMinWidth);
			defaultInfo.DesiredWidth = Math.Min(defaultInfo.MaxWidth, Math.Max(defaultInfo.MinWidth, defaultInfo.DesiredWidth));
			infos.ForEach(delegate(RibbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo info)
			{
				commonInfo.MinWidth += info.MinWidth;
				commonInfo.MaxWidth += info.MaxWidth;
				commonInfo.DesiredWidth += info.DesiredWidth;
			});
			if (commonInfo.MaxWidth + defaultInfo.MaxWidth <= availableSize.Width)
			{
				infos.ForEach(delegate(RibbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo info)
				{
					info.MeasureSize = new Size(info.MaxWidth, availableSize.Height);
				});
				defaultInfo.MeasureSize = new Size(defaultInfo.MaxWidth, availableSize.Height);
				return true;
			}
			if (commonInfo.MaxWidth + defaultInfo.DesiredWidth <= availableSize.Width)
			{
				infos.ForEach(delegate(RibbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo info)
				{
					info.MeasureSize = new Size(info.MaxWidth, availableSize.Height);
				});
				defaultInfo.MeasureSize = new Size(availableSize.Width - commonInfo.MaxWidth, availableSize.Height);
				return true;
			}
			if (commonInfo.DesiredWidth + defaultInfo.DesiredWidth <= availableSize.Width)
			{
				defaultInfo.MeasureSize = new Size(defaultInfo.DesiredWidth, availableSize.Height);
				double num = (availableSize.Width - defaultInfo.DesiredWidth) / (double)infos.Count();
				double coeff = (availableSize.Width - defaultInfo.DesiredWidth) / commonInfo.MaxWidth;
				infos.ForEach(delegate(RibbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo info)
				{
					info.MeasureSize = new Size(info.MaxWidth * coeff, availableSize.Height);
				});
				return true;
			}
			if (commonInfo.DesiredWidth + defaultInfo.MinWidth <= availableSize.Width)
			{
				infos.ForEach(delegate(RibbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo info)
				{
					info.MeasureSize = new Size(info.DesiredWidth, availableSize.Height);
				});
				defaultInfo.MeasureSize = new Size(availableSize.Width - commonInfo.DesiredWidth, availableSize.Height);
				return true;
			}
			if (commonInfo.MinWidth + defaultInfo.MinWidth <= availableSize.Width)
			{
				defaultInfo.MeasureSize = new Size(defaultInfo.MinWidth, availableSize.Height);
				double coeff2 = (availableSize.Width - defaultInfo.MinWidth) / commonInfo.DesiredWidth;
				infos.ForEach(delegate(RibbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo info)
				{
					info.MeasureSize = new Size(info.DesiredWidth * coeff2, availableSize.Height);
				});
				return true;
			}
			defaultInfo.MeasureSize = new Size(defaultInfo.MinWidth, availableSize.Height);
			return false;
		}

		protected override Size MeasureOverride(Size availableSize)
		{
			RibbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo defaultInfo = new RibbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo();
			IEnumerable<RibbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo> infos = GetInfos(availableSize, ref defaultInfo);
			if (!Reduce(availableSize, infos, defaultInfo))
			{
				infos.ForEach(delegate(RibbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo info)
				{
					info.MeasureSize = new Size(info.MinWidth, availableSize.Height);
					info.Owner.SetCurrentValue(RibbonPageCategoryControl.ShowHeaderProperty, false);
				});
			}
			else
			{
				infos.ForEach(delegate(RibbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo info)
				{
					info.Owner.SetCurrentValue(RibbonPageCategoryControl.ShowHeaderProperty, true);
				});
				Offset = 0.0;
			}
			Size result = default(Size);
			if (defaultInfo.Owner != null)
			{
				defaultInfo.Owner.Measure(defaultInfo.MeasureSize);
				result.Height = Math.Max(result.Height, defaultInfo.Owner.DesiredSize.Height);
			}
			result.Width += defaultInfo.MeasureSize.Width;
			for (int num = 0; num < infos.Count(); num++)
			{
				RibbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo ribbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo = infos.ElementAt(num);
				ribbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo.Owner.Measure(ribbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo.MeasureSize);
				result.Width += Math.Max(ribbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo.MinWidth, ribbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo.Owner.DesiredSize.Width);
				result.Height = Math.Max(result.Height, ribbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo.Owner.DesiredSize.Height);
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override Size ArrangeOverride(Size finalSize)
		{
			Rect finalRect = new Rect(new Point(Offset, 0.0), new Size(0.0, finalSize.Height));
			IEnumerable<RibbonPageCategoryControl> source = base.Children.OfType<RibbonPageCategoryControl>();
			RibbonPageCategoryControl defaultCategory = source.FirstOrDefault((RibbonPageCategoryControl cat) => cat.PageCategory.IsDefault);
			source = (from child in source
				where child != defaultCategory
				orderby GetChildOrder(child)
				select child).ToList();
			finalRect.Width = GetDefaultInfoMinWidth();
			if (defaultCategory != null)
			{
				finalRect.Width = Math.Max(defaultCategory.DesiredSize.Width, finalRect.Width);
				defaultCategory.Arrange(finalRect);
			}
			finalRect.X += finalRect.Width;
			DefaultHeaderWidth = finalRect.Width;
			UpdateControlBoxWidth(finalSize.Width);
			double num = finalSize.Width - ControlBoxWidth;
			for (int num2 = 0; num2 < source.Count(); num2++)
			{
				RibbonPageCategoryControl ribbonPageCategoryControl = source.ElementAt(num2);
				finalRect.Width = Math.Max(ribbonPageCategoryControl.DesiredSize.Width, num - finalRect.X + Offset - GetLeftOffset(source, num2));
				ribbonPageCategoryControl.Arrange(finalRect);
				finalRect.X += ribbonPageCategoryControl.RenderSize.Width;
			}
			return finalSize;
		}

		protected double GetDefaultInfoMinWidth()
		{
			if (Ribbon == null || Ribbon.HeaderToolbarContainer == null || !Ribbon.HeaderToolbarContainer.IsVisible)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			double minDesiredWidth = Ribbon.Toolbar.GetMinDesiredWidth();
			minDesiredWidth = Ribbon.HeaderToolbarContainer.TranslatePoint(new Point(minDesiredWidth, 0.0), Ribbon).X;
			return Math.Max(Ribbon.TranslatePoint(new Point(minDesiredWidth, 0.0), this).X, 0.0);
		}

		private Point GetControlBoxOffset(RibbonControl ribbon)
		{
			if (ribbon.AutoHideMode && ribbon.ControlBoxContainer != null)
			{
				return ribbon.ControlBoxContainer.TranslatePoint(default(Point), this);
			}
			FrameworkElement controlBoxContainer = ribbon.WindowHelper.GetControlBoxContainer();
			if (controlBoxContainer != null)
			{
				return controlBoxContainer.TranslatePoint(default(Point), this);
			}
			Window window = Window.GetWindow(ribbon);
			IRibbonWindow val = (IRibbonWindow)(object)((window is IRibbonWindow) ? window : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				return ribbon.TranslatePoint(val.GetControlBoxRect().Location, this);
			}
			return default(Point);
		}

		protected void UpdateControlBoxWidth(double available)
		{
			if (Ribbon != null)
			{
				if (Ribbon.IsInRibbonWindow)
				{
					ControlBoxWidth = Math.Max(0.0, available - GetControlBoxOffset(Ribbon).X);
				}
				else
				{
					ClearValue(ControlBoxWidthProperty);
				}
			}
		}

		protected double GetLeftOffset(IEnumerable<FrameworkElement> children, int idx)
		{
			return children.Skip(idx + 1).Sum((FrameworkElement elem) => elem.DesiredSize.Width);
		}

		protected virtual int? GetChildOrder(UIElement child)
		{
			if (!(child is RibbonPageCategoryControl { Ribbon: not null } ribbonPageCategoryControl) || (!Ribbon.IsMerged && Ribbon.ActualMergedParent == null))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return ribbonPageCategoryControl.PageCategory.ActualMergeOrder;
		}

		protected internal virtual void DecreaseOffset()
		{
			Offset += GetNextOffsetValue(left: true);
			CheckOffset();
			InvalidateArrange();
		}

		private double GetNextOffsetValue(bool left)
		{
			if (ScrollHost == null)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			foreach (RibbonPageCategoryControl child in base.Children)
			{
				if (child.ItemContainerGenerator.Status != GeneratorStatus.ContainersGenerated)
				{
					continue;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < child.Items.Count; i++)
				{
					RibbonPageHeaderControl ribbonPageHeaderControl = child.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromIndex(i) as RibbonPageHeaderControl;
					Point point = ribbonPageHeaderControl.TranslatePoint(default(Point), this);
					if (left && point.X + ribbonPageHeaderControl.RenderSize.Width > 0.0)
					{
						return point.X - ribbonPageHeaderControl.RenderSize.Width;
					}
					if (point.X > 0.1)
					{
						return point.X;
					}
				}
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		protected internal virtual void IncreaseOffset()
		{
			Offset += GetNextOffsetValue(left: false);
			CheckOffset();
			InvalidateArrange();
		}

		protected internal virtual void CheckOffset()
		{
			if (ScrollHost != null)
			{
				Offset = Math.Max(Offset, Math.Min(ScrollHost.ViewportWidth - base.RenderSize.Width, 0.0));
			}
			Offset = Math.Min(0.0, Offset);
		}
	}
	public class RibbonItemsPanelOfficeSlim : RibbonItemsPanel
	{
		protected override Size MeasureOverride(Size availableSize)
		{
			Size result = default(Size);
			List<RibbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo> list = new List<RibbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo>();
			foreach (RibbonPageCategoryControl child in base.Children)
			{
				child.Measure(availableSize);
				RibbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo item = child.SizeInfo ?? new RibbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo
				{
					Owner = child
				};
				result.Height = Math.Max(result.Height, child.DesiredSize.Height);
				list.Add(item);
			}
			result.Width = list.Sum((RibbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo info) => info.MinWidth);
			list.Reverse();
			double num = 0.0;
			Size availableSize2 = new Size(0.0, availableSize.Height);
			foreach (RibbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo item2 in list)
			{
				num = result.Width - item2.MinWidth + item2.MaxWidth;
				result.Width -= item2.MinWidth;
				availableSize2.Width = ((num <= availableSize.Width) ? item2.MaxWidth : Math.Max(availableSize.Width - result.Width, item2.MinWidth));
				item2.Owner.Measure(availableSize2);
				result.Width += item2.Owner.DesiredSize.Width;
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
	public class RibbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo : ICloneable
	{
		public UIElement Owner { get; set; }

		public double MaxWidth { get; set; }

		public double DesiredWidth { get; set; }

		public double MinWidth { get; set; }

		public Size MeasureSize { get; set; }

		public RibbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		public RibbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo(UIElement owner)
		{
			Owner = owner;
			MaxWidth = 0.0;
			DesiredWidth = 0.0;
			MinWidth = 0.0;
			MeasureSize = new Size(0.0, 0.0);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is RibbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo ribbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Owner.Equals(ribbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo.Owner) && MaxWidth == ribbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo.MaxWidth && DesiredWidth == ribbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo.DesiredWidth)
			{
				return MinWidth == ribbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo.MinWidth;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			return new RibbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo
			{
				Owner = Owner,
				MaxWidth = MaxWidth,
				DesiredWidth = DesiredWidth,
				MinWidth = MinWidth,
				MeasureSize = MeasureSize
			};
		}

		public RibbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo Clone()
		{
			return ((ICloneable)this).Clone() as RibbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo;
		}
	}
	public class RibbonOrderedPanel<TElement> : FakeRecyclingPanel<TElement>, INotifyPropertyChanged where TElement : UIElement, IRecyclableContainer
	{
		protected virtual bool IsOrdered => false;

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		protected override void OnRibbonChanged(RibbonControl oldValue)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs("Ribbon"));
			}
			((UIElement)(object)this).InvalidateArrange();
		}

		protected virtual int? GetChildOrder(UIElement child)
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected override Size MeasureOverride(Size availableSize)
		{
			Size result = new Size(0.0, 0.0);
			foreach (TElement item in ((RecyclingPanelBase<TElement>)(object)this).EnumerateChildren())
			{
				item.Measure(availableSize);
				result.Width += item.DesiredSize.Width;
				result.Height = Math.Max(result.Height, item.DesiredSize.Height);
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override Size ArrangeOverride(Size finalSize)
		{
			Rect finalRect = new Rect(new Size(0.0, finalSize.Height));
			foreach (TElement item in ((RecyclingPanelBase<TElement>)(object)this).EnumerateChildren())
			{
				finalRect.Width = item.DesiredSize.Width;
				item.Arrange(finalRect);
				finalRect.X += finalRect.Width;
			}
			return new Size(finalRect.X, finalSize.Height);
		}
	}

		public void InvalidateMeasureItems(DependencyObject from, DependencyObject to)
		{
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = from;
			do
			{
				if (dependencyObject is UIElement uIElement)
				{
					uIElement.InvalidateMeasure();
				}
				dependencyObject = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject);
			}
			while (dependencyObject != to);
			if (to is UIElement uIElement2)
			{
				uIElement2.InvalidateMeasure();
			}
		}

		public RibbonKeyTipLevelType KeyTipLevelType { get; set; }

		public bool HorizontalLoop { get; set; }

		public DependencyObject SelectedElement { get; set; }

		public RibbonKeyTipList KeyTips { get; set; }

		public RibbonKeyTipPresenters Presenters { get; set; }

		public bool IsKeyTipsVisible { get; set; }
	}

		protected RibbonNavigationLevel CurrentLevel
		{
			get

				if (Levels.Count > 0)

					return Levels[Levels.Count - 1];
				}

			}

		static RibbonNavigationManager()

			IsNavigationModeProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("IsNavigationMode", typeof(bool), typeof(RibbonNavigationManager), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(false, OnIsNavigationModePropertyChanged));
			IsSelectedProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("IsSelected", typeof(bool), typeof(RibbonNavigationManager), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(false));
			IsKeyTipsVisibleProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("IsKeyTipsVisible", typeof(bool), typeof(RibbonNavigationManager), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(false, OnIsKeyTipsVisiblePropertyChanged));
		}

		public RibbonNavigationManager(RibbonControl ribbon)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
