			Levels = new List<RibbonNavigationLevel>();
			Ribbon = ribbon;
			FilterString = "";
		}

		protected virtual void OnRibbonChanged(RibbonControl oldValue)
		{
			UnsubscribeRibbonEvents(oldValue);
			SubscribeRibbonEvents(Ribbon);
		}

		protected virtual void SubscribeRibbonEvents(RibbonControl target)
		{
			if (target != null)
			{
				UnsubscribeRibbonEvents(target);
				target.PreviewGotKeyboardFocus += OnRibbonPreviewGotKeyboardFocus;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UnsubscribeRibbonEvents(RibbonControl target)
		{
			if (target != null)
			{
				target.PreviewGotKeyboardFocus -= OnRibbonPreviewGotKeyboardFocus;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnRibbonPreviewGotKeyboardFocus(object sender, KeyboardFocusChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!Ribbon.AllowRibbonNavigationFromEditorOnTabPress || !(e.NewFocus is FrameworkElement) || IsNavigationMode)
			{
				return;
			}
			IBarItemLinkControl linkControl = LayoutHelper.FindLayoutOrVisualParentObject<IBarItemLinkControl>((DependencyObject)(FrameworkElement)e.NewFocus, true, (DependencyObject)null);
			if (linkControl == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			RibbonSelectedPageControl ribbonSelectedPageControl = LayoutHelper.FindLayoutOrVisualParentObject<RibbonSelectedPageControl>((DependencyObject)(FrameworkElement)(object)linkControl, true, (DependencyObject)null);
			RibbonPageGroupControl ribbonPageGroupControl = LayoutHelper.FindLayoutOrVisualParentObject<RibbonPageGroupControl>((DependencyObject)(FrameworkElement)(object)linkControl, true, (DependencyObject)null);
			RibbonNavigationLevelElements ribbonNavigationLevelElements = ((ribbonPageGroupControl == null) ? null : GetRibbonPageGroupElements(ribbonPageGroupControl));
			RibbonNavigationLevelElements ribbonNavigationLevelElements2 = ((ribbonSelectedPageControl == null) ? null : GetPageElements(ribbonSelectedPageControl));
			RibbonNavigationLevelElements targetElements = ribbonNavigationLevelElements2 ?? ribbonNavigationLevelElements;
			if (targetElements != null)
			{
				focusLocker.DoLockedActionIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
				{
					IsNavigationMode = true;
					HideKeyTips();
					CurrentLevel.Elements = targetElements;
					SelectedElement = (DependencyObject)(object)linkControl;
				});
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsNavigationModeChanged(bool oldValue)
		{
			//IL_0305: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_030f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_01e6: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0237: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_023d: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_026b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0275: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0247: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0251: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0193: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_019d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_01c2: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01cc: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (IsNavigationMode)
			{
				Ribbon.SetCurrentValue(RibbonControl.IsHiddenRibbonCollapsedProperty, false);
				FocusObserver.SaveFocus(true);
				Ribbon.Focusable = true;
				focusLocker.DoIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
				{
					Ribbon.Focus();
				});
				RibbonNavigationLevel ribbonNavigationLevel = new RibbonNavigationLevel();
				Levels.Add(ribbonNavigationLevel);
				if (Ribbon.ApplicationButton != null && Ribbon.ApplicationButton.IsChecked)
				{
					Levels.Insert(0, CreateHeaderKeyTipLevel(new RibbonNavigationLevel()));
					KeyTipGenerator.Generate((IEnumerable<IKeyTipInfo>)Levels[0].KeyTips);
					CreatePresenters(Levels[0]);
					ribbonNavigationLevel.HorizontalLoop = false;
					ribbonNavigationLevel.VerticalLoop = true;
					ribbonNavigationLevel.KeyTipLevelType = RibbonKeyTipLevelType.Popup;
					if (!Ribbon.ApplicationMenuIsPopupMenu())
					{
						if (!(Ribbon.ApplicationMenu is BackstageViewControl))
						{
							IsNavigationMode = false;
							return;
						}
						ribbonNavigationLevel.Owner = Ribbon.ApplicationMenu;
						ribbonNavigationLevel.Elements = GetBackstageElements();
						ribbonNavigationLevel.NavigationLevelType = RibbonNavigationLevelType.BackstageView;
						ribbonNavigationLevel.KeyTips = GetBackstageKeyTips();
					}
					if (!(Ribbon.ApplicationMenu is BackstageViewControl) && Ribbon.ApplicationMenu != null && ((Popup)(object)(Ribbon.ApplicationMenu as ApplicationMenu)).IsOpen)
					{
						ribbonNavigationLevel.Owner = Ribbon.ApplicationMenu;
						ribbonNavigationLevel.NavigationLevelType = RibbonNavigationLevelType.Popup;
						object owner = ribbonNavigationLevel.Owner;
						ribbonNavigationLevel.Elements = GetLinksControlElements((LinksControl)(PopupMenuBarControl)((PopupBase)((owner is BarPopupBase) ? owner : null)).PopupContent);
						ribbonNavigationLevel.HorizontalLoop = false;
						ribbonNavigationLevel.VerticalLoop = true;
						object owner2 = ribbonNavigationLevel.Owner;
						ribbonNavigationLevel.KeyTips = GetLinksControlKeyTips((LinksControl)(PopupMenuBarControl)((PopupBase)((owner2 is BarPopupBase) ? owner2 : null)).PopupContent);
					}
					ShowKeyTips();
					IsKeyTipsVisible = true;
				}
				else if ((int)Ribbon.RibbonHeaderVisibility == 0)
				{
					CreateHeaderKeyTipLevel(ribbonNavigationLevel);
					if (Ribbon.SelectedPage != null)
					{
						RibbonCaptionControl captionControlByPage = GetCaptionControlByPage(Ribbon.SelectedPage);
						SelectedElement = captionControlByPage;
					}
					IsKeyTipsVisible = true;
				}
				else
				{
					TryNavigateToPage(Dock.Bottom);
					if ((int)Ribbon.SelectedPageControl.ComplexLayoutState == 1)
					{
						OnSelectedPageControlComplexLayoutStateChanged(Ribbon, new ComplexLayoutStateChangedEventArgs((ComplexLayoutState)1));
						IsKeyTipsVisible = true;
					}
				}
				Ribbon.SelectedPageControl.ComplexLayoutStateChanged += new ComplexLayoutStateChangedEventHandler(OnSelectedPageControlComplexLayoutStateChanged);
				TopElement = LayoutHelper.FindRoot((DependencyObject)Ribbon, false) as FrameworkElement;
				if (TopElement != null)
				{
					TopElement.PreviewMouseDown += OnTopElementPreviewMouseDown;
					TopElement.AddHandler(AccessKeyManager.AccessKeyPressedEvent, new AccessKeyPressedEventHandler(OnTopElementAccessKeyPressed), handledEventsToo: true);
				}
				Ribbon.SizeChanged += OnRibbonSizeChanged;
			}
			else
			{
				Ribbon.ClearValue(RibbonControl.IsHiddenRibbonCollapsedProperty);
				Ribbon.SelectedPageControl.ComplexLayoutStateChanged -= new ComplexLayoutStateChangedEventHandler(OnSelectedPageControlComplexLayoutStateChanged);
				IsKeyTipsVisible = false;
				while (LevelCount != 0)
				{
					PopLevel();
				}
				SelectedElement = null;
				if (TopElement != null)
				{
					TopElement.PreviewMouseDown -= OnTopElementPreviewMouseDown;
					TopElement.RemoveHandler(AccessKeyManager.AccessKeyPressedEvent, new AccessKeyPressedEventHandler(OnTopElementAccessKeyPressed));
				}
				TopElement = null;
				Ribbon.SizeChanged -= OnRibbonSizeChanged;
				FilterString = string.Empty;
				RestoreFocus();
			}
		}

		private void OnTopElementAccessKeyPressed(object sender, AccessKeyPressedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(e.Key))
			{
				IsNavigationMode = false;
			}
		}

		public void RestoreFocus()
		{
			FocusedElement = null;
			FocusObserver.RestoreFocus(false, (Func<bool>)null);
		}

		protected virtual void SetFocus(DependencyObject element)
		{
			Keyboard.Focus(element as IInputElement);
		}

		protected RibbonNavigationLevel CreateHeaderKeyTipLevel(RibbonNavigationLevel level)
		{
			level.Elements = GetRibbonHeaderRow();
			level.NavigationLevelType = RibbonNavigationLevelType.Headers;
			level.HorizontalLoop = true;
			level.KeyTipLevelType = RibbonKeyTipLevelType.Headers;
			level.Owner = null;
			level.KeyTips = GetHeadersKeyTips();
			return level;
		}

		protected virtual void OnRibbonSizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			IsNavigationMode = false;
		}

		protected virtual void OnTopElementPreviewMouseDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (CurrentLevel != null && CurrentLevel.Owner is DependencyObject && e.OriginalSource is DependencyObject)
			{
				DependencyObject dependencyObject = (DependencyObject)e.OriginalSource;
				DependencyObject dependencyObject2 = (DependencyObject)CurrentLevel.Owner;
				if (LayoutHelper.IsChildElementEx(dependencyObject2, dependencyObject, true))
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			IsNavigationMode = false;
		}

		protected virtual void OnSelectedPageControlComplexLayoutStateChanged(object sender, ComplexLayoutStateChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0014: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (CurrentLevel.KeyTips == null && (int)e.State == 1 && LevelCount == 1)
			{
				CurrentLevel.KeyTips = GetPageKeyTips(Ribbon.SelectedPageControl);
				ShowKeyTips();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsKeyTipsVisibleChanged(bool oldValue)
		{
			if (IsKeyTipsVisible)
			{
				ShowKeyTips();
				return;
			}
			HideKeyTips();
			FilterString = "";
		}

		protected virtual void OnSelectedElementChanged(DependencyObject oldValue)
		{
			SetElementSelection(oldValue, isSelected: false);
			CurrentLevel.SelectedElement = SelectedElement;
			SetElementSelection(SelectedElement, isSelected: true);
			BringIntoView(SelectedElement);
		}

		private void BringIntoView(DependencyObject element)
		{
			if (!(element is BarItemLinkControlBase))
			{
				return;
			}
			BarItemLinkControlBase val = (BarItemLinkControlBase)(object)((element is BarItemLinkControlBase) ? element : null);
			if (!FrameworkElementExtensions.IsInVisualTree((FrameworkElement)(object)val))
			{
				return;
			}
			SubMenuScrollViewer val2 = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<SubMenuScrollViewer>(element);
			if (val2 != null)
			{
				Rect rect = ((Visual)(object)val).TransformToVisual((Visual)(object)val2).TransformBounds(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, ((FrameworkElement)(object)val).ActualWidth, ((FrameworkElement)(object)val).ActualHeight));
				if (rect.Top < 0.0)
				{
					val2.VerticalOffset -= rect.Top;
				}
				if (rect.Bottom > val2.ViewportHeight)
				{
					val2.VerticalOffset -= rect.Bottom - ((FrameworkElement)(object)val2).ActualHeight;
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void SetElementSelection(DependencyObject element, bool isSelected)
		{
			//IL_0056: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ed: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_008d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a3: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ad: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_00b4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00be: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_00c0: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (element == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			SetIsSelected(element, isSelected);
			if (element is RibbonPageCaptionControl)
			{
				if (isSelected)
				{
					Ribbon.SelectedPage = ((RibbonPageCaptionControl)element).Page;
				}
			}
			else if (element is RibbonCheckedBorderControl)
			{
				((RibbonCheckedBorderControl)element).AppFocusValue = isSelected;
			}
			else if (element is ItemBorderControl)
			{
				((ItemBorderControl)element).State = (BorderState)((!isSelected) ? 1 : 2);
			}
			else if (element is RibbonGalleryBarItemLinkControl)
			{
				((RibbonGalleryBarItemLinkControl)(object)element).DropDownButton.AppFocusValue = isSelected;
			}
			else if (element is GalleryItemControl)
			{
				((GalleryItemControl)element).IsSelected = isSelected;
			}
			else if (element is IBarItemLinkControl && BarItemLinkControlChecker.Is<IBarEditItemLinkControl>((IBarItemLinkControl)element))
			{
				if (isSelected)
				{
					FocusEditor((IBarEditItemLinkControl)element);
					FocusedElement = (DependencyObject)(object)((IBarEditItemLinkControl)element).Edit;
				}
				else
				{
					FocusedElement = null;
					SetFocus(Ribbon);
				}
			}
			if (element is IBarItemLinkControl)
			{
				((IBarItemLinkControl)element).IsSelected = isSelected;
			}
			if (element is BackstageItem)
			{
				if (element is BackstageTabItem && isSelected)
				{
					(element as BackstageTabItem).OnClick();
				}
				((BackstageItem)element).ActualIsFocused = isSelected;
			}
		}

		protected void SetKeyTipsVisibilityOnNavigate()
		{
			if (LevelCount == 1 || (CurrentLevel.NavigationLevelType != RibbonNavigationLevelType.Menu && CurrentLevel.NavigationLevelType != RibbonNavigationLevelType.GalleryMenu && CurrentLevel.NavigationLevelType != RibbonNavigationLevelType.Popup && CurrentLevel.NavigationLevelType != RibbonNavigationLevelType.Gallery))
			{
				IsKeyTipsVisible = false;
			}
		}

		public virtual bool TryShowPopupOnFocusedElement(Key key)
		{
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (FocusedElement is PopupBaseEdit && !((PopupBaseEdit)FocusedElement).IsPopupOpen && key == Key.Down)
			{
				((PopupBaseEdit)FocusedElement).ShowPopup();
			}
			return false;
		}

		public virtual bool IsFocusedElementKey(Key key)
		{
			if (key == Key.Tab || key == Key.Escape)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Keyboard.FocusedElement != null && Keyboard.FocusedElement != Ribbon)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (key != Key.Left && key != Key.Right && key != Key.Down && key != Key.Up && key != Key.Space)
			{
				return key != Key.Return;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public virtual bool ProcessChar(string symbol)
		{
			if (symbol.Length == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			char filterChar = symbol.ToUpper()[0];
			bool isKeyTipsVisible = CurrentLevel.IsKeyTipsVisible;
			AddCharToFilterString(filterChar);
			return isKeyTipsVisible;
		}

		public virtual bool Navigate(Key key, int platformKeyCode)
		{
			if (TryShowPopupOnFocusedElement(key) || IsFocusedElementKey(key))
			{
				return false;
			}
			switch (key)
			{
			case Key.Left:
				NavigateLeft();
				return true;
			case Key.Up:
				NavigateUp();
				return SelectedElement != null;
			case Key.Right:
				NavigateRight();
				return true;
			case Key.Down:
				NavigateDown();
				return SelectedElement != null;
			case Key.Tab:
				if (KeyboardHelper.IsShiftPressed)
				{
					NavigatePrior();
				}
				else
				{
					NavigateNext();
				}
				return true;
			case Key.Return:
			case Key.Space:
				ExecuteAction(SelectedElement);
				return true;
			case Key.Back:
				RemoveCharFromFilterString();
				return true;
			case Key.Escape:
				if (CurrentLevel.Owner is BackstageViewControl backstageViewControl && (backstageViewControl.CloseButtonVisibility == Visibility.Visible || !backstageViewControl.IsFullScreen))
				{
					backstageViewControl.Close();
				}
				if (LevelCount == 1)
				{
					if (FocusedElement != null)
					{
						IsNavigationMode = false;
						return true;
					}
					if (CurrentLevel.KeyTipLevelType == RibbonKeyTipLevelType.Headers)
					{
						IsNavigationMode = false;
						return true;
					}
					if (IsKeyTipsVisible && CurrentLevel.KeyTipLevelType == RibbonKeyTipLevelType.Page)
					{
						HideKeyTips();
						CurrentLevel.KeyTipLevelType = RibbonKeyTipLevelType.Headers;
						CurrentLevel.KeyTips = GetHeadersKeyTips();
						ShowKeyTips();
					}
					else
					{
						IsNavigationMode = false;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					PopLevel();
				}
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected void NavigateUp()
		{
			SetKeyTipsVisibilityOnNavigate();
			DependencyObject nearestElementFromList = GetNearestElementFromList(SelectedElement, CurrentLevel.Elements, Dock.Top);
			if (nearestElementFromList != null)
			{
				SelectedElement = nearestElementFromList;
				return;
			}
			switch (CurrentLevel.NavigationLevelType)
			{
			case RibbonNavigationLevelType.Toolbar:
				if (Ribbon.ToolbarShowMode == RibbonQuickAccessToolbarShowMode.ShowBelow && !TryNavigateToPageCaptions(Dock.Top) && !TryNavigateToPage(Dock.Top))
				{
					TryNavigateToHeaders(Dock.Top);
				}
				break;
			case RibbonNavigationLevelType.PageCaptions:
				if (!TryNavigateToPage(Dock.Top) && !TryNavigateToHeaders(Dock.Top))
				{
					TryNavigateToToolbarRow(Dock.Top);
				}
				break;
			case RibbonNavigationLevelType.Page:
				if (!TryNavigateToHeaders(Dock.Top))
				{
					TryNavigateToToolbarRow(Dock.Top);
				}
				break;
			case RibbonNavigationLevelType.Headers:
				TryNavigateToToolbarRow(Dock.Top);
				break;
			case RibbonNavigationLevelType.PageGroupCaption:
				TryNavigateToPageGroup();
				break;
			case RibbonNavigationLevelType.PageCaptionsInPopup:
				TryNavigateToPageInPopup();
				break;
			case RibbonNavigationLevelType.Menu:
			case RibbonNavigationLevelType.Popup:
			case RibbonNavigationLevelType.BackstageView:
				if (CurrentLevel.VerticalLoop && CurrentLevel.Elements != null && CurrentLevel.Elements.Count != 0)
				{
					SelectedElement = CurrentLevel.Elements[CurrentLevel.Elements.Count - 1];
				}
				break;
			case RibbonNavigationLevelType.GalleryMenu:
				TryNavigateToGallery();
				break;
			case RibbonNavigationLevelType.PageGroup:
			case RibbonNavigationLevelType.ToolbarInPopup:
			case RibbonNavigationLevelType.PageInPopup:
			case RibbonNavigationLevelType.Gallery:
				break;
			}
		}

		protected void NavigateDown()
		{
			SetKeyTipsVisibilityOnNavigate();
			DependencyObject nearestElementFromList = GetNearestElementFromList(SelectedElement, CurrentLevel.Elements, Dock.Bottom);
			if (nearestElementFromList != null)
			{
				SelectedElement = nearestElementFromList;
				return;
			}
			switch (CurrentLevel.NavigationLevelType)
			{
			case RibbonNavigationLevelType.Toolbar:
				if (Ribbon.ToolbarShowMode == RibbonQuickAccessToolbarShowMode.Default)
				{
					TryNavigateToHeaders(Dock.Bottom);
				}
				break;
			case RibbonNavigationLevelType.Headers:
				TryNavigateDownFromPageHeaders();
				break;
			case RibbonNavigationLevelType.Page:
				if (!TryNavigateToPageCaptions(Dock.Bottom))
				{
					TryNavigateToToolbarRow(Dock.Bottom);
				}
				break;
			case RibbonNavigationLevelType.PageCaptions:
				TryNavigateToToolbarRow(Dock.Bottom);
				break;
			case RibbonNavigationLevelType.PageGroup:
				TryNavigateToPageGroupCaption();
				break;
			case RibbonNavigationLevelType.PageInPopup:
				TryNavigateToPageCaptionsInPopup();
				break;
			case RibbonNavigationLevelType.Menu:
			case RibbonNavigationLevelType.Popup:
			case RibbonNavigationLevelType.GalleryMenu:
			case RibbonNavigationLevelType.BackstageView:
				if (CurrentLevel.VerticalLoop && CurrentLevel.Elements != null && CurrentLevel.Elements.Count != 0)
				{
					SelectedElement = CurrentLevel.Elements[0];
				}
				break;
			case RibbonNavigationLevelType.Gallery:
				TryNavigateToGalleryMenu();
				break;
			case RibbonNavigationLevelType.PageGroupCaption:
			case RibbonNavigationLevelType.ToolbarInPopup:
			case RibbonNavigationLevelType.PageCaptionsInPopup:
				break;
			}
		}

		protected bool TryNavigateDownFromPageHeaders()
		{
			if (SelectedElement is RibbonPageCaptionControl)
			{
				if (!TryNavigateToPage(Dock.Bottom) && !TryNavigateToPageCaptions(Dock.Bottom))
				{
					return TryNavigateToToolbarRow(Dock.Bottom);
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected void NavigateLeft()
		{
			if (CurrentLevel.Elements == null || CurrentLevel.Elements.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			SetKeyTipsVisibilityOnNavigate();
			if ((CurrentLevel.NavigationLevelType == RibbonNavigationLevelType.Menu || CurrentLevel.NavigationLevelType == RibbonNavigationLevelType.Popup || CurrentLevel.NavigationLevelType == RibbonNavigationLevelType.GalleryMenu) && LevelCount > 2)
			{
				PopLevel();
				return;
			}
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = GetNearestElementFromList(SelectedElement, CurrentLevel.Elements, Dock.Left);
			if (dependencyObject == null && CurrentLevel.HorizontalLoop)
			{
				dependencyObject = CurrentLevel.Elements[CurrentLevel.Elements.Count - 1];
			}
			if (dependencyObject != null)
			{
				SelectedElement = dependencyObject;
			}
		}

		protected void NavigateRight()
		{
			if (CurrentLevel.Elements == null || CurrentLevel.Elements.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			SetKeyTipsVisibilityOnNavigate();
			if ((CurrentLevel.NavigationLevelType == RibbonNavigationLevelType.Menu || CurrentLevel.NavigationLevelType == RibbonNavigationLevelType.Popup || CurrentLevel.NavigationLevelType == RibbonNavigationLevelType.GalleryMenu) && ElementIsPopupContainer(SelectedElement))
			{
				ExecuteAction(SelectedElement);
				return;
			}
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = GetNearestElementFromList(SelectedElement, CurrentLevel.Elements, Dock.Right);
			if (dependencyObject == null && CurrentLevel.HorizontalLoop)
			{
				dependencyObject = CurrentLevel.Elements[0];
			}
			if (dependencyObject != null)
			{
				SelectedElement = dependencyObject;
			}
		}

		protected void NavigateNext()
		{
			if (CurrentLevel.Elements == null || CurrentLevel.Elements.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			SetKeyTipsVisibilityOnNavigate();
			if (TryNavigateDownFromPageHeaders())
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = CurrentLevel.Elements.IndexOf(SelectedElement) + 1;
			if (num != 0)
			{
				if (num >= CurrentLevel.Elements.Count)
				{
					num = 0;
				}
				SelectedElement = CurrentLevel.Elements[num];
			}
		}

		protected void NavigatePrior()
		{
			if (CurrentLevel.Elements == null || CurrentLevel.Elements.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			SetKeyTipsVisibilityOnNavigate();
			int num = CurrentLevel.Elements.IndexOf(SelectedElement);
			if (num != -1)
			{
				int num2 = num - 1;
				if (num2 < 0)
				{
					num2 = CurrentLevel.Elements.Count - 1;
				}
				SelectedElement = CurrentLevel.Elements[num2];
			}
		}

		public virtual void PopLevel()
		{
			//IL_00ab: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b8: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c2: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0046: Expected O, but got Unknown
			HideKeyTips();
			RibbonNavigationLevel currentLevel = CurrentLevel;
			object owner = currentLevel.Owner;
			BarPopupBase val = (BarPopupBase)((owner is BarPopupBase) ? owner : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				if (((PopupBase)val).PopupContent is IComplexLayout)
				{
					((IComplexLayout)((PopupBase)val).PopupContent).ComplexLayoutStateChanged -= new ComplexLayoutStateChangedEventHandler(OnComplexLayoutStateChanged);
				}
				else
				{
					((FrameworkElement)(object)val).Loaded -= OnPopupLoaded;
				}
				((Popup)(object)val).Closed -= OnPopupClosed;
				if (val is GalleryDropDownPopupMenu)
				{
					((GalleryDropDownPopupMenu)(object)val).CloseWithTimer();
				}
				else if (!closePopupLocker.IsLocked)
				{
					val.ClosePopup();
				}
			}
			else if (currentLevel.Owner is IComplexLayout)
			{
				((IComplexLayout)currentLevel.Owner).ComplexLayoutStateChanged -= new ComplexLayoutStateChangedEventHandler(OnComplexLayoutStateChanged);
			}
			SelectedElement = null;
			Levels.Remove(CurrentLevel);
			if (LevelCount != 0)
			{
				FilterString = "";
				SelectedElement = CurrentLevel.SelectedElement;
				CurrentLevel.IsKeyTipsVisible = IsKeyTipsVisible;
				UpdatePresentersVisibility();
			}
			else
			{
				SelectedElement = null;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void PushLevel(RibbonNavigationLevel level)
		{
			//IL_0098: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a5: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00af: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_003f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0056: Expected O, but got Unknown
			FilterString = "";
			HideKeyTips();
			Levels.Add(level);
			object owner = level.Owner;
			BarPopupBase val = (BarPopupBase)((owner is BarPopupBase) ? owner : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				if (((PopupBase)val).PopupContent is IComplexLayout)
				{
					((IComplexLayout)((PopupBase)val).PopupContent).ComplexLayoutStateChanged += new ComplexLayoutStateChangedEventHandler(OnComplexLayoutStateChanged);
				}
				else
				{
					((FrameworkElement)(object)val).Loaded += OnPopupLoaded;
					NavigateFirstElementInPopup();
				}
				((Popup)(object)val).Closed += OnPopupClosed;
			}
			else if (level.Owner is IComplexLayout)
			{
				((IComplexLayout)level.Owner).ComplexLayoutStateChanged += new ComplexLayoutStateChangedEventHandler(OnComplexLayoutStateChanged);
			}
		}

		protected RibbonNavigationLevel FindLevelByPopup(BarPopupBase popup)
		{
			foreach (RibbonNavigationLevel level in Levels)
			{
				if (level.Owner == popup)
				{
					return level;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected virtual void OnPopupClosed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			RibbonNavigationLevel ribbonNavigationLevel = FindLevelByPopup((BarPopupBase)((sender is BarPopupBase) ? sender : null));
			if (ribbonNavigationLevel != null)
			{
				while (CurrentLevel != ribbonNavigationLevel)
				{
					PopLevel();
				}
				PopLevel();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnPopupLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			NavigateFirstElementInPopup();
		}

		protected virtual void OnComplexLayoutStateChanged(object sender, ComplexLayoutStateChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if ((int)e.State == 1)
			{
				if (CurrentLevel.Owner is BarPopupBase)
				{
					NavigateFirstElementInPopup();
				}
				if (CurrentLevel.Owner is BackstageViewControl)
				{
					NavigateFirstElementInBackstageView();
				}
			}
		}

		}

		public virtual void ExecuteAction(DependencyObject element)
		{
			//IL_00cd: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			_ = SelectedElement is IBarItemLinkControl;
			if (ElementIsApplicationButton(element))
			{
				ExecuteActionForApplicationButton();
			}
			else if (ElementIsHeaderOfMinimizedRibbon(element))
			{
				ExecuteActionForHeaderOfMinimizedRibbon(element);
			}
			else if (ElementIsCollapsedPageGroup(element))
			{
				ExecuteActionForCollapsedPageGroup(element);
			}
			else if (ElementIsToolbarCustomizationButton(element))
			{
				ExecuteActionForToolbarCustomizationButton();
			}
			else if (ElementIsToolbarDropDownButton(element))
			{
				ExecuteActionForToolbarDropDownButton();
			}
			else if (ElementIsBarSubItem(element))
			{
				ExecuteActionForBarSubItem(element);
			}
			else if (ElementIsBarSplitButton(element))
			{
				ExecuteActionForBarSplitButton(element);
			}
			else if (ElementIsBarSplitCheckItem(element))
			{
				ExecuteActionForBarSplitCheckItem(element);
			}
			else if (ElementIsGallery(element))
			{
				ExecuteActionForGallery(element);
			}
			else if (ElementIsCaptionButton(element))
			{
				ExecuteActionForCaptionButton(element);
			}
			else if (SelectedElementIsEditor(element))
			{
				ExecuteActionForEditor(element);
			}
			else if (element is IBarItemLinkControl)
			{
				((BarItemLinkBase)((IBarItemLinkControl)element).Link).Item.PerformClick();
				IsNavigationMode = false;
			}
			else if (element is BackstageButtonItem)
			{
				IsNavigationMode = false;
				((BackstageButtonItem)element).OnClick();
			}
			else if (element is BackstageTabItem)
			{
				IsNavigationMode = false;
				((BackstageTabItem)element).OnClick();
			}
		}

		}

		}

		protected void ExecuteActionForEditor(DependencyObject element)
		{
			IBarEditItemLinkControl val = (IBarEditItemLinkControl)(object)((element is IBarEditItemLinkControl) ? element : null);
			BaseEdit val2 = val.TemplatedEdit ?? val.Edit;
			if (val2 is CheckEdit)
			{
				BaseEditHelper.ToggleCheckEdit((CheckEdit)(object)((val2 is CheckEdit) ? val2 : null));
				IsNavigationMode = false;
			}
			else
			{
				SelectedElement = element;
				IsKeyTipsVisible = false;
				FocusEditor((IBarEditItemLinkControl)(object)((element is IBarEditItemLinkControl) ? element : null));
			}
		}

		protected void FocusEditor(IBarEditItemLinkControl editItem)
		{
			if (editItem == null)

				return;
			}
			BaseEdit val = editItem.Edit ?? editItem.TemplatedEdit;
			if (val == null || !((UIElement)(object)val).IsKeyboardFocusWithin)
			{
				UIElement uIElement = (UIElement)(((object)val) ?? ((object)(UIElement)(object)editItem));
				if (uIElement != null)
				{
					Keyboard.Focus(uIElement);
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool TryNavigateToToolbarRow(Dock direction)
		{
			//IL_002d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0033: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (direction == Dock.Bottom && Ribbon.ToolbarShowMode != RibbonQuickAccessToolbarShowMode.ShowBelow)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (direction == Dock.Top && Ribbon.ToolbarShowMode != RibbonQuickAccessToolbarShowMode.Default)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if ((int)Ribbon.RibbonHeaderVisibility == 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			RibbonNavigationLevelElements ribbonToolbarElements = GetRibbonToolbarElements();
			if (ribbonToolbarElements.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = GetNearestElementFromList(SelectedElement, ribbonToolbarElements, direction);
			if (dependencyObject == null)
			{
				dependencyObject = ribbonToolbarElements[ribbonToolbarElements.Count - 1];
			}
			CurrentLevel.Elements = ribbonToolbarElements;
			CurrentLevel.NavigationLevelType = RibbonNavigationLevelType.Toolbar;
			SelectedElement = dependencyObject;
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual bool TryNavigateToPage(Dock direction)
		{
			if (Ribbon.IsMinimized)
			{
				return false;
			}
			RibbonNavigationLevelElements pageElements = GetPageElements(Ribbon.SelectedPageControl);
			if (pageElements.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DependencyObject selectedElement = ((direction == Dock.Top) ? GetNearestElementFromList(SelectedElement, pageElements, direction) : pageElements[0]);
			CurrentLevel.Elements = pageElements;
			CurrentLevel.NavigationLevelType = RibbonNavigationLevelType.Page;
			SelectedElement = selectedElement;
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual bool TryNavigateToPageInPopup()
		{
			RibbonSelectedPageControl page = ((PopupBase)Ribbon.SelectedPagePopup).PopupContent as RibbonSelectedPageControl;
			RibbonNavigationLevelElements pageElements = GetPageElements(page);
			if (pageElements.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = (dependencyObject = GetNearestElementFromList(SelectedElement, pageElements, Dock.Top));
			if (dependencyObject == null)
			{
				dependencyObject = pageElements[0];
			}
			CurrentLevel.Elements = pageElements;
			CurrentLevel.NavigationLevelType = RibbonNavigationLevelType.PageInPopup;
			SelectedElement = dependencyObject;
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual bool TryNavigateToPageGroup()

			object owner = CurrentLevel.Owner;
			RibbonPageGroupControl groupControl = (RibbonPageGroupControl)((PopupBase)((owner is BarPopupBase) ? owner : null)).PopupContent;
			RibbonNavigationLevelElements ribbonPageGroupElements = GetRibbonPageGroupElements(groupControl);

			{
				return false;
			}
			CurrentLevel.Elements = ribbonPageGroupElements;
			CurrentLevel.NavigationLevelType = RibbonNavigationLevelType.PageGroup;
			SelectedElement = ribbonPageGroupElements[0];
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual bool TryNavigateToPageGroupCaption()
		{
			object owner = CurrentLevel.Owner;
			RibbonPageGroupControl ribbonPageGroupControl = (RibbonPageGroupControl)((PopupBase)((owner is BarPopupBase) ? owner : null)).PopupContent;
			if (!ribbonPageGroupControl.PageGroup.ShowCaptionButton)
			{
				return false;
			}

			ribbonNavigationLevelElements.Add(ribbonPageGroupControl.CaptionButton);
			CurrentLevel.Elements = ribbonNavigationLevelElements;

		protected virtual bool TryNavigateToPageCaptions(Dock direction)
		{
			RibbonSelectedPageControl selectedPageControl = Ribbon.SelectedPageControl;
			if (Ribbon.IsMinimized)
			{
				return false;
			}
			RibbonNavigationLevelElements pageCaptionsElements = GetPageCaptionsElements(selectedPageControl);
			if (pageCaptionsElements.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = null;
			if (direction == Dock.Bottom)
			{
				RibbonPageGroupControl ribbonPageGroupControl = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<RibbonPageGroupControl>(SelectedElement);
				if (ribbonPageGroupControl != null)
				{
					if (ribbonPageGroupControl.IsCollapsed)
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (ribbonPageGroupControl.PageGroup.ShowCaptionButton)
					{
						dependencyObject = ribbonPageGroupControl.CaptionButton;
					}
				}
			}
			if (dependencyObject == null)
			{
				dependencyObject = pageCaptionsElements[0];
			}
			CurrentLevel.Elements = pageCaptionsElements;
			CurrentLevel.NavigationLevelType = RibbonNavigationLevelType.PageCaptions;
			SelectedElement = dependencyObject;
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual bool TryNavigateToPageCaptionsInPopup()

			if (pageCaptionsElements.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;

			RibbonPageGroupControl ribbonPageGroupControl = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<RibbonPageGroupControl>(SelectedElement);
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = null;
			if (ribbonPageGroupControl != null && ribbonPageGroupControl.PageGroup.ShowCaptionButton)
			{
				dependencyObject = ribbonPageGroupControl.CaptionButton;
			}
			if (dependencyObject == null)
			{
				dependencyObject = pageCaptionsElements[0];
			}
			CurrentLevel.Elements = pageCaptionsElements;
			CurrentLevel.NavigationLevelType = RibbonNavigationLevelType.PageCaptionsInPopup;
			SelectedElement = dependencyObject;
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual bool TryNavigateToHeaders(Dock direction)
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000c: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if ((int)Ribbon.RibbonHeaderVisibility == 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			RibbonNavigationLevelElements ribbonHeaderRow = GetRibbonHeaderRow();
			if (ribbonHeaderRow.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = null;
			dependencyObject = ((direction != Dock.Top) ? GetNearestElementFromList(SelectedElement, ribbonHeaderRow, direction) : GetCaptionControlByPage(Ribbon.SelectedPage));
			if (dependencyObject == null)
			{
				dependencyObject = ribbonHeaderRow[0];
			}
			CurrentLevel.Elements = ribbonHeaderRow;
			CurrentLevel.NavigationLevelType = RibbonNavigationLevelType.Headers;
			CurrentLevel.HorizontalLoop = true;
			SelectedElement = dependencyObject;
			return true;
		}

		protected RibbonCaptionControl GetCaptionControlByPage(RibbonPage page)
		{
			RibbonPageCategoryBase category = ((page.MergedParentCategory == null) ? page.PageCategory : page.MergedParentCategory);
			RibbonPageCategoryControl pageCategoryControl = Ribbon.GetPageCategoryControl(category);
			RibbonPageHeaderControl input = (RibbonPageHeaderControl)pageCategoryControl.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(page);
			return input.With((RibbonPageHeaderControl h) => h.CaptionControl);
		}

		protected RibbonNavigationLevelElements GetRibbonHeaderRow()
		{
			RibbonNavigationLevelElements ribbonNavigationLevelElements = new RibbonNavigationLevelElements();
			ribbonNavigationLevelElements.Add(Ribbon.ApplicationButton);
			for (int i = 0; i < Ribbon.ActualCategories.Count; i++)
			{
				RibbonPageCategoryControl pageCategoryControl = Ribbon.GetPageCategoryControl(i);
				if (!pageCategoryControl.PageCategory.IsVisible)
				{
					continue;
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < pageCategoryControl.Items.Count; j++)
				{
					RibbonPageHeaderControl ribbonPageHeaderControl = (RibbonPageHeaderControl)pageCategoryControl.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromIndex(j);
					if (ribbonPageHeaderControl.Page.IsVisible)
					{
						ribbonNavigationLevelElements.Add(ribbonPageHeaderControl.CaptionControl);
					}
				}
			}
			ribbonNavigationLevelElements.AddRange(GetLinksControlElements((LinksControl)(object)Ribbon.PageHeaderLinksControl));
			return ribbonNavigationLevelElements;
		}

		protected IBarItemLinkControl GetLinkControl(LinksControl linksControl, int index)
		{
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = ((ItemsControl)(object)linksControl).ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromIndex(index);
			BarItemLinkInfo val = (BarItemLinkInfo)(object)((dependencyObject is BarItemLinkInfo) ? dependencyObject : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return val.LinkControl;
		}

		protected RibbonNavigationLevelElements GetLinksControlElements(LinksControl linksControl)
		{
			RibbonNavigationLevelElements ribbonNavigationLevelElements = new RibbonNavigationLevelElements();
			for (int i = 0; i < ((ItemsControl)(object)linksControl).Items.Count; i++)
			{
				IBarItemLinkControl linkControl = GetLinkControl(linksControl, i);
				if (linkControl != null && ((FrameworkElement)(object)linkControl).Visibility != Visibility.Collapsed && ((UIElement)(object)linkControl).Opacity != 0.0 && linkControl != null && ((IInputElement)linkControl).IsEnabled && !(linkControl is BarStaticItemLinkControl) && !(linkControl is BarItemLinkSeparatorControl))
				{
					if (linkControl is BarButtonGroupLinkControl)
					{
						ribbonNavigationLevelElements.AddRange(GetLinksControlElements((LinksControl)(object)((BarButtonGroupLinkControl)(object)linkControl).ItemsControl));
					}
					else
					{
						ribbonNavigationLevelElements.Add(linkControl as DependencyObject);
					}
				}
			}
			return ribbonNavigationLevelElements;
		}

		protected RibbonNavigationLevelElements GetBackstageElements()
		{
			RibbonNavigationLevelElements ribbonNavigationLevelElements = new RibbonNavigationLevelElements();
			BackstageViewControl backstageViewControl = CurrentLevel.Owner as BackstageViewControl;
			foreach (object item in (IEnumerable)backstageViewControl.ItemsControl.Items)
			{
				if (backstageViewControl.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(item) is BackstageItemBase backstageItemBase && !(backstageItemBase is BackstageSeparatorItem))
				{
					ribbonNavigationLevelElements.Add(backstageItemBase);
				}
			}
			return ribbonNavigationLevelElements;
		}

		protected RibbonNavigationLevelElements GetGalleryElements(GalleryDropDownControl control)
		{
			RibbonNavigationLevelElements ribbonNavigationLevelElements = new RibbonNavigationLevelElements();
			GalleryItemGroupsControl groupsControl = control.GalleryControl.GetGroupsControl();
			for (int i = 0; i < ((ItemsControl)(object)groupsControl).Items.Count; i++)
			{
				DependencyObject dependencyObject = ((ItemsControl)(object)groupsControl).ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromIndex(i);
				GalleryItemGroupControl val = (GalleryItemGroupControl)(object)((dependencyObject is GalleryItemGroupControl) ? dependencyObject : null);
				for (int j = 0; j < ((ItemsControl)(object)val).Items.Count; j++)
				{
					DependencyObject dependencyObject2 = ((ItemsControl)(object)val).ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromIndex(j);
					GalleryItemControl item = (GalleryItemControl)(object)((dependencyObject2 is GalleryItemControl) ? dependencyObject2 : null);
					ribbonNavigationLevelElements.Add((DependencyObject)(object)item);
				}
			}
			return ribbonNavigationLevelElements;
		}

		protected RibbonNavigationLevelElements GetRibbonToolbarElements()
		{
			RibbonNavigationLevelElements ribbonNavigationLevelElements = new RibbonNavigationLevelElements();
			ribbonNavigationLevelElements.AddRange(GetLinksControlElements((LinksControl)(object)Ribbon.Toolbar.Control));
			if (Ribbon.Toolbar.Control.IsCustomizationButtonVisible)
			{
				ribbonNavigationLevelElements.Add(Ribbon.Toolbar.Control.CustomizationButton);
			}
			if (Ribbon.Toolbar.Control.IsDropDownButtonVisible)
			{
				ribbonNavigationLevelElements.Add(Ribbon.Toolbar.Control.DropDownButton);
			}
			return ribbonNavigationLevelElements;
		}

		protected RibbonNavigationLevelElements GetToolbarPopupElements()
		{
			RibbonQuickAccessToolbarPopup ribbonQuickAccessToolbarPopup = CurrentLevel.Owner as RibbonQuickAccessToolbarPopup;
			RibbonQuickAccessToolbarControl ribbonQuickAccessToolbarControl = (RibbonQuickAccessToolbarControl)((PopupBase)ribbonQuickAccessToolbarPopup).PopupContent;
			RibbonNavigationLevelElements ribbonNavigationLevelElements = new RibbonNavigationLevelElements();
			ribbonNavigationLevelElements.AddRange(GetLinksControlElements((LinksControl)(object)ribbonQuickAccessToolbarControl));
			if (ribbonQuickAccessToolbarControl.IsCustomizationButtonVisible)
			{
				ribbonNavigationLevelElements.Add(ribbonQuickAccessToolbarControl.CustomizationButton);
			}
			if (ribbonQuickAccessToolbarControl.IsDropDownButtonVisible)
			{
				ribbonNavigationLevelElements.Add(ribbonQuickAccessToolbarControl.DropDownButton);
			}
			return ribbonNavigationLevelElements;
		}

		protected RibbonNavigationLevelElements GetPageElements(RibbonSelectedPageControl page)
		{
			RibbonNavigationLevelElements ribbonNavigationLevelElements = new RibbonNavigationLevelElements();
			for (int i = 0; i < page.GetPageGroupCount(); i++)
			{
				RibbonPageGroupControl pageGroupControlFromIndex = page.GetPageGroupControlFromIndex(i);
				if (pageGroupControlFromIndex != null)
				{
					ribbonNavigationLevelElements.AddRange(GetRibbonPageGroupElements(pageGroupControlFromIndex));
				}
			}
			return ribbonNavigationLevelElements;
		}

		protected RibbonNavigationLevelElements GetRibbonPageGroupElements(RibbonPageGroupControl groupControl)
		{
			if (!groupControl.IsCollapsed)
			{
				return GetLinksControlElements((LinksControl)(object)groupControl);
			}
			RibbonNavigationLevelElements ribbonNavigationLevelElements = new RibbonNavigationLevelElements();
			ribbonNavigationLevelElements.Add((DependencyObject)(object)groupControl.CollapsedStateBorder);
			return ribbonNavigationLevelElements;
		}

		private double CalcDistance(Size elementSize, Rect listElementRect)
		{
			double num = elementSize.Width / 2.0 - listElementRect.X - listElementRect.Width / 2.0;
			double num2 = elementSize.Height / 2.0 - listElementRect.Y - listElementRect.Height / 2.0;
			return num * num + num2 * num2;
		}

		protected RibbonNavigationLevelElements GetPageCaptionsElements(RibbonSelectedPageControl page)
		{
			RibbonNavigationLevelElements ribbonNavigationLevelElements = new RibbonNavigationLevelElements();
			if (page == null)
			{
				return ribbonNavigationLevelElements;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < page.GetPageGroupCount(); i++)
			{
				RibbonPageGroupControl pageGroupControlFromIndex = page.GetPageGroupControlFromIndex(i);
				if (pageGroupControlFromIndex != null && pageGroupControlFromIndex.PageGroup != null && pageGroupControlFromIndex.CaptionButton != null && pageGroupControlFromIndex.PageGroup.ShowCaptionButton && !pageGroupControlFromIndex.IsCollapsed)
				{
					ribbonNavigationLevelElements.Add(pageGroupControlFromIndex.CaptionButton);
				}
			}
			return ribbonNavigationLevelElements;
		}

		protected DependencyObject GetNearestElementFromList(DependencyObject element, RibbonNavigationLevelElements elements, Dock searchDirection)
		{
			if (!(element is UIElement))
			{
				return null;
			}
			DependencyObject result = null;
			double num = double.MaxValue;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			Size desiredSize = ((UIElement)element).DesiredSize;
			foreach (DependencyObject element2 in elements)
			{
				if (element2 == element || !(element2 is UIElement))
				{
					continue;
				}
				Rect listElementRect = ((UIElement)element2).TransformToVisual((UIElement)element).TransformBounds(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, ((UIElement)element2).RenderSize.Width, ((UIElement)element2).RenderSize.Height));
				switch (searchDirection)
				{
				case Dock.Bottom:
					if (listElementRect.X + listElementRect.Width < 0.0 || listElementRect.X > desiredSize.Width || listElementRect.Y <= 0.0)
					{
						continue;
					}
					break;
				case Dock.Left:
					if (listElementRect.Y + listElementRect.Height <= 0.0 || listElementRect.Y >= desiredSize.Height || listElementRect.X >= 0.0)
					{
						continue;
					}
					break;
				case Dock.Right:
					if (listElementRect.Y + listElementRect.Height <= 0.0 || listElementRect.Y >= desiredSize.Height || listElementRect.X <= 0.0)
					{
						continue;
					}
					break;
				case Dock.Top:
					if (listElementRect.X + listElementRect.Width < 0.0 || listElementRect.X > desiredSize.Width || listElementRect.Y >= 0.0)
					{
						continue;
					}
					break;
				}
				num2 = CalcDistance(desiredSize, listElementRect);
				if (num2 < num)
				{
					num = num2;
					result = element2;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected void ShowKeyTips()
		{
			CurrentLevel.IsKeyTipsVisible = true;
			KeyTipGenerator.Generate((IEnumerable<IKeyTipInfo>)CurrentLevel.KeyTips);
			CreatePresenters(CurrentLevel);
			UpdatePresentersVisibility();
		}

		protected void HideKeyTips()
		{
			CurrentLevel.IsKeyTipsVisible = false;
			UpdatePresentersVisibility();
		}

		protected void CreatePresenters(RibbonNavigationLevel level)
		{
			level.Presenters = new RibbonKeyTipPresenters();
			foreach (RibbonKeyTip item2 in (List<RibbonKeyTip>)(object)level.KeyTips)
			{
				if (item2.IsVisible)
				{
					RibbonKeyTipPresenter item = new RibbonKeyTipPresenter(item2);
					level.Presenters.Add(item);
				}
			}
		}

		protected void RemoveCharFromFilterString()
		{
			if (FilterString.Length != 0)
			{
				FilterString = FilterString.Substring(0, FilterString.Length - 1);
				UpdatePresentersVisibility();
			}
		}

		protected void AddCharToFilterString(char filterChar)
		{
			FilterString += filterChar;
			RibbonKeyTip keyTipForExecute = GetKeyTipForExecute();
			if (keyTipForExecute != null)
			{
				if (keyTipForExecute.Owner is RibbonPageCaptionControl && !Ribbon.IsMinimized)
				{
					HideKeyTips();
					CurrentLevel.KeyTips = null;
					FilterString = "";
					RibbonPage selectedPage = Ribbon.SelectedPage;
					SelectedElement = keyTipForExecute.Owner;
					CurrentLevel.KeyTipLevelType = RibbonKeyTipLevelType.Page;
					if (selectedPage == Ribbon.SelectedPage && IsKeyTipsVisible)
					{
						CurrentLevel.KeyTips = GetPageKeyTips(Ribbon.SelectedPageControl);
						ShowKeyTips();
					}
					return;
				}
				if (ElementIsBarSplitButton(keyTipForExecute.Owner) || ElementIsBarSplitCheckItem(keyTipForExecute.Owner))
				{
					DependencyObject owner = keyTipForExecute.Owner;
					BarSplitButtonItemLinkControl val = (BarSplitButtonItemLinkControl)(object)((owner is BarSplitButtonItemLinkControl) ? owner : null);
					if (keyTipForExecute.TargetElement is ArrowControl)
					{
						ExecuteAction((DependencyObject)(object)val);
						return;
					}
					if (LevelCount > 1 && (CurrentLevel.NavigationLevelType == RibbonNavigationLevelType.Gallery || CurrentLevel.NavigationLevelType == RibbonNavigationLevelType.GalleryMenu || CurrentLevel.NavigationLevelType == RibbonNavigationLevelType.Menu || CurrentLevel.NavigationLevelType == RibbonNavigationLevelType.Popup) && !val.SplitButtonItem.ActAsDropDown)
					{
						((BarItemLinkBase)((BarItemLinkControlBase)val).Link).Item.PerformClick();
						IsNavigationMode = false;
						return;
					}
				}
				ExecuteAction(keyTipForExecute.Owner);
			}
			else
			{
				UpdatePresentersVisibility();
			}
		}

		protected void UpdatePresentersVisibility()
		{
			UpdateActualKeyTipsVisibility();
			UpdatePresenters();
		}

		protected RibbonKeyTip GetKeyTipForExecute()
		{
			if (LevelCount == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			foreach (RibbonKeyTip item in (List<RibbonKeyTip>)(object)CurrentLevel.KeyTips)
			{
				if (item.ActualKeyTip == FilterString && item.IsActualVisible && item.IsEnabled)
				{
					return item;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected void UpdateActualKeyTipsVisibility()
		{
			if (CurrentLevel.KeyTips == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (RibbonKeyTip item in (List<RibbonKeyTip>)(object)CurrentLevel.KeyTips)
			{
				FrameworkElement frameworkElement = item.Owner as FrameworkElement;
				item.IsActualVisible = frameworkElement != null && frameworkElement.IsVisible && frameworkElement.ActualWidth > 0.0 && item.ActualKeyTip != null && FilterString != null && item.IsVisible && !FilterString.StartsWith(item.ActualKeyTip) && item.ActualKeyTip.StartsWith(FilterString) && IsKeyTipsVisible && CurrentLevel.IsKeyTipsVisible;
			}
		}

		protected void UpdatePresenters()
		{
			Action action = delegate
			{
				if (CurrentLevel.Presenters == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (RibbonKeyTipPresenter presenter in CurrentLevel.Presenters)
				{
					if (presenter.KeyTip.IsActualVisible && (CurrentLevel.Owner as Popup).If((Popup x) => !x.IsOpen).ReturnSuccess())
					{
						break;
					}
					presenter.UpdateView();
				}
			};
			if (Ribbon.IsMinimized && !Ribbon.SelectedPagePopup.wasOpened && IsNavigationMode)
			{
				base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(action);
			}
			else
			{
				action();
			}
		}

		protected RibbonKeyTipList GetPageGroupKeyTips(RibbonPageGroupControl groupControl)
		{
			RibbonKeyTipList linksControlKeyTips = GetLinksControlKeyTips((LinksControl)(object)groupControl);
			((List<RibbonKeyTip>)(object)linksControlKeyTips).Add(CreateKeyTipForCaptionButton(groupControl));
			if (groupControl.IsCollapsed)
			{
				foreach (RibbonKeyTip item in (List<RibbonKeyTip>)(object)linksControlKeyTips)
				{
					item.IsVisible = false;
				}
			}
			((List<RibbonKeyTip>)(object)linksControlKeyTips).Add(CreateKeyTipForCollapsedPageGroup(groupControl));
			return linksControlKeyTips;
		}

		protected RibbonKeyTip CreateKeyTipForCaptionButton(RibbonPageGroupControl groupControl)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Expected O, but got Unknown
			RibbonKeyTip val = new RibbonKeyTip();
			val.KeyTip = groupControl.PageGroup.KeyTip;
			val.Owner = groupControl.CaptionButton;
			val.TargetElement = groupControl.CaptionButton;
			val.HorizontalPlacement = (RibbonKeyTipHorizontalPlacement)4;
			val.VerticalPlacement = (RibbonKeyTipVerticalPlacement)4;
			val.IsVisible = groupControl.PageGroup.ShowCaptionButton;
			val.IsEnabled = true;
			return val;
		}

		protected RibbonKeyTip CreateKeyTipForCollapsedPageGroup(RibbonPageGroupControl groupControl)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Expected O, but got Unknown
			RibbonKeyTip val = new RibbonKeyTip();
			val.KeyTip = groupControl.PageGroup.KeyTipGroupExpanding;
			val.Owner = (DependencyObject)(object)groupControl.CollapsedStateBorder;
			val.TargetElement = (DependencyObject)(object)groupControl;
			val.IsVisible = groupControl.IsCollapsed;
			val.HorizontalPlacement = (RibbonKeyTipHorizontalPlacement)4;
			val.VerticalPlacement = (RibbonKeyTipVerticalPlacement)5;
			val.IsEnabled = true;
			return val;
		}

		protected RibbonKeyTipList GetPageKeyTips(RibbonSelectedPageControl page)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

		{

			{
				return keyTip;
			}
			protected set
			{
				if (keyTip != value)
				{
					RibbonKeyTip oldValue = keyTip;
					keyTip = value;
					OnKeyTipChanged(oldValue);
				}
			}
		}

		public RibbonKeyTipPresenter(RibbonKeyTip keyTip)
			: base(keyTip.TargetElement as UIElement)

			KeyTipControl.SizeChanged += OnKeyTipControlSizeChanged;
			KeyTip = keyTip;
		}

		private void OnKeyTipControlSizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		private void OnKeyTipChanged(RibbonKeyTip oldValue)
		{
			if (KeyTip == null)

				ClearValue(UIElement.IsEnabledProperty);
				return;
			}
			KeyTipControl.SetBinding(UIElement.IsEnabledProperty, new Binding
			{
				Source = KeyTip,
				Path = new PropertyPath("IsEnabled")
			});
		}

		public virtual void UpdateView()
		{

			{
				Show();
			}
			else
			{
				Hide();
			}
		}

			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = sender as FrameworkElement;
			frameworkElement.Loaded -= OnOwnerLoaded;
			UpdateAdornerLayer(frameworkElement);
		}

		private void UpdateAdornerLayer(FrameworkElement fe)
		{
			AdornerLayer = FindAdornerLayer(fe);
			if (AdornerLayer != null)
			{
				AdornerLayer.Add(this);
			}
		}

		protected void Hide()
		{
			if (AdornerLayer != null)
			{
				AdornerLayer.Remove(this);
			}
			AdornerLayer = null;
		}

		private AdornerLayer FindAdornerLayer(UIElement targetElement)
		{
			RibbonControl ribbonControl = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<RibbonControl>(KeyTip.Owner);
			if (ribbonControl != null)
			{
				return AdornerLayer.GetAdornerLayer((Visual)(((object)ribbonControl.Manager) ?? ((object)ribbonControl)));
			}
			AdornerLayer adornerLayer = AdornerLayer.GetAdornerLayer(KeyTip.Owner as UIElement);
			if (adornerLayer == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			UIElement visual = LayoutHelper.GetParent((DependencyObject)adornerLayer, false) as UIElement;
			while (AdornerLayer.GetAdornerLayer(visual) != null)
			{
				adornerLayer = AdornerLayer.GetAdornerLayer(visual);
				visual = LayoutHelper.GetParent((DependencyObject)adornerLayer, false) as UIElement;
			}
			return adornerLayer;
		}
	}
	public class RibbonPageCategoriesPane : ItemsControl
	{
		private ButtonBase leftButton;

		private ButtonBase rightButton;

		private ScrollViewer scrollHost;

		public RibbonControl Ribbon
		{
			get
			{
				RibbonControl ribbonControl = base.TemplatedParent as RibbonControl;
				if (ribbonControl == null)
				{
					ribbonControl = RibbonControl.GetRibbon(this);
				}
				return ribbonControl;
			}
		}

		public ButtonBase LeftButton
		{
			get
			{
				return leftButton;
			}
			private set
			{
				if (leftButton != value)
				{
					ButtonBase oldValue = leftButton;
					leftButton = value;
					OnLeftButtonChanged(oldValue);
				}
			}
		}

		public ButtonBase RightButton
		{
			get
			{
				return rightButton;
			}
			private set
			{
				if (rightButton != value)
				{
					ButtonBase oldValue = rightButton;
					rightButton = value;
					OnRightButtonChanged(oldValue);
				}
			}
		}

		public ScrollViewer ScrollHost
		{
			get
			{
				return scrollHost;
			}
			private set
			{
				if (scrollHost != value)
				{
					ScrollViewer oldValue = scrollHost;
					scrollHost = value;
					OnSrollHostChanged(oldValue);
				}
			}
		}

		public RibbonItemsPanel RibbonItemsPanel
		{
			get
			{
				if (ItemsPresenter == null || VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(ItemsPresenter) == 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(ItemsPresenter, 0) as RibbonItemsPanel;
			}
		}

		private ItemsPresenter ItemsPresenter { get; set; }

		private RibbonPageCategoryHeaderControl HeaderControl { get; set; }

		protected override bool HandlesScrolling => NavigationTree.IsMenuMode;

		static RibbonPageCategoriesPane()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<RibbonPageCategoriesPane>();
		}

		public RibbonPageCategoriesPane()
		{
			base.LayoutUpdated += OnLayoutUpdated;
			base.SizeChanged += OnSizeChanged;
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			ItemsPresenter = GetTemplateChild("PART_ItemsPresenter") as ItemsPresenter;
			LeftButton = GetTemplateChild("PART_LeftRepeatButton") as ButtonBase;
			RightButton = GetTemplateChild("PART_RightRepeatButton") as ButtonBase;
			ScrollHost = GetTemplateChild("PART_ScrollViewer") as ScrollViewer;
			HeaderControl = GetTemplateChild("PART_OriginHeaderControl") as RibbonPageCategoryHeaderControl;
			if (HeaderControl != null)
			{
				BindingOperations.ClearBinding(HeaderControl, RibbonPageCategoryHeaderControl.IsAeroModeProperty);
			}
		}

		public double GetContextualCategoriesLeftOffset()
		{
			if (base.ItemContainerGenerator.Status != GeneratorStatus.ContainersGenerated)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			IEnumerable<RibbonOrderedItemInfo> source = (from RibbonPageCategoryBase cat in base.Items
				where !cat.IsDefault && cat.IsVisible
				select cat).Select((RibbonPageCategoryBase x, int i) => new RibbonOrderedItemInfo(i, GetChildOrder(x), x));
			source = RibbonOrderedItemsHelper.SortByOrder(source.ToArray());
			object obj = source.FirstOrDefault().With((RibbonOrderedItemInfo x) => x.Item);
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = (FrameworkElement)base.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(obj);
			return frameworkElement.TranslatePoint(default(Point), this).X;
		}

		public double GetHeadersWidth()
		{
			if (base.ItemContainerGenerator.Status != GeneratorStatus.ContainersGenerated)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			IEnumerable<RibbonPageCategoryControl> source = from RibbonPageCategoryBase cat in base.Items
				where !cat.IsDefault
				select (RibbonPageCategoryControl)base.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(cat);
			return source.Sum((RibbonPageCategoryControl cat) => cat.GetHeaderWidth());
		}

		protected override void ClearContainerForItemOverride(DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			RibbonPageCategoryControl ribbonPageCategoryControl = element as RibbonPageCategoryControl;
			ribbonPageCategoryControl.PageCategory = null;
			ribbonPageCategoryControl.Ribbon = null;
			base.ClearContainerForItemOverride(element, item);
		}

		protected override DependencyObject GetContainerForItemOverride()
		{
			return new RibbonPageCategoryControl();
		}

		protected override bool IsItemItsOwnContainerOverride(object item)
		{
			return item is RibbonPageCategoryControl;
		}

		protected override void PrepareContainerForItemOverride(DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			base.PrepareContainerForItemOverride(element, item);
			RibbonPageCategoryControl ribbonPageCategoryControl = element as RibbonPageCategoryControl;
			RibbonPageCategoryBase ribbonPageCategoryBase = null;
			if (item is RibbonPageCategoryBase)
			{
				ribbonPageCategoryBase = (RibbonPageCategoryBase)item;
				ribbonPageCategoryControl.PageCategory = ribbonPageCategoryBase;
				ribbonPageCategoryControl.Ribbon = Ribbon;
				return;
			}
			throw new ArgumentException("Only RibbonPageCategory or DefaultRibbonPageCategory can be added to RibbonControl.");
		}

		protected virtual void OnLayoutUpdated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateScrollButtonsVisibility();
		}

		protected virtual void OnLeftButtonChanged(ButtonBase oldValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				oldValue.Click -= OnLeftButtonClick;
			}
			if (LeftButton != null)
			{
				LeftButton.Click += OnLeftButtonClick;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnRightButtonChanged(ButtonBase oldValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				oldValue.Click -= OnRightButtonClick;
			}
			if (RightButton != null)
			{
				RightButton.Click += OnRightButtonClick;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnSizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (RibbonItemsPanel != null)
			{
				RibbonItemsPanel.CheckOffset();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnSrollHostChanged(ScrollViewer oldValue)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnLeftButtonClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (RibbonItemsPanel != null)
			{
				RibbonItemsPanel.IncreaseOffset();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnRightButtonClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (RibbonItemsPanel != null)
			{
				RibbonItemsPanel.DecreaseOffset();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseDown(e);
			if (Ribbon != null && Ribbon.CanDragRibbonWindow())
			{
				UIElement input = e.OriginalSource as UIElement;
				RibbonPageCategoryControl ribbonPageCategoryControl = input.With((UIElement x) => TreeHelper.GetParent<RibbonPageCategoryControl>((DependencyObject)x, (Func<RibbonPageCategoryControl, bool>)null, true, true));
				if (ribbonPageCategoryControl == null)
				{
					Ribbon.WindowHelper.DragOrMaximizeWindow(this, e);
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateScrollButtonsVisibility()
		{
			if (RibbonItemsPanel != null && LeftButton != null && RightButton != null)
			{
				LeftButton.Visibility = ((!(RibbonItemsPanel.Offset < 0.0)) ? Visibility.Hidden : Visibility.Visible);
				RightButton.Visibility = ((RibbonItemsPanel.Offset <= ScrollHost.ViewportWidth - RibbonItemsPanel.RenderSize.Width) ? Visibility.Hidden : Visibility.Visible);
			}
		}

		private int? GetChildOrder(RibbonPageCategoryBase category)
		{
			if (Ribbon == null || (!Ribbon.IsMerged && Ribbon.ActualMergedParent == null))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return category.ActualMergeOrder;
		}
	}

		static RibbonPageCategoryBase()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(RibbonPageCategoryBase);
			DXSerializer.EnabledProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(RibbonPageCategoryBase), new UIPropertyMetadata(false));
			AltitudeProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Altitude", typeof(int), typeof(RibbonPageCategoryBase), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0, RaiseAltitudeChanged));
			RibbonPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("Ribbon", typeof(RibbonControl), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure, OnRibbonPropertyChanged));
			RibbonProperty = RibbonPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			AllowRemoveFromParentDuringCustomizationProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("AllowRemoveFromParentDuringCustomization", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(true));
			CaptionProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Caption", typeof(string), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(string.Empty, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsArrange, OnCaptionPropertyChanged));
			ColorProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Color", typeof(Color), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(Color.FromArgb(byte.MaxValue, 158, 197, 126), FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender, OnColorPropertyChanged));
			IsDefaultPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("IsDefault", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(false, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsArrange, OnIsDefaultPropertyChanged, OnIsDefaultPropertyCoerce));
			IsDefaultProperty = IsDefaultPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			IsVisibleProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("IsVisible", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(true, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None, OnIsVisiblePropertyChanged, OnIsVisiblePropertyCoerce));
			IsSelectedPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("IsSelected", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(false, OnIsSelectedPropertyChanged));
			IsSelectedProperty = IsSelectedPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			MergeOrderProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("MergeOrder", typeof(int?), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null));
			MergeTypeProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("MergeType", typeof(RibbonMergeType), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(RibbonMergeType.MergeItems));
			PagesPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("Pages", typeof(RibbonPageCollection), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null));
			PagesProperty = PagesPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			PagesSourceProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("PagesSource", typeof(object), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null, OnPagesSourcePropertyChanged));
			PageTemplateProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("PageTemplate", typeof(DataTemplate), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null, OnPagesTemplatePropertyChanged));
			PageTemplateSelectorProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("PageTemplateSelector", typeof(DataTemplateSelector), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null, OnPagesTemplatePropertyChanged));
			PageStyleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("PageStyle", typeof(Style), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null, OnPagesTemplatePropertyChanged));
			PageStyleSelectorProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("PageStyleSelector", typeof(StyleSelector), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null, OnPagesTemplatePropertyChanged));
			PagesAttachedBehaviorProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("PagesAttachedBehavior", typeof(ItemsAttachedBehaviorCore<RibbonPageCategoryBase, RibbonPage>), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new UIPropertyMetadata(null));
			CustomPagesPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("CustomPages", typeof(RibbonPageCollection), typeof(RibbonPageCategoryBase), new PropertyMetadata(null));
			CustomPagesProperty = CustomPagesPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			FrameworkContentElement.NameProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(string.Empty, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((RibbonPageCategoryBase)d).OnNameChanged(e.OldValue as string);
			}));
			ActualIsVisiblePropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("ActualIsVisible", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(true));
			ActualIsVisibleProperty = ActualIsVisiblePropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			BackgroundProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Background", typeof(Brush), typeof(RibbonPageCategoryBase), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata((object)null));
			ForegroundProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Foreground", typeof(Brush), typeof(RibbonPageCategoryBase), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata((object)null));
			CornerRadiusProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("CornerRadius", typeof(CornerRadius), typeof(RibbonPageCategoryBase), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(default(CornerRadius)));
			MarginProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Margin", typeof(Thickness), typeof(RibbonPageCategoryBase), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(default(Thickness)));
			PaddingProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Padding", typeof(Thickness), typeof(RibbonPageCategoryBase), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(default(Thickness)));
			BorderThicknessProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("BorderThickness", typeof(Thickness), typeof(RibbonPageCategoryBase), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(default(Thickness)));
			BorderBrushProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("BorderBrush", typeof(Brush), typeof(RibbonPageCategoryBase), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));
			((BasicRegistrator)new Registrator<RibbonPageCategoryBase>()).OverrideBackground(BackgroundProperty).OverrideForeground(ForegroundProperty).OverrideCornerRadius(CornerRadiusProperty)
				.OverrideBorderBrush(BorderBrushProperty)
				.OverrideBorderThickness(BorderThicknessProperty)
				.OverridePadding(PaddingProperty)
				.OverrideMargin(MarginProperty);
		}

			if (Ribbon != null)
			{
				Ribbon.PageToCategoryBinder.NameChanged(this, oldValue, base.Name);
			}
		}
