		public RibbonPageCategoryBase()
		{
			RaisePageIsSelectedChanged = true;
			Pages = CreatePagesCollection();
			ActualPagesCore = new MergedItemsCollection<RibbonPage>(Pages);
			SetValue(CustomPagesPropertyKey, CreatePagesCollection());
			composerHelper = new CollectionComposerHelper<ObservableCollection<RibbonPage>, RibbonPage>((IEnumerable<ObservableCollection<RibbonPage>>)new ObservableCollection<RibbonPage>[2] { ActualPagesCore, CustomPages });
			unmergedComposerHelper = new CollectionComposerHelper<ObservableCollection<RibbonPage>, RibbonPage>((IEnumerable<ObservableCollection<RibbonPage>>)new ObservableCollection<RibbonPage>[2] { Pages, CustomPages });
			ActualPages = composerHelper.Items;
			InitBindings();
			DXSerializer.SetSerializationIDDefault((DependencyObject)this, "RibbonPageCategoryBase");
			base.Loaded += OnLoaded;
		}

		protected virtual void OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateActualIsVisible();
		}

		protected virtual void InitBindings()
		{
		}

		protected virtual RibbonPageCollection CreatePagesCollection()
		{
			return new RibbonPageCollection(this);
		}

		private static void RaiseAltitudeChanged(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			((RibbonPageCategoryBase)dObj).altitudeChanged.Invoke((object)dObj, new ValueChangedEventArgs<int>((int)args.OldValue, (int)args.NewValue));
		}

		protected internal RibbonPage GetLastSelectedPage()
		{
			RibbonPage result = null;
			foreach (RibbonPage item in unmergedComposerHelper.Items)
			{
				if (item.IsSelected)
				{
					result = item;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected virtual void OnColorChanged(Color oldValue, Color newValue)
		{
			foreach (RibbonPage actualPage in ActualPages)
			{
				actualPage.UpdateActualColor();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnCaptionChanged(string oldValue)
		{
			CategoryControls.ForEach(InvalidateParentMeasure);
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsDefaultChanged(bool oldValue)
		{
		}

		private void InvalidateParentMeasure(DependencyObject element)
		{
			(element as UIElement).Do(delegate(UIElement x)
			{
				x.InvalidateMeasure();
			});
			(VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(element) as UIElement).Do(delegate(UIElement x)
			{
				x.InvalidateMeasure();
			});
		}

		private void OnPagesTemplateChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ItemsAttachedBehaviorCore<RibbonPageCategoryBase, RibbonPage>.OnItemsGeneratorTemplatePropertyChanged((DependencyObject)this, e, PagesAttachedBehaviorProperty);
		}

		protected virtual void OnPagesSourceChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.NewValue is IEnumerable || e.OldValue is IEnumerable)
			{
				ItemsAttachedBehaviorCore<RibbonPageCategoryBase, RibbonPage>.OnItemsSourcePropertyChanged((DependencyObject)this, e, PagesAttachedBehaviorProperty, PageTemplateProperty, PageTemplateSelectorProperty, PageStyleProperty, PageStyleSelectorProperty, (Func<RibbonPageCategoryBase, IList>)((RibbonPageCategoryBase category) => category.Pages), (Func<RibbonPageCategoryBase, RibbonPage>)((RibbonPageCategoryBase category) => new RibbonPage()), (Action<int, object>)null, (Action<RibbonPage>)null, (ISupportInitialize)null, (Action<RibbonPage, object>)null, true, true, (Func<RibbonPage, bool>)null, (Action<RibbonPage, RibbonPage>)null, false);
			}
			else
			{
				PopulateItemsHelper.GenerateItems(e, (Func<ICommandGroupsGenerator>)(() => (ICommandGroupsGenerator)(object)new PagesGenerator(this)));
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnRibbonChanged(RibbonControl oldValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				oldValue.IsEnabledChanged -= OnRibbonIsEnabledChanged;
			}
			if (Ribbon != null)
			{
				Ribbon.IsEnabledChanged += OnRibbonIsEnabledChanged;
			}
			if (Ribbon == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (RibbonPage item in unmergedComposerHelper.Items)
			{
				if (item.IsSelected)
				{
					Ribbon.SelectedPage = item;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnRibbonIsEnabledChanged(object sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			CoerceValue(ContentElement.IsEnabledProperty);
		}

		protected void ExecuteActionOnCategoryHeaderControls(CategoryHeaderControlAction action)
		{
			foreach (RibbonPageCategoryHeaderControl categoryHeaderControl in CategoryHeaderControls)
			{
				action(categoryHeaderControl);
			}
		}

		protected void ExecuteActionOnCategoryControls(CategoryControlAction action)
		{
			foreach (RibbonPageCategoryControl categoryControl in CategoryControls)
			{
				action(categoryControl);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsSelectedChanged(bool oldValue)
		{
		}

		public RibbonPage GetFirstSelectablePage()
		{
			return ActualPages.OrderBy((RibbonPage page) => page.ActualMergeOrder).FirstOrDefault((RibbonPage page) => page.IsSelectable);
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsVisibleChanged(bool oldValue)
		{
			foreach (RibbonPage item in unmergedComposerHelper.Items)
			{
				item.UpdateActualIsVisible();
			}
			if (Ribbon != null)
			{
				Ribbon.OnPageCategoryIsVisibleChanged(this);
			}
			UpdateActualIsVisible();
		}

		protected virtual void IsVisibleChanging(ref bool newValue)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void IsDefaultChanging(ref bool newValue)
		{
		}

		private void UpdateActualIsVisible()
		{
			if (!IsVisible)
			{
				ActualIsVisible = false;
			}
			ActualIsVisible = !Pages.Any() || !Pages.All((RibbonPage x) => x.HideWhenEmpty == true && x.ShouldHide());
		}

		protected internal void OnPageRemoved(RibbonPage page, int oldIndex)
		{
			RemoveLogicalChild(page);
			if (this.PageRemoved != null)
			{
				this.PageRemoved(page, new RibbonPageRemovedEventArgs(page, oldIndex));
			}
			if (page.IsSelected)
			{
				page.SetCurrentValue(RibbonPage.IsSelectedProperty, false);
				RibbonSelectionHelper.SwitchPagesSelection(page, oldIndex)?.SetCurrentValue(RibbonPage.IsSelectedProperty, true);
			}
			UpdateActualIsVisible();
		}

		protected internal void OnPageInserted(RibbonPage page, int newIndex)
		{
			if (page.Parent == null && !((IRibbonItem)page).IsInItems)
			{
				AddLogicalChild(page);
			}
			if (this.PageInserted != null)
			{
				this.PageInserted(page, new RibbonPageInsertedEventArgs(page, newIndex));
			}
			if (page.IsSelected)
			{
				OnPageIsSelectedCoreChanged(page);
			}
			UpdateActualIsVisible();
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			FrameworkContentElementHelper.SafeOnPropertyChanged((FrameworkContentElement)this, e);
		}

		protected internal void OnPageGroupInserted(RibbonPageGroup group, int index)
		{
			if (this.PageGroupInserted != null)
			{
				this.PageGroupInserted(group, new RibbonPageGroupInsertedEventArgs(group, index));
			}
			UpdateActualIsVisible();
		}

		protected internal void OnPageGroupRemoved(RibbonPageGroup group, int index)
		{
			if (this.PageGroupRemoved != null)
			{
				this.PageGroupRemoved(group, new RibbonPageGroupRemovedEventArgs(group, index));
			}
			UpdateActualIsVisible();
		}

		protected internal void OnSelectedPageIsVisibleCoreChanged(RibbonPage page)
		{
			if (!page.IsSelected && !page.IsVisible)
			{
				RibbonSelectionHelper.SwitchPagesSelection(page, unmergedComposerHelper.Items.IndexOf(page))?.SetCurrentValue(RibbonPage.IsSelectedProperty, true);
			}
		}

		protected internal void OnPageIsSelectedCoreChanged(RibbonPage page)
		{
			if (page.IsSelected && Ribbon == null)
			{
				foreach (RibbonPage item in unmergedComposerHelper.Items)
				{
					item.SetCurrentValue(RibbonPage.IsSelectedProperty, item == page);
				}
			}
			if (this.PageIsSelectedChanged != null && RaisePageIsSelectedChanged)
			{
				this.PageIsSelectedChanged(page, new EventArgs());
			}
		}

		void ILogicalChildrenContainer.AddLogicalChild(object child)
		{
			logicalChildrenContainerItems.Add(child);
			AddLogicalChild(child);
		}

		void ILogicalChildrenContainer.RemoveLogicalChild(object child)
		{
			logicalChildrenContainerItems.Remove(child);
			RemoveLogicalChild(child);
		}

		protected virtual RibbonPageCategoryBase CreateEmptyClone()
		{
			return new RibbonPageCategoryBase();
		}

		protected virtual void AssignPropertiesFromSource(RibbonPageCategoryBase sourceCategory)
		{
			Caption = sourceCategory.Caption;
			Color = sourceCategory.Color;
			IsDefault = sourceCategory.IsDefault;
			MergeType = ((!sourceCategory.IsDefault || sourceCategory.MergeType != RibbonMergeType.Add) ? sourceCategory.MergeType : RibbonMergeType.MergeItems);
			MergeOrder = sourceCategory.MergeOrder;
		}

		protected virtual void ClonePagesFromSource(RibbonPageCategoryBase sourceCategory)
		{
			foreach (RibbonPage item in sourceCategory.unmergedComposerHelper.Items)
			{
				Pages.Add((RibbonPage)((ICloneable)item).Clone());
			}
		}

		internal RibbonPage GetPageByCaption(string caption)
		{
			foreach (RibbonPage item in ActualPagesCore)
			{
				if (item.Caption as string == caption)
				{
					return item;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected internal RibbonPage GetSelectedPage()
		{
			foreach (RibbonPage item in ActualPagesCore)
			{
				if (item.IsSelected)
				{
					return item;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			RibbonPageCategoryBase ribbonPageCategoryBase = CreateEmptyClone();
			ribbonPageCategoryBase.AssignPropertiesFromSource(this);
			ribbonPageCategoryBase.ClonePagesFromSource(this);
			return ribbonPageCategoryBase;
		}

		private int? GetActualMergeOrder()
		{
			for (int num = MergedChildren.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				RibbonPageCategoryBase ribbonPageCategoryBase = MergedChildren[num];
				if (ribbonPageCategoryBase.MergeOrder.HasValue)
				{
					return ribbonPageCategoryBase.MergeOrder;
				}
			}
			return MergeOrder;
		}

		internal void Merge(RibbonPageCategoryBase childCategory)
		{
			if (!MergedChildren.Contains(childCategory))
			{
				MergedChildren.Add(childCategory);
				childCategory.MergedParent = this;
				ActualPagesCore.Populate(MergedChildren.Select((RibbonPageCategoryBase x) => x.Pages));
				ActualPages.ForEach(delegate(RibbonPage x)
				{
					x.UpdateActualColor();
				});
				UpdateActualIsVisible();
			}
		}

		internal void UnMerge(RibbonPageCategoryBase cat)
		{
			if (MergedChildren.Contains(cat))
			{
				List<RibbonPage> first = ActualPages.ToList();
				MergedChildren.Remove(cat);
				ActualPagesCore.Populate(MergedChildren.Select((RibbonPageCategoryBase x) => x.Pages));
				cat.MergedParent = null;
				first.Except(ActualPages).ForEach(delegate(RibbonPage x)
				{
					x.UpdateActualColor();
				});
			}
		}

		object IMultipleElementRegistratorSupport.GetName(object registratorKey)
		{
			return base.Name;
		}

		object IBarManagerControllerAction.GetObject()
		{
			return this;
		}

		void IControllerAction.Execute(DependencyObject context)
		{
			CollectionActionHelper.Execute((IBarManagerControllerAction)(object)this);
		}

		void IRibbonMergingSupport.Merge(IRibbonMergingSupport second)
		{
			Merge((RibbonPageCategoryBase)second);
		}

		void IRibbonMergingSupport.Unmerge(IRibbonMergingSupport second)
		{
			UnMerge((RibbonPageCategoryBase)second);
		}
	}
	[ContentProperty("Pages")]
	public class RibbonPageCategory : RibbonPageCategoryBase
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty SelectedPageOnCategoryShowingProperty;

		public SelectedPageOnCategoryShowing SelectedPageOnCategoryShowing
		{
			get
			{
				return (SelectedPageOnCategoryShowing)GetValue(SelectedPageOnCategoryShowingProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(SelectedPageOnCategoryShowingProperty, value);
			}
		}

		static RibbonPageCategory()
		{
			SelectedPageOnCategoryShowingProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("SelectedPageOnCategoryShowing", typeof(SelectedPageOnCategoryShowing), typeof(RibbonPageCategory), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(SelectedPageOnCategoryShowing.FirstPage));
			RibbonPageCategoryBase.CaptionProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(RibbonPageCategory), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				d.CoerceValue(BarItemSearchSettings.SearchPathSegmentProperty);
			}));
			BarItemSearchSettings.SearchPathSegmentProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(RibbonPageCategory), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, (DependencyObject o, object value) => value ?? Convert.ToString(o.GetValue(RibbonPageCategoryBase.CaptionProperty))));
		}

		protected override RibbonPageCategoryBase CreateEmptyClone()
		{
			return new RibbonPageCategory();
		}

		protected override void OnIsVisibleChanged(bool oldValue)
		{
			base.OnIsVisibleChanged(oldValue);
			if (base.IsVisible && SelectedPageOnCategoryShowing == SelectedPageOnCategoryShowing.FirstPage)
			{
				GetFirstSelectablePage()?.SetCurrentValue(RibbonPage.IsSelectedProperty, true);
			}
		}
	}

	public class RibbonPageCategoryCollection : ObservableCollection<RibbonPageCategoryBase>
	{
		private RibbonControl ribbon;

		public RibbonControl Ribbon
		{
			get
			{
				return ribbon;
			}
			private set
			{
				RibbonControl ribbonControl = ribbon;
				ribbon = value;
				if (ribbonControl != value)
				{
					OnRibbonControlChanged(ribbonControl, value);
				}
			}
		}

		public RibbonPageCategoryBase this[string name]
		{
			get
			{
				using (IEnumerator<RibbonPageCategoryBase> enumerator = GetEnumerator())
				{
					while (enumerator.MoveNext())
					{
						RibbonPageCategoryBase current = enumerator.Current;
						if (current.Name == name)
						{
							return current;
						}
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		private void OnRibbonControlChanged(RibbonControl oldValue, RibbonControl newValue)
		{
		}

		public RibbonPageCategoryCollection(RibbonControl owner)
		{
			Ribbon = owner;
		}
	}

		}

		public RibbonPageCategoryControl()
		{
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0012: Expected O, but got Unknown
			recyclingPanelSource = new RecyclingPanelSource((ItemsControl)this);
			base.LayoutUpdated += OnLayoutUpdated;
			CollapsedPages = Enumerable.Empty<RibbonPage>();
			base.IsVisibleChanged += OnIsVisibleChanged;
			base.ItemContainerGenerator.StatusChanged += OnGeneratorStatusChanged;
		}

		private void OnGeneratorStatusChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.ItemContainerGenerator.Status == GeneratorStatus.ContainersGenerated && Ribbon != null)
			{
				UIElementAutomationPeer.FromElement(this)?.ResetChildrenCache();
				Ribbon.InvalidateAutomationTree();
			}
		}

		private void OnIsVisibleChanged(object sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateSizeInfo(0.0);
			if (Ribbon != null)
			{
				Ribbon.TitlePanel.InvalidateMeasure();
			}
		}

		public double GetHeaderWidth()
		{
			if (PageCategoryHeaderControl == null || !PageCategoryHeaderControl.IsVisible)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return base.ActualWidth;
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			PageCategoryHeaderControl = GetTemplateChild("PART_CategoryHeaderControl") as RibbonPageCategoryHeaderControl;
			BackgroundHeader = GetTemplateChild("PART_HighlightedHeadersBackground") as RibbonCheckedBorderControl;
			ItemsPresenter = GetTemplateChild("PART_ItemsPresenter") as ItemsPresenter;
			CollapseButton = GetTemplateChild("PART_CollapseButton") as ToggleButton;
		}

		protected virtual void OnLayoutUpdated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (Ribbon != null && Ribbon.IsInRibbonWindow && Ribbon.WindowHelper.RibbonWindow != null)
			{
				FrameworkElement controlBoxContainer = Ribbon.WindowHelper.GetControlBoxContainer();
				if (controlBoxContainer == null)
				{
					Rect controlBoxRect = Ribbon.WindowHelper.RibbonWindow.GetControlBoxRect();
					Point point = Ribbon.TranslatePoint(new Point(Ribbon.ActualWidth - controlBoxRect.Width, 0.0), this);
					RightCaptionPadding = Math.Max(base.ActualWidth - point.X, 0.0);
				}
				else
				{
					RightCaptionPadding = Math.Max(base.ActualWidth - controlBoxContainer.TranslatePoint(default(Point), this).X, 0.0);
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnBackgroundHeaderChanged(RibbonCheckedBorderControl oldValue)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnRibbonChanged(RibbonControl oldValue)
		{
			BindingOperations.ClearBinding(this, IsAeroModeProperty);
			BindingOperations.ClearBinding(this, IsRibbonMinimizedProperty);
			if (Ribbon != null)
			{
				SetBinding(IsRibbonMinimizedProperty, new Binding("IsMinimized")
				{
					Source = Ribbon
				});
				SetBinding(IsAeroModeProperty, new Binding("IsAeroMode")
				{
					Source = Ribbon
				});
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnRightCaptionPaddingChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateHeaderControlClipping();
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateHeaderControlClipping()
		{
			if (PageCategoryHeaderControl != null)
			{
				if (RightCaptionPadding > 0.0)
				{
					PageCategoryHeaderControl.Clip = new RectangleGeometry(new Rect(new Size(Math.Max(base.ActualWidth - RightCaptionPadding, 0.0), base.ActualHeight)));
				}
				else
				{
					PageCategoryHeaderControl.ClearValue(UIElement.ClipProperty);
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnPageCategoryChanged(RibbonPageCategoryBase oldValue)
		{
			oldValue?.CategoryControls.Remove(this);
			if (PageCategory != null)
			{
				PageCategory.CategoryControls.Add(this);
			}
			UpdateItemsSource();
		}

		protected virtual void OnPageCategoryHeaderControlChanged(RibbonPageCategoryHeaderControl oldValue)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnAeroTemplateChanged(ControlTemplate oldValue)

			UpdateTemplate();
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsAeroModeChanged(bool oldValue)

			UpdateTemplate();
		}

			if (IsAeroMode)

			}
		}

		{
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateItemsSource()
		{
			recyclingPanelSource.ItemsSource = PageCategory.With((RibbonPageCategoryBase cat) => cat.ActualPages);
		}

		}

		protected virtual void OnCollapsedPagesChanged(IEnumerable<RibbonPage> oldValue)
		{
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return NavigationAutomationPeersCreator.Default.Create((object)this);
		}

		protected override DependencyObject GetContainerForItemOverride()
		{
			return new RibbonPageHeaderControl();
		}

		protected override bool IsItemItsOwnContainerOverride(object item)
		{
			return item is RibbonPageHeaderControl;
		}

		protected override void PrepareContainerForItemOverride(DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			base.PrepareContainerForItemOverride(element, item);
			RibbonPageHeaderControl ribbonPageHeaderControl = (RibbonPageHeaderControl)element;
			RibbonPage ribbonPage = (RibbonPage)item;
			ribbonPage.IsSelectedChanged += OnPageIsSelectedChanged;
			ribbonPageHeaderControl.Page = ribbonPage;
			if (ribbonPage.IsSelected)
			{
				ActivePage = ribbonPageHeaderControl;
			}
		}

		protected override void ClearContainerForItemOverride(DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			RibbonPageHeaderControl ribbonPageHeaderControl = element as RibbonPageHeaderControl;
			if (ribbonPageHeaderControl != null)
			{
				ribbonPageHeaderControl.Page.IsSelectedChanged -= OnPageIsSelectedChanged;
				ribbonPageHeaderControl.Page = null;
			}
			if (ActivePage == ribbonPageHeaderControl)
			{
				ActivePage = null;
			}
			base.ClearContainerForItemOverride(element, item);
		}

		internal RibbonPageHeaderControl GetContainerFromIndex(int index)
		{
			return base.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromIndex(index) as RibbonPageHeaderControl;
		}

		protected override Size MeasureOverride(Size constraint)
		{
			CollapseButton.Do(delegate(ToggleButton x)
			{
				x.Visibility = BooleanExtensions.ToVisibility(AllowCollapse);
			});
			Size size = base.MeasureOverride(SizeHelper.Infinite);
			if (PageCategoryHeaderControl != null)
			{
				CaptionWidth = PageCategoryHeaderControl.BestWidth;
			}
			UpdateSizeInfo(size.Width - (CollapseButton?.DesiredSize.Width ?? 0.0));
			IsCollapsed = AllowCollapse && SizeInfo.MaxWidth > constraint.Width;
			CollapseButton?.ClearValue(UIElement.VisibilityProperty);
			return base.MeasureOverride(constraint);
		}

		protected override Size ArrangeOverride(Size arrangeBounds)
		{
			CollapsedPages = GetCollapsedPages();
			Size result = base.ArrangeOverride(arrangeBounds);
			Ribbon.TitlePanel.InvalidateMeasure();
			return result;
		}

		private IEnumerable<RibbonPage> GetCollapsedPages()
		{
			if (!IsCollapsed || base.ItemContainerGenerator.Status != GeneratorStatus.ContainersGenerated)
			{
				return Enumerable.Empty<RibbonPage>();
			}
			return from page in base.Items.OfType<RibbonPage>()
				where RibbonControlLayoutHelper.GetIsItemCollapsed(base.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(page))
				select page;
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateSizeInfo(double diff)
		{
			if (base.Visibility != Visibility.Visible)
			{
				SizeInfo = new RibbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo(this);
				return;
			}
			RibbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo ribbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo = (AllowCollapse ? GetAllowCollapseSizeInfo() : GetSizeInfo());
			ribbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo.MinWidth = Math.Max(CaptionWidth, ribbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo.MinWidth);
			ribbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo.MaxWidth = Math.Max(ribbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo.MaxWidth, ribbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo.MinWidth);
			ribbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo.DesiredWidth = Math.Max(ribbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo.DesiredWidth, ribbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo.MinWidth);
			diff = Math.Max(0.0, diff - ribbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo.MaxWidth);
			ribbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo.MaxWidth += diff;
			ribbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo.DesiredWidth += diff;
			ribbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo.MinWidth += diff;
			SizeInfo = ribbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo;
		}

		protected virtual RibbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo GetAllowCollapseSizeInfo()
		{
			IEnumerable<RibbonPageHeaderControl> pageHeaders = GetPageHeaders();
			RibbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo ribbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo = new RibbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo(this);
			ribbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo.MinWidth = ((ActivePage == null) ? 0.0 : ActivePage.BestDesiredSize.Width);
			ribbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo.MaxWidth = pageHeaders.Sum((RibbonPageHeaderControl header) => header.BestDesiredSize.Width);
			ribbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo.DesiredWidth = ribbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo.MaxWidth;
			if (pageHeaders.Count() > 1)
			{
				ribbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo.MinWidth += CollapseButton?.DesiredSize.Width ?? 0.0;
			}
			return ribbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo;
		}

		protected virtual RibbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo GetSizeInfo()
		{
			RibbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo ribbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo = new RibbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo(this);
			IEnumerable<RibbonPageHeaderControl> pageHeaders = GetPageHeaders();
			foreach (RibbonPageHeaderControl item in pageHeaders)
			{
				ribbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo.MinWidth += item.MinDesiredWidth;
				ribbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo.MaxWidth += item.BestDesiredSize.Width;
				ribbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo.DesiredWidth += item.BestDesiredSize.Width - MaxPageCaptionTextIndent;
			}
			return ribbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo;
		}

		private IEnumerable<RibbonPageHeaderControl> GetPageHeaders()
		{
			if (base.ItemContainerGenerator.Status != GeneratorStatus.ContainersGenerated)
			{
				return Enumerable.Empty<RibbonPageHeaderControl>();
			}
			return from item in base.Items.OfType<RibbonPage>()
				where item.ActualIsVisible
				select (RibbonPageHeaderControl)base.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(item) into x
				where x != null
				select x;
		}

		protected virtual void OnSizeInfoChanged(RibbonPageCategoryHeaderInfo oldValue)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnCaptionWidthChanged()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnPageIsSelectedChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			RibbonPage ribbonPage = (RibbonPage)sender;
			if (ribbonPage.IsSelected)
			{
				ActivePage = (RibbonPageHeaderControl)base.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(ribbonPage);
			}
			InvalidateMeasure();
		}
	}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			if (NormalContent != null)
			{
				NormalContent.SizeChanged -= OnContentSizeChanged;
			}
			if (SelectedContent != null)
			{
				SelectedContent.SizeChanged -= OnContentSizeChanged;
			}
			NormalContent = GetTemplateChild("PART_NormalContent") as ContentControl;
			SelectedContent = GetTemplateChild("PART_SelectedContent") as ContentControl;
			if (NormalContent != null)
			{
				NormalContent.SizeChanged += OnContentSizeChanged;
			}
			if (SelectedContent != null)
			{
				SelectedContent.SizeChanged += OnContentSizeChanged;
			}

			UpdateSizeInfo();

		protected override void OnMouseLeftButtonUp(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeftButtonUp(e);
			RibbonControl ribbon = RibbonControl.GetRibbon(this);
			if (ribbon == null || ribbon.IsBackStageViewOpen)
			{
				return;
			}
			RibbonPage ribbonPage = Category.ActualPages.FirstOrDefault((RibbonPage page) => page.ActualIsVisible);
			if (ribbonPage != null)
			{
				ribbon.SetCurrentValue(RibbonControl.SelectedPageProperty, ribbonPage);
				if (ribbon.IsMinimizedRibbonCollapsed)
				{
					ribbon.ExpandMinimizedRibbon();
				}
			}
		}

	public class RibbonPageCategoryItemsPanel : RibbonOrderedOnMergeItemsPanel<RibbonPageHeaderControl>
	{
		protected RibbonPageCategoryControl Owner => (RibbonPageCategoryControl)ItemsControl.GetItemsOwner((DependencyObject)(object)this);

		protected override bool IsOrdered => true;

		protected override int? GetChildOrder(UIElement child)
		{
			if (!(child is RibbonPageHeaderControl { Ribbon: not null, Page: not null } ribbonPageHeaderControl))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (ribbonPageHeaderControl.Ribbon.IsMerged || ribbonPageHeaderControl.Ribbon.ActualMergedParent != null)
			{
				return ribbonPageHeaderControl.Page.ActualMergeOrder;
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override Size MeasureOverride(Size availableSize)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			int num2 = 0;
			foreach (RibbonPageHeaderControl item in ((RecyclingPanelBase<RibbonPageHeaderControl>)(object)this).EnumerateChildren())
			{
				item.Index = num2;
				item.Measure(availableSize);
				item.Measure(new Size(item.BestDesiredSize.Width, availableSize.Height));
				if (item.Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
				{
					num += item.MinDesiredWidth;
				}
				num2++;
			}
			if (availableSize.Width <= num + 1E-05)
			{
				foreach (RibbonPageHeaderControl item2 in ((RecyclingPanelBase<RibbonPageHeaderControl>)(object)this).EnumerateChildren())
				{
					item2.Measure(new Size(item2.MinDesiredWidth, double.PositiveInfinity));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				Reduce(((RecyclingPanelBase<RibbonPageHeaderControl>)(object)this).EnumerateChildren().OfType<RibbonPageHeaderControl>(), availableSize.Width, 0.0);
			}
			Size result = default(Size);
			foreach (RibbonPageHeaderControl item3 in ((RecyclingPanelBase<RibbonPageHeaderControl>)(object)this).EnumerateChildren())
			{
				result.Height = Math.Max(result.Height, item3.DesiredSize.Height);
				result.Width += item3.DesiredSize.Width;
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override Size ArrangeOverride(Size finalSize)
		{
			Rect finalRect = new Rect(new Size(0.0, finalSize.Height));
			double num = ((RecyclingPanelBase<RibbonPageHeaderControl>)(object)this).EnumerateChildren().OfType<UIElement>().Sum((UIElement item) => item.DesiredSize.Width);
			double num2 = finalSize.Width / num;
			if (double.IsInfinity(num2) || double.IsNaN(num2))
			{
				num2 = 1.0;
			}
			foreach (RibbonPageHeaderControl item in ((RecyclingPanelBase<RibbonPageHeaderControl>)(object)this).EnumerateChildren())
			{
				finalRect.Width = item.DesiredSize.Width * num2;
				item.Arrange(finalRect);
				finalRect.X += finalRect.Width;
			}
			return finalSize;
		}

		private void Reduce(IEnumerable<RibbonPageHeaderControl> children, double availableWidth, double lastReduceCoeff)
		{
			double num = ((RecyclingPanelBase<RibbonPageHeaderControl>)(object)this).EnumerateChildren().OfType<RibbonPageHeaderControl>().Sum((RibbonPageHeaderControl child) => child.DesiredSize.Width);
			if (availableWidth + 1E-05 >= num)
			{
				return;
			}
			double num2 = CalcReduceCoef(children, availableWidth, num);
			if (Math.Abs(num2 - lastReduceCoeff) <= 1E-05 || num2 < 0.0)
			{
				return;
			}
			lastReduceCoeff = num2;
			List<RibbonPageHeaderControl> list = children.ToList();
			double num3 = 0.0;
			children = children.OrderBy((RibbonPageHeaderControl child) => child.DesiredSize.Width);
			foreach (RibbonPageHeaderControl child in children)
			{
				num3 = child.DesiredSize.Width * num2;
				if (num3 <= child.MinDesiredWidth)
				{
					num3 = child.MinDesiredWidth;
					list.Remove(child);
				}
				num -= child.DesiredSize.Width;
				child.Measure(new Size(num3, double.PositiveInfinity));
				num += child.DesiredSize.Width;
				if (num <= availableWidth + 1E-05)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			Reduce(list, availableWidth, lastReduceCoeff);
		}

		private double CalcReduceCoef(IEnumerable<RibbonPageHeaderControl> children, double available, double totalWidth)
		{
			IEnumerable<RibbonPageHeaderControl> source = ((RecyclingPanelBase<RibbonPageHeaderControl>)(object)this).EnumerateChildren().OfType<RibbonPageHeaderControl>().Except(children);
			double num = source.Sum((RibbonPageHeaderControl child) => child.DesiredSize.Width);
			return (available - num) / (totalWidth - num);
		}
	}

		protected virtual void RecalcHasVisibleGroups()
		{
			if (base.ItemContainerGenerator.Status != GeneratorStatus.ContainersGenerated || Page == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			foreach (RibbonPageGroupControl item in Enumerable.Range(0, base.Items.Count).Select(base.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromIndex).OfType<RibbonPageGroupControl>())
			{
				if (item != null)
				{
					flag |= item.IsPageGroupVisible;
					if (flag)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			HasVisibleGroups = flag;
		}

		{

				return null;
			}
			RibbonControl ribbon = RibbonControl.GetRibbon(this);
			foreach (RibbonPageHeaderControl pageHeaderControl in Page.PageHeaderControls)
			{
				if (pageHeaderControl != null && RibbonControl.GetRibbon(pageHeaderControl) == ribbon)
				{
					return pageHeaderControl;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

			{
				list.Add((INavigationElement)(object)OverflowButton);
			}

		}

		{

		internal void InitOverflowMenu(PopupMenu menu, CancelEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0061: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0067: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (SimplifiedLayoutCalculator == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			BarItemMenuHeader val = null;
			foreach (SimplifiedRibbonOverflowMenuItemInfo overflowMenuItem in SimplifiedLayoutCalculator.OverflowMenuItems)
			{
				if (val == null || (string)((BarItem)val).Content != overflowMenuItem.Group.Caption)
				{
					if (val != null && ((Collection<IBarItem>)(object)val.Items).Count != 0)
					{
						((Collection<IBarItem>)(object)menu.Items).Add((IBarItem)(object)val);
					}
					val = new BarItemMenuHeader();
					((BarItem)val).Content = overflowMenuItem.Group.Caption;
				}
				CommonBarItemCollection items = val.Items;
				object obj = ((ICloneable)overflowMenuItem.LinkBase).Clone();
				((Collection<IBarItem>)(object)items).Add((IBarItem)((obj is BarItemLink) ? obj : null));
			}
			if (val != null && ((Collection<IBarItem>)(object)val.Items).Count != 0)
			{
				((Collection<IBarItem>)(object)menu.Items).Add((IBarItem)(object)val);
			}
		}

		public int CalcRecycleScore(object item)
		{
			if (object.Equals(PreviousPage, item))
			{
				return 10;
			}
			if (item != null && PreviousPage != null && object.Equals(PreviousPage.Caption, ((RibbonPage)item).Caption))
			{
				return 5;
			}
			return 1;
		}

		static RibbonPageGroup()
		{
			captionButtonClickEventHandler = new object();
			afterMergeEventHandler = new object();
			afterUnMergeEventHandler = new object();
			isVisibleChangedEventHandler = new object();
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(RibbonPageGroup);
			DXSerializer.EnabledProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(RibbonPageGroup), new UIPropertyMetadata(false));
			IsRemovedProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("IsRemoved", typeof(bool), typeof(RibbonPageGroup), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(false, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((RibbonPageGroup)d).UpdateActualIsVisible();
			}));
			AltitudeProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Altitude", typeof(int), typeof(RibbonPageGroup), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0, RaiseAltitudeChanged));
			HideWhenEmptyProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("HideWhenEmpty", typeof(bool?), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((RibbonPageGroup)d).OnHideWhenEmptyChanged((bool?)e.OldValue);
			}));
			AllowRemoveFromParentDuringCustomizationProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("AllowRemoveFromParentDuringCustomization", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(true));
			ActualIsVisiblePropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("ActualIsVisible", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(true));
			ActualIsVisibleProperty = ActualIsVisiblePropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			CaptionProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Caption", typeof(string), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(string.Empty, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure, delegate(DependencyObject o, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs args)
			{
				o.CoerceValue(BarItemSearchSettings.SearchPathSegmentProperty);
			}));
			BarItemSearchSettings.SearchPathSegmentProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(RibbonPageGroup), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, (DependencyObject o, object value) => value ?? Convert.ToString(o.GetValue(CaptionProperty))));
			GlyphProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Glyph", typeof(ImageSource), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure));
			SmallGlyphProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("SmallGlyph", typeof(ImageSource), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null));
			PagePropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("Page", typeof(RibbonPage), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure, OnPagePropertyChanged));
			PageProperty = PagePropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			ShowCaptionButtonProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ShowCaptionButton", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(false, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure));
			IsCaptionButtonEnabledProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("IsCaptionButtonEnabled", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(true, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure, OnIsCaptionButtonEnabledPropertyChanged, OnIsCaptionButtonEnabledPropertyCoerce));
			CaptionButtonCommandProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("CaptionButtonCommand", typeof(ICommand), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnCaptionButtonCommandPropertyChanged));
			CaptionButtonCommandTargetProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("CaptionButtonCommandTarget", typeof(IInputElement), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnCaptionButtonCommandTargetPropertyChanged));
			CaptionButtonCommandParameterProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("CaptionButtonCommandParameter", typeof(object), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnCaptionButtonCommandParameterPropertyChanged));
			AllowCollapseProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("AllowCollapse", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new UIPropertyMetadata(true));
			SuperTipProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("SuperTip", typeof(SuperTip), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None, OnSuperTipPropertyChanged));
			KeyTipProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("KeyTip", typeof(string), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(string.Empty));
			KeyTipGroupExpandingProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("KeyTipGroupExpanding", typeof(string), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(string.Empty));
			IsVisibleProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("IsVisible", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(true, OnIsVisiblePropertyChanged));
			ItemLinksSourceProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ItemLinksSource", typeof(object), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null, OnItemLinksSourcePropertyChanged));
			ItemTemplateProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ItemTemplate", typeof(DataTemplate), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null, OnItemLinksTemplatePropertyChanged));
			ItemTemplateSelectorProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ItemTemplateSelector", typeof(DataTemplateSelector), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null, OnItemLinksTemplateSelectorPropertyChanged));
			ItemStyleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ItemStyle", typeof(Style), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null, OnItemLinksTemplatePropertyChanged));
			ItemStyleSelectorProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ItemStyleSelector", typeof(StyleSelector), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null, OnItemLinksTemplatePropertyChanged));
			RibbonBarItemsAttachedBehaviorProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("RibbonBarItemsAttachedBehavior", typeof(ItemsAttachedBehaviorCore<RibbonPageGroup, BarItem>), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new UIPropertyMetadata(null));
			ItemLinksSourceElementGeneratesUniqueBarItemProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ItemLinksSourceElementGeneratesUniqueBarItem", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(true, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((RibbonPageGroup)d).OnItemLinksSourceElementGeneratesUniqueBarItemChanged((bool)e.OldValue);
			}));
			MergeOrderProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("MergeOrder", typeof(int?), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));
			MergeTypeProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("MergeType", typeof(RibbonMergeType), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(RibbonMergeType.MergeItems));
			FrameworkContentElement.NameProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(string.Empty, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((RibbonPageGroup)d).OnNameChanged(e.OldValue as string);
			}));
			SimplifiedModeSettings.LocationProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(RibbonPageGroup), new PropertyMetadata((object)(SimplifiedModeLocation)0, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((RibbonPageGroup)d).OnSimplifiedModeLocationChanged((SimplifiedModeLocation?)e.OldValue);
			}));
			BackgroundProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Background", typeof(Brush), typeof(RibbonPageGroup), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata((object)null));
			HeaderBorderStyleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("HeaderBorderStyle", typeof(Style), typeof(RibbonPageGroup), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, ContentAreaStylePropertyChanged));
			ForegroundProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Foreground", typeof(Brush), typeof(RibbonPageGroup), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata((object)null));
			CornerRadiusProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("CornerRadius", typeof(CornerRadius), typeof(RibbonPageGroup), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(default(CornerRadius)));
			MarginProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Margin", typeof(Thickness), typeof(RibbonPageGroup), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(default(Thickness)));
			PaddingProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Padding", typeof(Thickness), typeof(RibbonPageGroup), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(default(Thickness)));
			BorderThicknessProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("BorderThickness", typeof(Thickness), typeof(RibbonPageGroup), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(default(Thickness)));
			BorderBrushProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("BorderBrush", typeof(Brush), typeof(RibbonPageGroup), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));
			((BasicRegistrator)new Registrator<RibbonPageGroup>()).OverrideBackground(BackgroundProperty).OverrideForeground(ForegroundProperty).OverrideCornerRadius(CornerRadiusProperty)
				.OverridePadding(PaddingProperty)
				.OverrideMargin(MarginProperty)
				.OverrideBorderBrush(BorderBrushProperty)
				.OverrideBorderThickness(BorderThicknessProperty)
				.OverrideSvgPalette(WpfSvgPalette.PaletteProperty);
		}

	public class RibbonPageGroupCollection : ObservableCollection<RibbonPageGroup>
	{
		private int updating;

		private RibbonPage page;

		public RibbonControl Ribbon
		{
			get
			{
				if (PageCategory != null)
				{
					return PageCategory.Ribbon;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public RibbonPageCategoryBase PageCategory
		{
			get
			{
				if (Page != null)
				{
					return Page.PageCategory;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public RibbonPage Page
		{
			get
			{
				return page;
			}
			private set
			{
				RibbonPage ribbonPage = page;
				page = value;
				if (value != ribbonPage)
				{
					OnRibbonPageChanged(ribbonPage, value);
				}
			}
		}

		public bool IsUpdating => updating > 0;

		public RibbonPageGroup this[string name]
		{
			get
			{
				using (IEnumerator<RibbonPageGroup> enumerator = GetEnumerator())
				{
					while (enumerator.MoveNext())
					{
						RibbonPageGroup current = enumerator.Current;
						if (current.Name == name)
						{
							return current;
						}
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public RibbonPageGroupCollection(RibbonPage page)
		{
			Page = page;
		}

		private void OnRibbonPageChanged(RibbonPage oldValue, RibbonPage newValue)
		{
		}

		public void BeginUpdate()
		{
			updating++;
		}

		public void EndUpdate()
		{
			updating--;
			if (updating < 0)
			{
				updating = 0;
			}
			if (!IsUpdating)
			{
				OnCategoryChanged();
			}
		}

		protected override void InsertItem(int index, RibbonPageGroup group)
		{
			if (!Contains(group))
			{
				base.InsertItem(index, group);
				OnInsertItem(group, index);
			}
		}

		protected override void RemoveItem(int index)
		{
			RibbonPageGroup ribbonPageGroup = base[index];
			base.RemoveItem(index);
			OnRemoveItem(ribbonPageGroup, index);
		}

		protected override void ClearItems()
		{
			List<RibbonPageGroup> list = new List<RibbonPageGroup>();
			using (IEnumerator<RibbonPageGroup> enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					RibbonPageGroup current = enumerator.Current;
					list.Add(current);
				}
			}
			base.ClearItems();
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				OnRemoveItem(list[i], i);
			}
		}

		protected override void SetItem(int index, RibbonPageGroup item)
		{
			RibbonPageGroup ribbonPageGroup = base[index];
			base.SetItem(index, item);
			OnRemoveItem(ribbonPageGroup, index);
			OnInsertItem(item, index);
		}

		protected virtual void OnRemoveItem(RibbonPageGroup group, int index)
		{
			if (group.Page != null)
			{
				group.Page.OnPageGroupRemoved(group, index);
			}
			group.Page = null;
		}

		protected virtual void OnInsertItem(RibbonPageGroup group, int index)
		{
			if (group.Page == null)
			{
				group.Page = Page;
			}
			if (group.Page != null)
			{
				group.Page.OnPageGroupInserted(group, index);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnCategoryChanged()
		{
			if (!IsUpdating)
			{
				OnCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset));
			}
		}
	}

		public RibbonControl Ribbon
		{
			get
			{
				return ribbonCore;
			}
			protected internal set
			{
				if (ribbonCore != value)
				{
					RibbonControl oldValue = ribbonCore;
					ribbonCore = value;
					OnRibbonChanged(oldValue);
				}
			}
		}

		public RibbonPageGroupControl Owner
		{
			get
			{
				return ownerCore;
			}
			set
			{
				if (ownerCore != value)
				{
					RibbonPageGroupControl ribbonPageGroupControl = ownerCore;
					ownerCore = value;
					OnOwnerChanged(ribbonPageGroupControl);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override IEnumerator LogicalChildren
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0049: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_004f: Expected O, but got Unknown
				//IL_0058: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_005e: Expected O, but got Unknown
				ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
				if (CollapseButtonInfo != null)
				{
					arrayList.Add(CollapseButtonInfo.Item);
					arrayList.Add(CollapseButtonInfo.Link);
				}
				return (IEnumerator)new MergedEnumerator(new IEnumerator[3]
				{
					((ItemsControl)(object)this).LogicalChildren,
					(IEnumerator)new SingleLogicalChildEnumerator((object)popupGroup),
					arrayList.GetEnumerator()
				});
			}
		}

			IsCollapsedProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("IsCollapsed", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(false, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure, OnIsCollapsedPropertyChanged));

			IsPopupOpenedProperty = IsPopupOpenedPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;

		private Visibility CoerceVisibility(Visibility value)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if ((int)((IRecyclableContainer)this).Status != 1)
			{
				return value;
			}
			return Visibility.Hidden;
		}

		protected override bool CoerceUseLightweightTemplates(bool baseValue)
		{
			if (RibbonStyle == RibbonStyle.OfficeSlim || RibbonStyle == RibbonStyle.TabletOffice)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return ((LinksControl)this).CoerceUseLightweightTemplates(baseValue);
		}

		protected override void OnUseLightweightTemplatesChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			((LinksControl)this).OnUseLightweightTemplatesChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			if (ItemsHost is RibbonPageGroupItemsPanel ribbonPageGroupItemsPanel)
			{
				((RecyclingPanelBase<BarItemLinkInfo>)(object)ribbonPageGroupItemsPanel).ClearCaches();
			}
		}

		protected static object CoerceIsPageGroupVisibleProperty(DependencyObject d, object baseValue)
		{
			return ((RibbonPageGroupControl)(object)d).CoerceIsPageGroupVisibleProperty(baseValue);
		}

		protected object CoerceIsPageGroupVisibleProperty(object value)
		{
			if (PageGroup == null)
			{
				return value;
			}
			if (!SimplifiedModeSettingsHelper.IsLocationCompatibleWithSimplifiedMode(IsInSimplifiedRibbon, SimplifiedModeLocation))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return (bool)value & (!PageGroup.ActualHideWhenEmpty || HaveVisibleInfos);
		}

		protected static void OnIsCollapsedPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((RibbonPageGroupControl)(object)d).OnIsCollapsedChanged((bool)e.OldValue);
		}

		protected static void OnIsPopupOpenedPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((RibbonPageGroupControl)(object)d).OnIsPopupOpenedChanged((bool)e.OldValue);
		}

		protected static void OnPageGroupPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((RibbonPageGroupControl)(object)d).OnPageGroupChanged((RibbonPageGroup)e.OldValue);
		}

		protected static void OnBorderTemplatePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{

				PageGroup.AfterUnMerge += OnUnMergePageGroup;
				((ObservableCollection<BarItemLinkBase>)(object)PageGroup.ItemLinks).CollectionChanged += OnPageGroupItemLinksCollectionChanged;
				PageGroup.PageGroupControls.Add(this);
			}
		}

		private bool NeedRecreateItemsSource(PageGroupControlCollapseItemsStrategyBase oldValue, PageGroupControlCollapseItemsStrategyBase newValue)
		{
			if ((oldValue == null && newValue != null) || (newValue == null && oldValue != null))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!IsTabletStrategy(oldValue))
			{
				return IsTabletStrategy(newValue);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool IsTabletStrategy(PageGroupControlCollapseItemsStrategyBase strategy)
		{
			if (!(strategy is OfficeSlimPageGroupControlCollapseItemsStrategy))
			{
				return strategy is TabletOfficePageGroupControlCollapseItemsStrategy;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override void OnMouseDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			((UIElement)(object)this).OnMouseDown(e);
			if (e.LeftButton == MouseButtonState.Pressed && IsCollapsed && PopupButton.Return((FrameworkElement x) => x.IsMouseOver, () => true))
			{
				if (!IsPopupOpened)
				{
					OpenPopup();
				}
				else
				{
					ClosePopup();
				}
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void UpdateCollapsedBorderState()
		{
			if (CollapsedStateBorder == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (RibbonNavigationManager.GetIsSelected((DependencyObject)(object)this))
			{
				CollapsedStateBorder.State = (BorderState)(IsPopupOpened ? 4 : 2);
				return;
			}
			if (((UIElement)(object)this).IsMouseOver)
			{
				if (IsPopupOpened || IsLeftButtonPressed)
				{
					CollapsedStateBorder.State = (BorderState)6;
				}
				else
				{
					CollapsedStateBorder.State = (BorderState)2;
				}
			}
			else if (IsPopupOpened)
			{
				CollapsedStateBorder.State = (BorderState)4;
			}
			else
			{
				CollapsedStateBorder.State = (BorderState)1;
			}
			UpdatePopupButtonSvgPaletteState();
			UpdateTextSplitterBorderState();
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateTextSplitterBorderState()
		{
			//IL_001d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (PopupButtonTextSplitter != null && CollapsedStateBorder != null)
			{
				PopupButtonTextSplitter.BorderState = CollapsedStateBorder.State;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdatePopupButtonSvgPaletteState()
		{
			if (PopupButton != null && CollapsedStateBorder != null)
			{
				SvgImageHelper.SetState((DependencyObject)PopupButton, GetPopupButtonSvgPaletteState());
			}
		}

		protected string GetPopupButtonSvgPaletteState()
		{
			//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001a: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0022: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0028: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0030: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0036: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0044: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004a: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (CollapsedStateBorder == null)
			{
				return "Normal";
			}
			if ((int)CollapsedStateBorder.State == 3 || (int)CollapsedStateBorder.State == 4 || (int)CollapsedStateBorder.State == 6)
			{
				return "Pressed";
			}
			if ((int)CollapsedStateBorder.State == 2)
			{
				return "Hover";
			}
			return "Normal";
		}

		protected virtual bool CollapseItems()
		{

			return true;
		}

		protected internal virtual List<RibbonGalleryBarItemLinkControl> GetGalleryList()
		{
			if (((ItemsControl)(object)this).ItemContainerGenerator.Status != GeneratorStatus.ContainersGenerated)
			{
				return new List<RibbonGalleryBarItemLinkControl>();
			}
			return (from x in (from x in Enumerable.Range(0, ((ItemsControl)(object)this).Items.Count)
					select ((ItemsControl)(object)this).ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromIndex(x)).OfType<BarItemLinkInfo>()
				select x.LinkControl).OfType<RibbonGalleryBarItemLinkControl>().ToList();
		}

		protected internal virtual void Reset()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < ((ItemsControl)(object)this).Items.Count; i++)
			{
				IBarItemLinkControl child = GetChild(i);
				if (child != null)
				{
					if (!IsInSimplifiedRibbon)
					{
						if (CollapseButtonInfo == null || (object)child.Link != CollapseButtonInfo.Link)
						{
							((DependencyObject)(object)child.LinkInfo).SetValue(RibbonControlLayoutHelper.IsItemCollapsedProperty, BooleanBoxes.False);
						}
						child.DesiredRibbonStyle = null;
					}
					if (child is RibbonGalleryBarItemLinkControl)
					{
						((RibbonGalleryBarItemLinkControl)(object)child).UpdateColCount();
					}
				}
				if (child is BarButtonGroupLinkControl { ItemsControl: not null } barButtonGroupLinkControl && barButtonGroupLinkControl.ItemsControl.ItemsPresenterCore != null)
				{
					((FrameworkElement)(object)barButtonGroupLinkControl).Height = double.NaN;
					ButtonGroupSetLayoutCalculator.SetRowCount((DependencyObject)(object)barButtonGroupLinkControl, 2);
					if (((BarItemLinkControlBase)barButtonGroupLinkControl).LinkInfo != null)
					{
						ButtonGroupSetLayoutCalculator.SetRowCount((DependencyObject)(object)((BarItemLinkControlBase)barButtonGroupLinkControl).LinkInfo, 2);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal bool AllItemsAreCollapsed()
		{

				if (child != null && !RibbonControlLayoutHelper.GetIsItemCollapsed((DependencyObject)(object)child.LinkInfo) && child.LinkInfo.ActualIsVisible)
				{
					return false;
				}

		}

		internal static RibbonGalleryBarItemLinkControl FindLargestReducibleGallery(List<RibbonGalleryBarItemLinkControl> list)
		{
			RibbonGalleryBarItemLinkControl result = null;
			double num = 0.0;
			foreach (RibbonGalleryBarItemLinkControl item in list)
			{
				if (item.CanReduce() && num < ((FrameworkElement)(object)item).ActualWidth)
				{
					result = item;
					num = ((FrameworkElement)(object)item).ActualWidth;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected virtual ItemsRange FindGroupOfLargeButtons()
		{
			for (int num = ((ItemsControl)(object)this).Items.Count - 1; num >= 1; num--)
			{
				if (IsModifiableLargeButton(GetChild(num)) && IsModifiableLargeButton(GetChild(num - 1)))
				{
					if (num < 2)
					{
						return new ItemsRange(0, 2);
					}
					if (IsModifiableLargeButton(GetChild(num - 2)))
					{
						return new ItemsRange(num - 2, 3);
					}
					return new ItemsRange(num - 1, 2);
				}
			}
			return new ItemsRange();
		}

		protected virtual IBarItemLinkControl FindLargestVisibleItem()

					num = ((IFrameworkElementAPISupport)child).ActualWidth;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected virtual ItemsRange FindGroupOfSmallButtonsWithText()
		{
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			Dictionary<int, List<Tuple<int, IBarItemLinkControl>>> dictionary = new Dictionary<int, List<Tuple<int, IBarItemLinkControl>>>();
			for (int i = 0; i < ((ItemsControl)(object)this).Items.Count; i++)
			{
				IBarItemLinkControl child = GetChild(i);
				if (child == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				BarItemLinkInfo linkInfo = child.LinkInfo;
				if (linkInfo != null && linkInfo.Link != null && ((BarItemLinkBase)linkInfo.Link).ActualIsVisible)
				{
					int column = RibbonPageGroupItemsPanel.GetColumn((DependencyObject)(object)child.LinkInfo);
					if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(column, out var value))
					{
						value = (dictionary[column] = new List<Tuple<int, IBarItemLinkControl>>());
						list.Add(column);
					}
					value.Add(new Tuple<int, IBarItemLinkControl>(i, child));
				}
			}
			foreach (int item in list.OrderByDescending((int x) => x))
			{
				List<Tuple<int, IBarItemLinkControl>> list3 = dictionary[item];
				if (list3.Count == 0)
				{
					continue;
				}
				int num = -1;
				int num2 = 0;
				for (int num3 = 0; num3 < list3.Count; num3++)
				{
					Tuple<int, IBarItemLinkControl> tuple = list3[0];
					if (IsModifiableSmallButtonWithText(tuple.Item2))
					{
						if (num == -1)
						{
							num = tuple.Item1;
							num2 = 1;
						}
						else
						{
							num2++;
						}
					}
				}
				if (num != -1 && num2 > 0)
				{
					return new ItemsRange(num, num2);
				}
			}
			return new ItemsRange();
		}

		protected internal virtual bool CanReduce(bool allowCollapse)
		{
			if (CanReduceGallery())
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (CanReduceButtonGroups())
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (CanReduceOfLargeButtons())
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (CanReduceGroupOfSmallButtonsWithText())
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (CanCollapseItems())
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (allowCollapse && !IsCollapsed)
			{
				return PageGroup.AllowCollapse;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal virtual void Reduce()
		{
			if (!ReduceGallery() && !ReduceButtonGroups() && !ReduceGroupOfLargeButtons() && !ReduceGroupOfSmallButtonsWithText() && !CollapseItems() && PageGroup.AllowCollapse)
			{
				((DependencyObject)(object)this).SetCurrentValue(IsCollapsedProperty, (object)true);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual bool CanReduceButtonGroups()
		{
			return FindButtonGroupsIn2Rows().Count != 0;
		}

		protected internal virtual bool ReduceButtonGroups()
		{
			ItemsRange itemsRange = FindButtonGroupsIn2Rows();
			if (itemsRange.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = itemsRange.StartIndex; i <= itemsRange.EndIndex; i++)
			{
				IBarItemLinkControl child = GetChild(i);
				ButtonGroupSetLayoutCalculator.SetRowCount(child as DependencyObject, 3);
				if (child.LinkInfo != null)
				{
					ButtonGroupSetLayoutCalculator.SetRowCount((DependencyObject)(object)child.LinkInfo, 3);
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual ItemsRange FindButtonGroupsIn2Rows()
		{
			int startIndex = 0;
			ItemsRange itemsRange;
			while (true)
			{
				itemsRange = FindButtonGroupsIn2Rows(startIndex);
				if (itemsRange.Count == 0)
				{
					return itemsRange;
				}
				if (IsButtonGroupLayoutCanGiveEffect(itemsRange))
				{
					break;
				}
				startIndex = itemsRange.EndIndex + 1;
			}
			return itemsRange;
		}

		protected virtual bool IsButtonGroupLayoutCanGiveEffect(ItemsRange range)
		{
			if (range.Count < 3)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (ButtonGroupSetLayoutCalculator.GetRowCount(GetChild(range.StartIndex) as DependencyObject) == 3)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual ItemsRange FindButtonGroupsIn2Rows(int startIndex)

					return new ItemsRange(i, GetButtonGroupCount(i));
				}
			}
			return new ItemsRange(0, 0);
		}

		}

			if (keyTipTarget is FrameworkElement)
			{
				thickness = ((FrameworkElement)keyTipTarget).Margin;
			}

				3 => ((FrameworkElement)(object)this).ActualHeight - point.Y - thickness.Top - thickness.Bottom, 
				_ => 0.0, 
			};
		}

		BarItemLinkControlToolTipHorizontalPlacement? IKeyTipNavigationProvider.GetHorizontalPlacement(IKeyTipNavigationElement element)
		{
			BarItemLinkInfo input = (BarItemLinkInfo)(object)((element is BarItemLinkInfo) ? element : null);
			IBarItemLinkControl val = input.With((BarItemLinkInfo x) => x.LinkControl);
			if (val is RibbonGalleryBarItemLinkControl)
			{
				return (BarItemLinkControlToolTipHorizontalPlacement)5;
			}
			if (val == null)
			{
				return (BarItemLinkControlToolTipHorizontalPlacement)6;
			}
			if (IsInSimplifiedRibbon)
			{
				return (BarItemLinkControlToolTipHorizontalPlacement)8;
			}
			if (val.ActualGlyphSize.Width >= 32.0)
			{
				return (BarItemLinkControlToolTipHorizontalPlacement)6;
			}
			return (BarItemLinkControlToolTipHorizontalPlacement)1;
		}

		BarItemLinkControlToolTipVerticalPlacement? IKeyTipNavigationProvider.GetVerticalPlacement(IKeyTipNavigationElement element)
		{
			BarItemLinkInfo val = (BarItemLinkInfo)(object)((element is BarItemLinkInfo) ? element : null);

			}

				return (BarItemLinkControlToolTipVerticalPlacement)5;
			}
			if (IsInSimplifiedRibbon)
			{
				return (BarItemLinkControlToolTipVerticalPlacement)8;
			}
			return RibbonPageGroupItemsPanel.GetRow((DependencyObject)(object)val) switch
			{
				0 => (BarItemLinkControlToolTipVerticalPlacement)2, 
				1 => (BarItemLinkControlToolTipVerticalPlacement)8, 
				_ => (BarItemLinkControlToolTipVerticalPlacement)5, 
			};
		}

		{
			((ControlClipper)(object)d).OnTargetChanged((UIElement)e.OldValue);
		}

		protected override void OnAttached()
		{
			((AttachableObjectBase)this).OnAttached();
			base.AssociatedObject.SizeChanged += OnSizeChanged;
			UpdateClipping();
		}

		protected override void OnDetaching()
		{
			((AttachableObjectBase)this).OnDetaching();
			base.AssociatedObject.SizeChanged -= OnSizeChanged;
			base.AssociatedObject.ClearValue(UIElement.ClipProperty);
		}

		private void OnTargetChanged(UIElement uIElement)
		{
			UpdateClipping();
		}

		private void OnSizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateClipping();
		}

		private void UpdateClipping()
		{
			if (base.AssociatedObject != null)
			{
				if (Target == null)
				{
					base.AssociatedObject.ClearValue(UIElement.ClipProperty);
					return;
				}
				Point point = Target.TranslatePoint(default(Point), base.AssociatedObject);
				double x = Math.Min(point.X + Target.RenderSize.Width, base.AssociatedObject.RenderSize.Width);
				double y = Math.Min(point.Y + Target.RenderSize.Height, base.AssociatedObject.RenderSize.Height);
				Rect rect = new Rect(point, new Point(x, y));
				Rect rect2 = new Rect(base.AssociatedObject.RenderSize);
				base.AssociatedObject.Clip = Geometry.Combine(new RectangleGeometry(rect2), new RectangleGeometry(rect), GeometryCombineMode.Exclude, null);
			}
		}
	}

	public class RibbonPagesControl : ItemsControl, IRecyclableContainer
	{
		private class AsyncRibbonPagesSourceCollection : AsyncObservableCollectionConverter<RibbonPage, RibbonPage>
		{
			private RibbonPageCategoryBase category;

			private RibbonControl Ribbon => category.With((RibbonPageCategoryBase x) => x.Ribbon).With((RibbonControl x) => x.ActualMergedParent ?? x);

			public AsyncRibbonPagesSourceCollection(RibbonPageCategoryBase category)
			{
				this.category = category;
				base.Dispatcher = category.Dispatcher;
				base.SleepTime = int.MaxValue;
				((ObservableCollectionConverter<RibbonPage, RibbonPage>)(object)this).Selector = SelectorMethod;
				((ObservableCollectionConverter<RibbonPage, RibbonPage>)(object)this).Source = category.ActualPages;
			}

			protected override void OnReset()
			{
				base.OnReset();
				ForceAddSelectedPage();
			}

			protected override void OnAdd(int p, IList list)
			{
				base.OnAdd(p, list);
				ForceAddSelectedPage();
			}

			protected override void OnRemove(int p, IList list)
			{
				base.OnRemove(p, list);
				ForceAddSelectedPage();
			}

			public void ForceAddSelectedPage()
			{
				Ribbon.With((RibbonControl x) => x.SelectedPage).Do((Action<RibbonPage>)base.ForceAdd);
			}

			private RibbonPage SelectorMethod(RibbonPage page)
			{
				return page;
			}
		}

		public static readonly DependencyProperty SelectedPageProperty;

		private SpacingMode spacingMode;

		private RibbonPageCategoryBase pageCategoryCore;

		private RibbonSelectedPageControl selectedPageControl;

		private RecyclingPanelSource recyclingPanelSource;

		private WeakReference previousCategory = new WeakReference(null);

		protected internal SpacingMode SpacingMode
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				return spacingMode;
			}
			set
			{
				//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (value != spacingMode)
				{
					SpacingMode oldValue = spacingMode;
					spacingMode = value;
					OnSpacingModeChanged(oldValue);
				}
			}
		}

		public RibbonPage SelectedPage
		{
			get
			{
				return (RibbonPage)GetValue(SelectedPageProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(SelectedPageProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("")]
		public RibbonSelectedPageControl SelectedPageControl => selectedPageControl;

		[Description("")]
		public RibbonPageCategoryBase PageCategory
		{
			get
			{
				return pageCategoryCore;
			}
			set
			{
				if (pageCategoryCore != value)
				{
					RibbonPageCategoryBase oldValue = pageCategoryCore;
					pageCategoryCore = value;
					OnPageCategoryChanged(oldValue);
				}
			}
		}

		private AsyncRibbonPagesSourceCollection AsyncItemsSource => recyclingPanelSource.ItemsSource as AsyncRibbonPagesSourceCollection;

		public RibbonControl Ribbon
		{
			get
			{
				if (SelectedPageControl != null)
				{
					return SelectedPageControl.Ribbon;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public RibbonPageCategoryBase PreviousCategory => previousCategory.Target as RibbonPageCategoryBase;

		int IRecyclableContainer.MinRecycleScore => 5;

		public RecyclableContainerStatus Status { get; set; }

		static RibbonPagesControl()
		{
			SelectedPageProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("SelectedPage", typeof(RibbonPage), typeof(RibbonPagesControl), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnSelectedPagePropertyChanged));
			UIElement.IsHitTestVisibleProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(RibbonPagesControl), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, (DependencyObject x, object v) => (int)((IRecyclableContainer)x).Status != 1 && (bool)v));
			UIElement.VisibilityProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(RibbonPagesControl), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, (DependencyObject x, object v) => ((int)((IRecyclableContainer)x).Status == 1) ? Visibility.Hidden : ((Visibility)v)));
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<RibbonPagesControl>();
		}

		protected virtual void OnSpacingModeChanged(SpacingMode oldValue)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Items.Count; i++)
			{
				DependencyObject dependencyObject = base.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromIndex(i);
				BarItemLinkInfo val = (BarItemLinkInfo)(object)((dependencyObject is BarItemLinkInfo) ? dependencyObject : null);
			}
		}

		protected static void OnSelectedPagePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((RibbonPagesControl)d).OnSelectedPageChanged((RibbonPage)e.OldValue);
		}

		public RibbonPagesControl(RibbonSelectedPageControl selectedPageControl)
		{
			//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			recyclingPanelSource = new RecyclingPanelSource((ItemsControl)this);
			this.selectedPageControl = selectedPageControl;
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<RibbonPagesControl>(this);
			SetBinding(SelectedPageProperty, new Binding("SelectedPage")
			{
				Source = SelectedPageControl
			});
		}

		protected virtual void OnSelectedPageChanged(RibbonPage oldValue)
		{
			ForceAddSelectedPage();
		}

		protected override bool IsItemItsOwnContainerOverride(object item)
		{
			return item is RibbonPageGroupsControl;
		}

		protected override DependencyObject GetContainerForItemOverride()
		{
			return new RibbonPageGroupsControl(this);
		}

		protected override void PrepareContainerForItemOverride(DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			base.PrepareContainerForItemOverride(element, item);
			RibbonPageGroupsControl ribbonPageGroupsControl = (RibbonPageGroupsControl)element;
			ribbonPageGroupsControl.Page = (RibbonPage)item;
			ribbonPageGroupsControl.VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Stretch;
		}

		protected override void ClearContainerForItemOverride(DependencyObject element, object item)
		{
			base.ClearContainerForItemOverride(element, item);
			RibbonPageGroupsControl ribbonPageGroupsControl = (RibbonPageGroupsControl)element;
			ribbonPageGroupsControl.Page = null;
		}

		protected virtual void OnPageCategoryChanged(RibbonPageCategoryBase oldValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				recyclingPanelSource.ItemsSource = null;
			}
			if (PageCategory == null)
			{
				recyclingPanelSource.ItemsSource = null;
				SelectedPage = null;
				return;
			}
			if (Ribbon != null && Ribbon.LoadPagesInBackground)
			{
				recyclingPanelSource.ItemsSource = (IEnumerable)new AsyncRibbonPagesSourceCollection(PageCategory);
			}
			else
			{
				recyclingPanelSource.ItemsSource = PageCategory.ActualPages;
			}
			ForceAddSelectedPage();
		}

		private void ForceAddSelectedPage()
		{
			AsyncItemsSource.Do(delegate(AsyncRibbonPagesSourceCollection x)
			{
				x.ForceAddSelectedPage();
			});
		}

		protected internal virtual void RecreateEditors()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Items.Count; i++)
			{
				((RibbonPageGroupsControl)base.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromIndex(i))?.RecreateEditors();
			}
		}

		public void Destroy()
		{
			PageCategory = null;
		}

		public int CalcRecycleScore(object item)
		{
			if (object.Equals(item, PreviousCategory))
			{
				return 10;
			}
			RibbonPageCategoryBase ribbonPageCategoryBase = item as RibbonPageCategoryBase;
			if (PreviousCategory == null)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (ribbonPageCategoryBase == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (ribbonPageCategoryBase.IsDefault != PreviousCategory.IsDefault)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (ribbonPageCategoryBase.IsDefault == PreviousCategory.IsDefault || ribbonPageCategoryBase.Caption == PreviousCategory.Caption)
			{
				return 5;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		public void OnRecycled()
		{
			previousCategory = new WeakReference(PageCategory);
		}

		public void OnReused(object item)
		{
			PageCategory = (RibbonPageCategoryBase)item;
			previousCategory = new WeakReference(null);
		}

		public bool CanRecycle()
		{
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class RibbonCaptionContentPanel : Panel
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty HorizontalContentMarginProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ContentWidthProperty;

		public double HorizontalContentMargin
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(HorizontalContentMarginProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(HorizontalContentMarginProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public double ContentWidth
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(ContentWidthProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ContentWidthProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public double MaxHorizontalContentMargin { get; private set; }

		public double MinContentWidth { get; private set; }

		public double MaxContentWidth { get; private set; }

		protected Size prevContentSize { get; private set; }

		public double ActualContentWidth
		{
			get
			{
				if (!double.IsNaN(ContentWidth))
				{
					return ContentWidth;
				}
				return MaxContentWidth;
			}
		}

		static RibbonCaptionContentPanel()
		{
			HorizontalContentMarginProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("HorizontalContentMargin", typeof(double), typeof(RibbonCaptionContentPanel), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0.0, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure));
			ContentWidthProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ContentWidth", typeof(double), typeof(RibbonCaptionContentPanel), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(double.NaN, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure));
		}

		protected override Size MeasureOverride(Size constraint)
		{
			Size availableSize = new Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity);
			Size size = new Size(0.0, 0.0);
			MaxContentWidth = 0.0;
			MinContentWidth = double.MaxValue;
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				child.Measure(availableSize);
				size = new Size(Math.Max(child.DesiredSize.Width, size.Width), Math.Max(child.DesiredSize.Height, size.Height));
				MinContentWidth = Math.Min(child.DesiredSize.Width, MinContentWidth);
			}
			MaxContentWidth = size.Width;
			Size size2 = new Size(0.0, 0.0);
			if (!prevContentSize.IsEmpty && (prevContentSize.Width != size.Width || prevContentSize.Height != prevContentSize.Height))
			{
				ContentWidth = double.NaN;
			}
			prevContentSize = size;
			size2 = ((!double.IsNaN(ContentWidth)) ? new Size(ContentWidth + HorizontalContentMargin, size.Height) : new Size(MaxContentWidth + HorizontalContentMargin, size.Height));
			if (!double.IsPositiveInfinity(constraint.Width))
			{
				size2.Width = constraint.Width;
			}
			if (!double.IsPositiveInfinity(constraint.Height))
			{
				size2.Height = constraint.Height;
			}
			return size2;
		}

		protected override void OnInitialized(EventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnInitialized(e);
			MaxHorizontalContentMargin = HorizontalContentMargin;
		}

		protected override Size ArrangeOverride(Size finalSize)
		{
			Rect finalRect = new Rect
			{
				X = HorizontalContentMargin / 2.0,
				Height = finalSize.Height,
				Width = finalSize.Width
			};
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				child.Arrange(finalRect);
			}
			return finalSize;
		}

		public virtual double GetMaxEnlargeValueOfContentWidth()
		{
			return MaxContentWidth - ActualContentWidth;
		}

		public virtual double GetMaxReduceValueOfContentWidth()
		{
			return ActualContentWidth;
		}

		public virtual double ReduceContentWidth(double desiredReduceValue)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double maxReduceValueOfContentWidth = GetMaxReduceValueOfContentWidth();
			num = Math.Min(maxReduceValueOfContentWidth, desiredReduceValue);
			if (num == 0.0)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			ContentWidth = ActualContentWidth - num;
			return num;
		}

		public virtual double EnlargeContentWidth(double desiredEnlargeValue)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double maxEnlargeValueOfContentWidth = GetMaxEnlargeValueOfContentWidth();
			num = Math.Min(maxEnlargeValueOfContentWidth, desiredEnlargeValue);
			if (num == 0.0)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			if (num + ActualContentWidth >= MaxContentWidth)
			{
				ContentWidth = double.NaN;
			}
			else
			{
				ContentWidth = num + ActualContentWidth;
			}
			return num;
		}

		public virtual double GetMaxEnlargeValueOfContentMargin()
		{
			return MaxHorizontalContentMargin - HorizontalContentMargin;
		}

		public virtual double GetMaxReduceValueOfContentMargin()
		{
			return HorizontalContentMargin;
		}

		public virtual double ReduceContentMargin(double desiredReduceValue)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double maxReduceValueOfContentMargin = GetMaxReduceValueOfContentMargin();
			num = Math.Min(maxReduceValueOfContentMargin, desiredReduceValue);
			if (num == 0.0)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			HorizontalContentMargin -= num;
			return num;
		}

		public virtual double EnlargeContentMargin(double desiredEnlargeValue)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double maxEnlargeValueOfContentMargin = GetMaxEnlargeValueOfContentMargin();
			num = Math.Min(maxEnlargeValueOfContentMargin, desiredEnlargeValue);
			if (num == 0.0)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			HorizontalContentMargin += num;
			return num;
		}
	}

		}

		private void OnHideWhenEmptyChanged(bool? oldValue)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnScopeChanged(ScopeChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			if (Commands.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (BarItemCommand command in Commands.Values)
			{
				args.OldScope.With((BarNameScope x) => x.GetService<ICommandSourceService>()).Do(delegate(ICommandSourceService x)
				{
					x.Unregister((ICommandSourceServiceSupport)(object)command);
				});
				args.NewScope.With((BarNameScope x) => x.GetService<ICommandSourceService>()).Do(delegate(ICommandSourceService x)
				{
					x.Register((ICommandSourceServiceSupport)(object)command);
				});
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsRemovedChanged()
		{
			UpdateActualIsVisible();
			Ribbon.SelectFirstVisiblePage();
		}

		protected virtual void OnNameChanged(string oldValue)
		{
			BarNameScope.GetService<IElementRegistratorService>((object)this).NameChanged((IBarNameScopeSupport)(object)this, (object)typeof(IFrameworkInputElement), (object)oldValue, (object)base.Name, false);
			if (Ribbon != null)
			{
				Ribbon.OnPageNameChanged(this);
			}
		}
