		public RibbonPage()
		{
			if (DependencyObjectExtensions.IsInDesignTool((DependencyObject)this))
			{
				SetCurrentValue(CaptionProperty, "Ribbon Page");
			}
			SetValue(GroupsPropertyKey, CreatePageGroupCollection());
			SetRibbonPage(this, this);
			CustomGroups = CreatePageGroupCollection();
			ActualGroupsCore = new MergedItemsCollection<RibbonPageGroup>(Groups);
			composerHelper = new CollectionComposerHelper<ObservableCollection<RibbonPageGroup>, RibbonPageGroup>((IEnumerable<ObservableCollection<RibbonPageGroup>>)new ObservableCollection<RibbonPageGroup>[2] { ActualGroupsCore, CustomGroups });
			ActualGroups = composerHelper.Items;
			SetValue(CommandsProperty, CreateCommandCollection());
			InitBindings();
			DXSerializer.SetSerializationIDDefault((DependencyObject)this, "RibbonPage");
		}

		protected virtual RibbonPageGroupCollection CreatePageGroupCollection()
		{
			return new RibbonPageGroupCollection(this);
		}

		protected virtual BarItemCommandCollection CreateCommandCollection()
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Expected O, but got Unknown
			return new BarItemCommandCollection((IBarItemCommandCollectionContainer)(object)this);
		}

		private static void RaiseAltitudeChanged(DependencyObject dObj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			((RibbonPage)dObj).altitudeChanged.Invoke((object)dObj, new ValueChangedEventArgs<int>((int)args.OldValue, (int)args.NewValue));
		}

		protected void ExecutePageHeaderControlAction(PageHeaderControlAction action)
		{
			foreach (RibbonPageHeaderControl pageHeaderControl in PageHeaderControls)
			{
				action(pageHeaderControl);
			}
		}

		}

		private void NotifyOnCaptionChange()
		{
			if (Ribbon != null)
			{
				Ribbon.OnPageCaptionChanged(this);
				if (MergedParent != null)
				{
					MergedParent.NotifyOnCaptionChange();
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnCategoryNameChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (Ribbon != null)
			{
				Ribbon.PageToCategoryBinder.CategoryNameChanged(this, e.OldValue.ToString(), e.NewValue.ToString());
			}
			if (base.Parent != null && base.Parent is RibbonControl)
			{
				(base.Parent as RibbonControl).PageToCategoryBinder.CategoryNameChanged(this, e.OldValue.ToString(), e.NewValue.ToString());
			}
		}

		protected internal void SetIsSelectedSealed(bool value)
		{
			suppressIsSelectedLogic = true;
			SetCurrentValue(IsSelectedProperty, value);
			suppressIsSelectedLogic = false;
		}

		protected virtual void OnActualIsVisibleChanged(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			ExecutePageHeaderControlAction(delegate(RibbonPageHeaderControl ph)
			{
				if (ph.Ribbon != null && ph.Ribbon.CategoriesPane != null && ph.Ribbon.CategoriesPane.RibbonItemsPanel != null)
				{
					ph.Ribbon.CategoriesPane.RibbonItemsPanel.InvalidateMeasure();
				}
			});
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsVisibleChanged(bool oldValue)
		{
			UpdateActualIsVisible();
			bool isSelected = IsSelected;
			if (!IsVisible)
			{
				SetCurrentValue(IsSelectedProperty, false);
			}
			if (this.IsVisibleChangedWhenSelected != null && isSelected)
			{
				this.IsVisibleChangedWhenSelected(this, new EventArgs());
			}
			if (!IsVisible && IsSelected)
			{
				Ribbon.SelectFirstVisiblePage();
			}
			if (!oldValue && IsVisible && Ribbon != null && (Ribbon.SelectedPage ?? Ribbon.With((RibbonControl x) => x.ActualMergedParent).With((RibbonControl x) => x.SelectedPage)) == null)
			{
				Ribbon.SelectFirstVisiblePage(ignoreSelectedPageValue: true);
			}
			RaiseIsVisibleChanged();
		}

		protected internal void UpdateActualIsVisible()
		{
			if (IsRemoved)
			{
				ActualIsVisible = false;
				return;
			}
			if (PageCategory != null)
			{
				ActualIsVisible = PageCategory.IsVisible && IsVisible;
			}
			else
			{
				ActualIsVisible = IsVisible;
			}
			foreach (RibbonPageGroup group in Groups)
			{
				group.UpdateActualIsVisible();
			}
			if (!ActualIsVisible && IsSelected && Ribbon != null && Ribbon.MergedParent != null)
			{
				Ribbon.MergedParent.SelectFirstVisiblePage();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void RaiseIsVisibleChanged()
		{
			if (this.IsVisibleChanged != null)
			{
				this.IsVisibleChanged(this, new EventArgs());
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsSelectedChanged(bool oldValue)
		{
			if (!suppressIsSelectedLogic && Ribbon != null)
			{
				IsSelectedChangedProcessing = true;
				if (this.IsSelectedChanged != null)
				{
					this.IsSelectedChanged(this, new EventArgs());
				}
				if (IsSelected)
				{
					ForceLoadGroupCollectionTemplate();
				}
				if (MergedParentCategory != null)
				{
					MergedParentCategory.OnPageIsSelectedCoreChanged(this);
				}
				else if (MergedParent != null)
				{
					MergedParent.SetCurrentValue(IsSelectedProperty, IsSelected);
				}
				else if (PageCategory != null && PageCategory.MergedParentRibbon != null)
				{
					PageCategory.MergedParentRibbon.OnPageIsSelectedChanged(this, new EventArgs());
				}
				IsSelectedChangedProcessing = false;
			}
		}

		internal bool ShouldHide()
		{
			if (GroupCollectionTemplate != null && !isGroupCollectionTemplateApplied)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (HideWhenEmpty == true)
			{
				return ActualGroupsCore.All((RibbonPageGroup x) => x.ShouldHide());
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual bool ApplyGroupCollectionTemplate()
		{
			if (GroupCollectionTemplate == null || isGroupCollectionTemplateApplied)
			{
				return false;
			}
			using (DataBindEngineHelper.CalcAndForcePostponedBindings())
			{
				IEnumerable<RibbonPageGroup> enumerable = TemplateHelper.LoadItemsFromTemplate<RibbonPageGroup>(GroupCollectionTemplate);
				foreach (RibbonPageGroup item in enumerable)
				{
					Groups.Add(item);
				}
				isGroupCollectionTemplateApplied = true;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void ForceLoadGroupCollectionTemplate()
		{
			bool isApplied = ApplyGroupCollectionTemplate();
			MergedChildren.ForEach(delegate(RibbonPage x)
			{
				isApplied |= x.ApplyGroupCollectionTemplate();
			});
			if (CompatibilitySettings.UseRibbonDeferredPageMerging && needPopulateMergingChildren)
			{
				ActualGroupsCore.Populate(MergedChildren.Select((RibbonPage x) => x.Groups));
				needPopulateMergingChildren = false;
			}
			if (isApplied)
			{
				RaiseEvent(new RoutedEventArgs(ExecutePostponedActionsEvent));
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnPageCategoryChanged(RibbonPageCategoryBase oldValue)
		{
			UpdateActualColor();
			if (oldValue != null && (oldValue.Pages.Contains(this) || oldValue.CustomPages.Contains(this)))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Set a new PageCategory property for the page failed, because this page was not removed from Pages collection of another PageCategory.");
			}
			UpdateActualIsVisible();
		}

		internal RibbonPageGroup GetGroupByCaption(string caption)
		{
			foreach (RibbonPageGroup item in ActualGroupsCore)
			{
				if (item.Caption == caption)
				{
					return item;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected virtual void OnGroupsSourceChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.NewValue is IEnumerable || e.OldValue is IEnumerable)
			{
				ItemsAttachedBehaviorCore<RibbonPage, RibbonPageGroup>.OnItemsSourcePropertyChanged((DependencyObject)this, e, GroupsAttachedBehaviorProperty, GroupTemplateProperty, GroupTemplateSelectorProperty, GroupStyleProperty, GroupStyleSelectorProperty, (Func<RibbonPage, IList>)((RibbonPage page) => page.Groups), (Func<RibbonPage, RibbonPageGroup>)((RibbonPage page) => new RibbonPageGroup()), (Action<int, object>)null, (Action<RibbonPageGroup>)null, (ISupportInitialize)null, (Action<RibbonPageGroup, object>)null, true, true, (Func<RibbonPageGroup, bool>)null, (Action<RibbonPageGroup, RibbonPageGroup>)null, false);
			}
			else
			{
				if (e.NewValue == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				PopulateItemsHelper.GenerateItems(e, (Func<ICommandGroupsGenerator>)delegate
				{
					//IL_004c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
					//IL_0056: Expected O, but got Unknown
					//IL_0051: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
					//IL_0057: Expected O, but got Unknown
					RibbonPageGroup ribbonPageGroup = PopulateItemsHelper.FindOrCreateNew<RibbonPageGroup>((IList<RibbonPageGroup>)Groups, (Func<RibbonPageGroup, bool>)((RibbonPageGroup x) => string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.Caption)), (Func<RibbonPageGroup>)(() => new RibbonPageGroup()));
					return (ICommandGroupsGenerator)new SingleGroupGenerator((ICommandsGenerator)new BarItemsGenerator((ILinksHolder)(object)ribbonPageGroup, (ImageType)1));
				});
			}
		}

		private void OnGroupsTemplateChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ItemsAttachedBehaviorCore<RibbonPage, RibbonPageGroup>.OnItemsGeneratorTemplatePropertyChanged((DependencyObject)this, e, GroupsAttachedBehaviorProperty);
		}

		private void OnGroupCollectionTemplateChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			isGroupCollectionTemplateApplied = false;
			Groups.Clear();
			if (IsSelected)
			{
				ApplyGroupCollectionTemplate();
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void UpdateActualColor()
		{
			if (MergedParentCategory != null)
			{
				ActualColor = MergedParentCategory.Color;
			}
			else if (PageCategory != null)
			{
				ActualColor = PageCategory.Color;
			}
		}

		private void InitBindings()
		{
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnPageGroupInserted(RibbonPageGroup group, int index)
		{
			if (group.Page == this && group.Parent == null)
			{
				AddLogicalChild(group);
			}
			if (PageCategory != null)
			{
				PageCategory.OnPageGroupInserted(group, index);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnPageGroupRemoved(RibbonPageGroup group, int index)
		{
			RemoveLogicalChild(group);
			if (PageCategory != null)
			{
				PageCategory.OnPageGroupRemoved(group, index);
			}
		}

		void ILogicalChildrenContainer.AddLogicalChild(object child)
		{
			logicalChildrenContainerItems.Add(child);
			AddLogicalChild(child);
		}

		void ILogicalChildrenContainer.RemoveLogicalChild(object child)
		{
			logicalChildrenContainerItems.Remove(child);
			RemoveLogicalChild(child);
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			RibbonPage ribbonPage = new RibbonPage();
			ribbonPage.AssignPropertiesFromSource(this);
			ribbonPage.AssignGroupsFromSource(this);
			return ribbonPage;
		}

		protected virtual void AssignPropertiesFromSource(RibbonPage source)
		{
			CaptionTemplate = source.CaptionTemplate;
			Caption = source.Caption;
			CaptionMinWidth = source.CaptionMinWidth;
			MergeType = source.MergeType;
			MergeOrder = source.MergeOrder;
		}

		protected virtual void AssignGroupsFromSource(RibbonPage source)
		{
			foreach (RibbonPageGroup group in source.Groups)
			{
				Groups.Add((RibbonPageGroup)((ICloneable)group).Clone());
			}
		}

		private int? GetActualMergeOrder()
		{
			for (int num = MergedChildren.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				RibbonPage ribbonPage = MergedChildren[num];
				if (ribbonPage.MergeOrder.HasValue)
				{
					return ribbonPage.MergeOrder;
				}
			}
			return MergeOrder;
		}

		internal void Merge(RibbonPage childPage)
		{
			if (MergedChildren.Contains(childPage))
			{
				return;
			}
			needPopulateMergingChildren = true;
			MergedChildren.Add(childPage);
			childPage.MergedParent = this;
			if (IsSelected && childPage.ApplyGroupCollectionTemplate())
			{
				RaiseEvent(new RoutedEventArgs(ExecutePostponedActionsEvent));
			}
			if (!CompatibilitySettings.UseRibbonDeferredPageMerging || IsSelected)
			{
				ActualGroupsCore.Populate(MergedChildren.Select((RibbonPage x) => x.Groups));
				needPopulateMergingChildren = false;
			}
		}

		internal void UnMerge(RibbonPage childPage)
		{
			if (MergedChildren.Contains(childPage))
			{
				MergedChildren.Remove(childPage);
				childPage.MergedParent = null;
				ActualGroupsCore.Populate(MergedChildren.Select((RibbonPage x) => x.Groups));
			}
		}

		object IMultipleElementRegistratorSupport.GetName(object registratorKey)
		{
			return base.Name;
		}

		object IBarManagerControllerAction.GetObject()
		{
			return this;
		}

		void IControllerAction.Execute(DependencyObject context)
		{
			CollectionActionHelper.Execute((IBarManagerControllerAction)(object)this);
		}

		void IRibbonMergingSupport.Merge(IRibbonMergingSupport second)
		{
			Merge((RibbonPage)second);
		}

		void IRibbonMergingSupport.Unmerge(IRibbonMergingSupport second)
		{
			UnMerge((RibbonPage)second);
		}

		void IBarItemCommandCollectionContainer.RegisterCommand(BarItemCommand command)
		{
			((ILogicalChildrenContainer)this).AddLogicalChild((object)command);
			command.CommandSourceHelper.Attach();
			BarNameScope.GetService<ICommandSourceService>((object)this).Register((ICommandSourceServiceSupport)(object)command);
		}

		void IBarItemCommandCollectionContainer.UnregisterCommand(BarItemCommand command)
		{
			command.CommandSourceHelper.Detach();
			((ILogicalChildrenContainer)this).RemoveLogicalChild((object)command);
			BarNameScope.GetService<ICommandSourceService>((object)this).Unregister((ICommandSourceServiceSupport)(object)command);
		}

		void IBarItemCommandCollectionContainer.UnregisterAllCommands()
		{
			foreach (BarItemCommand value in Commands.Values)
			{
				((IBarItemCommandCollectionContainer)this).UnregisterCommand(value);
			}
		}
	}
	public class RibbonCaptionControl : Control
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsPressedProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsSelectedProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty MaxDesiredSizeProperty;

		public bool IsPressed
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(IsPressedProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(IsPressedProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public bool IsSelected
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(IsSelectedProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(IsSelectedProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual RibbonControl Ribbon => LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<RibbonControl>((DependencyObject)this);

		protected internal ContentViewport ContentViewport { get; private set; }

		public double MaxEnlargeValue => double.PositiveInfinity;

		public double MaxReduceIndentValue
		{
			get
			{
				if (BestIndent > GetTotalReduceValue())
				{
					return GetTotalReduceValue();
				}
				return BestIndent;
			}
		}

		public double MaxReduceWidthValue => Math.Max(GetTotalReduceValue() - BestIndent, 0.0);

		public Size MaxDesiredSize
		{
			get
			{
				return (Size)GetValue(MaxDesiredSizeProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(MaxDesiredSizeProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public double BestIndent
		{
			get
			{
				if (Ribbon != null)
				{
					return Ribbon.MaxPageCaptionTextIndent;
				}
				return 0.0;
			}
		}

		public double BestWidth => Math.Ceiling(ScreenHelper.GetScaledValue(Math.Max(GetTotalWidth(), base.MinWidth)));

		public double BestDesiredWidth => base.DesiredSize.Width - base.ActualWidth + Math.Max(GetTotalWidth(), base.MinWidth) - base.Margin.Right;

		static RibbonCaptionControl()
		{
			IsSelectedProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("IsSelected", typeof(bool), typeof(RibbonCaptionControl), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(false, OnIsSelectedPropertyChanged));
			IsPressedProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("IsPressed", typeof(bool), typeof(RibbonCaptionControl), (PropertyMetadata)new UIPropertyMetadata(false));
			MaxDesiredSizeProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("MaxDesiredSize", typeof(Size), typeof(RibbonCaptionControl), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(default(Size)));
		}

		protected static void OnIsSelectedPropertyChanged(DependencyObject o, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((RibbonCaptionControl)o).OnIsSelectedChanged((bool)e.OldValue);
		}

		public RibbonCaptionControl()
		{
			base.Loaded += OnLoaded;
		}

		protected virtual void OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (BlendHelper.IsInBlendTemplateEditor((object)this))
			{
				PrepareControlForBlendEditor();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseDown(e);
			IsPressed = true;
		}

		protected override void OnMouseUp(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseUp(e);
			IsPressed = false;
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeave(e);
			IsPressed = false;
		}

		protected virtual void PrepareControlForBlendEditor()
		{
		}

		private double GetTotalContentWidth()
		{
			if (ContentViewport != null)
			{
				return ContentViewport.ContentSize.Width + BestIndent;
			}
			return BestIndent;
		}

		private double GetTotalWidth()
		{
			if (ContentViewport == null)
			{
				return base.ActualWidth + GetTotalContentWidth();
			}
			return base.ActualWidth - ((FrameworkElement)(object)ContentViewport).ActualWidth + GetTotalContentWidth();
		}

		private double GetTotalReduceValue()
		{
			return Math.Max(GetTotalWidth() - base.MinWidth, 0.0);
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			ContentViewport = (ContentViewport)GetTemplateChild("PART_Content");
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsSelectedChanged(bool oldValue)
		{
		}

		protected override Size MeasureOverride(Size constraint)
		{
			MaxDesiredSize = base.MeasureOverride(SizeHelper.Infinite);
			return base.MeasureOverride(constraint);
		}

		protected void InvalidateParentsMeasure()
		{
			if (Ribbon == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			IEnumerable<UIElement> enumerable = LayoutHelper.GetRootPath((DependencyObject)Ribbon.CategoriesPane, (DependencyObject)this).OfType<UIElement>();
			foreach (UIElement item in enumerable)
			{
				item.InvalidateMeasure();
			}
		}
	}

		protected static void OnSelectedTextStylePropertyChanged(DependencyObject o, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{

		protected virtual void OnPageHeaderControlChanged(RibbonPageHeaderControl oldValue)
		{
			ClearValue(IsRibbonMinimizedProperty);
			if (PageHeaderControl != null)
			{
				SetBinding(IsRibbonMinimizedProperty, new Binding("IsRibbonMinimized")
				{
					Source = PageHeaderControl
				});
			}
		}

		public RibbonPageCaptionControl()
		{
			CreateBindings();
		}

		protected virtual void OnSelectedTextStyleChanged(Style oldValue)
		{
			UpdateActualTextStyle();
		}

		protected virtual void OnNormalTextStyleChanged(Style oldValue)
		{
			UpdateActualTextStyle();
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsDefaultCategoryChanged(bool oldValue)
		{
			UpdateActualContentContainerStyle();
			UpdateActualBorderTemplate();
		}

		protected virtual void OnNormalContentContainerStyleChanged(Style oldValue)
		{
			UpdateActualContentContainerStyle();
		}

		protected virtual void OnHighlightedContentContainerStyleChanged(Style oldValue)
		{
			UpdateActualContentContainerStyle();
		}

		protected virtual void OnNormalTextStyleInMinimizedRibbonChanged(Style oldValue)
		{
			UpdateActualTextStyle();
		}

		protected virtual void OnHoverTextStyleChanged(Style oldValue)
		{
			UpdateActualTextStyle();
		}

		protected virtual void OnSelectedTextStyleInMinimizedRibbonChanged(Style oldValue)
		{
			UpdateActualTextStyle();
		}

		protected virtual void OnHoverTextStyleInMinimizedRibbonChanged(Style oldValue)
		{
			UpdateActualTextStyle();
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsRibbonMinimizedChanged(bool oldValue)
		{
			UpdateActualTextStyle();
			UpdateActualBorderTemplate();
		}

		protected virtual void OnPageChanged(RibbonPage oldValue)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnBorderTemplateChanged(ControlTemplate oldValue)
		{
			UpdateActualBorderTemplate();
		}

		protected virtual void OnContentChanged(object oldValue)
		{
			UpdateActualContentTemplate();
		}

		protected virtual void OnContentTemplateChanged(DataTemplate oldValue)
		{
			UpdateActualContentTemplate();
		}

		protected virtual void OnDefaultContentTemplateChanged(DataTemplate oldValue)
		{
			UpdateActualContentTemplate();
		}

		protected virtual void OnHighlightedBorderTemplateChanged(ControlTemplate oldValue)
		{
			UpdateActualBorderTemplate();
		}

		protected virtual void OnBorderTemplateInMinimizedRibbonChanged(ControlTemplate oldValue)
		{
			UpdateActualBorderTemplate();
		}

		protected virtual void OnHighlightedBorderTemplateInMinimizedRibbonChanged(ControlTemplate oldValue)
		{
			UpdateActualBorderTemplate();
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateActualBorderTemplate()
		{
			if (IsRibbonMinimized)
			{
				ActualBorderTemplate = (IsDefaultCategory ? BorderTemplateInMinimizedRibbon : HighlightedBorderTemplateInMinimizedRibbon);
			}
			else
			{
				ActualBorderTemplate = (IsDefaultCategory ? BorderTemplate : HighlightedBorderTemplate);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateActualContentTemplate()
		{
			if (ContentTemplate != null)
			{
				ActualContentTemplate = ContentTemplate;
			}
			else
			{
				ActualContentTemplate = ((Content == null || Content is string) ? DefaultContentTemplate : null);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void CreateBindings()
		{
			CreateBinding("Page.PageCategory.IsDefault", IsDefaultCategoryProperty);
			CreateBinding("Page.CaptionTemplate", ContentTemplateProperty);
			CreateBinding("Page.Caption", ContentProperty);
		}

		private void CreateBinding(string path, DependencyProperty property)
		{
			Binding binding = new Binding(path);
			binding.Source = this;
			SetBinding(property, binding);
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateActualTextStyle()
		{
			if (base.IsSelected)
			{
				ActualTextStyle = (IsRibbonMinimized ? SelectedTextStyleInMinimizedRibbon : SelectedTextStyle);
			}
			else if (base.IsMouseOver)
			{
				ActualTextStyle = (IsRibbonMinimized ? HoverTextStyleInMinimizedRibbon : HoverTextStyle);
			}
			else
			{
				ActualTextStyle = (IsRibbonMinimized ? NormalTextStyleInMinimizedRibbon : NormalTextStyle);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateActualContentContainerStyle()
		{
			ActualContentContainerStyle = (IsDefaultCategory ? NormalContentContainerStyle : HighlightedContentContainerStyle);
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			UpdateActualTextStyle();
			UpdateActualContentContainerStyle();
			UserContent = GetTemplateChild("PART_UserContent") as ContentControl;
		}

		protected override void OnIsSelectedChanged(bool oldValue)
		{
			base.OnIsSelectedChanged(oldValue);
			UpdateActualTextStyle();
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnter(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseEnter(e);
			UpdateActualTextStyle();
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeave(e);
			UpdateActualTextStyle();
		}

		protected virtual void OnUserContentChanged(ContentControl oldValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				oldValue.SizeChanged += OnUserContentSizeChanged;
			}
			if (UserContent != null)
			{
				UserContent.SizeChanged += OnUserContentSizeChanged;
			}
		}

		private void OnUserContentSizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			InvalidateParentsMeasure();
		}
	}
	public class RibbonPageCollection : BaseDependencyObjectCollection<RibbonPage>
	{
		private RibbonPageCategoryBase pageCategory;

		public RibbonControl Ribbon
		{
			get
			{
				if (PageCategory != null)
				{
					return PageCategory.Ribbon;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public RibbonPageCategoryBase PageCategory
		{
			get
			{
				return pageCategory;
			}
			private set
			{
				RibbonPageCategoryBase ribbonPageCategoryBase = pageCategory;
				pageCategory = value;
				if (ribbonPageCategoryBase != value)
				{
					OnPageCategoryChanged(ribbonPageCategoryBase, value);
				}
			}
		}

		public RibbonPageCollection(RibbonPageCategoryBase pageCategory)
		{
			PageCategory = pageCategory;
		}

		private void OnPageCategoryChanged(RibbonPageCategoryBase oldValue, RibbonPageCategoryBase newValue)
		{
		}

		protected override void OnReplaceItem(int index, RibbonPage newItem, RibbonPage oldItem)
		{
			bool isSelected = oldItem.IsSelected;
			OnRemoveItem(index, oldItem);
			newItem.SetCurrentValue(RibbonPage.IsSelectedProperty, isSelected || newItem.IsSelected);
			OnInsertItem(index, newItem);
		}

		protected override void OnRemoveItem(int oldIndex, RibbonPage page)
		{
			if (page.PageCategory != null)
			{
				page.PageCategory.OnPageRemoved(page, oldIndex);
			}
			page.IsSelectedChanged -= OnPageIsSelectedCoreChanged;
			page.IsVisibleChangedWhenSelected -= OnPageIsVisibleCoreChanged;
			page.PageCategory = null;
		}

		protected override void OnInsertItem(int newIndex, RibbonPage page)
		{
			page.PageCategory = PageCategory;
			page.IsSelectedChanged += OnPageIsSelectedCoreChanged;
			page.IsVisibleChangedWhenSelected += OnPageIsVisibleCoreChanged;
			if (page.PageCategory != null)
			{
				page.PageCategory.OnPageInserted(page, newIndex);
			}
		}

		internal void OnPageIsSelectedCoreChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			RibbonPage ribbonPage = sender as RibbonPage;
			if (ribbonPage.PageCategory != null)
			{
				ribbonPage.PageCategory.OnPageIsSelectedCoreChanged(ribbonPage);
			}
		}

		internal void OnPageIsVisibleCoreChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			RibbonPage ribbonPage = sender as RibbonPage;
			if (ribbonPage.PageCategory != null)
			{
				ribbonPage.PageCategory.OnSelectedPageIsVisibleCoreChanged(ribbonPage);
			}
		}
	}
	public class RibbonPageHeaderContentPresenter : ContentPresenter
	{
		public RibbonPageHeaderControl PageHeader => RibbonPageHeaderControl.GetPageHeaderControl(this);

		protected internal virtual void OnPageHeaderChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (PageHeader != null)
			{
				PageHeader.ContentPresenter = this;
			}
		}
	}

		bool IBarsNavigationSupport.IsSelected
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(RibbonNavigationManager.IsSelectedProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				if (((IBarsNavigationSupport)this).IsSelected == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				SetValue(RibbonNavigationManager.IsSelectedProperty, value);
				if (value)
				{
					if (Page != null)
					{
						Page.IsSelected = true;
						base.Focusable = true;
						Focus();
					}
				}
				else
				{
					base.Focusable = false;
				}
			}
		}

			AltitudeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Altitude", typeof(int), typeof(RibbonPageHeaderControl), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsParentMeasure | FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsParentArrange));
			AeroTemplateProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("AeroTemplate", typeof(ControlTemplate), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnAeroTemplatePropertyChanged));
			IsAeroModeProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("IsAeroMode", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(false, OnIsAeroModePropertyChanged));
			PageProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Page", typeof(RibbonPage), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure, OnPagePropertyChanged));
			PageHeaderControlProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("PageHeaderControl", typeFromHandle, typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure | FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.Inherits, OnPageHeaderControlPropertyChanged));
			SeparatorOpacityProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("SeparatorOpacity", typeof(double), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0.0));
			IsPageSelectedProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("IsPageSelected", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(false, OnIsPageSelectedPropertyChanged));
			IsMinimizedRibbonCollapsedProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("IsMinimizedRibbonCollapsed", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(false, OnIsMinimizedRibbonCollapsedChanged));
			IsRibbonMinimizedProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("IsRibbonMinimized", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(false, OnIsRibbonMinimizedChanged));
			ActualPageCaptionMinWidthPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("ActualPageCaptionMinWidth", typeof(double), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0.0, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure));
			ActualPageCaptionMinWidthProperty = ActualPageCaptionMinWidthPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			PageCaptionMinWidthProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("PageCaptionMinWidth", typeof(double), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0.0, OnPageCaptionMinWidthPropertyChanged));
			CommonPageCaptionMinWidthProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("CommonPageCaptionMinWidth", typeof(double), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0.0, OnCommonPageCaptionMinWidthPropertyChanged));
			IsRibbonBackStageViewOpenedProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("IsRibbonBackStageViewOpened", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(false, OnIsRibbonBackStageViewOpenedChanged));
			NavigationAutomationPeersCreator.Default.RegisterObject(typeFromHandle, typeof(RibbonPageHeaderControlAutomationPeer), (CreateObjectMethod<AutomationPeer>)((object owner) => (AutomationPeer)(object)new RibbonPageHeaderControlAutomationPeer((RibbonPageHeaderControl)owner)));
			BestDesiredSizeProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("BestDesiredSize", typeof(Size), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(default(Size), delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((RibbonPageHeaderControl)d).OnBestDesiredSizeChanged((Size)e.OldValue);
			}));
			MinDesiredWidthProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("MinDesiredWidth", typeof(double), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0.0, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((RibbonPageHeaderControl)d).OnMinDesiredWidthChanged();
			}));
			DependencyPropertyHelper2.AddCoerceValueCallback(UIElement.VisibilityProperty, typeof(RibbonPageHeaderControl), (CoerceValueCallback)((DependencyObject o, object value) => ((RibbonPageHeaderControl)o).CoerceVisibility((Visibility)value)));
		}

			((RibbonPageHeaderControl)d).UpdateCaptionControlProperties();

		public RibbonPageHeaderControl()
		{
			base.Loaded += OnLoaded;
			base.Unloaded += OnUnloaded;
			base.FocusVisualStyle = null;
		}

		private void StartDoubleClickTimer()
		{
			if (waitingDoubleClickTimer == null)
			{
				waitingDoubleClickTimer = new DispatcherTimer();
				waitingDoubleClickTimer.Interval = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(200.0);
				waitingDoubleClickTimer.Tick += OnDoubleClickTimerTick;
			}
			waitingDoubleClickTimer.Start();
		}

		public virtual void UpdateVisibility()
		{
			RibbonControl ribbon = Ribbon;
			if (Page != null && ribbon != null)
			{
				shouldHide = Page.HideWhenEmpty == true && Page.ShouldHide();
				CoerceValue(UIElement.VisibilityProperty);
				if (shouldHide && Page.IsSelected)
				{
					ribbon.SwitchSelectedPageOnHideWhenEmpty();
				}
			}
		}

		private Visibility CoerceVisibility(Visibility baseValue)
		{
			if (shouldHide)
			{
				return Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			return baseValue;
		}

		private void OnDoubleClickTimerTick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			StopDoubleClickTimer();
			OnMouseLeftButtonSingleClick();
			UpdateActualIsMinimizedRibbonCollapsed();
		}

		private bool AllowDoubleClickTimer()
		{
			return false;
		}

		private void StopDoubleClickTimer()
		{
			if (waitingDoubleClickTimer != null)
			{
				waitingDoubleClickTimer.Stop();
			}
		}

		private bool IsWaitingDoubleClick()
		{
			if (waitingDoubleClickTimer != null)
			{
				return waitingDoubleClickTimer.IsEnabled;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateVisibility();
		}

		private void OnUnloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateActualCaptionMinWidth()
		{
			ActualPageCaptionMinWidth = ((PageCaptionMinWidth == 0.0) ? CommonPageCaptionMinWidth : PageCaptionMinWidth);
		}

		protected virtual void OnPageChanged(RibbonPage oldValue)
		{
			oldValue?.PageHeaderControls.Remove(this);
			if (Page != null)
			{
				Page.PageHeaderControls.Add(this);
				SetBinding(AltitudeProperty, new Binding
				{
					Path = new PropertyPath(RibbonPage.AltitudeProperty),
					Source = Page
				});
			}
			else
			{
				ClearValue(AltitudeProperty);
			}
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return NavigationAutomationPeersCreator.Default.Create((object)this);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnter(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseEnter(e);
			if (Ribbon != null)
			{
				Ribbon.popupIsAlwaysOpen = true;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeave(e);
			if (Ribbon != null)
			{
				Ribbon.popupIsAlwaysOpen = false;
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnMouseLeftButtonDoubleClick()
		{
			RibbonControl ribbon = Ribbon;
			if (ribbon != null)
			{
				ribbon.IsMinimized = !ribbon.IsMinimized;
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnMouseLeftButtonSingleClick()
		{
			if (Ribbon == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (Ribbon.IsBackStageViewOpen)
			{
				Ribbon.CloseApplicationMenu();
				if (Ribbon.IsMinimized)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			if (IsRibbonMinimized && Ribbon.SelectedPage == Page && !ActualIsMinimizedRibbonCollapsed)
			{
				Ribbon.CollapseMinimizedRibbon();
				return;
			}
			if (!Page.IsSelected)
			{
				Page.SetCurrentValue(RibbonPage.IsSelectedProperty, true);
			}
			if (Ribbon.IsMinimized)
			{
				Ribbon.ExpandMinimizedRibbon();
			}
		}

		protected override Size MeasureOverride(Size constraint)
		{
			Size bestDesiredSize = base.MeasureOverride(SizeHelper.Infinite);
			if (CaptionControl != null)
			{
				bestDesiredSize.Width -= CaptionControl.DesiredSize.Width;
				MinDesiredWidth = bestDesiredSize.Width + ActualPageCaptionMinWidth;
				bestDesiredSize.Width += Math.Max(ActualPageCaptionMinWidth, CaptionControl.MaxDesiredSize.Width) + ((Ribbon == null) ? 0.0 : Ribbon.MaxPageCaptionTextIndent);
			}
			SeparatorOpacity = (double.IsPositiveInfinity(constraint.Width) ? 0.0 : (1.0 - (constraint.Width - MinDesiredWidth) / (bestDesiredSize.Width - MinDesiredWidth)));
			BestDesiredSize = bestDesiredSize;
			return base.MeasureOverride(constraint);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeftButtonDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeftButtonDown(e);
			if (IsWaitingDoubleClick())
			{
				StopDoubleClickTimer();
				OnMouseLeftButtonDoubleClick();
			}
			else if (AllowDoubleClickTimer())
			{
				StartDoubleClickTimer();
			}
			else if (e.ClickCount == 1)
			{
				OnMouseLeftButtonSingleClick();
			}
			else
			{
				OnMouseLeftButtonDoubleClick();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnAeroTemplateChanged(ControlTemplate oldValue)
		{
			UpdateTemplate();
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateTemplate()
		{
			if (IsAeroMode)
			{
				base.Template = AeroTemplate;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsAeroModeChanged(bool oldValue)
		{
			UpdateTemplate();
		}

		protected internal virtual void UpdateCaptionControlProperties()
		{
			if (CaptionControl != null)
			{
				CaptionControl.IsSelected = ((IsPageSelected && !IsRibbonMinimized) || (IsPageSelected && !IsMinimizedRibbonCollapsed)) && !IsRibbonBackStageViewOpened;
				CaptionControl.PageHeaderControl = this;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsPageSelectedChanged(bool oldValue)
		{
			UpdateCaptionControlProperties();
			RaiseWeakPageIsSelectedChanged(new ValueChangedEventArgs<bool>(oldValue, IsPageSelected));
		}

		private void RaiseWeakPageIsSelectedChanged(ValueChangedEventArgs<bool> args)
		{
			foreach (ValueChangedEventHandler<bool> item in handlersWeakPageIsSelectedChanged)
			{
				item.Invoke((object)this, args);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateActualIsMinimizedRibbonCollapsed()
		{
			ActualIsMinimizedRibbonCollapsed = IsMinimizedRibbonCollapsed;
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			CaptionControl = GetTemplateChild("PART_CaptionControl") as RibbonPageCaptionControl;
			SeparatorControl = GetTemplateChild("PART_Separator") as Control;
			UpdateCaptionControlProperties();
		}

		protected override void OnMouseMove(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseMove(e);
			if (IsWaitingDoubleClick())
			{
				StopDoubleClickTimer();
				OnMouseLeftButtonSingleClick();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnBestDesiredSizeChanged(Size oldValue)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnMinDesiredWidthChanged()
		{
		}

		bool INavigationElement.ProcessKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Key == Key.Return || e.Key == Key.Space)
			{
				((IKeyTipNavigationElement)this).Select();
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		bool IKeyTipNavigationElement.Select()
		{
			Ribbon.SelectedPage = Page;
			if (Ribbon.IsMinimized)
			{
				Ribbon.OpenPopup();
			}
			DispatcherHelper.DoEvents(1);
			NavigationTree.SelectElement((IBarsNavigationSupport)(object)((INavigationElement)this).BoundOwner);
			return true;
		}

		public void Destroy()
		{
		}

		public int CalcRecycleScore(object item)
		{
			return -1;
		}

		public void OnRecycled()
		{
		}

		public void OnReused(object item)
		{
		}

		public bool CanRecycle()
		{
			return false;
		}

	public enum MeasureType
	{
		Default = 1,
		AllowCollapse = 2,
		AllowHide = 4,
		Collapsed = 8
	}
	public class RibbonSelectedPageControlItemsPanel : FakeRecyclingPanel<RibbonPagesControl>
	{
		protected override Size MeasureOverride(Size availableSize)
		{
			Size result = default(Size);
			foreach (RibbonPagesControl item in ((RecyclingPanelBase<RibbonPagesControl>)(object)this).EnumerateChildren())
			{
				item.Measure(availableSize);
				result.Width = Math.Max(result.Width, item.DesiredSize.Width);
				result.Height = Math.Max(result.Height, item.DesiredSize.Height);
			}
			if (base.Ribbon != null)
			{
				result.Height = Math.Max(result.Height, base.Ribbon.OriginPageGroupsHeight);
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override Size ArrangeOverride(Size finalSize)
		{
			foreach (RibbonPagesControl item in ((RecyclingPanelBase<RibbonPagesControl>)(object)this).EnumerateChildren())
			{
				item.Arrange(new Rect(default(Point), finalSize));
			}
			return finalSize;
		}
	}
	public class RibbonPageGroupsItemsPanel : RibbonOrderedOnMergeItemsPanel<RibbonPageGroupControl>
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty MeasureTypeProperty;

		protected internal PageGroupsPanelSimplifiedLayoutCalculator SimplifiedCalculator { get; private set; }

		protected RibbonPageGroupsControl PageGroupsControl => VisualTreeExtensions.VisualParents((DependencyObject)(object)this, false).OfType<RibbonPageGroupsControl>().FirstOrDefault();

		protected internal bool IsOrigin
		{
			get
			{
				if (PageGroupsControl != null)
				{
					return PageGroupsControl.IsOrigin;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected override bool IsOrdered => true;

		static RibbonPageGroupsItemsPanel()
		{
			MeasureTypeProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("MeasureType", typeof(MeasureType), typeof(RibbonPageGroupsItemsPanel), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(MeasureType.Default, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure | FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.Inherits));
		}

		public static MeasureType GetMeasureType(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			return (MeasureType)obj.GetValue(MeasureTypeProperty);
		}

		public static void SetMeasureType(DependencyObject obj, MeasureType value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(MeasureTypeProperty, value);
		}

		public RibbonPageGroupsItemsPanel()
		{
			SimplifiedCalculator = new PageGroupsPanelSimplifiedLayoutCalculator(this);
			((UIElement)(object)this).IsVisibleChanged += OnIsVisibleChanged;
		}

		protected override int? GetChildOrder(UIElement child)
		{
			RibbonPageGroupControl input = child as RibbonPageGroupControl;
			RibbonPageGroup ribbonPageGroup = input.With((RibbonPageGroupControl x) => x.PageGroup);
			bool flag = ribbonPageGroup.With((RibbonPageGroup x) => x.Ribbon).Return((RibbonControl x) => x.IsMerged || x.ActualMergedParent != null, () => false);
			if (ribbonPageGroup == null)
			{
				return base.GetChildOrder(child);
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				return ribbonPageGroup.ActualMergeOrder;
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override Size MeasureOverride(Size availableSize)
		{
			if (base.Ribbon == null || (base.Ribbon.RibbonStyle != RibbonStyle.TabletOffice && base.Ribbon.RibbonStyle != RibbonStyle.OfficeSlim && !base.Ribbon.IsSimplified))
			{
				Size result = base.MeasureOverride(availableSize);
				if (base.Ribbon != null)
				{
					result.Height = (IsOrigin ? result.Height : Math.Max(result.Height, base.Ribbon.OriginPageGroupHeight));
				}
				return result;
			}
			Size size = default(Size);
			if (!base.Ribbon.IsSimplified)
			{
				Dictionary<UIElement, Size> minDesiredSize = GetMinDesiredSize();
				Size infinite = SizeHelper.Infinite;
				foreach (RibbonPageGroupControl item in ((RecyclingPanelBase<RibbonPageGroupControl>)(object)this).EnumerateChildren())
				{
					MeasureChild((UIElement)(object)item, infinite, MeasureType.Default);
					size.Width += ((UIElement)(object)item).DesiredSize.Width;
					size.Height = Math.Max(size.Height, ((UIElement)(object)item).DesiredSize.Height);
				}
				if (size.Width > availableSize.Width)
				{
					size = ReduceAdapt(availableSize, size, minDesiredSize);
					return ReduceCollapse(availableSize, size);
				}
				return size;
			}
			return SimplifiedCalculator.MeasureOverride(availableSize);
		}

		private void OnIsVisibleChanged(object sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if ((bool)e.NewValue)
			{
				((UIElement)(object)this).InvalidateMeasure();
			}
		}

		protected void MeasureChild(UIElement child, Size availableSize, MeasureType measureType)
		{
			SetMeasureType(child, measureType);
			child.Measure(availableSize);
		}

		private double GetMinWidthCollapsed(RibbonPageGroupControl pgc)
		{
			if (base.Ribbon != null && base.Ribbon.IsSimplified)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			double result = 0.0;
			if (!((RecyclingPanelBase<RibbonPageGroupControl>)(object)this).EnumerateChildren().Any())
			{
				return result;
			}
			MeasureChild((UIElement)(object)pgc, SizeHelper.Infinite, MeasureType.Collapsed);
			result = ((UIElement)(object)pgc).DesiredSize.Width;
			((UIElement)(object)pgc).InvalidateMeasure();
			return result;
		}

		private Dictionary<UIElement, Size> GetMinDesiredSize()
		{
			Dictionary<UIElement, Size> dictionary = new Dictionary<UIElement, Size>();
			foreach (RibbonPageGroupControl item in ((RecyclingPanelBase<RibbonPageGroupControl>)(object)this).EnumerateChildren())
			{
				MeasureChild((UIElement)(object)item, SizeHelper.Infinite, MeasureType.AllowCollapse);
				dictionary.Add((UIElement)(object)item, ((UIElement)(object)item).DesiredSize);
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		private Size ReduceAdapt(Size availableSize, Size currentSize, Dictionary<UIElement, Size> minSize)
		{
			Size result = currentSize;
			double num = 0.0;
			Size availableSize2 = new Size(0.0, availableSize.Height);
			List<RibbonPageGroupControl> list = (from x in ((RecyclingPanelBase<RibbonPageGroupControl>)(object)this).EnumerateChildren()
				orderby ((UIElement)(object)x).DesiredSize.Width descending
				select x).ToList();
			foreach (RibbonPageGroupControl item in list)
			{
				if (result.Width <= availableSize.Width)
				{
					break;
				}
				num = ((UIElement)(object)item).DesiredSize.Width;
				availableSize2.Width = Math.Max(minSize[(UIElement)(object)item].Width, availableSize.Width - GetSumWidth((UIElement)(object)item) - GetAfterSumWidth((UIElement)(object)item));
				MeasureChild((UIElement)(object)item, availableSize2, MeasureType.Default);
				result.Width -= num - ((UIElement)(object)item).DesiredSize.Width;
				result.Height = Math.Max(result.Height, ((UIElement)(object)item).DesiredSize.Height);
			}
			return result;
		}

		private Size ReduceCollapse(Size availableSize, Size currentSize)
		{
			Size result = currentSize;
			double num = 0.0;
			Size availableSize2 = new Size(0.0, availableSize.Height);
			double num2 = double.NaN;
			List<RibbonPageGroupControl> list = (from x in ((RecyclingPanelBase<RibbonPageGroupControl>)(object)this).EnumerateChildren()
				orderby ((UIElement)(object)x).DesiredSize.Width descending
				select x).ToList();
			foreach (RibbonPageGroupControl item in list)
			{
				if (result.Width <= availableSize.Width)
				{
					break;
				}
				num = ((UIElement)(object)item).DesiredSize.Width;
				RibbonPageGroupControl ribbonPageGroupControl = item;
				if (ribbonPageGroupControl != null)
				{
					num2 = GetMinWidthCollapsed(ribbonPageGroupControl);
					availableSize2.Width = Math.Max(num2, availableSize.Width - GetSumWidth((UIElement)(object)item) - GetAfterSumWidth((UIElement)(object)item));
					MeasureChild((UIElement)(object)item, availableSize2, MeasureType.AllowHide);
					if (base.Ribbon != null && base.Ribbon.IsSimplified && item.AllItemsAreCollapsed())
					{
						MeasureChild((UIElement)(object)item, new Size(0.0, 0.0), MeasureType.AllowHide);
					}
					result.Width -= num - ((UIElement)(object)item).DesiredSize.Width;
					result.Height = Math.Max(result.Height, ((UIElement)(object)item).DesiredSize.Height);
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private double GetSumWidth(UIElement child)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			foreach (RibbonPageGroupControl item in ((RecyclingPanelBase<RibbonPageGroupControl>)(object)this).EnumerateChildren())
			{
				if (object.Equals(child, item))
				{
					break;
				}
				num += ((UIElement)(object)item).DesiredSize.Width;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private double GetAfterSumWidth(UIElement child)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			foreach (RibbonPageGroupControl item in ((RecyclingPanelBase<RibbonPageGroupControl>)(object)this).EnumerateChildren())
			{
				num = ((!object.Equals(child, item)) ? (num + ((UIElement)(object)item).DesiredSize.Width) : 0.0);
			}
			return num;
		}
	}
	public class RibbonPagesItemsPanel : FakeRecyclingPanel<RibbonPageGroupsControl>
	{
		private static Size emptySize;

		public RibbonPagesItemsPanel()
		{
			((FrameworkElement)(object)this).SizeChanged += OnSizeChanged;
		}

		private void OnSizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.Ribbon != null && !e.PreviousSize.Equals(emptySize) && base.Ribbon.RibbonStyle == RibbonStyle.TabletOffice)
			{
				TranslateTransform translateTransform = (TranslateTransform)(((UIElement)(object)this).RenderTransform = new TranslateTransform());
				double value = Math.Min((e.NewSize.Width - e.PreviousSize.Width) / 2.0, 30.0);
				DoubleAnimation doubleAnimation = new DoubleAnimation
				{
					FillBehavior = FillBehavior.Stop
				};
				doubleAnimation.Duration = new Duration(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(80.0));
				doubleAnimation.From = value;
				doubleAnimation.EasingFunction = new QuadraticEase
				{
					EasingMode = EasingMode.EaseOut
				};
				translateTransform.BeginAnimation(TranslateTransform.XProperty, doubleAnimation);
			}
		}

		protected override Size MeasureOverride(Size availableSize)
		{
			if (SimplifiedModeSettingsHelper.GetIsInSimplifiedRibbon((DependencyObject)(object)this))
			{
				return MeasureOverrideInSimplifiedMode(availableSize);
			}
			Size result = new Size(0.0, 0.0);
			foreach (RibbonPageGroupsControl item in ((RecyclingPanelBase<RibbonPageGroupsControl>)(object)this).EnumerateChildren())
			{
				if (item is RibbonPageGroupsControl ribbonPageGroupsControl)
				{
					item.Measure(availableSize);
					if (ribbonPageGroupsControl.Page != null && ribbonPageGroupsControl.Page.IsSelected)
					{
						result = item.DesiredSize;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					item.Measure(availableSize);
				}
			}
			if (base.Ribbon != null)
			{
				result.Height = Math.Max(result.Height, base.Ribbon.OriginPageGroupsHeight);
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override Size ArrangeOverride(Size finalSize)
		{
			foreach (RibbonPageGroupsControl item in ((RecyclingPanelBase<RibbonPageGroupsControl>)(object)this).EnumerateChildren())
			{
				if (item is RibbonPageGroupsControl ribbonPageGroupsControl && ((ribbonPageGroupsControl.Page != null && ribbonPageGroupsControl.Page.IsSelected) || !ribbonPageGroupsControl.IsArranged))
				{
					item.Arrange(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, item.DesiredSize.Width, finalSize.Height));
				}
			}
			return finalSize;
		}

		protected virtual Size MeasureOverrideInSimplifiedMode(Size availableSize)
		{
			Size result = new Size(0.0, 0.0);
			foreach (RibbonPageGroupsControl item in ((RecyclingPanelBase<RibbonPageGroupsControl>)(object)this).EnumerateChildren())
			{
				if (item is RibbonPageGroupsControl ribbonPageGroupsControl)
				{
					if (ribbonPageGroupsControl.Page.IsSelected)
					{
						item.Measure(availableSize);
						result = item.DesiredSize;
					}
					else
					{
						item.Measure(new Size(double.PositiveInfinity, availableSize.Height));
					}
				}
				else
				{
					item.Measure(availableSize);
				}
			}
			if (base.Ribbon != null)
			{
				result.Height = Math.Max(result.Height, base.Ribbon.OriginPageGroupsHeight);
			}
			return result;
		}
	}

				}
			}
		}

		static RibbonSelectedPagePopup()
		{
		}

		public RibbonSelectedPagePopup()

		protected internal virtual void RecreateEditors()

			{
				ribbonSelectedPageControl.RecreateEditors();

		}

		protected virtual void UpdatePopupContent()
		{
			if (((PopupBase)this).PopupContent is RibbonSelectedPageControl && ((Popup)(object)this).Child is RibbonSelectedPagePopupBorderControl ribbonSelectedPagePopupBorderControl)
			{
				ribbonSelectedPagePopupBorderControl.Ribbon = Ribbon;
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdatePlacement(UIElement control)
		{
			((Popup)(object)this).Placement = PlacementMode.Bottom;
		}

		public void ShowRibbonPageGroupInScrollViewer(RibbonPageGroup pageGroup)
		{

		public void ScrollRight()
		{
			ScrollTo(GetFirstVisibleGroupInScrollViewer() + 1);
		}

		public void ScrollLeft()
		{
			ScrollTo(GetFirstVisibleGroupInScrollViewer() - 1);
		}

		protected virtual void ScrollTo(int idx)
		{
			double num = GetGroupHorizontalOffsetInScrollViewer(idx);
			double actualScrollWidth = GetActualScrollWidth();
			double num2 = num - ScrollViewer.HorizontalOffset;
			double num3 = Math.Abs(num2);
			int num4 = (int)(num2 / num3);
			if (num3 > actualScrollWidth)
			{
				num = ScrollViewer.HorizontalOffset + (double)num4 * Math.Min(num3, actualScrollWidth);
			}
			ScrollViewer.ScrollToHorizontalOffset(num);
		}

		private double GetActualScrollWidth()
		{
			double num = base.ActualWidth;
			if (LeftRepeatButton != null)
			{
				num -= LeftRepeatButton.ActualWidth;
			}
			if (RightRepeatButton != null)
			{
				num -= RightRepeatButton.ActualWidth;
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected virtual void OnSelectedPageChanged(RibbonPage oldValue)
		{
			UpdateActualBorder();
			foreach (RibbonPagesControl item in EnumeratePagesControls())
			{
				item.SelectedPage = SelectedPage;
			}
			RibbonPageGroupsControl pageGroupsControlByPage = GetPageGroupsControlByPage(oldValue);
			if (pageGroupsControlByPage != null && VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(pageGroupsControlByPage) is UIElement uIElement)
			{
				uIElement.InvalidateMeasure();
			}
			pageGroupsControlByPage = GetPageGroupsControlByPage(SelectedPage);
			if (pageGroupsControlByPage != null && VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(pageGroupsControlByPage) is UIElement uIElement2)
			{
				uIElement2.InvalidateMeasure();
			}
			Reset();
			IsSelectedPageFullyLoaded = false;
			SetComplexLayoutState((ComplexLayoutState)0);
		}

		private IEnumerable<RibbonPagesControl> EnumeratePagesControls()
		{
			return Enumerable.Range(0, base.Items.Count).Select(base.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromIndex).OfType<RibbonPagesControl>();
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateActualBorder()
		{
			if (SelectedPage == null || SelectedPage.PageCategory == null || SelectedPage.PageCategory.IsDefault)
			{
				ActualBorderTemplate = (IsPopup ? BorderTemplateInPopup : BorderTemplate);
			}
			else
			{
				ActualBorderTemplate = (IsPopup ? HighlightedBorderTemplateInPopup : HighlightedBorderTemplate);
			}
		}

		protected internal RibbonPageGroupsControl GetPageGroupsControlByPage(RibbonPage page)
		{
			if (page == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			foreach (RibbonPageGroupsControl pageGroupsControl in page.PageGroupsControls)
			{
				if (pageGroupsControl.PagesControl != null && pageGroupsControl.PagesControl.SelectedPageControl == this)
				{
					return pageGroupsControl;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private int GetFirstVisibleGroupInScrollViewer()
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < GetPageGroupCount(); i++)
			{
				RibbonPageGroupControl pageGroupControlFromIndex = GetPageGroupControlFromIndex(i);
				if (pageGroupControlFromIndex != null && ((UIElement)(object)pageGroupControlFromIndex).Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
				{
					if (num >= ScrollViewer.HorizontalOffset)
					{
						return i;
					}
					num += ((FrameworkElement)(object)pageGroupControlFromIndex).ActualWidth;
				}
			}
			return 0;
		}

		internal double GetGroupHorizontalOffsetInScrollViewer(int visibleGroupIndex)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < GetPageGroupCount(); i++)
			{
				RibbonPageGroupControl pageGroupControlFromIndex = GetPageGroupControlFromIndex(i);
				if (pageGroupControlFromIndex != null && ((UIElement)(object)pageGroupControlFromIndex).Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
				{
					if (i >= visibleGroupIndex)
					{
						return num;
					}
					num += ((FrameworkElement)(object)pageGroupControlFromIndex).ActualWidth;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected virtual void OnLayoutUpdated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (ScrollViewer == null || !ScrollViewer.IsVisible)
			{
				return;
			}
			if ((PrevActualWidth < base.ActualWidth && ScrollViewer.ExtentWidth <= ScrollViewer.ActualWidth) || IsFirstLayoutUpdated)
			{
				IsFirstLayoutUpdated = false;
				Reset();
				SetComplexLayoutState((ComplexLayoutState)0);
			}
			try
			{
				if (PrevActualWidth == base.ActualWidth && PrevExtentWidth == ScrollViewer.ExtentWidth && isReduced)
				{
					return;
				}
				PrevActualWidth = base.ActualWidth;
				PrevExtentWidth = ScrollViewer.ExtentWidth;
				if (ScrollViewer.ExtentWidth > ScrollViewer.ActualWidth)
				{
					SetComplexLayoutState((ComplexLayoutState)0);
					if (!Reduce())
					{
						SetComplexLayoutState((ComplexLayoutState)1);
					}
				}
				else if (IsItemsControlFullyLoaded(CurrentPageControl))
				{
					SetComplexLayoutState((ComplexLayoutState)1);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				UpdateRepeatButtonsVisibility();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateRepeatButtonsVisibility()
		{
			Visibility visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			Visibility visibility2 = Visibility.Collapsed;
			if (isReduced)
			{
				if (ScrollViewer.HorizontalOffset != 0.0)
				{
					visibility = Visibility.Visible;
				}
				if (ScrollViewer.ExtentWidth - ScrollViewer.HorizontalOffset > ScrollViewer.ActualWidth + RightRepeatButton.ActualWidth)
				{
					visibility2 = Visibility.Visible;
				}
			}
			LeftRepeatButton.Visibility = visibility;
			RightRepeatButton.Visibility = visibility2;
		}

		internal int GetPageGroupCount()
		{
			if (CurrentPageControl == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return CurrentPageControl.Items.Count;
		}

		internal RibbonPageGroupControl GetPageGroupControlFromIndex(int index)
		{
			if (SelectedPage == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			RibbonPageGroup ribbonPageGroup = SelectedPage.ActualGroups[index];
			foreach (RibbonPageGroupControl pageGroupControl in ribbonPageGroup.PageGroupControls)
			{
				if (IsOwnPageGroupControl(pageGroupControl))
				{
					return pageGroupControl;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private bool IsOwnPageGroupControl(RibbonPageGroupControl groupControl)
		{
			if (groupControl == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (groupControl.PageGroupsControl == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (groupControl.PageGroupsControl.PagesControl == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return groupControl.PageGroupsControl.PagesControl.SelectedPageControl == this;
		}

		internal int GetIndexOfPageGroupControl(RibbonPageGroup control)
		{
			if (CurrentPageControl == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return CurrentPageControl.Items.IndexOf(control);
		}

		protected void SetIsCollapsed(object value)
		{
			int i = 0;
			for (int pageGroupCount = GetPageGroupCount(); i < pageGroupCount; i++)
			{
				((DependencyObject)(object)GetPageGroupControlFromIndex(i))?.SetValue(RibbonPageGroupControl.IsCollapsedProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected virtual Size CalcTotalSize()
		{
			Size result = new Size(0.0, 0.0);
			for (int i = 0; i < GetPageGroupCount(); i++)
			{
				RibbonPageGroupControl pageGroupControlFromIndex = GetPageGroupControlFromIndex(i);
				if (pageGroupControlFromIndex != null && ((UIElement)(object)pageGroupControlFromIndex).Visibility != Visibility.Collapsed)
				{
					((UIElement)(object)pageGroupControlFromIndex).Measure(new Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity));
					result.Width += ((UIElement)(object)pageGroupControlFromIndex).DesiredSize.Width;
					result.Height = Math.Max(result.Height, ((UIElement)(object)pageGroupControlFromIndex).DesiredSize.Height);
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected internal virtual void ResetAllGroups()
		{
			if ((Ribbon == null || (Ribbon.RibbonStyle != RibbonStyle.TabletOffice && Ribbon.RibbonStyle != RibbonStyle.OfficeSlim)) && !IsInSimplifiedRibbon)
			{
				SetIsCollapsed(BooleanBoxes.False);
				for (int i = 0; i < GetPageGroupCount(); i++)
				{
					GetPageGroupControlFromIndex(i)?.Reset();
				}
			}
		}

		protected void ReduceGroup(int index)
		{
			GetPageGroupControlFromIndex(index)?.Reduce();
		}

		protected RibbonPageGroupControl GetLargestReduciblePageControl(bool allowCollapse)
		{
			List<RibbonPageGroupControl> list = new List<RibbonPageGroupControl>();
			for (int i = 0; i < GetPageGroupCount(); i++)
			{
				RibbonPageGroupControl pageGroupControlFromIndex = GetPageGroupControlFromIndex(i);
				if (pageGroupControlFromIndex != null)
				{
					list.Add(pageGroupControlFromIndex);
				}
			}
			foreach (RibbonPageGroupControl item in from x in list.Select((RibbonPageGroupControl x, int index) => new
				{
					Index = index,
					Item = x
				})
				orderby ((FrameworkElement)(object)x.Item).ActualWidth descending, x.Index descending
				select x.Item)
			{
				if (item.CanReduce(allowCollapse))
				{
					return item;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected bool ReduceGalleries()
		{
			List<RibbonGalleryBarItemLinkControl> list = new List<RibbonGalleryBarItemLinkControl>();
			RibbonGalleryBarItemLinkControl ribbonGalleryBarItemLinkControl = null;
			for (int i = 0; i < GetPageGroupCount(); i++)
			{
				RibbonPageGroupControl pageGroupControlFromIndex = GetPageGroupControlFromIndex(i);
				if (pageGroupControlFromIndex != null)
				{
					ribbonGalleryBarItemLinkControl = RibbonPageGroupControl.FindLargestReducibleGallery(pageGroupControlFromIndex.GetGalleryList());
					if (ribbonGalleryBarItemLinkControl != null)
					{
						list.Add(ribbonGalleryBarItemLinkControl);
					}
				}
			}
			ribbonGalleryBarItemLinkControl = RibbonPageGroupControl.FindLargestReducibleGallery(list);
			if (ribbonGalleryBarItemLinkControl == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ribbonGalleryBarItemLinkControl.Reduce();
			return true;
		}

		protected bool ReduceButtonGroups()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < GetPageGroupCount(); i++)
			{
				RibbonPageGroupControl pageGroupControlFromIndex = GetPageGroupControlFromIndex(i);
				if (pageGroupControlFromIndex != null && pageGroupControlFromIndex.ReduceButtonGroups())
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual bool Reduce()
		{
			bool allowCollapse = Ribbon != null && Ribbon.RibbonStyle != RibbonStyle.TabletOffice && Ribbon.RibbonStyle != RibbonStyle.OfficeSlim;
			if (ReduceGalleries() || ReduceButtonGroups())
			{
				return true;
			}
			RibbonPageGroupControl ribbonPageGroupControl = GetLargestReduciblePageControl(allowCollapse: false) ?? GetLargestReduciblePageControl(allowCollapse);
			if (ribbonPageGroupControl != null)
			{
				ribbonPageGroupControl.Reduce();
				return true;
			}
			isReduced = true;
			return false;
		}

		protected int GetNextPageGroupIndex(int index)
		{
			for (int num = index - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				RibbonPageGroupControl pageGroupControlFromIndex = GetPageGroupControlFromIndex(num);
				if (pageGroupControlFromIndex != null && !pageGroupControlFromIndex.IsCollapsed)
				{
					return num;
				}
			}
			return GetLastPageGroupIndex();
		}

		protected int GetLastPageGroupIndex()
		{
			for (int num = GetPageGroupCount() - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				RibbonPageGroupControl pageGroupControlFromIndex = GetPageGroupControlFromIndex(num);
				if (pageGroupControlFromIndex != null && !pageGroupControlFromIndex.IsCollapsed)
				{
					return num;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		protected internal virtual void Reset()
		{
			if (Ribbon != null && !IsInSimplifiedRibbon)
			{
				ResetAllGroups();
				LastReducedGroupIndex = -1;
				CurrentPageGroupIndex = -1;
				if (ScrollViewer != null)
				{
					ScrollViewer.ScrollToLeftEnd();
				}
				isReduced = false;
				InvalidateMeasure();
			}
		}

		protected internal static bool IsItemsControlFullyLoaded(ItemsControl itemsControl)
		{
			if (itemsControl == null || (itemsControl.Visibility == Visibility.Visible && (!itemsControl.IsLoaded || itemsControl.ItemContainerGenerator.Status != GeneratorStatus.ContainersGenerated)))
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < itemsControl.Items.Count; i++)
			{
				DependencyObject dependencyObject = itemsControl.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromIndex(i);
				if (dependencyObject is ItemsControl && !IsItemsControlFullyLoaded(dependencyObject as ItemsControl))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void OnThemeChanged(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			IsFirstLayoutUpdated = true;
		}

		protected internal virtual void RecreateEditors()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Items.Count; i++)
			{
				((RibbonPagesControl)base.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromIndex(i))?.RecreateEditors();
			}
		}
	}

		protected bool UpdateOriginHeights()
		{
			if (Ribbon == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			RibbonPageGroupControl ribbonPageGroupControl = VisualTreeExtensions.VisualChildren((DependencyObject)OriginPageGroups, false).OfType<RibbonPageGroupControl>().FirstOrDefault();
			if (ribbonPageGroupControl == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			List<BarItemLinkInfo> list = VisualTreeExtensions.VisualChildren((DependencyObject)(object)ribbonPageGroupControl, false).OfType<BarItemLinkInfo>().ToList();
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool result = false;
			double num = list.Select((BarItemLinkInfo oli) => ((UIElement)(object)oli).DesiredSize.Height).Max();
			if (num != Ribbon.OriginButtonHeight)
			{
				result = true;
				Ribbon.OriginButtonHeight = num;
			}
			if (((UIElement)(object)ribbonPageGroupControl).DesiredSize.Height != Ribbon.OriginPageGroupHeight)
			{
				result = true;
				Ribbon.OriginPageGroupHeight = ((UIElement)(object)ribbonPageGroupControl).DesiredSize.Height;
			}
			if (OriginPageGroups.DesiredSize.Height != Ribbon.OriginPageGroupsHeight)
			{
				result = true;
				Ribbon.OriginPageGroupsHeight = OriginPageGroups.DesiredSize.Height;
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected virtual void OnRibbonChanged(RibbonControl oldValue)
		{
			UpdateOriginHeights();
		}

		protected void InvalidateVisualTree(UIElement element)
		{
			VisualTreeExtensions.VisualChildren((DependencyObject)element, true).OfType<UIElement>().ForEach(delegate(UIElement x)
			{
				x.InvalidateMeasure();
			});
		}

		protected override Size MeasureOverride(Size availableSize)
		{
			if (OriginPageGroups != null)
			{
				OriginPageGroups.Measure(SizeHelper.Infinite);
			}
			bool flag = UpdateOriginHeights();
			Size zero = SizeHelper.Zero;
			foreach (UIElement item in base.InternalChildren.OfType<UIElement>().Take(base.Children.Count))
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					InvalidateVisualTree(item);
				}
				item.Measure(availableSize);
				zero.Width = Math.Max(zero.Width, item.DesiredSize.Width);
				zero.Height = Math.Max(zero.Height, item.DesiredSize.Height);
			}
			return zero;
		}

		protected override Size ArrangeOverride(Size finalSize)
		{
			if (OriginPageGroups != null)
			{
				OriginPageGroups.Arrange(new Rect(OriginPageGroups.DesiredSize));
			}
			Rect finalRect = new Rect(finalSize);
			base.InternalChildren.OfType<UIElement>().Take(base.Children.Count).ForEach(delegate(UIElement x)
			{
				x.Arrange(finalRect);
			});
			return finalSize;
		}

		protected override Visual GetVisualChild(int index)
		{
			if (index >= base.Children.Count)
			{
				return OriginPageGroups;
			}
			return base.GetVisualChild(index);
		}
	}

		public RibbonStatusBarControl()
		{
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0028: Expected O, but got Unknown
			addPartControlsAction = new PostponedAction((Func<bool>)(() => !base.IsInitialized));
			base.Loaded += OnLoaded;
			base.Unloaded += OnUnloaded;
			LeftPartControl = new RibbonStatusBarLeftPartControl((ILogicalChildrenContainer)(object)this);
			RightPartControl = new RibbonStatusBarRightPartControl((ILogicalChildrenContainer)(object)this);
			addPartControlsAction.PerformPostpone((Action)delegate
			{
				AddLogicalChild(LeftPartControl);
				AddLogicalChild(RightPartControl);
			});
			base.IsTabStop = false;
			SetBinding(IsWindowMaximizedProperty, new Binding
			{
				Path = new PropertyPath("(0)", FloatingContainer.IsMaximizedProperty),
				Source = this
			});
			KeyboardNavigation.SetTabNavigation(this, KeyboardNavigationMode.None);
			((IMergingSupport)this).IsAutomaticallyMerged = true;
		}

		private void OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			UnsubscribeMDIChildHostEvents();
			mdiChildHost = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<IMDIChildHost>((DependencyObject)this);
			SubscribeMDIChildHostEvents();
			UnsubscribeTemplateEvents();
			SubscribeTemplateEvents();
			UpdateActualVisibility();
			UpdateActualIsSizeGripVisible();
		}

		private void OnUnloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			UnsubscribeTemplateEvents();
			SubscribeMDIChildHostEvents();
		}

		private void OnManagerChanged(BarManager oldValue, BarManager newValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null && GetRibbonStatusBar((DependencyObject)(object)oldValue) == this)
			{
				SetRibbonStatusBar((DependencyObject)(object)oldValue, null);
			}
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				SetRibbonStatusBar((DependencyObject)(object)newValue, this);
				if (BarManagerHelper.GetChildRibbonStatusBar(newValue) == null)
				{
					BarManagerHelper.SetChildRibbonStatusBar(newValue, (object)this);
				}
			}
		}

		private void SubscribeTemplateEvents()
		{
			if (SizeGrip != null)
			{
				SizeGrip.DragDelta += OnGripSizeThumbDragDelta;
				SizeGrip.MouseEnter += OnSizeGripMouseEnter;
				SizeGrip.PreviewMouseDown += OnSizeGripPreviewMouseDown;
			}
			if (LeftContentControl != null)
			{
				LeftContentControl.Content = LeftPartControl;
			}
			if (RightContentControl != null)
			{
				RightContentControl.Content = RightPartControl;
			}
		}

		private void OnSizeGripPreviewMouseDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if ((mdiChildHost == null || !mdiChildHost.CanResize) && GetParentWindow() is DXRibbonWindow dXRibbonWindow)
			{
				if (base.FlowDirection == FlowDirection.LeftToRight)
				{
					dXRibbonWindow.ResizeWindow((DXWindowActiveResizeParts)8);
				}
				else
				{
					dXRibbonWindow.ResizeWindow((DXWindowActiveResizeParts)7);
				}
			}
		}

		private void UnsubscribeTemplateEvents()
		{
			if (SizeGrip != null)
			{
				SizeGrip.DragDelta -= OnGripSizeThumbDragDelta;
				SizeGrip.MouseEnter -= OnSizeGripMouseEnter;
				SizeGrip.PreviewMouseDown -= OnSizeGripPreviewMouseDown;
			}
			if (LeftContentControl != null)
			{
				LeftContentControl.Content = null;
			}
			if (RightContentControl != null)
			{
				RightContentControl.Content = null;
			}
		}

			}

		private Window GetParentWindow()
		{
			return VisualTreeExtensions.VisualParents((DependencyObject)this, false).OfType<Window>().FirstOrDefault();
		}

		private double MinMax(double value, double minValue, double maxValue)
		{
			return Math.Max(minValue, Math.Min(value, maxValue));
		}

		private void OnGripSizeThumbDragDelta(object sender, DragDeltaEventArgs e)
		{
			if (mdiChildHost != null && mdiChildHost.CanResize)
			{
				ResizeMdiChildHost(sender, e);
			}
			else
			{
				ResizeWindow(e);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void ResizeWindow(DragDeltaEventArgs e)
		{
			Window parentWindow = GetParentWindow();
			if (parentWindow == null || !(parentWindow.Content is UIElement) || parentWindow.WindowState == WindowState.Maximized)
			{
				return;
			}
			UIElement uIElement = parentWindow.Content as UIElement;
			if (parentWindow.FlowDirection == FlowDirection.LeftToRight)
			{
				parentWindow.Width = Math.Max(parentWindow.Width + MinMax(parentWindow.Width + e.HorizontalChange, base.MinWidth, base.MaxWidth) - parentWindow.Width, parentWindow.MinWidth);
				parentWindow.Height = Math.Max(parentWindow.Height + MinMax(uIElement.RenderSize.Height + e.VerticalChange, base.ActualHeight, parentWindow.MaxHeight) - uIElement.RenderSize.Height, parentWindow.MinHeight);
				return;
			}
			double num = Math.Max(parentWindow.Width + MinMax(parentWindow.Width + e.HorizontalChange, base.MinWidth, base.MaxWidth) - parentWindow.Width, parentWindow.MinWidth);
			double num2 = parentWindow.Width - num;
			parentWindow.Width = num;
			parentWindow.Height = Math.Max(parentWindow.Height + MinMax(uIElement.RenderSize.Height + e.VerticalChange, base.ActualHeight, parentWindow.MaxHeight) - uIElement.RenderSize.Height, parentWindow.MinHeight);
			if (num == parentWindow.ActualWidth)
			{
				parentWindow.Left += num2;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void ResizeMdiChildHost(object sender, DragDeltaEventArgs e)
		{
			Size size = mdiChildHost.Size;
			Size minSize = mdiChildHost.MinSize;
			Size maxSize = mdiChildHost.MaxSize;
			double width = Math.Max(size.Width + MinMax(size.Width + e.HorizontalChange, base.MinWidth, base.MaxWidth) - size.Width, minSize.Width);
			double height = Math.Max(size.Height + MinMax(size.Height + e.VerticalChange, base.ActualHeight, maxSize.Height) - size.Height, minSize.Height);
			mdiChildHost.Size = new Size(width, height);
		}

		public bool IsMergedChild(RibbonStatusBarControl item)
		{
			return HierarchicalMergingHelper.CompositeMergedChildren.Contains(item);
		}

		public void Merge(RibbonStatusBarControl childStatusBar)
		{
			HierarchicalMergingHelper.Merge(childStatusBar);
		}

		private void MergeCore(RibbonStatusBarControl childStatusBar)
		{
			if (childStatusBar != null && IsMergedChild(childStatusBar) && childStatusBar.HierarchicalMergingHelper.ActualMergedParent == null && childStatusBar.HierarchicalMergingHelper.ActualMergedParent != this)
			{
				childStatusBar.HierarchicalMergingHelper.ActualMergedParent = this;
				MergedChildren.Add(childStatusBar);
				((ILinksHolder)LeftPartControl).Merge((ILinksHolder)(object)childStatusBar.LeftPartControl);
				((ILinksHolder)RightPartControl).Merge((ILinksHolder)(object)childStatusBar.RightPartControl);
			}
		}

		protected virtual object CoerceVisibility(object value)
		{
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000f: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0036: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003c: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (MergingProperties.GetHideElements((DependencyObject)this) && (int)MDIMergeStyle != 3 && HasMergingCandidates())
			{
				return Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			if ((mdiChildHost != null && !mdiChildHost.IsChildMenuVisible && (int)MDIMergeStyle != 3) || MergedParent != null)
			{
				return Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			return value;
		}

		private bool HasMergingCandidates()
		{
			object name = ((IMultipleElementRegistratorSupport)this).GetName((object)typeof(IMergingSupport));
			return (from x in BarNameScope.GetService<IElementRegistratorService>((object)this).GetElements<IMergingSupport>(name, (ScopeSearchSettings)1)
				where BarNameScope.GetService<IMergingService>((object)x).CanMerge(x, (IMergingSupport)(object)this)
				select x).Any();
		}

		public void UnMerge(RibbonStatusBarControl childStatusBar)
		{
			HierarchicalMergingHelper.UnMerge(childStatusBar);
		}

		private void UnMergeCore(RibbonStatusBarControl childStatusBar)
		{
			if (childStatusBar != null && MergedChildren.Contains(childStatusBar))
			{
				MergedChildren.Remove(childStatusBar);
				childStatusBar.HierarchicalMergingHelper.ActualMergedParent = null;
				((ILinksHolder)LeftPartControl).UnMerge((ILinksHolder)(object)childStatusBar.LeftPartControl);
				((ILinksHolder)RightPartControl).UnMerge((ILinksHolder)(object)childStatusBar.RightPartControl);
			}
		}

		public void UnMerge()
		{
			while (HierarchicalMergingHelper.MergedChildren.Count != 0)
			{
				UnMerge(HierarchicalMergingHelper.MergedChildren[HierarchicalMergingHelper.MergedChildren.Count - 1]);
			}
		}

		void IRibbonStatusBarControl.Merge(object child)
		{
			Merge((RibbonStatusBarControl)child);
		}

		void IRibbonStatusBarControl.UnMerge(object child)
		{
			UnMerge((RibbonStatusBarControl)child);
		}

						.Any();

			container = (ShouldSearchRibbonWindow ? TreeHelper.GetParent<DXRibbonWindowContainer>((DependencyObject)ribbon, (Func<DXRibbonWindowContainer, bool>)null, true, true) : null);
			if (container != null)

				BindingOperations.SetBinding(ribbon, RibbonControl.ApplicationIconProperty, new Binding
				{
					Source = container,
					Path = new PropertyPath(DXRibbonWindowContainer.IconProperty)

		}
