	internal class CommonRibbonWindowHelper : IRibbonWindowHelper
	{
		private readonly RibbonControl ribbon;

		private readonly NullRibbonWindowHelper nullRibbonWindowHelper;

		private readonly DXRibbonWindowHelper ribbonWindowHelper;

		private readonly ThemedWindowHelper themedWindowHelper;

		private readonly RibbonWindowContainerHelper ribbonWindowContainerHelper;

		private IRibbonWindowHelper CurrentHelper { get; set; }

		IRibbonWindow IRibbonWindowHelper.RibbonWindow => CurrentHelper.RibbonWindow;

		Window IRibbonWindowHelper.Window => CurrentHelper.Window;

		bool IRibbonWindowHelper.HasRibbonWindowAsParent => CurrentHelper.HasRibbonWindowAsParent;

		bool IRibbonWindowHelper.IsAeroMode => CurrentHelper.IsAeroMode;

		public CommonRibbonWindowHelper(RibbonControl ribbon)
		{
			this.ribbon = ribbon;
			CurrentHelper = (nullRibbonWindowHelper = new NullRibbonWindowHelper(ribbon));
			ribbonWindowHelper = new DXRibbonWindowHelper(ribbon);
			themedWindowHelper = new ThemedWindowHelper(ribbon);
			ribbonWindowContainerHelper = new RibbonWindowContainerHelper(ribbon);
		}

		void IRibbonWindowHelper.UpdateRibbonWindow()
		{
			//IL_0058: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0063: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			try
			{
				ribbonWindowHelper.UpdateRibbonWindow();
				if (ribbonWindowHelper.RibbonWindow != null)
				{
					CurrentHelper = ribbonWindowHelper;
					return;
				}
				themedWindowHelper.UpdateRibbonWindow();
				if (themedWindowHelper.RibbonWindow != null)
				{
					CurrentHelper = themedWindowHelper;
					ThemedWindowsHelper.SetRibbonHeaderVisibility((DependencyObject)(ThemedWindow)themedWindowHelper.RibbonWindow, ribbon.RibbonHeaderVisibility);
					return;
				}
				ribbonWindowContainerHelper.UpdateRibbonWindow();
				if (ribbonWindowContainerHelper.RibbonWindow != null)
				{
					CurrentHelper = ribbonWindowContainerHelper;
				}
				else
				{
					CurrentHelper = nullRibbonWindowHelper;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				ribbon.UpdateIsInRibbonWindow();
			}
		}

		UIElement IRibbonWindowHelper.GetRibbonWindowContent()
		{
			return CurrentHelper.GetRibbonWindowContent();
		}

		void IRibbonWindowHelper.UpdateRibbonVisibility()
		{
			CurrentHelper.UpdateRibbonVisibility();
		}

		void IRibbonWindowHelper.SetAeroContentHorizontalOffset(double offset)
		{
			CurrentHelper.SetAeroContentHorizontalOffset(offset);
		}

		FrameworkElement IRibbonWindowHelper.GetControlBoxContainer()
		{
			return CurrentHelper.GetControlBoxContainer();
		}

		UIElement IRibbonWindowHelper.GetTitleElement()
		{
			return CurrentHelper.GetTitleElement();
		}

		void IRibbonWindowHelper.SetRibbonHeaderBorderHeight(double height)
		{
			CurrentHelper.SetRibbonHeaderBorderHeight(height);
		}

		void IRibbonWindowHelper.Close()
		{
			CurrentHelper.Close();
		}

		void IRibbonWindowHelper.DragOrMaximizeWindow(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs mouseButtonEventArgs)
		{
			CurrentHelper.DragOrMaximizeWindow(sender, mouseButtonEventArgs);
		}

		void IRibbonWindowHelper.ShowSystemMenu(UIElement headerBorder, Point point)
		{
			CurrentHelper.ShowSystemMenu(headerBorder, point);
		}

		string IRibbonWindowHelper.GetTitle()
		{

	internal class RibbonWindowChecker
	{
		[IgnoreDependencyPropertiesConsistencyChecker]
		internal static readonly DependencyProperty RibbonPulseProperty;

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static List<RibbonControl> pulseItems;

		static RibbonWindowChecker()
		{
			RibbonPulseProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("RibbonPulse", typeof(bool), typeof(RibbonWindowChecker), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(false, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.Inherits, OnRibbonPulsePropertyChanged));
		}

		private static void OnRibbonPulsePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is RibbonControl ribbonControl && pulseItems != null && ribbonControl.RecalcNonForcedVisibility() && (bool)e.NewValue)
			{
				pulseItems.Add(ribbonControl);
			}
		}

		internal static bool CheckRibbon(Window window, RibbonControl ribbon)
		{
			try
			{
				pulseItems = new List<RibbonControl>();
				window.SetValue(RibbonPulseProperty, true);
				window.ClearValue(RibbonPulseProperty);
				if (pulseItems.FirstOrDefault() != ribbon)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				pulseItems.Clear();
				pulseItems = null;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	internal abstract class BaseRibbonWindowHelper<TRibbonWindow> : IRibbonWindowHelper where TRibbonWindow : Window, IRibbonWindow
	{
		private TRibbonWindow ribbonWindow;

		public Window Window => ribbonWindow;

		public IRibbonWindow RibbonWindow => (IRibbonWindow)(object)ribbonWindow;

		protected TRibbonWindow WindowInstance => ribbonWindow;

		public bool HasRibbonWindowAsParent
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsInMDIChildHost())
				{
					return HasRibbonWindowAsParentOverride;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected abstract bool HasRibbonWindowAsParentOverride { get; }

		public abstract bool IsAeroMode { get; }

		protected RibbonControl Ribbon { get; private set; }

		private bool ShouldSearchRibbonWindow
		{
			get
			{
				if (Ribbon.RecalcNonForcedVisibility())
				{
					return !BarNameScope.GetService<IElementRegistratorService>((object)Ribbon).GetElements<IFrameworkInputElement>((ScopeSearchSettings)1).OfType<RibbonControl>()
						.Any();
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool IsInMDIChildHost()
		{
			return LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<IMDIChildHost>((DependencyObject)Ribbon) != null;
		}

		public BaseRibbonWindowHelper(RibbonControl ribbon)
		{
			Ribbon = ribbon;
		}

		public UIElement GetRibbonWindowContent()
		{
			return RibbonWindow.With((IRibbonWindow x) => x.GetContentContainer());
		}

		public void UpdateRibbonVisibility()
		{
			//IL_0066: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006c: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0137: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_013d: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (RibbonWindow == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				if (!Ribbon.IsInRibbonWindow)
				{
					Ribbon.ForcedVisibility = null;
				}
				else if (Ribbon.MinWidth == 0.0)
				{
					Ribbon.ForcedVisibility = null;
					RibbonWindow.IsCaptionVisible = (int)Ribbon.RibbonHeaderVisibility == 1;
					RibbonWindow.IsRibbonCaptionVisible = !RibbonWindow.IsCaptionVisible;
				}
				else if (Ribbon.MergedParent == null)
				{
					if (GetRibbonWindowContent().RenderSize.Width < Ribbon.MinWidth)
					{
						Ribbon.ForcedVisibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
						((UIElement)(object)Ribbon.Toolbar.Control).Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
						RibbonWindow.IsRibbonCaptionVisible = false;
						RibbonWindow.IsCaptionVisible = true;
					}
					else
					{
						Ribbon.ForcedVisibility = null;
						((UIElement)(object)Ribbon.Toolbar.Control).Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
						bool flag = (int)Ribbon.RibbonHeaderVisibility == 0;
						RibbonWindow.IsCaptionVisible = !flag;
						RibbonWindow.IsRibbonCaptionVisible = flag;
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (Window.WindowState == WindowState.Minimized && !Window.ShowInTaskbar)
				{
					Ribbon.ForcedVisibility = Visibility.Hidden;
					RibbonWindow.IsCaptionVisible = true;
					RibbonWindow.IsRibbonCaptionVisible = false;
				}
				Ribbon.CoerceValue(UIElement.VisibilityProperty);
			}
		}

		public void SetRibbonControlVisibility()
		{
			if (Window != null && Ribbon.ActualMergedParent == null)
			{
				if (Ribbon.IsRibbonTitleBarActualVisible)
				{
					ThemedWindowsHelper.SetRibbonControlVisibility((DependencyObject)Window, Visibility.Visible);
				}
				else
				{
					ThemedWindowsHelper.SetRibbonControlVisibility((DependencyObject)Window, Visibility.Collapsed);
				}
			}
		}

		public abstract void SetAeroContentHorizontalOffset(double offset);

		public FrameworkElement GetControlBoxContainer()
		{
			return RibbonWindow.With((IRibbonWindow x) => x.GetControlBoxContainer());
		}

		public virtual UIElement GetTitleElement()
		{
			return RibbonWindow.With((IRibbonWindow x) => x.GetWindowHeaderElement());
		}

		public abstract void SetRibbonHeaderBorderHeight(double height);

		public void Close()
		{
			Window.Do(delegate(Window x)
			{
				x.Close();
			});
		}

		public abstract void DragOrMaximizeWindow(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs mouseButtonEventArgs);

		public abstract void ShowSystemMenu(UIElement headerBorder, Point point);

		public string GetTitle()
		{
			return Window.With((Window x) => x.Title);
		}

		public virtual void UpdateRibbonWindow()
		{
			TRibbonWindow val = ribbonWindow;
			TRibbonWindow val2 = (ShouldSearchRibbonWindow ? (Window.GetWindow(Ribbon) as TRibbonWindow) : null);
			if (val2 != null && !RibbonWindowChecker.CheckRibbon(val2, Ribbon))
			{
				val2 = null;
			}
			ribbonWindow = val2;
			if (val != ribbonWindow)
			{
				OnWindowChanged(val, ribbonWindow);
			}
		}

		public void UpdateRibbon()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnWindowChanged(TRibbonWindow oldValue, TRibbonWindow newValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				((IRibbonWindow)oldValue).Ribbon = null;
			}
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				((IRibbonWindow)newValue).Ribbon = (IRibbonControl)(object)Ribbon;
			}
			SetRibbonControlVisibility();
		}
	}
	internal class DXRibbonWindowHelper : BaseRibbonWindowHelper<DXRibbonWindow>
	{
		public override bool IsAeroMode => ((DXWindow)base.WindowInstance).IsAeroMode;

		protected override bool HasRibbonWindowAsParentOverride => base.RibbonWindow != null;

		public DXRibbonWindowHelper(RibbonControl ribbon)
			: base(ribbon)
		{
		}

		public override void SetAeroContentHorizontalOffset(double offset)
		{
			base.WindowInstance.SetAeroContentHorizontalOffset(offset);
		}

		public override void DragOrMaximizeWindow(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.WindowInstance.DragOrMaximizeWindow(sender, e);
		}

		public override void ShowSystemMenu(UIElement headerBorder, Point point)
		{
			base.WindowInstance.ShowSystemMenu(headerBorder, point);
		}

		protected override void OnWindowChanged(DXRibbonWindow oldValue, DXRibbonWindow newValue)
		{
			base.OnWindowChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			UnsubscribeRibbonWindowEvents(oldValue);
			SubscribeRibbonWindowEvents(newValue);
		}

		public virtual void SubscribeRibbonWindowEvents(DXRibbonWindow value)
		{
			if (value != null)
			{
				((Window)(object)value).Activated += OnWindowActivated;
				((Window)(object)value).Deactivated += OnWindowDeactivated;
				if (base.RibbonWindow != null)
				{
					value.Ribbon = base.Ribbon;
					InitializeRibbonWindow();
					value.IsAeroModeChanged = (EventHandler)Delegate.Combine(value.IsAeroModeChanged, new EventHandler(OnRibbonWindowIsAeroModeChanged));
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual void UnsubscribeRibbonWindowEvents(DXRibbonWindow value)
		{
			if (value != null)
			{
				((Window)(object)value).Activated -= OnWindowActivated;
				((Window)(object)value).Deactivated -= OnWindowDeactivated;
				value.Ribbon = null;
				value.IsAeroModeChanged = (EventHandler)Delegate.Remove(value.IsAeroModeChanged, new EventHandler(OnRibbonWindowIsAeroModeChanged));
				UnInitializeRibbonWindow();
			}
		}

		private void OnWindowDeactivated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			OnActivateWindowStatusChanged();
		}

		private void OnWindowActivated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			OnActivateWindowStatusChanged();
		}

		private void OnRibbonWindowIsAeroModeChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			base.Ribbon.IsAeroMode = ((DXWindow)(DXRibbonWindow)sender).IsAeroMode;
		}

		protected virtual void OnActivateWindowStatusChanged()
		{
			base.Ribbon.KeyboardNavigationManager.IsNavigationMode = false;
			if (base.Ribbon.HeaderBorder != null && base.Ribbon.IsInRibbonWindow && base.RibbonWindow != null)
			{
				FloatingContainer.SetIsActive((DependencyObject)base.Ribbon.HeaderBorder, ((Window)(object)base.WindowInstance).IsActive);
			}
		}

		public virtual void InitializeRibbonWindow()
		{
			if (base.RibbonWindow != null)
			{
				base.Ribbon.IsHeaderBorderVisible = true;
				OnActivateWindowStatusChanged();
				BindingOperations.SetBinding(base.Ribbon, RibbonControl.ApplicationIconProperty, new Binding
				{
					Source = base.RibbonWindow,
					Path = new PropertyPath(DXWindow.SmallIconProperty)
				});
			}
		}

		public virtual void UnInitializeRibbonWindow()
		{
			base.Ribbon.IsHeaderBorderVisible = false;
			base.Ribbon.ClearValue(RibbonControl.ApplicationIconProperty);
		}

		public override void SetRibbonHeaderBorderHeight(double height)
		{
			base.WindowInstance.SetRibbonHeaderBorderHeight(height);
		}
	}

	public class DXRibbonWindowTitlePanel : Panel
	{
		private enum TitlePlacement
		{
			None,
			Left,
			Right
		}

		private class HeaderBounds
		{
			private readonly IRibbonWindow ribbonWindow;

			private readonly RibbonControl ribbon;

			private readonly ContentControl windowHeader;

			public bool CoerceRTL { get; set; }

			public double Top { get; set; }

			public double MinLeft { get; set; }

			public double MaxRight { get; set; }

			public double ContextualCategoryRight { get; set; }

			public double ContextualCategoryLeft { get; set; }

			public double WindowCenter { get; set; }

			public TitlePlacement TitlePlacementOfContextCategory { get; set; }

			public bool ShowContextualCategoryHeader { get; set; }

			public DXRibbonWindowTitlePanel TitlePanel { get; set; }

			public HeaderBounds(IRibbonWindow window, DXRibbonWindowTitlePanel panel)
			{
				ribbonWindow = window;
				windowHeader = ribbonWindow.GetWindowHeaderElement() as ContentControl;
				ribbon = panel.Ribbon;
				Top = 0.0;
				MinLeft = 0.0;
				MaxRight = 0.0;
				ContextualCategoryRight = 0.0;
				ContextualCategoryLeft = 0.0;
				WindowCenter = 0.0;
				TitlePlacementOfContextCategory = TitlePlacement.Left;
				TitlePanel = panel;
				CoerceRTL = false;
			}

			public void UpdateHeaderBounds()
			{
				TitlePlacementOfContextCategory = TitlePlacement.Left;
				GetWindowCenter();
				GetTop();
				GetMinLeft();
				GetMaxRight();
				if (!ribbon.IsContextualCategoryExist)
				{
					return;
				}
				CalcContextualCategoryBounds();
				if (ShowContextualCategoryHeader)
				{
					if (ribbon.PageCategoryAlignment == RibbonPageCategoryCaptionAlignment.Default && WindowCenter > ContextualCategoryRight)
					{
						CoerceBounds();
					}
					else if (MaxRight > ContextualCategoryLeft)
					{
						MaxRight = ContextualCategoryLeft;
					}
				}
			}

			private void CoerceBounds()
			{
				TitlePlacementOfContextCategory = TitlePlacement.Right;
				MinLeft = ContextualCategoryRight;
			}

			private void GetTop()
			{
				Top = (TitlePanel.ActualHeight - TitlePanel.CaptionContentControl.DesiredSize.Height) / 2.0;
			}

			private void GetMaxRight()
			{
				FrameworkElement controlBoxContainer = ribbon.WindowHelper.GetControlBoxContainer();
				if (controlBoxContainer != null)
				{
					MaxRight = controlBoxContainer.TranslatePoint(default(Point), TitlePanel).X;
				}
				else
				{
					MaxRight = TitlePanel.ActualWidth - ThemedWindowsHelper.GetMinWidth((DependencyObject)(Window)(object)ribbonWindow);
				}
			}

			private void GetMinLeft()
			{
				if (TitlePanel.ToolbarControl != null && TitlePanel.RibbonStyle != RibbonStyle.TabletOffice)
				{
					if (ribbon.CategoriesPane.Opacity == 0.0)
					{
						MinLeft = ribbon.TranslatePoint(new Point(((BackstageViewControl)ribbon.ApplicationMenu).GetLeftPartActualWidth(), 0.0), TitlePanel).X;
					}
					else
					{
						MinLeft = TitlePanel.ToolbarControl.TranslatePoint(new Point(TitlePanel.ToolbarControl.ActualWidth, 0.0), TitlePanel).X;
					}
				}
			}

			private void GetWindowCenter()
			{
				//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0072: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0074: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				WindowTitleAlignment val = (WindowTitleAlignment)0;
				ContentControl contentControl;
				if (ribbonWindow is ThemedWindow)
				{
					if (windowHeader == null)
					{
						return;
					}
					contentControl = windowHeader;
					IRibbonWindow obj = ribbonWindow;
					val = ((ThemedWindow)((obj is ThemedWindow) ? obj : null)).TitleAlignment;
				}
				else
				{
					contentControl = ribbonWindow as Window;
				}
				if (contentControl != null)
				{
					double actualWidth = contentControl.ActualWidth;
					WindowCenter = (actualWidth - TitlePanel.CaptionContentControl.DesiredSize.Width) / 2.0;
					if ((int)val == 2)
					{
						WindowCenter += TitlePanel.CaptionContentControl.DesiredSize.Width;
					}
				}
				if (contentControl != null)
				{
					WindowCenter = (NeedToCoerce(contentControl) ? (contentControl.TranslatePoint(new Point(WindowCenter, 0.0), TitlePanel).X - TitlePanel.CaptionContentControl.DesiredSize.Width) : contentControl.TranslatePoint(new Point(WindowCenter, 0.0), TitlePanel).X);
				}
			}

			private bool NeedToCoerce(ContentControl holder)
			{
				if (!(holder is Window))
				{
					return false;
				}
				Window window = holder as Window;
				if (window.FlowDirection != FlowDirection.LeftToRight || !CoerceRTL)
				{
					if (window.FlowDirection == FlowDirection.RightToLeft)
					{
						return !CoerceRTL;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}

			private RibbonPageCategoryControl GetFirstContextualCategoryControl()
			{
				RibbonPageCategoryBase ribbonPageCategory = null;
				foreach (RibbonPageCategoryBase actualCategory in ribbon.ActualCategories)
				{
					if (!actualCategory.IsDefault && actualCategory.IsVisible)
					{
						ribbonPageCategory = actualCategory;
						break;
					}
				}
				return RibbonControlHelper.GetRibbonPageCategoryControl(ribbonPageCategory);
			}

			private RibbonPageCategoryControl GetLastContextualCategoryControl()
			{
				RibbonPageCategoryBase ribbonPageCategory = null;
				foreach (RibbonPageCategoryBase item in ribbon.ActualCategories.Reverse())
				{
					if (!item.IsDefault && item.IsVisible)
					{
						ribbonPageCategory = item;
						break;
					}
				}
				return RibbonControlHelper.GetRibbonPageCategoryControl(ribbonPageCategory);
			}

			private void CalcContextualCategoryBounds()
			{
				RibbonPageCategoryControl firstContextualCategoryControl = GetFirstContextualCategoryControl();
				RibbonPageCategoryControl lastContextualCategoryControl = GetLastContextualCategoryControl();
				if (firstContextualCategoryControl != null && lastContextualCategoryControl != null)
				{
					ContextualCategoryLeft = firstContextualCategoryControl.TranslatePoint(default(Point), TitlePanel).X;
					ContextualCategoryRight = lastContextualCategoryControl.TranslatePoint(default(Point), TitlePanel).X + lastContextualCategoryControl.DesiredSize.Width;
					ShowContextualCategoryHeader = firstContextualCategoryControl.ShowHeader;
				}
			}
		}

			((DXRibbonWindowTitlePanel)d).OnQuickAccessToolbarContainerChanged((ContentControl)e.OldValue, (ContentControl)e.NewValue);
		}

		protected static void OnRibbonWindowPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
		}

		protected static void OnRibbonStylePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((DXRibbonWindowTitlePanel)d).OnRibbonStyleChanged((RibbonStyle)e.OldValue);
		}

		protected static void OnCaptionContentControlPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((DXRibbonWindowTitlePanel)d).OnCaptionContentControlChanged((ContentControl)e.OldValue);
		}

		protected static void OnFlowDirectionPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((DXRibbonWindowTitlePanel)d).OnFlowDirectionChanged((FlowDirection)e.OldValue, (FlowDirection)e.NewValue);
		}

		public DXRibbonWindowTitlePanel()
		{
			base.Loaded += OnLoaded;
			base.Unloaded += OnUnloaded;
		}

		private Size MeasureChildren(Size availableSize)
		{
			Size result = default(Size);
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				child.Measure(availableSize);
				if (child != MinCaptionWidthBlock)
				{
					result.Width += child.DesiredSize.Width;
					result.Height = Math.Max(result.Height, child.DesiredSize.Height);
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal bool CheckWindowStateForMeasureAndArrange()
		{
			if (!(RibbonWindow is Window window))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (window.WindowState == WindowState.Minimized)
			{
				if (justMinimized)
				{
					base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
					{
						justMinimized = false;
					}, DispatcherPriority.Background);
				}
				return justMinimized;
			}
			justMinimized = true;
			return true;
		}

		private bool IsReadyToMeasureAndArrange()
		{
			if (RibbonWindow == null || !CheckWindowStateForMeasureAndArrange())
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Ribbon == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (CaptionContentControl == null || MinCaptionWidthBlock == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override Size MeasureOverride(Size availableSize)
		{
			if (!IsReadyToMeasureAndArrange())
			{
				return base.MeasureOverride(availableSize);
			}
			Size result = MeasureChildren(availableSize);
			CaptionContentControl.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
			Bounds.UpdateHeaderBounds();
			double num = Bounds.MaxRight - Bounds.MinLeft;
			if (num <= minVisibleTitleWidth)
			{
				CaptionContentControl.Visibility = Visibility.Hidden;
				return result;
			}
			CaptionContentControl.Measure(new Size(num, CaptionContentControl.DesiredSize.Height));
			return result;
		}

		protected override Size ArrangeOverride(Size finalSize)
		{
			if (!IsReadyToMeasureAndArrange())
			{
				return base.ArrangeOverride(finalSize);
			}
			if (SizeHelper.IsZero(CaptionContentControl.DesiredSize))
			{
				CaptionContentControl.Measure(finalSize);
			}
			if (Bounds.CoerceRTL)
			{
				Bounds.CoerceRTL = false;
			}
			double left = 0.0;
			double delta = 0.0;
			if (RibbonWindow is ThemedWindow)
			{
				ArrangeWithTitleAlignment(ref left, ref delta);
			}
			else
			{
				ArrangeJustCenteredAlignment(out left, out delta);
			}
			if (left < Bounds.MinLeft)
			{
				left = Bounds.MinLeft;
				CaptionContentControl.Arrange(new Rect(new Point(left, Bounds.Top), CaptionContentControl.DesiredSize));
				return finalSize;
			}
			CaptionContentControl.Arrange(new Rect(new Point(left, Bounds.Top), CaptionContentControl.DesiredSize));
			return finalSize;
		}

		private void ArrangeJustCenteredAlignment(out double left, out double delta)
		{
			left = Bounds.WindowCenter;
			delta = Bounds.MaxRight - (left + CaptionContentControl.DesiredSize.Width);
			if (Ribbon.IsContextualCategoryExist && Bounds.ShowContextualCategoryHeader)
			{
				switch (Ribbon.PageCategoryAlignment)
				{
				case RibbonPageCategoryCaptionAlignment.Default:
					if (Bounds.TitlePlacementOfContextCategory == TitlePlacement.Left)
					{
						if (Bounds.MaxRight < Bounds.ContextualCategoryLeft)
						{
							left = (Bounds.MaxRight - Bounds.MinLeft - CaptionContentControl.DesiredSize.Width) / 2.0 + Bounds.MinLeft;
						}
						else
						{
							left = (Bounds.ContextualCategoryLeft - Bounds.MinLeft - CaptionContentControl.DesiredSize.Width) / 2.0 + Bounds.MinLeft;
						}
					}
					break;
				case RibbonPageCategoryCaptionAlignment.Right:
					if (delta < 0.0)
					{
						left = (Bounds.ContextualCategoryLeft - Bounds.MinLeft - CaptionContentControl.DesiredSize.Width) / 2.0 + Bounds.MinLeft;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			else if (delta < 0.0)
			{
				left = (Bounds.MaxRight - Bounds.MinLeft - CaptionContentControl.DesiredSize.Width) / 2.0 + Bounds.MinLeft;
			}
		}

		private void ArrangeWithTitleAlignment(ref double left, ref double delta)
		{
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0023: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			IRibbonWindow ribbonWindow = RibbonWindow;
			WindowTitleAlignment titleAlignment = ((ThemedWindow)((ribbonWindow is ThemedWindow) ? ribbonWindow : null)).TitleAlignment;
			switch ((int)titleAlignment)
			{
			case 0:
				left = Bounds.MinLeft;
				delta = Bounds.MaxRight - (left + CaptionContentControl.DesiredSize.Width);
				break;
			case 2:
				left = Bounds.MaxRight - CaptionContentControl.DesiredSize.Width;
				delta = Bounds.MaxRight - (left + CaptionContentControl.DesiredSize.Width);
				break;
			case 1:
				ArrangeJustCenteredAlignment(out left, out delta);
				break;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateRibbonWindow();
			InvalidateMeasure();
			if (RibbonWindow != null)
			{
				Bounds = new HeaderBounds(RibbonWindow, this);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnUnloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			RibbonWindow = null;
		}

		protected override void OnRenderSizeChanged(SizeChangedInfo sizeInfo)
		{
			base.OnRenderSizeChanged(sizeInfo);
			InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		private void OnFlowDirectionChanged(FlowDirection oldValue, FlowDirection newValue)
		{
			if (Bounds != null)
			{
				Bounds.CoerceRTL = true;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnPropertyChanged(e);
			if (e.Property == UIElement.VisibilityProperty)
			{
				InvalidateMeasure();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateRibbonWindow()
		{
			Window window = Window.GetWindow(this);
			RibbonWindow = (IRibbonWindow)(object)((window is IRibbonWindow) ? window : null);
		}

		protected virtual void OnCaptionContentControlChanged(ContentControl oldValue)
		{
			InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		protected virtual void OnRibbonStyleChanged(RibbonStyle oldValue)
		{
			InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		protected virtual void OnQuickAccessToolbarContainerChanged(ContentControl oldValue, ContentControl newValue)
		{
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				QuickAccessToolbar = TreeHelper.GetChild<RibbonQuickAccessToolbarControl>((DependencyObject)newValue, (Func<RibbonQuickAccessToolbarControl, bool>)null);
			}
			InvalidateMeasure();
		}
	}
	public class TitleToMinTextWidthConverter : MarkupExtension, IValueConverter
	{
		public override object ProvideValue(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
		{
			return this;
		}

		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (!(value is string { Length: var length } text))
			{
				return value;
			}
			if (length == 0)
			{
				return text;
			}
			return ((length <= 3) ? text : text.Remove(3)) + "...";
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return value;
		}
	}
}

		private void TabsCustomizationControl_AddInItems(object sender, AddWrapperItemEventArgs e)
		{

			if (treeViewItem != null)

				treeViewItem.IsExpanded = true;

				}

			}

			if (num2 >= 0 && num2 < array.Length - 1)
			{

		{

		protected virtual void OnRightTabsModeChanged(int oldValue)
		{
			if (RightTabsMode == 0)
			{
				RibbonWrapper.ShowMainTabs = true;
				RibbonWrapper.ShowToolTabs = true;
			}
			else if (RightTabsMode == 1)
			{
				RibbonWrapper.ShowMainTabs = true;
				RibbonWrapper.ShowToolTabs = false;
			}
			else if (RightTabsMode == 2)
			{
				RibbonWrapper.ShowMainTabs = false;
				RibbonWrapper.ShowToolTabs = true;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateLeftSource()
		{
			if (LeftTabsMode == 1)
			{
				LeftSource = new RibbonElementWrapper(Ribbon, skipCustomizations: true, this).Items;
				return;
			}
			LeftSource = (from x in (from x in Ribbon.ActualMergedChildren.Concat(new RibbonControl[1] { Ribbon })
					where x != null
					select x).SelectMany((RibbonControl ribbon) => BarNameScope.GetService<IElementRegistratorService>((object)ribbon).GetElements<IFrameworkInputElement>((ScopeSearchSettings)3).OfType<BarItem>()).Distinct()
				where !x.IsPrivate || ((DependencyObject)(object)x).GetValue(ItemsAttachedBehaviorSourceProperty) != null
				where !(x is BarItemSeparator)
				select new BarItemElementWrapper(x, this) into x
				where x.IsDropDown || x.IsEditor || x.IsMenu || x.Content != null
				orderby x.Content
				select x).ToArray();
		}

		private TreeViewItem FindTreeItem(ElementWrapper element)
		{
			return FindTreeItem(element, rightTreeView);
		}

		private TreeViewItem FindTreeItem(ElementWrapper element, TreeView container)
		{
			List<ElementWrapper> list = new List<ElementWrapper>();
			list.Add(element);
			ElementWrapper parentWrapper = element.ParentWrapper;
			TreeViewItem treeViewItem;
			if (parentWrapper.ParentWrapper != null)
			{
				while (parentWrapper.ParentWrapper.ParentWrapper != null)
				{
					list.Add(parentWrapper);
					parentWrapper = parentWrapper.ParentWrapper;
				}
				treeViewItem = (TreeViewItem)container.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(parentWrapper);
				while (list.Count > 0)
				{
					treeViewItem.UpdateLayout();
					treeViewItem = (TreeViewItem)treeViewItem.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(list.Last());
					if (treeViewItem == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					if (!treeViewItem.IsExpanded)
					{
						treeViewItem.IsExpanded = true;
						treeViewItem.UpdateLayout();
					}
					list.RemoveAt(list.Count - 1);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				treeViewItem = (TreeViewItem)container.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(parentWrapper);
			}
			if (treeViewItem != null)
			{
				treeViewItem.IsExpanded = false;
			}
			return treeViewItem;
		}

	public class BarItemLinkToImageNameConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		static BarItemLinkToImageNameConverter()
		{
		}

		public static object Convert(object value)
		{
			return new BarItemLinkToImageNameConverter().Convert(value, null, null, null);
		}

		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value is BarItemLink)
			{
				value = ((BarItemLinkBase)((value is BarItemLink) ? value : null)).Item;
			}
			bool flag = value is BarSplitButtonItem || value is BarSplitButtonItemLink;
			bool flag2 = value is BarSubItem || value is BarSubItemLink;
			bool flag3 = value is BarEditItem || value is BarEditItemLink;
			if (flag && !flag2 && !flag3)
			{
				return "barSplitButtonItemCustomizationIcon.png";
			}
			if (!flag && flag2 && !flag3)
			{
				return "barSubItemCustomizationIcon.png";
			}
			if (!flag && !flag2 && flag3)
			{
				return "barEditItemCustomizationIcon.png";
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}

	public class RibbonModelBuilder
	{
		public virtual RibbonControlModel GetDefaultLayout(RibbonControl ribbon)
		{
			RibbonControlModel ribbonControlModel = new RibbonControlModel();
			foreach (RibbonPageCategoryBase selfCategory in ribbon.SelfCategories)
			{
				RibbonPageCategoryModel ribbonPageCategoryModel = new RibbonPageCategoryModel(ribbonControlModel);
				ribbonPageCategoryModel.CustomizationID = selfCategory.With((Func<RibbonPageCategoryBase, string>)BarManagerCustomizationHelper.GetSerializationName);
				ribbonPageCategoryModel.IsDefault = selfCategory.IsDefault;
				ribbonControlModel.Categories.Add(ribbonPageCategoryModel);
				foreach (RibbonPage page in selfCategory.Pages)
				{
					RibbonPageModel ribbonPageModel = new RibbonPageModel(ribbonPageCategoryModel);
					ribbonPageModel.CustomizationID = page.With((Func<RibbonPage, string>)BarManagerCustomizationHelper.GetSerializationName);
					ribbonPageCategoryModel.Pages.Add(ribbonPageModel);
					ribbonPageModel.Caption = Convert.ToString(page.Caption);
					foreach (RibbonPageGroup group in page.Groups)
					{
						RibbonPageGroupModel ribbonPageGroupModel = new RibbonPageGroupModel(ribbonPageModel);
						ribbonPageGroupModel.Caption = group.Caption;
						string customizationID = (ribbonPageGroupModel.SerializationName = group.With((Func<RibbonPageGroup, string>)BarManagerCustomizationHelper.GetSerializationName));
						ribbonPageGroupModel.CustomizationID = customizationID;
						ribbonPageModel.Groups.Add(ribbonPageGroupModel);
						AddLinkFromHolder(ribbonPageGroupModel, group.ItemLinks, ribbonPageGroupModel.ItemLinks);
					}
				}
			}
			ribbonControlModel.ToolbarName = ribbon.Toolbar.With((Func<RibbonQuickAccessToolbar, string>)BarManagerCustomizationHelper.GetSerializationName);
			ribbonControlModel.HeaderName = ribbon.PageHeaderLinksControl.With((Func<RibbonPageHeaderLinksControl, string>)BarManagerCustomizationHelper.GetSerializationName);
			AddLinkFromHolder(ribbonControlModel, ribbon.ToolbarItemLinks, ribbonControlModel.ToolbarItems);
			AddLinkFromHolder(ribbonControlModel, ribbon.PageHeaderItemLinks, ribbonControlModel.HeaderItems);
			return ribbonControlModel;
		}

		protected void AddLinkFromHolder(BaseSerializationModel parentModel, BarItemLinkCollection elementCollection, List<ItemLinkModel> modelCollection)
		{
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0015: Expected O, but got Unknown
			foreach (BarItemLink item in (Collection<BarItemLinkBase>)(object)elementCollection)
			{
				BarItemLink val = item;
				ItemLinkModel itemLinkModel = new ItemLinkModel(parentModel);
				itemLinkModel.BarItemName = ((BarItemLinkBase)val).BarItemName;
				itemLinkModel.SerializationName = val.With((Func<BarItemLink, string>)BarManagerCustomizationHelper.GetSerializationName);
				modelCollection.Add(itemLinkModel);
			}
		}
	}

				{
					Match match = Regex.Match(page.CustomizationID, "C[0-9]+P([0-9]+)");
					if (match.Success)
					{
						int num = int.Parse(match.Groups[1].Value);
						if (IListExtensions.IsValidIndex<RibbonPageModel>((IList<RibbonPageModel>)defaultModel.Pages, num))
						{
							ribbonPageModel = defaultModel.Pages[num];
						}
					}
					else
					{
						ribbonPageModel = defaultModel.Pages.FirstOrDefault((RibbonPageModel x) => x.CustomizationID == page.CustomizationID);
					}
				}
				if (ribbonPageModel == null)
				{
					CreateCustomizationsForPage(page, defaultModel.CustomizationID, customizations);
					continue;
				}
				list.Remove(ribbonPageModel);
				ComparePages(ribbonPageModel, page, customizations);
			}
			foreach (RibbonPageModel item in list)
			{
				customizations.Add((RuntimeCustomization)new RuntimePropertyCustomization
				{
					TargetName = item.CustomizationID,
					PropertyName = "IsRemoved",
					OldValue = false,
					NewValue = true
				});
			}
		}

		protected void CompareLayouts(RibbonControlModel defaultLayout, RibbonControlModel loadedLayout, List<RuntimeCustomization> customizations)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < defaultLayout.Categories.Count && i < loadedLayout.Categories.Count; i++)
			{
				CompareCategories(defaultLayout.Categories[i], loadedLayout.Categories[i], customizations);
			}
			ReplaceItemLinksCollections(defaultLayout.ToolbarName, defaultLayout.ToolbarItems, loadedLayout.ToolbarItems, customizations);
			ReplaceItemLinksCollections(defaultLayout.HeaderName, defaultLayout.HeaderItems, loadedLayout.HeaderItems, customizations);
		}

		public bool RestoreLayout(RibbonControl ribbon, object path)
		{
			Stream stream = null;
			if (path == null || !IsEnabled)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			if (path is Stream)
			{
				stream = path as Stream;
			}
			else
			{
				string path2 = Convert.ToString(path);
				if (File.Exists(path2))
				{
					stream = new FileStream(path2, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read);
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			if (stream == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			try
			{
				long position = stream.Position;
				XDocument doc = SafeXml.CreateXDocument(stream, (Action<XmlReaderSettings>)null);
				if (IsNewLayoutVersion(doc))
				{
					stream.Position = position;
					return false;
				}
				RibbonControlModel loadedLayout = XMLModelBuilder.ReadLayoutStream(doc);
				RibbonControlModel defaultLayout = RibbonModelBuilder.GetDefaultLayout(ribbon);
				List<RuntimeCustomization> list = new List<RuntimeCustomization>();
				CompareLayouts(defaultLayout, loadedLayout, list);
				ribbon.RuntimeCustomizations.Undo(true, false);
				foreach (RuntimeCustomization item in list)
				{
					((Collection<RuntimeCustomization>)(object)ribbon.RuntimeCustomizations).Add(item);
				}
				ribbon.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(new Action(ribbon.RuntimeCustomizations.Apply), DispatcherPriority.Background);
				return true;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					stream.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool IsNewLayoutVersion(XDocument doc)
		{
			return XMLModelBuilder.GetDescendants(doc, "RuntimeCustomizations").Any();
		}
	}
	public class XMLModelBuilder
	{
		private static XName nameAttribute = XName.Get("name");

		protected virtual ItemLinkModel CreateItemLinkModel(BaseSerializationModel parentModel)
		{
			return new ItemLinkModel(parentModel);
		}

		protected virtual RibbonPageGroupModel CreatePageGroupModel(RibbonPageModel pageModel)
		{
			return new RibbonPageGroupModel(pageModel);
		}

		protected virtual RibbonPageModel CreatePageModel(RibbonPageCategoryModel categoryModel)
		{
			return new RibbonPageModel(categoryModel);
		}

		protected virtual RibbonPageCategoryModel CreatePageCategoryModel(RibbonControlModel ribbonModel)
		{
			return new RibbonPageCategoryModel(ribbonModel);
		}

		protected void AddLink(BaseSerializationModel parentModel, List<ItemLinkModel> collection, XElement xElement)
		{
			ItemLinkModel itemLinkModel = CreateItemLinkModel(parentModel);
			AssignLinkModelProperties(xElement, itemLinkModel);
			collection.Add(itemLinkModel);
		}

		protected virtual void AssignLinkModelProperties(XElement xElement, ItemLinkModel model)
		{
			model.BarItemName = GetElementValue(xElement, "BarItemName");
			model.SerializationName = GetElementValue(xElement, "SerializationName");
			bool.TryParse(GetElementValue(xElement, "IsRemoved", "false"), out var result);
			model.IsRemoved = result;
		}

		protected virtual void AssignGroupModelProperties(XElement xElement, RibbonPageGroupModel model)
		{
			model.Caption = GetElementValue(xElement, "Caption");
			model.SerializationName = GetElementValue(xElement, "SerializationName");
			bool.TryParse(GetElementValue(xElement, "CustomizationInfo.IsOrigin", "false"), out var result);
			model.IsOrigin = result;
			model.CustomizationID = GetElementValue(xElement, "CustomizationInfo.CustomizationID", "false");
		}

		protected virtual void AssignPageModelProperties(XElement xElement, RibbonPageModel model)
		{
			model.Caption = GetElementValue(xElement, "Caption");
			bool.TryParse(GetElementValue(xElement, "CustomizationInfo.IsOrigin", "false"), out var result);
			model.IsOrigin = result;
			model.CustomizationID = GetElementValue(xElement, "CustomizationInfo.CustomizationID", "false");
		}

		protected virtual void AssignCategoryModelProperties(XElement xElement, RibbonPageCategoryModel model)
		{
			bool.TryParse(GetElementValue(xElement, "IsDefault", "false"), out var result);
			model.IsDefault = result;
		}

		protected void AddGroup(RibbonPageModel pageModel, List<RibbonPageGroupModel> collection, XElement xElement)
		{
			RibbonPageGroupModel ribbonPageGroupModel = CreatePageGroupModel(pageModel);
			AssignGroupModelProperties(xElement, ribbonPageGroupModel);
			collection.Add(ribbonPageGroupModel);
			foreach (XElement item in EnumerateElementsForNode(xElement, "ItemLinks"))
			{
				AddLink(ribbonPageGroupModel, ribbonPageGroupModel.ItemLinks, item);
			}
		}

		protected void AddPage(RibbonPageCategoryModel categoryModel, List<RibbonPageModel> collection, XElement xElement)
		{
			RibbonPageModel ribbonPageModel = CreatePageModel(categoryModel);
			AssignPageModelProperties(xElement, ribbonPageModel);
			collection.Add(ribbonPageModel);
			foreach (XElement item in EnumerateElementsForNode(xElement, "Groups"))
			{
				AddGroup(ribbonPageModel, ribbonPageModel.Groups, item);
			}
		}

		protected void AddCategory(RibbonControlModel ribbonModel, List<RibbonPageCategoryModel> collection, XElement xElement)
		{
			RibbonPageCategoryModel ribbonPageCategoryModel = CreatePageCategoryModel(ribbonModel);
			AssignCategoryModelProperties(xElement, ribbonPageCategoryModel);
			collection.Add(ribbonPageCategoryModel);
			foreach (XElement item in EnumerateElementsForNode(xElement, "Pages"))
			{
				AddPage(ribbonPageCategoryModel, ribbonPageCategoryModel.Pages, item);
			}
		}

		protected internal static IEnumerable<XElement> GetDescendants(XContainer node, string name)
		{
			return from x in node.Descendants()
				where CheckName(x, name)
				select x;
		}

		protected static IEnumerable<XElement> GetElements(XContainer node, string name)
		{
			return from x in node.Elements()
				where CheckName(x, name)
				select x;
		}

		protected static bool CheckName(XElement element, string name)
		{
			XAttribute xAttribute = element.Attribute(nameAttribute);
			if (xAttribute == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return xAttribute.Value == name;
		}

		protected static XElement GetElement(XElement node, string complexPath)
		{
			XElement xElement = node;
			string[] array = complexPath.Split('.');
			foreach (string name in array)
			{
				XElement[] array2 = GetElements(xElement, name).ToArray();
				if (array2.Length == 1)
				{
					xElement = array2[0];
					continue;
				}
				return null;
			}
			return xElement;
		}

		protected static IEnumerable<XElement> EnumerateElementsForNode(XElement node, string complexPath = null)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(complexPath))
			{
				node = GetElement(node, complexPath);
			}
			if (node == null)
			{
				yield break;
			}
			foreach (XElement item in node.Elements())
			{
				yield return item;
			}
		}

		protected static string GetElementValue(XElement node, string complexNPath, string defaultValue = null)
		{
			return GetElement(node, complexNPath).Return((XElement x) => x.Value, () => defaultValue);
		}

		public virtual RibbonControlModel ReadLayoutStream(XDocument doc)
		{
			XElement node = GetDescendants(doc, "$ribbonControl").Single();
			RibbonControlModel ribbonControlModel = new RibbonControlModel();
			Enum.TryParse<RibbonQuickAccessToolbarShowMode>(GetElementValue(node, "ToolbarShowMode", "Default"), out var result);
			ribbonControlModel.ToolbarShowMode = result;
			bool.TryParse(GetElementValue(node, "IsMinimized", "false"), out var result2);
			ribbonControlModel.IsMinimized = result2;
			foreach (XElement item in EnumerateElementsForNode(node, "Categories"))
			{
				AddCategory(ribbonControlModel, ribbonControlModel.Categories, item);
			}
			foreach (XElement item2 in EnumerateElementsForNode(node, "PageHeaderLinksControl.ItemLinks"))
			{
				AddLink(ribbonControlModel, ribbonControlModel.HeaderItems, item2);
			}
			foreach (XElement item3 in EnumerateElementsForNode(node, "Toolbar.ItemLinks"))
			{
				AddLink(ribbonControlModel, ribbonControlModel.ToolbarItems, item3);
			}
			return ribbonControlModel;
		}
	}
}

	public class RibbonControlAutomationPeer : BaseNavigationAutomationPeer, IExpandCollapseProvider
	{
		private RibbonTabsAutomationPeer tabsPeer;

		public ExpandCollapseState ExpandCollapseState
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonControl).IsMinimized)
				{
					return ExpandCollapseState.Expanded;
				}
				return ExpandCollapseState.Collapsed;
			}
		}

		public RibbonControlAutomationPeer(RibbonControl control)
			: base((FrameworkElement)control)
		{
		}

		protected override void SetFocusCore()
		{
			(((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonControl).Focus();
		}

		protected override List<AutomationPeer> GetChildrenCore()
		{
			RibbonControl ribbonControl = ((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonControl;
			List<AutomationPeer> list = new List<AutomationPeer>();
			GetTabsScrollViewer(ribbonControl);
			if (tabsPeer != null)
			{
				list.Add((AutomationPeer)(object)tabsPeer);
			}
			if (!ribbonControl.IsMinimized && ribbonControl.SelectedPageControl != null)
			{
				AutomationPeer automationPeer = UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(ribbonControl.SelectedPageControl);
				if (automationPeer != null)
				{
					list.Add(automationPeer);
				}
			}
			if (ribbonControl.ApplicationButton != null)
			{
				AutomationPeer automationPeer2 = UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(ribbonControl.ApplicationButton);
				if (automationPeer2 != null)
				{
					list.Add(automationPeer2);
				}
			}
			if (ribbonControl.Toolbar != null && ribbonControl.Toolbar.Control != null)
			{
				AutomationPeer automationPeer3 = UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement((UIElement)(object)ribbonControl.Toolbar.Control);
				if (automationPeer3 != null)
				{
					list.Add(automationPeer3);
				}
			}
			if (ribbonControl.MinimizationButtonPosition == MinimizationButtonPosition.PageHeader)
			{
				if (ribbonControl.MinimizationButtonInPageHeader != null && ribbonControl.MinimizationButtonInPageHeader.IsVisible && UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(ribbonControl.MinimizationButtonInPageHeader) is RibbonCheckedBorderControlAutomationPeer ribbonCheckedBorderControlAutomationPeer)
				{
					list.Add((AutomationPeer)(object)ribbonCheckedBorderControlAutomationPeer);
					ribbonCheckedBorderControlAutomationPeer.parent = ribbonControl;
					ribbonCheckedBorderControlAutomationPeer.role = RibbonCheckedBorderRole.expander;
				}
			}
			else if (!ribbonControl.IsMinimized && ribbonControl.SelectedPageControl != null && ribbonControl.SelectedPageControl.MinimizationButton != null && ribbonControl.SelectedPageControl.MinimizationButton.IsVisible && UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(ribbonControl.SelectedPageControl.MinimizationButton) is RibbonCheckedBorderControlAutomationPeer ribbonCheckedBorderControlAutomationPeer2)
			{
				list.Add((AutomationPeer)(object)ribbonCheckedBorderControlAutomationPeer2);
				ribbonCheckedBorderControlAutomationPeer2.parent = ribbonControl;
				ribbonCheckedBorderControlAutomationPeer2.role = RibbonCheckedBorderRole.expander;
			}
			if (ribbonControl.PageHeaderItemLinks != null && ((Collection<BarItemLinkBase>)(object)ribbonControl.PageHeaderItemLinks).Count != 0 && ribbonControl.PageHeaderLinksControlContainer != null)
			{
				List<AutomationPeer> children = new FrameworkElementAutomationPeer((FrameworkElement)(object)ribbonControl.PageHeaderLinksControlContainer).GetChildren();
				if (children != null)
				{
					list.AddRange(children);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected override string GetNameCore()
		{
			bool flag = default(bool);
			object obj = ((BaseNavigationAutomationPeer)this).TryGetAutomationPropertyValue(AutomationProperties.NameProperty, ref flag);
			if (flag)
			{
				return (string)obj;
			}
			return "RibbonControl";
		}

		protected override AutomationControlType GetAutomationControlTypeCore()
		{
			return AutomationControlType.Group;
		}

		internal static RibbonTabsAutomationPeer GetTabsScrollViewer(RibbonControl ribbon)
		{
			if (!(UIElementAutomationPeer.FromElement(ribbon) is RibbonControlAutomationPeer ribbonControlAutomationPeer))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (ribbonControlAutomationPeer.tabsPeer != null)
			{
				return ribbonControlAutomationPeer.tabsPeer;
			}
			RibbonPageCategoriesPane categoriesPane = ribbon.CategoriesPane;
			if (categoriesPane == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ScrollViewer scrollHost = categoriesPane.ScrollHost;
			if (scrollHost == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			RibbonTabsAutomationPeer ribbonTabsAutomationPeer = new RibbonTabsAutomationPeer(scrollHost);
			if (categoriesPane.LeftButton is RepeatButton owner)
			{
				ribbonTabsAutomationPeer.leftPeer = new RepeatButtonAutomationPeer(owner);
			}
			if (categoriesPane.RightButton is RepeatButton owner2)
			{
				ribbonTabsAutomationPeer.rightPeer = new RepeatButtonAutomationPeer(owner2);
			}
			ribbonTabsAutomationPeer.Ribbon = ribbon;
			ribbonControlAutomationPeer.tabsPeer = ribbonTabsAutomationPeer;
			return ribbonTabsAutomationPeer;
		}

		public void Collapse()
		{
			if (!(((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonControl).IsMinimized)
			{
				ExpandCollapseState expandCollapseState = ExpandCollapseState;
				(((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonControl).IsMinimized = true;
				((AutomationPeer)this).RaisePropertyChangedEvent(ExpandCollapsePatternIdentifiers.ExpandCollapseStateProperty, (object)expandCollapseState, (object)ExpandCollapseState);
			}
		}

		public void Expand()
		{
			if ((((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonControl).IsMinimized)
			{
				ExpandCollapseState expandCollapseState = ExpandCollapseState;
				(((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonControl).IsMinimized = false;
				((AutomationPeer)this).RaisePropertyChangedEvent(ExpandCollapsePatternIdentifiers.ExpandCollapseStateProperty, (object)expandCollapseState, (object)ExpandCollapseState);
			}
		}

		public override object GetPattern(PatternInterface patternInterface)
		{
			if (patternInterface != PatternInterface.ExpandCollapse)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return this;
		}
	}

			List<AutomationPeer> childrenCore = ((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).GetChildrenCore();
			if (childrenCore == null)

			return AutomationControlType.Group;
		}

		}

		public IRawElementProviderSimple SelectionContainer
		{
			get
			{
				if (((AutomationPeer)this).GetParent() == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return ((AutomationPeer)this).ProviderFromPeer((((AutomationPeer)this).GetParent() is RibbonPageCategoryControlAutomationPeer) ? ((AutomationPeer)this).GetParent().GetParent() : ((AutomationPeer)this).GetParent());
			}
		}

		}

				((AutomationPeer)this).RaiseAutomationEvent(AutomationEvents.SelectionItemPatternOnElementSelected);
			}
		}

		protected override List<AutomationPeer> GetChildrenCore()

			return "Page" + Convert.ToString(ribbonPageHeaderControl.Page.PageCategory.ActualPages.IndexOf(ribbonPageHeaderControl.Page));
		}

		}
