	public class RibbonPageGroupControlAutomationPeer : BaseNavigationAutomationPeer, IScrollItemProvider, IExpandCollapseProvider
	{
		internal RibbonSelectedPageControl lowerRibbon;

		internal bool isOffscreen { get; set; }

		public ExpandCollapseState ExpandCollapseState
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner is RibbonPageGroupControl ribbonPageGroupControl))
				{
					return ExpandCollapseState.LeafNode;
				}
				if (!ribbonPageGroupControl.IsCollapsed)
				{
					return ExpandCollapseState.LeafNode;
				}
				if (!ribbonPageGroupControl.IsPopupOpened)
				{
					return ExpandCollapseState.Collapsed;
				}
				return ExpandCollapseState.Expanded;
			}
		}

		public RibbonPageGroupControlAutomationPeer(RibbonPageGroupControl control)
			: base((FrameworkElement)(object)control)
		{
		}

		protected override void SetFocusCore()
		{
			((UIElement)(object)(((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonPageGroupControl)).Focus();
		}

		protected override bool IsOffscreenCore()
		{
			return isOffscreen;
		}

		protected override Rect GetBoundingRectangleCore()
		{
			if (!isOffscreen)
			{
				return ((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).GetBoundingRectangleCore();
			}
			return default(Rect);
		}

		protected override string GetNameCore()
		{
			bool flag = default(bool);
			object obj = ((BaseNavigationAutomationPeer)this).TryGetAutomationPropertyValue(AutomationProperties.NameProperty, ref flag);
			if (flag)
			{
				return (string)obj;
			}
			if ((((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonPageGroupControl).PageGroup == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty((((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonPageGroupControl).PageGroup.Caption))
			{
				return (((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonPageGroupControl).PageGroup.Caption;
			}
			return "PageGroup" + (((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonPageGroupControl).PageGroup.Page.Groups.IndexOf((((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonPageGroupControl).PageGroup);
		}

		protected override List<AutomationPeer> GetChildrenCore()
		{
			if (!(((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner is RibbonPageGroupControl ribbonPageGroupControl))
			{
				return ((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).GetChildrenCore();
			}
			List<AutomationPeer> list = new List<AutomationPeer>();
			if (ExpandCollapseState != ExpandCollapseState.LeafNode)
			{
				AddFirstVisiblePeer((FrameworkElement)(object)ribbonPageGroupControl.PopupGroup, list);
				return list;
			}
			foreach (object item in ((ItemsControl)(object)ribbonPageGroupControl).ItemsSource)
			{
				if (item != null && ((ItemsControl)(object)ribbonPageGroupControl).ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(item) is FrameworkElement { IsVisible: not false } frameworkElement)
				{
					AddFirstVisiblePeer(frameworkElement, list);
				}
			}
			if (ribbonPageGroupControl.CaptionButton != null && ribbonPageGroupControl.CaptionButton.IsVisible)
			{
				UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(ribbonPageGroupControl.CaptionButton).Do(list.Add);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static void AddFirstVisiblePeer(FrameworkElement item, List<AutomationPeer> children)
		{
			foreach (FrameworkElement item2 in from x in TreeHelper.GetChildren<FrameworkElement>((DependencyObject)item, (Func<FrameworkElement, bool>)null)
				where x.IsVisible
				select x)
			{
				AutomationPeer automationPeer = UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(item2);
				if (automationPeer != null)
				{
					children.Add(automationPeer);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override AutomationControlType GetAutomationControlTypeCore()
		{
			return AutomationControlType.Group;
		}

		protected internal virtual void SetIsOffscreen(bool value)
		{
			bool flag = isOffscreen;
			isOffscreen = value;
			((AutomationPeer)this).RaisePropertyChangedEvent(AutomationElementIdentifiers.IsOffscreenProperty, (object)flag, (object)value);
		}

		public void ScrollIntoView()
		{
			if ((((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonPageGroupControl).PageGroup == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!(((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonPageGroupControl).PageGroup.IsVisible)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Item cannot be scrolled into view");
			}
			if (lowerRibbon != null && lowerRibbon.SelectedPage != null && lowerRibbon.SelectedPage.Groups != null)
			{
				int visibleGroupIndex = lowerRibbon.SelectedPage.Groups.IndexOf((((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonPageGroupControl).PageGroup);
				double groupHorizontalOffsetInScrollViewer = lowerRibbon.GetGroupHorizontalOffsetInScrollViewer(visibleGroupIndex);
				if (lowerRibbon.ScrollViewer != null)
				{
					lowerRibbon.ScrollViewer.ScrollToHorizontalOffset(groupHorizontalOffsetInScrollViewer);
				}
			}
		}

		public override object GetPattern(PatternInterface patternInterface)
		{
			switch (patternInterface)
			{
			case PatternInterface.ScrollItem:
				return this;
			case PatternInterface.ExpandCollapse:
				if ((((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonPageGroupControl).Return((RibbonPageGroupControl x) => x.IsCollapsed, () => false))
				{
					return this;
				}
				break;
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<DependencyObject> GetAttachedAutomationPropertySource()
		{
			yield return (((UIElementAutomationPeer)(object)this).Owner as RibbonPageGroupControl).PageGroup;
			yield return ((UIElementAutomationPeer)(object)this).Owner;
		}

		public void Expand()
		{
			(((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonPageGroupControl)?.OpenPopup();
		}

		public void Collapse()
		{
			(((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonPageGroupControl)?.ClosePopup();
		}
	}
	internal enum RibbonCheckedBorderRole
	{
		customization,
		expander
	}
	public class RibbonCheckedBorderControlAutomationPeer : BaseNavigationAutomationPeer, IInvokeProvider, IExpandCollapseProvider, IToggleProvider
	{
		internal object parent;

		internal RibbonCheckedBorderRole role;

		public ExpandCollapseState ExpandCollapseState
		{
			get
			{
				if ((parent as RibbonQuickAccessToolbarControl).CustomizationButton == null)
				{
					return ExpandCollapseState.LeafNode;
				}
				if ((parent as RibbonQuickAccessToolbarControl).CustomizationButton.IsChecked != true)
				{
					return ExpandCollapseState.Collapsed;
				}
				return ExpandCollapseState.Expanded;
			}
		}

		public ToggleState ToggleState
		{
			get
			{
				if (parent is RibbonControl)
				{
					if (!(parent as RibbonControl).IsMinimized)
					{
						return ToggleState.Off;
					}
					return ToggleState.On;
				}
				if (parent is BackstageViewControlAutomationPeer)
				{
					if (!(((UIElementAutomationPeer)(object)(parent as BackstageViewControlAutomationPeer)).Owner is BackstageViewControl backstageViewControl))
					{
						return ToggleState.Indeterminate;
					}
					if (!backstageViewControl.IsOpen)
					{
						return ToggleState.Off;
					}
					return ToggleState.On;
				}
				return ToggleState.Indeterminate;
			}
		}

		public RibbonCheckedBorderControlAutomationPeer(RibbonCheckedBorderControl control)
			: base((FrameworkElement)control)
		{
		}

		protected override void SetFocusCore()
		{
			(((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonCheckedBorderControl).Focus();
		}

		protected override string GetNameCore()
		{
			bool flag = default(bool);
			object obj = ((BaseNavigationAutomationPeer)this).TryGetAutomationPropertyValue(AutomationProperties.NameProperty, ref flag);
			if (flag)
			{
				return (string)obj;
			}
			if (parent is RibbonPageGroup && ((AutomationPeer)this).GetParent() is RibbonPageGroupControlAutomationPeer ribbonPageGroupControlAutomationPeer && ((UIElementAutomationPeer)(object)ribbonPageGroupControlAutomationPeer).Owner is RibbonPageGroupControl && (((UIElementAutomationPeer)(object)ribbonPageGroupControlAutomationPeer).Owner as RibbonPageGroupControl).PageGroup != null)
			{
				RibbonPageGroup pageGroup = (((UIElementAutomationPeer)(object)ribbonPageGroupControlAutomationPeer).Owner as RibbonPageGroupControl).PageGroup;
				return (string.IsNullOrEmpty(pageGroup.Caption) ? ((AutomationPeer)(object)ribbonPageGroupControlAutomationPeer).GetName() : pageGroup.Caption) + " CaptionButton";
			}
			if (parent is RibbonQuickAccessToolbarControl)
			{
				if (role == RibbonCheckedBorderRole.customization)
				{
					return "Customize Toolbar";
				}
				if (role == RibbonCheckedBorderRole.expander)
				{
					return "DropDownButton";
				}
			}
			if (parent is RibbonControl)
			{
				return "Minimize Ribbon";
			}
			if (parent is RibbonGalleryBarItemLinkControlAutomationPeer)
			{
				return "Expand Gallery";
			}
			if (parent is BackstageViewControlAutomationPeer)
			{
				return "Hide Backstage View";
			}
			return "";
		}

		protected override AutomationControlType GetAutomationControlTypeCore()
		{
			return AutomationControlType.Button;
		}

		public void Invoke()
		{
			if (parent is RibbonPageGroup)
			{
				if ((parent as RibbonPageGroup).FirstPageGroupControl == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				(parent as RibbonPageGroup).FirstPageGroupControl.OnCaptionButtonClick();
			}
			((AutomationPeer)this).RaiseAutomationEvent(AutomationEvents.InvokePatternOnInvoked);
		}

		public void Collapse()
		{
			if (!(parent is RibbonQuickAccessToolbarControl) || ((role != RibbonCheckedBorderRole.customization || (parent as RibbonQuickAccessToolbarControl).CustomizationMenu == null || !((Popup)(object)(parent as RibbonQuickAccessToolbarControl).CustomizationMenu).IsOpen) && (role != RibbonCheckedBorderRole.expander || (parent as RibbonQuickAccessToolbarControl).DropDownButton == null || (parent as RibbonQuickAccessToolbarControl).DropDownButton.IsChecked != true)))
			{
				return;
			}
			ExpandCollapseState expandCollapseState = ExpandCollapseState;
			if (parent is RibbonQuickAccessToolbarControl ribbonQuickAccessToolbarControl)
			{
				if (role == RibbonCheckedBorderRole.customization)
				{
					ribbonQuickAccessToolbarControl.CloseCustomizationMenu();
				}
				if (role == RibbonCheckedBorderRole.expander)
				{
					ribbonQuickAccessToolbarControl.DropDownButton.IsChecked = false;
					ribbonQuickAccessToolbarControl.IsPopupOpened = false;
				}
				((AutomationPeer)this).RaisePropertyChangedEvent(ExpandCollapsePatternIdentifiers.ExpandCollapseStateProperty, (object)expandCollapseState, (object)ExpandCollapseState);
			}
		}

		public void Expand()
		{
			if (!(parent is RibbonQuickAccessToolbarControl) || ((role != RibbonCheckedBorderRole.customization || (parent as RibbonQuickAccessToolbarControl).CustomizationMenu == null || ((Popup)(object)(parent as RibbonQuickAccessToolbarControl).CustomizationMenu).IsOpen) && (role != RibbonCheckedBorderRole.expander || (parent as RibbonQuickAccessToolbarControl).DropDownButton == null || (parent as RibbonQuickAccessToolbarControl).DropDownButton.IsChecked == true)))
			{
				return;
			}
			ExpandCollapseState expandCollapseState = ExpandCollapseState;
			if (parent is RibbonQuickAccessToolbarControl ribbonQuickAccessToolbarControl)
			{
				if (role == RibbonCheckedBorderRole.customization)
				{
					ribbonQuickAccessToolbarControl.CustomizationButton.IsChecked = true;
					ribbonQuickAccessToolbarControl.ShowCustomizationMenu();
				}
				if (role == RibbonCheckedBorderRole.expander)
				{
					ribbonQuickAccessToolbarControl.DropDownButton.IsChecked = true;
					ribbonQuickAccessToolbarControl.IsPopupOpened = true;
				}
				((AutomationPeer)this).RaisePropertyChangedEvent(ExpandCollapsePatternIdentifiers.ExpandCollapseStateProperty, (object)expandCollapseState, (object)ExpandCollapseState);
			}
		}

		public void Toggle()
		{
			ToggleState toggleState = ToggleState;
			if (parent is RibbonControl)
			{
				(parent as RibbonControl).IsMinimized = !(parent as RibbonControl).IsMinimized;
			}
			if (parent is BackstageViewControlAutomationPeer)
			{
				if (!(((UIElementAutomationPeer)(object)(parent as BackstageViewControlAutomationPeer)).Owner is BackstageViewControl backstageViewControl))
				{
					return;
				}
				backstageViewControl.IsOpen = !backstageViewControl.IsOpen;
			}
			((AutomationPeer)this).RaisePropertyChangedEvent(TogglePatternIdentifiers.ToggleStateProperty, (object)toggleState, (object)ToggleState);
		}

		public override object GetPattern(PatternInterface patternInterface)
		{
			switch (patternInterface)
			{
			case PatternInterface.Invoke:
				if (!(parent is RibbonPageGroup))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return this;
			case PatternInterface.ExpandCollapse:
				if (!(parent is RibbonQuickAccessToolbarControl))
				{
					if (!(parent is RibbonGalleryBarItemLinkControlAutomationPeer))
					{
						return null;
					}
					return parent as IExpandCollapseProvider;
				}
				return this;
			case PatternInterface.Toggle:
				if (!(parent is RibbonControl) && !(parent is BackstageViewControlAutomationPeer))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return this;
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}
	}
	public class QuickAccessToolbarAutomationPeer : BaseNavigationAutomationPeer
	{
		private RibbonCheckedBorderControlAutomationPeer customizationButton;

		private RibbonCheckedBorderControlAutomationPeer dropdownButton;

		public QuickAccessToolbarAutomationPeer(RibbonQuickAccessToolbarControl control)
			: base((FrameworkElement)(object)control)
		{
		}

		protected override AutomationControlType GetAutomationControlTypeCore()
		{
			return AutomationControlType.ToolBar;
		}

		protected override void SetFocusCore()
		{
			((UIElement)(object)(((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonQuickAccessToolbarControl)).Focus();
		}

		protected override List<AutomationPeer> GetChildrenCore()
		{
			RibbonQuickAccessToolbarControl ribbonQuickAccessToolbarControl = ((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonQuickAccessToolbarControl;
			List<AutomationPeer> list = new List<AutomationPeer>();
			foreach (BarItemLinkBase item in (Collection<BarItemLinkBase>)(object)((LinksControl)ribbonQuickAccessToolbarControl).ItemLinks)
			{
				BarItemLink val = (BarItemLink)(object)((item is BarItemLink) ? item : null);
				if (val != null && ((BarItemLinkBase)val).LinkControl != null)
				{
					AutomationPeer automationPeer = UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(((BarItemLinkBase)val).LinkControl as UIElement);
					if (automationPeer != null)
					{
						list.Add(automationPeer);
					}
				}
			}
			if (customizationButton == null && ribbonQuickAccessToolbarControl.CustomizationButton != null)
			{
				customizationButton = new RibbonCheckedBorderControlAutomationPeer(ribbonQuickAccessToolbarControl.CustomizationButton)
				{
					parent = ribbonQuickAccessToolbarControl,
					role = RibbonCheckedBorderRole.customization
				};
			}
			RibbonCheckedBorderControl dropDownButton = (((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonQuickAccessToolbarControl).DropDownButton;
			if (dropDownButton != null && ribbonQuickAccessToolbarControl.IsDropDownButtonVisible)
			{
				if (dropdownButton == null)
				{
					dropdownButton = UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(dropDownButton) as RibbonCheckedBorderControlAutomationPeer;
					dropdownButton.parent = ribbonQuickAccessToolbarControl;
					dropdownButton.role = RibbonCheckedBorderRole.expander;
				}
				if (dropdownButton != null)
				{
					list.Add((AutomationPeer)(object)dropdownButton);
				}
			}
			if (customizationButton != null)
			{
				list.Add((AutomationPeer)(object)customizationButton);
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected override string GetNameCore()
		{
			bool flag = default(bool);
			object obj = ((BaseNavigationAutomationPeer)this).TryGetAutomationPropertyValue(AutomationProperties.NameProperty, ref flag);
			if (flag)
			{
				return (string)obj;
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public class LowerRibbonAutomationPeer : BaseNavigationAutomationPeer, IScrollProvider
	{
		private WeakEventHandler<LowerRibbonAutomationPeer, RibbonPropertyChangedEventArgs, RibbonPropertyChangedEventHandler> selectedPageChangedWeakHandler;

		public double HorizontalScrollPercent
		{
			get
			{
				if ((((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonSelectedPageControl).ScrollViewer == null)
				{
					return -1.0;
				}
				if (!HorizontallyScrollable)
				{
					return -1.0;
				}
				return (((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonSelectedPageControl).ScrollViewer.HorizontalOffset / (((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonSelectedPageControl).ScrollViewer.ScrollableWidth * 100.0;
			}
		}

		public double HorizontalViewSize
		{
			get
			{
				if ((((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonSelectedPageControl).ScrollViewer == null)
				{
					return 100.0;
				}
				if (!HorizontallyScrollable)
				{
					return 100.0;
				}
				return (((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonSelectedPageControl).ScrollViewer.ActualWidth / (((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonSelectedPageControl).ScrollViewer.ScrollableWidth * 100.0;
			}
		}

		public bool HorizontallyScrollable
		{
			get
			{
				if ((((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonSelectedPageControl).ScrollViewer == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if ((((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonSelectedPageControl).ScrollViewer.ActualWidth < (((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonSelectedPageControl).ScrollViewer.ScrollableWidth)
				{
					return (((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonSelectedPageControl).ScrollViewer.ScrollableWidth != 0.0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public double VerticalScrollPercent => -1.0;

		public double VerticalViewSize => 100.0;

		public bool VerticallyScrollable => false;

		public LowerRibbonAutomationPeer(RibbonSelectedPageControl control)
			: base((FrameworkElement)control)
		{
			control.Ribbon.SelectedPageChanged += (selectedPageChangedWeakHandler = new WeakEventHandler<LowerRibbonAutomationPeer, RibbonPropertyChangedEventArgs, RibbonPropertyChangedEventHandler>(this, (Action<LowerRibbonAutomationPeer, object, RibbonPropertyChangedEventArgs>)delegate(LowerRibbonAutomationPeer owner, object sender, RibbonPropertyChangedEventArgs args)
			{
				owner.OnSelectedPageChanged();
			}, (Action<WeakEventHandler<LowerRibbonAutomationPeer, RibbonPropertyChangedEventArgs, RibbonPropertyChangedEventHandler>, object>)delegate(WeakEventHandler<LowerRibbonAutomationPeer, RibbonPropertyChangedEventArgs, RibbonPropertyChangedEventHandler> wh, object sender)
			{
				((RibbonControl)sender).SelectedPageChanged -= wh.Handler;
			}, (Func<WeakEventHandler<LowerRibbonAutomationPeer, RibbonPropertyChangedEventArgs, RibbonPropertyChangedEventHandler>, RibbonPropertyChangedEventHandler>)((WeakEventHandler<LowerRibbonAutomationPeer, RibbonPropertyChangedEventArgs, RibbonPropertyChangedEventHandler> wh) => wh.OnEvent))).Handler;
		}

		protected virtual void OnSelectedPageChanged()
		{
			((AutomationPeer)this).ResetChildrenCache();
		}

		protected override AutomationControlType GetAutomationControlTypeCore()
		{
			return AutomationControlType.Pane;
		}

		protected override List<AutomationPeer> GetChildrenCore()
		{
			RibbonSelectedPageControl ribbonSelectedPageControl = ((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonSelectedPageControl;
			List<AutomationPeer> list = new List<AutomationPeer>();
			if (ribbonSelectedPageControl == null)
			{
				return list;
			}
			if (ribbonSelectedPageControl.SelectedPage != null && ribbonSelectedPageControl.SelectedPage.Groups != null && ribbonSelectedPageControl.SelectedPage.ActualGroups != null)
			{
				foreach (RibbonPageGroup actualGroup in ribbonSelectedPageControl.SelectedPage.ActualGroups)
				{
					RibbonPageGroupControl ribbonPageGroupControl = actualGroup.PageGroupControls.FirstOrDefault((RibbonPageGroupControl x) => x.Ribbon == RibbonControl.GetRibbon(((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner));
					if (ribbonPageGroupControl == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					AutomationPeer automationPeer = UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement((UIElement)(object)ribbonPageGroupControl);
					if (automationPeer != null)
					{
						list.Add(UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement((UIElement)(object)ribbonPageGroupControl));
						if (list[list.Count - 1] is RibbonPageGroupControlAutomationPeer)
						{
							(list[list.Count - 1] as RibbonPageGroupControlAutomationPeer).lowerRibbon = ribbonSelectedPageControl;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (ribbonSelectedPageControl.Ribbon != null && ribbonSelectedPageControl.Ribbon.IsMinimized && ribbonSelectedPageControl.MinimizationButton != null && ribbonSelectedPageControl.Ribbon.IsMinimizationButtonVisible && UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(ribbonSelectedPageControl.MinimizationButton) is RibbonCheckedBorderControlAutomationPeer ribbonCheckedBorderControlAutomationPeer)
			{
				list.Add((AutomationPeer)(object)ribbonCheckedBorderControlAutomationPeer);
				ribbonCheckedBorderControlAutomationPeer.parent = ribbonSelectedPageControl;
				ribbonCheckedBorderControlAutomationPeer.role = RibbonCheckedBorderRole.expander;
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected override void SetFocusCore()
		{
			(((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonSelectedPageControl).Focus();
		}

		protected override string GetNameCore()
		{
			bool flag = default(bool);
			object obj = ((BaseNavigationAutomationPeer)this).TryGetAutomationPropertyValue(AutomationProperties.NameProperty, ref flag);
			if (flag)
			{
				return (string)obj;
			}
			return "Lower Ribbon";
		}

		public void Scroll(ScrollAmount horizontalAmount, ScrollAmount verticalAmount)
		{
			if (verticalAmount != ScrollAmount.NoAmount)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			ScrollViewer scrollViewer = (((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonSelectedPageControl).ScrollViewer;
			if (scrollViewer == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			switch (horizontalAmount)
			{
			case ScrollAmount.LargeIncrement:
				if (scrollViewer.HorizontalOffset < scrollViewer.ScrollableWidth)
				{
					scrollViewer.ScrollToHorizontalOffset(scrollViewer.HorizontalOffset + scrollViewer.ActualWidth);
				}
				break;
			case ScrollAmount.LargeDecrement:
				if (scrollViewer.HorizontalOffset > 0.0)
				{
					scrollViewer.ScrollToHorizontalOffset(scrollViewer.HorizontalOffset - scrollViewer.ActualWidth);
				}
				break;
			case ScrollAmount.SmallDecrement:
				if (scrollViewer.HorizontalOffset > 0.0)
				{
					((RibbonSelectedPageControl)((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner).ScrollLeft();
				}
				break;
			case ScrollAmount.SmallIncrement:
				if (scrollViewer.HorizontalOffset < scrollViewer.ScrollableWidth)
				{
					((RibbonSelectedPageControl)((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner).ScrollRight();
				}
				break;
			case ScrollAmount.NoAmount:
				break;
			}
		}

		public void SetScrollPercent(double horizontalPercent, double verticalPercent)
		{
			if (!HorizontallyScrollable)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Lower Ribbon is not scrollable");
			}
			if (verticalPercent != 0.0 && verticalPercent != -1.0)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			if (horizontalPercent > 100.0 || (horizontalPercent < 0.0 && horizontalPercent != -1.0))
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("Value must be greater than 0 or less than 100 (except -1)");
			}
			if (horizontalPercent != -1.0 && (((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonSelectedPageControl).ScrollViewer != null)
			{
				(((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonSelectedPageControl).ScrollViewer.ScrollToHorizontalOffset((((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonSelectedPageControl).ScrollViewer.ScrollableWidth * horizontalPercent / 100.0);
			}
		}

		public override object GetPattern(PatternInterface patternInterface)
		{
			if (patternInterface != PatternInterface.Scroll)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return this;
		}
	}
	public class RibbonTabsAutomationPeer : BaseNavigationAutomationPeer, ISelectionProvider, IScrollProvider
	{
		internal RibbonControl Ribbon;

		internal RepeatButtonAutomationPeer leftPeer;

		internal RepeatButtonAutomationPeer rightPeer;

		internal ScrollViewer scrollViewer;

		public bool CanSelectMultiple => false;

		public bool IsSelectionRequired => true;

		public double HorizontalScrollPercent
		{
			get
			{
				if (scrollViewer == null)
				{
					return -1.0;
				}
				if (!HorizontallyScrollable)
				{
					return -1.0;
				}
				return scrollViewer.HorizontalOffset / scrollViewer.ScrollableWidth * 100.0;
			}
		}

		public double HorizontalViewSize
		{
			get
			{
				if (scrollViewer == null)
				{
					return 100.0;
				}
				if (!HorizontallyScrollable)
				{
					return 100.0;
				}
				return scrollViewer.ActualWidth / scrollViewer.ScrollableWidth * 100.0;
			}
		}

		public bool HorizontallyScrollable
		{
			get
			{
				if (scrollViewer.ActualWidth < scrollViewer.ScrollableWidth)
				{
					return scrollViewer.ScrollableWidth != 0.0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public double VerticalScrollPercent => -1.0;

		public double VerticalViewSize => 100.0;

		public bool VerticallyScrollable => false;

		public RibbonTabsAutomationPeer(ScrollViewer viewer)
			: base((FrameworkElement)viewer)
		{
			scrollViewer = viewer;
		}

		protected override List<AutomationPeer> GetChildrenCore()
		{
			List<AutomationPeer> list = null;
			list = ((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).GetChildrenCore();
			if (list == null)
			{
				return new List<AutomationPeer>();
			}
			if (list.Count((AutomationPeer i) => !(i is RibbonPageCategoryControlAutomationPeer)) != 0)
			{
				list.RemoveAll((AutomationPeer i) => !(i is RibbonPageCategoryControlAutomationPeer));
			}
			AutomationPeer automationPeer = null;
			if (list.Count((AutomationPeer i) => i is RibbonPageCategoryControlAutomationPeer && (i as RibbonPageCategoryControlAutomationPeer).isDefault) != 0)
			{
				automationPeer = list.Find((AutomationPeer i) => i is RibbonPageCategoryControlAutomationPeer && (i as RibbonPageCategoryControlAutomationPeer).isDefault);
			}
			if (automationPeer != null)
			{
				List<AutomationPeer> children = automationPeer.GetChildren();
				if (children != null)
				{
					list.AddRange(children);
				}
				list.Remove(automationPeer);
			}
			SetScrollViewer(list);
			return list;
		}

		protected override void SetFocusCore()
		{
			scrollViewer.Focus();
		}

		protected override AutomationControlType GetAutomationControlTypeCore()
		{
			return AutomationControlType.Tab;
		}

		protected override string GetNameCore()
		{
			bool flag = default(bool);
			object obj = ((BaseNavigationAutomationPeer)this).TryGetAutomationPropertyValue(AutomationProperties.NameProperty, ref flag);
			if (flag)
			{
				return (string)obj;
			}
			return "Ribbon Tabs";
		}

		private void SetScrollViewer(List<AutomationPeer> children)
		{
			foreach (AutomationPeer child in children)
			{
				if (child is RibbonPageHeaderControlAutomationPeer)
				{
					(child as RibbonPageHeaderControlAutomationPeer).scrollViewer = scrollViewer;
				}
				if (child is RibbonPageCategoryControlAutomationPeer)
				{
					List<AutomationPeer> children2 = child.GetChildren();
					if (children2 != null)
					{
						SetScrollViewer(children2);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public IRawElementProviderSimple[] GetSelection()
		{
			RibbonPageHeaderControlAutomationPeer ribbonPageHeaderControlAutomationPeer = null;
			foreach (AutomationPeer child in ((AutomationPeer)this).GetChildren())
			{
				if (child is RibbonPageHeaderControlAutomationPeer && (child as RibbonPageHeaderControlAutomationPeer).IsSelected)
				{
					ribbonPageHeaderControlAutomationPeer = child as RibbonPageHeaderControlAutomationPeer;
				}
				if (!(child is RibbonPageCategoryControlAutomationPeer))
				{
					continue;
				}
				List<AutomationPeer> children = child.GetChildren();
				if (children == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (AutomationPeer item in children)
				{
					if (item is RibbonPageHeaderControlAutomationPeer && (item as RibbonPageHeaderControlAutomationPeer).IsSelected)
					{
						ribbonPageHeaderControlAutomationPeer = item as RibbonPageHeaderControlAutomationPeer;
					}
				}
			}
			if (ribbonPageHeaderControlAutomationPeer == null)
			{
				return new IRawElementProviderSimple[0];
			}
			return new IRawElementProviderSimple[1] { ((AutomationPeer)this).ProviderFromPeer((AutomationPeer)(object)ribbonPageHeaderControlAutomationPeer) };
		}

		public void Scroll(ScrollAmount horizontalAmount, ScrollAmount verticalAmount)
		{
			if (verticalAmount != ScrollAmount.NoAmount)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			if (scrollViewer == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			switch (horizontalAmount)
			{
			case ScrollAmount.LargeIncrement:
				if (scrollViewer.HorizontalOffset < scrollViewer.ScrollableWidth)
				{
					scrollViewer.ScrollToHorizontalOffset(scrollViewer.HorizontalOffset + scrollViewer.ActualWidth);
				}
				break;
			case ScrollAmount.LargeDecrement:
				if (scrollViewer.HorizontalOffset > 0.0)
				{
					scrollViewer.ScrollToHorizontalOffset(scrollViewer.HorizontalOffset - scrollViewer.ActualWidth);
				}
				break;
			case ScrollAmount.SmallDecrement:
				if (scrollViewer.HorizontalOffset > 0.0)
				{
					((IInvokeProvider)leftPeer).Invoke();
				}
				break;
			case ScrollAmount.SmallIncrement:
				if (scrollViewer.HorizontalOffset < scrollViewer.ScrollableWidth)
				{
					((IInvokeProvider)rightPeer).Invoke();
				}
				break;
			case ScrollAmount.NoAmount:
				break;
			}
		}

		public void SetScrollPercent(double horizontalPercent, double verticalPercent)
		{
			if (!HorizontallyScrollable)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Ribbon tabs are not scrollable");
			}
			if (verticalPercent != 0.0 && verticalPercent != -1.0)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			if (horizontalPercent > 100.0 || (horizontalPercent < 0.0 && horizontalPercent != -1.0))
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("Value must be greater than 0 or less than 100 (except -1)");
			}
			if (horizontalPercent != -1.0 && scrollViewer != null)
			{
				scrollViewer.ScrollToHorizontalOffset(scrollViewer.ScrollableWidth * horizontalPercent / 100.0);
			}
		}

		public override object GetPattern(PatternInterface patternInterface)
		{
			return patternInterface switch
			{
				PatternInterface.Scroll => this, 
				PatternInterface.Selection => this, 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}
	}

	public class RibbonGalleryBarItemLinkControlAutomationPeer : BarItemLinkControlAutomationPeer, IExpandCollapseProvider
	{
		private GalleryScrollButtonAutomationPeer up;

		private GalleryScrollButtonAutomationPeer down;

		private RibbonCheckedBorderControlAutomationPeer expand;

		public ExpandCollapseState ExpandCollapseState
		{
			get
			{
				if ((((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonGalleryBarItemLinkControl).DropDownButton == null)
				{
					return ExpandCollapseState.LeafNode;
				}
				if ((((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonGalleryBarItemLinkControl).DropDownButton.IsChecked != true)
				{
					return ExpandCollapseState.Collapsed;
				}
				return ExpandCollapseState.Expanded;
			}
		}

		public RibbonGalleryBarItemLinkControlAutomationPeer(RibbonGalleryBarItemLinkControl control)
			: base((IBarItemLinkControl)(object)control)
		{
		}

		protected override List<AutomationPeer> GetChildrenCore()
		{
			if (up == null && (((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonGalleryBarItemLinkControl).GetTemplateChildCore("PART_Up") is Button)
			{
				up = new GalleryScrollButtonAutomationPeer((((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonGalleryBarItemLinkControl).GetTemplateChildCore("PART_Up") as Button, "Scroll Up");
			}
			if (down == null && (((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonGalleryBarItemLinkControl).GetTemplateChildCore("PART_Down") is Button)
			{
				down = new GalleryScrollButtonAutomationPeer((((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonGalleryBarItemLinkControl).GetTemplateChildCore("PART_Down") as Button, "Scroll Down");
			}
			if (expand == null && (((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonGalleryBarItemLinkControl).GetTemplateChildCore("PART_DropDown") is RibbonCheckedBorderControl)
			{
				expand = new RibbonCheckedBorderControlAutomationPeer((((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonGalleryBarItemLinkControl).GetTemplateChildCore("PART_DropDown") as RibbonCheckedBorderControl)
				{
					parent = this
				};
			}
			AutomationPeer automationPeer = null;
			if ((((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonGalleryBarItemLinkControl).GalleryControl != null)
			{
				automationPeer = UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement((UIElement)(object)(((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonGalleryBarItemLinkControl).GalleryControl);
			}
			List<AutomationPeer> list = new List<AutomationPeer>();
			AutomationPeer[] array = new AutomationPeer[4]
			{
				automationPeer,
				up,
				down,
				(AutomationPeer)(object)expand
			};
			foreach (AutomationPeer automationPeer2 in array)
			{
				if (automationPeer2 != null)
				{
					list.Add(automationPeer2);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public void Collapse()
		{
			if ((((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonGalleryBarItemLinkControl).DropDownButton != null && (((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonGalleryBarItemLinkControl).DropDownButton.IsChecked != false)
			{
				ExpandCollapseState expandCollapseState = ExpandCollapseState;
				(((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonGalleryBarItemLinkControl).ShowDropDownGallery();
				((AutomationPeer)this).RaisePropertyChangedEvent(ExpandCollapsePatternIdentifiers.ExpandCollapseStateProperty, (object)expandCollapseState, (object)ExpandCollapseState);
			}
		}

		public void Expand()
		{
			if ((((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonGalleryBarItemLinkControl).DropDownButton != null && (((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonGalleryBarItemLinkControl).DropDownButton.IsChecked != true)
			{
				ExpandCollapseState expandCollapseState = ExpandCollapseState;
				(((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonGalleryBarItemLinkControl).ShowDropDownGallery();
				((AutomationPeer)this).RaisePropertyChangedEvent(ExpandCollapsePatternIdentifiers.ExpandCollapseStateProperty, (object)expandCollapseState, (object)ExpandCollapseState);
			}
		}

		protected override AutomationControlType GetAutomationControlTypeCore()
		{
			return AutomationControlType.Group;
		}

		protected override string GetNameCore()
		{
			string text = null;
			if (((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner is RibbonGalleryBarItemLinkControl && (((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonGalleryBarItemLinkControl).GalleryLink != null && (((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonGalleryBarItemLinkControl).GalleryLink.GalleryItem != null)
			{
				text = Convert.ToString(((BarItem)(((UIElementAutomationPeer)this).Owner as RibbonGalleryBarItemLinkControl).GalleryLink.GalleryItem).Content);
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return text;
			}
			return "Ribbon Gallery Item";
		}

		public override object GetPattern(PatternInterface patternInterface)
		{
			switch (patternInterface)
			{
			case PatternInterface.ExpandCollapse:
				return this;
			case PatternInterface.Scroll:
				if (((AutomationPeer)(object)this).GetChildrenCore() != null)
				{
					return ((AutomationPeer)(object)this).GetChildrenCore()[0];
				}
				return null;
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.Xpf.Ribbon.Internal
{
	public abstract class ApplicationMenuStrategyBase : IDisposable
	{
		private bool isMenuOpened;

		public RibbonControl Ribbon { get; private set; }

		public bool IsMenuOpened
		{
			get
			{
				return isMenuOpened;
			}
			protected set
			{
				if (isMenuOpened != value)
				{
					isMenuOpened = value;
					OnIsMenuOpenedChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		public static ApplicationMenuStrategyBase CreateStrategy(RibbonControl ribbon, DependencyObject appMenu)
		{
			if (appMenu is ApplicationMenu || appMenu is ApplicationMenuInfo)
			{
				return new ApplicationMenuStrategy(ribbon);
			}
			if (appMenu is BackstageViewControl)
			{
				return new BackstageViewMenuStrategy(ribbon);
			}
			return new UndefinedMenuStrategy(ribbon);
		}

		public abstract void Open();

		public abstract void Close();

		public ApplicationMenuStrategyBase(RibbonControl ribbon)
		{
			if (ribbon == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException();
			}
			Ribbon = ribbon;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			OnDispose();
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsMenuOpenedChanged()
		{
			UpdateApplicationButtonCheckedState();
		}

		protected virtual void OnDispose()
		{
			Ribbon = null;
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateApplicationButtonCheckedState()
		{
			if (Ribbon.ApplicationButton != null)
			{
				Ribbon.ApplicationButton.SetCurrentValue(RibbonApplicationButtonControl.IsCheckedProperty, IsMenuOpened);
			}
		}

		public abstract INavigationOwner GetNavigationOwner();
	}
	public class ApplicationMenuStrategy : ApplicationMenuStrategyBase
	{
		private IPopupControl applicationMenu;

		public IPopupControl ApplicationMenu
		{
			get
			{
				return applicationMenu;
			}
			private set
			{
				if (applicationMenu != value)
				{
					IPopupControl oldValue = applicationMenu;
					applicationMenu = value;
					OnApplicationMenuChanged(oldValue);
				}
			}
		}

		public ApplicationMenuStrategy(RibbonControl ribbon)
			: base(ribbon)
		{
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			ApplicationMenu = (IPopupControl)base.Ribbon.ApplicationMenu;
		}

		public override void Open()
		{
			(ApplicationMenu.Popup as ApplicationMenu).Show(base.Ribbon.ApplicationButton);
		}

		public override void Close()
		{
			ApplicationMenu.ClosePopup();
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			ApplicationMenu = null;
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		protected virtual void OnApplicationMenuOpened(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			base.IsMenuOpened = true;
		}

		protected virtual void OnApplicationMenuClosed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			base.IsMenuOpened = false;
		}

		protected virtual void OnApplicationMenuChanged(IPopupControl oldValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				((ILogicalChildrenContainer)base.Ribbon).RemoveLogicalChild((object)oldValue);
				oldValue.Opened -= OnApplicationMenuOpened;
				oldValue.Closed -= OnApplicationMenuClosed;
			}
			if (ApplicationMenu != null)
			{
				ApplicationMenu.Opened += OnApplicationMenuOpened;
				ApplicationMenu.Closed += OnApplicationMenuClosed;
				if (LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(ApplicationMenu as DependencyObject) == null)
				{
					((ILogicalChildrenContainer)base.Ribbon).AddLogicalChild((object)ApplicationMenu);
				}
			}
		}

		public override INavigationOwner GetNavigationOwner()
		{
			object obj = ApplicationMenu.With((IPopupControl x) => x.Popup).With((BarPopupBase x) => ((PopupBase)x).PopupContent);
			return (INavigationOwner)((obj is INavigationOwner) ? obj : null);
		}
	}

	public class AdornerBackstageViewHost : BackstageViewHostBase
	{
		private FrameworkElement currentContent;

		protected AdornerLayer BackstageViewContentControlAdornerLayer { get; private set; }

		protected AdornerContainer BackstageViewContentControlAdornerContainer { get; private set; }

		public override BackstageViewPlacement Placement => BackstageViewPlacement.Adorner;

		public AdornerBackstageViewHost(RibbonControl ribbon)
			: base(ribbon)
		{
		}

		public override void Show(FrameworkElement adornedElement, FrameworkElement content)
		{
			//IL_000a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0014: Expected O, but got Unknown
			currentContent = content;
			BackstageViewContentControlAdornerContainer = new AdornerContainer((UIElement)adornedElement, (UIElement)content);
			BackstageViewContentControlAdornerLayer = GetAdornerLayer(adornedElement);
			BackstageViewContentControlAdornerLayer.Add((Adorner)(object)BackstageViewContentControlAdornerContainer);
		}

		private AdornerLayer GetAdornerLayer(FrameworkElement adornedElement)
		{
			if (adornedElement is AdornerDecorator)
			{
				return ((AdornerDecorator)adornedElement).AdornerLayer;
			}
			if (adornedElement is ScrollContentPresenter)
			{
				return ((ScrollContentPresenter)adornedElement).AdornerLayer;
			}
			return AdornerLayer.GetAdornerLayer(adornedElement);
		}

		public override void Close()
		{
			currentContent = null;
			BackstageViewContentControlAdornerLayer.Remove((Adorner)(object)BackstageViewContentControlAdornerContainer);
			BackstageViewContentControlAdornerLayer = null;
			BackstageViewContentControlAdornerContainer = null;
		}

		public override void SetPadding(Thickness thickness)
		{
			if (currentContent != null)
			{
				currentContent.SetCurrentValue(FrameworkElement.MarginProperty, thickness);
			}
		}

		public static bool Test(RibbonControl ribbon)
		{
			return true;
		}

	public class WindowBackstageViewHost : BackstageViewHostBase
	{
		[Flags]
		private enum InterestPoints
		{
			None = 0,
			N = 1,
			E = 2,
			S = 4,
			W = 8,
			NE = 3,
			SE = 6,
			SW = 0xC,
			NW = 9
		}

		private Dictionary<Rect, InterestPoints> interestPoints = new Dictionary<Rect, InterestPoints>();

		private Window currentWindow;

		private PinnedWindowBehavior pinnedBehavior;

		private InterestPoints currentInterestPoint;

		private bool isDragging;

		public override BackstageViewPlacement Placement => BackstageViewPlacement.Window;

		public WindowBackstageViewHost(RibbonControl ribbon)
			: base(ribbon)
		{
		}

		public override void Show(FrameworkElement adornedElement, FrameworkElement content)
		{
			//IL_009e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a3: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00aa: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b1: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b3: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_00b8: Expected O, but got Unknown
			Close();
			currentWindow = new Window
			{
				WindowStyle = WindowStyle.None,
				WindowStartupLocation = WindowStartupLocation.Manual,
				Background = null,
				ShowInTaskbar = false,
				ShowActivated = false,
				AllowsTransparency = false,
				ResizeMode = ResizeMode.NoResize
			};
			if (!CommonThemeHelper.UseLightweightThemes)
			{
				currentWindow.SetBinding(ThemeManager.ThemeNameProperty, new Binding
				{
					Source = adornedElement,
					Path = new PropertyPath("(0).ThemeName", ThemeManager.TreeWalkerProperty)
				});
			}
			WindowSystemCommands.SetIsSpecialWindow((DependencyObject)currentWindow, true);
			BehaviorCollection behaviors = Interaction.GetBehaviors((DependencyObject)currentWindow);
			PinnedWindowBehavior val = new PinnedWindowBehavior
			{
				BoundObject = adornedElement,
				Pinned = true
			};
			PinnedWindowBehavior value = val;
			pinnedBehavior = val;
			((FreezableCollection<Behavior>)(object)behaviors).Add((Behavior)(object)value);
			currentWindow.Content = content;
			currentWindow.MouseEnter += CurrentWindowOnMouseEnter;
			currentWindow.MouseLeave += CurrentWindowOnMouseLeave;
			currentWindow.MouseMove += CurrentWindowOnMouseMove;
			currentWindow.SizeChanged += CurrentWindowOnSizeChanged;
			currentWindow.PreviewMouseLeftButtonDown += CurrentWindowOnPreviewMouseLeftButtonDown;
			currentWindow.PreviewMouseLeftButtonUp += CurrentWindowOnPreviewMouseLeftButtonUp;
			currentWindow.Show();
		}

		private Cursor InterestPointToCursor(InterestPoints point)
		{
			switch (point)
			{
			case InterestPoints.N:
			case InterestPoints.S:
				return Cursors.SizeNS;
			case InterestPoints.E:
			case InterestPoints.W:
				return Cursors.SizeWE;
			case InterestPoints.NE:
			case InterestPoints.SW:
				return Cursors.SizeNESW;
			case InterestPoints.SE:
			case InterestPoints.NW:
				return Cursors.SizeNWSE;
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		private void CalcInterestPoints()
		{
			if (interestPoints.Any() || pinnedBehavior == null || pinnedBehavior.BoundWindow == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Window boundWindow = pinnedBehavior.BoundWindow;
			if (boundWindow.ResizeMode != ResizeMode.NoResize && boundWindow.ResizeMode != ResizeMode.CanMinimize)
			{
				Thickness thickness = new Thickness(6.0);
				if (boundWindow.ResizeMode == ResizeMode.CanResizeWithGrip)
				{
					interestPoints.Add(new Rect(new Point(boundWindow.ActualWidth - thickness.Left - thickness.Right, boundWindow.ActualHeight - thickness.Top - thickness.Bottom), new Size(thickness.Right, thickness.Bottom)), InterestPoints.SE);
					return;
				}
				Rect key = new Rect(default(Point), new Size(thickness.Left, boundWindow.ActualHeight));
				Rect key2 = new Rect(default(Point), new Size(boundWindow.ActualWidth, thickness.Top));
				Rect key3 = new Rect(new Point(0.0, boundWindow.ActualHeight - thickness.Bottom), new Size(boundWindow.ActualWidth, thickness.Bottom));
				Rect key4 = new Rect(new Point(boundWindow.ActualWidth - thickness.Right, 0.0), new Size(thickness.Right, boundWindow.ActualHeight));
				interestPoints[key] = InterestPoints.W;
				interestPoints[key2] = InterestPoints.N;
				interestPoints[key4] = InterestPoints.E;
				interestPoints[key3] = InterestPoints.S;
			}
		}

		private void CurrentWindowOnSizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs sizeChangedEventArgs)
		{
			interestPoints.Clear();
		}

		private void CurrentWindowOnMouseMove(object sender, MouseEventArgs mouseEventArgs)
		{
			UpdateCursor();
			if (isDragging)
			{
				Window boundWindow = pinnedBehavior.BoundWindow;
				Point position = Mouse.GetPosition(boundWindow);
				if (currentInterestPoint.HasFlag(InterestPoints.N))
				{
					double num = Math.Max(SystemParameters.MinimumWindowTrackHeight, boundWindow.MinHeight);
					double num2 = Math.Min(position.Y, boundWindow.ActualHeight - num);
					boundWindow.Top += num2;
					boundWindow.Height = boundWindow.ActualHeight - num2;
				}
				if (currentInterestPoint.HasFlag(InterestPoints.W))
				{
					double num3 = Math.Max(SystemParameters.MinimumWindowTrackWidth, boundWindow.MinWidth);
					double num4 = Math.Min(position.X, boundWindow.ActualWidth - num3);
					boundWindow.Left += num4;
					boundWindow.Width = boundWindow.ActualWidth - num4;
				}
				if (currentInterestPoint.HasFlag(InterestPoints.S))
				{
					boundWindow.Height = Math.Max(0.0, boundWindow.ActualHeight + position.Y - boundWindow.ActualHeight);
				}
				if (currentInterestPoint.HasFlag(InterestPoints.E))
				{
					boundWindow.Width = Math.Max(0.0, boundWindow.ActualWidth + position.X - boundWindow.ActualWidth);
				}
			}
		}

		private void CurrentWindowOnMouseLeave(object sender, MouseEventArgs mouseEventArgs)
		{
			UpdateCursor();
		}

		private void CurrentWindowOnMouseEnter(object sender, MouseEventArgs mouseEventArgs)
		{
			UpdateCursor();
		}

		private void CurrentWindowOnPreviewMouseLeftButtonUp(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs mouseButtonEventArgs)
		{
			if (isDragging)
			{
				Mouse.Capture(null);
				isDragging = false;
			}
			UpdateCursor();
		}

		private void CurrentWindowOnPreviewMouseLeftButtonDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs mouseButtonEventArgs)
		{
			UpdateCursor();
			if (currentInterestPoint != InterestPoints.None && currentWindow != null && currentWindow.IsMouseOver && pinnedBehavior != null && pinnedBehavior.BoundWindow != null)
			{
				Mouse.Capture(currentWindow);
				isDragging = true;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateCursor()
		{
			if (isDragging)
			{
				SetOrUpdateCursor(currentInterestPoint);
				return;
			}
			CalcInterestPoints();
			if (currentWindow == null || !currentWindow.IsMouseOver || pinnedBehavior == null || pinnedBehavior.BoundWindow == null)
			{
				Mouse.UpdateCursor();
				currentInterestPoint = InterestPoints.None;
				return;
			}
			Window boundWindow = pinnedBehavior.BoundWindow;
			Point position = Mouse.GetPosition(boundWindow);
			IEnumerable<InterestPoints> enumerable = from x in this.interestPoints
				where x.Key.Contains(position)
				select x.Value;
			InterestPoints interestPoints = InterestPoints.None;
			foreach (InterestPoints item in enumerable)
			{
				interestPoints |= item;
			}
			SetOrUpdateCursor(interestPoints);
			currentInterestPoint = interestPoints;
		}

		private void SetOrUpdateCursor(InterestPoints point)
		{
			Cursor cursor = InterestPointToCursor(point);
			if (cursor != null)
			{
				Mouse.SetCursor(cursor);
			}
			else
			{
				Mouse.UpdateCursor();
			}
		}

		public override void Close()
		{
			if (currentWindow != null)
			{
				currentWindow.Close();
				currentWindow.Content = null;
				if (!CommonThemeHelper.UseLightweightThemes)
				{
					currentWindow.ClearValue(ThemeManager.ThemeNameProperty);
				}
				((FreezableCollection<Behavior>)(object)Interaction.GetBehaviors((DependencyObject)currentWindow)).Clear();
				currentWindow.MouseEnter -= CurrentWindowOnMouseEnter;
				currentWindow.MouseLeave -= CurrentWindowOnMouseLeave;
				currentWindow.MouseMove -= CurrentWindowOnMouseMove;
				currentWindow.SizeChanged -= CurrentWindowOnSizeChanged;
				currentWindow.PreviewMouseLeftButtonDown -= CurrentWindowOnPreviewMouseLeftButtonDown;
				currentWindow.PreviewMouseLeftButtonUp -= CurrentWindowOnPreviewMouseLeftButtonUp;
				pinnedBehavior = null;
				currentWindow = null;
			}
		}

		public override void SetPadding(Thickness thickness)
		{
			if (pinnedBehavior != null)
			{
				pinnedBehavior.Padding = thickness;
			}
		}

		public static bool Test(RibbonControl ribbon)
		{
			return PresentationSource.FromDependencyObject(ribbon).With((PresentationSource x) => x.RootVisual) is Window;
		}
	}
	public class UndefinedMenuStrategy : ApplicationMenuStrategyBase
	{
		private BackstageViewHostBase host;

		private ApplicationMenuContentControl backstageViewContentControl;

		public ApplicationMenuContentControl BackstageViewContentControl
		{
			get
			{
				return backstageViewContentControl;
			}
			private set
			{
				if (backstageViewContentControl != value)
				{
					ApplicationMenuContentControl oldValue = backstageViewContentControl;
					backstageViewContentControl = value;
					OnBackstageViewContentControlChanged(oldValue);
				}
			}
		}

		public UndefinedMenuStrategy(RibbonControl ribbon)
			: base(ribbon)
		{
			host = new AdornerBackstageViewHost(ribbon);
		}

		public override void Open()
		{
			if (base.IsMenuOpened || DependencyObjectExtensions.IsInDesignTool((DependencyObject)base.Ribbon))
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				UpdateHost();
				if (GetBackstageViewRoot() is FrameworkElement adornedElement)
				{
					BackstageViewContentControl = new ApplicationMenuContentControl();
					base.IsMenuOpened = true;
					host.Show(adornedElement, BackstageViewContentControl);
					UpdateBackstageViewOffset();
				}
			}
			catch
			{
				base.IsMenuOpened = false;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateHost()
		{
			BackstageViewPlacement placement = GetPlacement();
			if (host.Placement != placement)
			{
				if (placement == BackstageViewPlacement.Window && WindowBackstageViewHost.Test(base.Ribbon))
				{
					host = new WindowBackstageViewHost(base.Ribbon);
				}
				else
				{
					host = new AdornerBackstageViewHost(base.Ribbon);
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Close()
		{
			if (base.IsMenuOpened && BackstageViewContentControl != null)
			{
				BackstageViewContentControl.Close();
			}
		}

		protected virtual BackstageViewPlacement GetPlacement()
		{
			return BackstageViewPlacement.Adorner;
		}

		protected virtual void OnBackstageViewContentControlChanged(ApplicationMenuContentControl oldValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				oldValue.Content = null;
				oldValue.Closed -= OnClosed;
			}
			if (BackstageViewContentControl != null)
			{
				BackstageViewContentControl.Content = base.Ribbon.ApplicationMenu;
				BackstageViewContentControl.Closed += OnClosed;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnClosed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (BackstageViewContentControl != null)
			{
				BackstageViewContentControl = null;
				host.Close();
				base.IsMenuOpened = false;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnIsMenuOpenedChanged()
		{
			base.OnIsMenuOpenedChanged();
			base.Ribbon.SetValue(RibbonControl.IsBackStageViewOpenPropertyKey, base.IsMenuOpened);
		}

		protected virtual UIElement GetBackstageViewRoot()
		{
			if (base.Ribbon.Manager != null)
			{
				return (UIElement)(object)base.Ribbon.Manager;
			}
			if (base.Ribbon.IsInRibbonWindow)
			{
				return (UIElement)LayoutHelper.FindLayoutOrVisualParentObject((DependencyObject)base.Ribbon, (Predicate<DependencyObject>)((DependencyObject x) => x is AdornerDecorator || x is ScrollContentPresenter), false, (DependencyObject)null);
			}
			return VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(base.Ribbon) as UIElement;
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateBackstageViewOffset()
		{
			host.SetPadding(GetBackstageViewOffset());
		}

		protected virtual Thickness GetBackstageViewOffset()
		{
			if (BackstageViewContentControl == null)
			{
				return default(Thickness);
			}
			if (base.Ribbon.WindowHelper.HasRibbonWindowAsParent && base.Ribbon.WindowHelper.IsAeroMode)
			{
				return new Thickness(0.0, base.Ribbon.HeaderBorder.RenderSize.Height, 0.0, 0.0);
			}
			return default(Thickness);
		}

		public override INavigationOwner GetNavigationOwner()
		{
			return null;
		}
	}
	public class BackstageViewMenuStrategy : UndefinedMenuStrategy
	{
		private BackstageViewControl backstageView;

		public BackstageViewControl BackstageView
		{
			get
			{
				return backstageView;
			}
			private set
			{
				if (value != backstageView)
				{
					BackstageViewControl oldValue = backstageView;
					backstageView = value;
					OnBackstageViewChanged(oldValue);
				}
			}
		}

		private WeakReference FocusedElementOnBackstageClosed { get; set; }

		public BackstageViewMenuStrategy(RibbonControl ribbon)
			: base(ribbon)
		{
			BackstageView = (BackstageViewControl)base.Ribbon.ApplicationMenu;
		}

		protected override BackstageViewPlacement GetPlacement()
		{
			if (BackstageView != null)
			{
				return BackstageView.Placement;
			}
			return base.GetPlacement();
		}

		protected override void OnIsMenuOpenedChanged()
		{
			base.OnIsMenuOpenedChanged();
			BackstageView.SetCurrentValue(BackstageViewControl.IsOpenProperty, base.IsMenuOpened);
			RibbonControlHelper.SetIsBackstageInFullScreen(base.Ribbon, base.IsMenuOpened && BackstageView.IsFullScreen);
		}

		protected override UIElement GetBackstageViewRoot()
		{
			UIElement uIElement = null;
			if (base.Ribbon.IsInRibbonWindow)
			{
				if (BackstageView.IsFullScreen && BackstageView.EnableWindowTitleShrink)
				{
					return (UIElement)LayoutHelper.FindLayoutOrVisualParentObject((DependencyObject)base.Ribbon, (Predicate<DependencyObject>)((DependencyObject x) => x is AdornerDecorator || x is ScrollContentPresenter), false, (DependencyObject)null);
				}
				return base.Ribbon.WindowHelper.GetRibbonWindowContent();
			}
			return TreeHelper.GetParent<UIElement>((DependencyObject)base.Ribbon, (Func<UIElement, bool>)((UIElement x) => BarNameScope.IsScopeTarget((object)x) && AdornerLayer.GetAdornerLayer(x) != null), true, true) ?? AdornerLayer.GetAdornerLayer(base.Ribbon).With((AdornerLayer x) => FrameworkElementExtensions.GetVisualParent((FrameworkElement)x));
		}

		protected virtual void OnBackstageViewChanged(BackstageViewControl oldValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				oldValue.Ribbon = null;
				oldValue.Loaded -= OnBackstageViewLoaded;
				((ILogicalChildrenContainer)base.Ribbon).RemoveLogicalChild((object)oldValue);
			}
			if (BackstageView != null)
			{
				((ILogicalChildrenContainer)base.Ribbon).AddLogicalChild((object)BackstageView);
				BackstageView.Loaded += OnBackstageViewLoaded;
				BackstageView.Ribbon = base.Ribbon;
				if (!base.Ribbon.IsBackStageViewOpen && BackstageView.IsOpen && FrameworkElementExtensions.IsInVisualTree((FrameworkElement)base.Ribbon) && base.Ribbon.IsLoaded)
				{
					Open();
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnBackstageViewLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			FocusedElementOnBackstageClosed = new WeakReference(Keyboard.FocusedElement);
			UpdateBackstageViewOffset();
			((BackstageViewControl)sender).UpdateFocus();
		}

		protected override Thickness GetBackstageViewOffset()
		{
			if (base.BackstageViewContentControl == null)
			{
				return default(Thickness);
			}
			UIElement backstageViewRoot = GetBackstageViewRoot();
			if (base.Ribbon.WindowHelper.HasRibbonWindowAsParent && (base.Ribbon.WindowHelper.IsAeroMode || !BackstageView.EnableWindowTitleShrink) && BackstageView.IsFullScreen && base.Ribbon.WindowHelper.GetTitleElement() != null)
			{
				return new Thickness(0.0, base.Ribbon.WindowHelper.GetTitleElement().TransformToVisual(backstageViewRoot).Transform(new Point(0.0, base.Ribbon.WindowHelper.GetTitleElement().RenderSize.Height))
					.Y, 0.0, 0.0);
			}
			if (!BackstageView.IsFullScreen && backstageViewRoot != null && base.Ribbon.SelectedPageControlContainer != null && backstageViewRoot.IsAncestorOf(base.Ribbon.SelectedPageControlContainer))
			{
				return new Thickness(0.0, base.Ribbon.SelectedPageControlContainer.TransformToAncestor(backstageViewRoot).Transform(default(Point)).Y, 0.0, 0.0);
			}
			return default(Thickness);
		}

		protected override void OnClosed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnClosed(sender, e);
			FocusedElementOnBackstageClosed.With((WeakReference x) => x.Target as IInputElement).Do(delegate(IInputElement x)
			{
				x.Focus();
			});
			FocusedElementOnBackstageClosed = null;
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			BackstageView = null;
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		public override INavigationOwner GetNavigationOwner()
		{
			return (INavigationOwner)(object)BackstageView;
		}
	}
	public class BackstageViewLeftPartPanel : StackPanel
	{
		public BackstageViewLeftPartPanel()
		{
			base.Orientation = Orientation.Vertical;
		}

		protected override Size ArrangeOverride(Size arrangeSize)
		{
			Rect finalRect = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, arrangeSize.Width, 0.0);
			Rect finalRect2 = new Rect(0.0, arrangeSize.Height, arrangeSize.Width, 0.0);
			foreach (UIElement item in from x in base.Children.OfType<UIElement>()
				where !IsBottomElement(x)
				select x)
			{
				finalRect.Height = item.DesiredSize.Height;
				item.Arrange(finalRect);
				finalRect.Y += finalRect.Height;
			}
			foreach (UIElement item2 in (from x in base.Children.OfType<UIElement>()
				where IsBottomElement(x)
				select x).Reverse())
			{
				finalRect2.Height = item2.DesiredSize.Height;
				finalRect2.Y -= finalRect2.Height;
				item2.Arrange(finalRect2);
			}
			return arrangeSize;
		}

		private bool IsBottomElement(UIElement element)
		{
			if (element is BackstageItemBase)
			{
				return ((BackstageItemBase)element).Placement == BackstageItemPlacement.Bottom;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

	internal class BackstageViewHeaderPresenterNativeMethods
	{
		public enum SPI
		{
			GETANIMATION = 72,
			SETANIMATION
		}

		[Flags]
		public enum SPIF
		{
			None = 0,
			UPDATEINIFILE = 1,
			SENDCHANGE = 2,
			SENDWININICHANGE = 2
		}

		public struct ANIMATIONINFO
		{
			public uint cbSize;

			public int iMinAnimate;

			public ANIMATIONINFO(int iMinAnimate)
			{
				cbSize = (uint)Marshal.SizeOf(typeof(ANIMATIONINFO));
				this.iMinAnimate = iMinAnimate;
			}
		}

		private static ANIMATIONINFO currentAnimationinfo = new ANIMATIONINFO
		{
			cbSize = (uint)Marshal.SizeOf(typeof(ANIMATIONINFO))
		};

		private static bool animationsDisabled;

		private static readonly object olock = new object();

		[DllImport("user32.dll", SetLastError = true)]
		[return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)]
		private static extern bool SystemParametersInfo(SPI uiAction, uint uiParam, ref ANIMATIONINFO pvParam, SPIF fWinIni);

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public static void DisableAnimations()
		{
			if (animationsDisabled)
			{
				return;
			}
			lock (olock)
			{
				if (!animationsDisabled)
				{
					animationsDisabled = true;
					if (!SystemParametersInfo(SPI.GETANIMATION, (uint)Marshal.SizeOf(typeof(ANIMATIONINFO)), ref currentAnimationinfo, SPIF.None))
					{
						animationsDisabled = false;
						return;
					}
					ANIMATIONINFO pvParam = default(ANIMATIONINFO);
					pvParam.cbSize = (uint)Marshal.SizeOf(pvParam);
					pvParam.iMinAnimate = 0;
					SystemParametersInfo(SPI.SETANIMATION, (uint)Marshal.SizeOf(typeof(ANIMATIONINFO)), ref pvParam, SPIF.SENDCHANGE);
				}
			}
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public static void EnableAnimations()
		{
			if (!animationsDisabled)
			{
				return;
			}
			lock (olock)
			{
				if (animationsDisabled)
				{
					SystemParametersInfo(SPI.SETANIMATION, (uint)Marshal.SizeOf(typeof(ANIMATIONINFO)), ref currentAnimationinfo, SPIF.SENDCHANGE);
					animationsDisabled = false;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class BackstageViewHeaderPresenter : ContentControl
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty LeftOffsetProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("LeftOffset", typeof(double), typeof(BackstageViewHeaderPresenter), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0.0, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure | FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsArrange, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((BackstageViewHeaderPresenter)d).OnLeftOffsetChanged((double)e.OldValue, (double)e.NewValue);
		}));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty RightOffsetProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("RightOffset", typeof(double), typeof(BackstageViewHeaderPresenter), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0.0, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure | FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsArrange, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((BackstageViewHeaderPresenter)d).OnRightOffsetChanged((double)e.OldValue, (double)e.NewValue);
		}));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty BackstageViewControlProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("BackstageViewControl", typeof(BackstageViewControl), typeof(BackstageViewHeaderPresenter), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((BackstageViewHeaderPresenter)d).OnBackstageViewControlChanged((BackstageViewControl)e.OldValue, (BackstageViewControl)e.NewValue);
		}));

		private double infiniteWidth;

		private bool restoreOnMove;

		public BackstageViewControl BackstageViewControl
		{
			get
			{
				return (BackstageViewControl)GetValue(BackstageViewControlProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(BackstageViewControlProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public double RightOffset
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(RightOffsetProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(RightOffsetProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public double LeftOffset
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(LeftOffsetProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(LeftOffsetProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnBackstageViewControlChanged(BackstageViewControl oldValue, BackstageViewControl newValue)
		{
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnLeftOffsetChanged(double oldValue, double newValue)
		{
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnRightOffsetChanged(double oldValue, double newValue)
		{
		}

		protected override Size MeasureOverride(Size constraint)
		{
			infiniteWidth = base.MeasureOverride(new Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity)).Width;
			return base.MeasureOverride(new Size(Math.Max(0.0, constraint.Width - RightOffset - LeftOffset), constraint.Height));
		}

		protected override HitTestResult HitTestCore(PointHitTestParameters hitTestParameters)
		{
			if (new Rect(new Point(LeftOffset, 0.0), new Size(Math.Max(0.0, base.ActualWidth - LeftOffset - RightOffset), base.ActualHeight)).Contains(hitTestParameters.HitPoint))
			{
				return new PointHitTestResult(this, hitTestParameters.HitPoint);
			}
			return base.HitTestCore(hitTestParameters);
		}

		protected override void OnPreviewMouseLeftButtonDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnPreviewMouseLeftButtonDown(e);
			BackstageViewHeaderPresenterNativeMethods.DisableAnimations();
			try
			{
				Window window = DXWindowsHelper.GetWindow((DependencyObject)this);
				if (DXWindowsHelper.GetWindowKind((DependencyObject)this) == "DXRibbonWindow")
				{
					(window as DXRibbonWindow).Do(delegate(DXRibbonWindow x)
					{
						x.DragOrMaximizeWindow(this, e);
					});
				}
				else if (window != null && BackstageViewControl.Placement == BackstageViewPlacement.Window)
				{
					if (window.WindowState == WindowState.Normal)
					{
						window.DragMove();
					}
					else
					{
						restoreOnMove = true;
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				BackstageViewHeaderPresenterNativeMethods.EnableAnimations();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPreviewMouseLeftButtonUp(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnPreviewMouseLeftButtonUp(e);
			BackstageViewHeaderPresenterNativeMethods.EnableAnimations();
			restoreOnMove = false;
		}

		protected override void OnMouseMove(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseMove(e);
			if (restoreOnMove)
			{
				restoreOnMove = false;
				Window window = DXWindowsHelper.GetWindow((DependencyObject)this);
				Point screenPoint = ScreenHelper.GetScreenPoint((FrameworkElement)this, e.GetPosition(this));
				BackstageViewHeaderPresenterNativeMethods.DisableAnimations();
				window.WindowState = WindowState.Normal;
				window.Left = screenPoint.X - window.RestoreBounds.Width / 2.0;
				window.Top = screenPoint.Y - base.ActualHeight / 2.0;
				if (Mouse.LeftButton == MouseButtonState.Pressed)
				{
					window.DragMove();
					BackstageViewHeaderPresenterNativeMethods.EnableAnimations();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseDoubleClick(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseDoubleClick(e);
			if (BackstageViewControl.Placement == BackstageViewPlacement.Adorner)
			{
				return;
			}
			Window window = DXWindowsHelper.GetWindow((DependencyObject)this);
			if (window != null && DXWindowsHelper.GetWindowKind((DependencyObject)this) != "DXRibbonWindow")
			{
				if (window.WindowState == WindowState.Maximized)
				{
					window.WindowState = WindowState.Normal;
				}
				else if (window.WindowState == WindowState.Normal)
				{
					window.WindowState = WindowState.Maximized;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override Size ArrangeOverride(Size arrangeBounds)
		{
			double num = (arrangeBounds.Width - infiniteWidth) / 2.0;
			double num2 = num + infiniteWidth;
			Rect rect = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, arrangeBounds.Width, arrangeBounds.Height);
			if (num2 > arrangeBounds.Width - RightOffset || num < LeftOffset)
			{
				rect = new Rect(LeftOffset, 0.0, Math.Max(0.0, arrangeBounds.Width - LeftOffset - RightOffset), arrangeBounds.Height);
			}
			if (VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(this) == 0)
			{
				return default(Size);
			}
			UIElement uIElement = VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(this, 0) as UIElement;
			Rect finalRect = new Rect(Math.Max(rect.Left, RectExtension.CenterX(rect) - uIElement.DesiredSize.Width / 2.0), Math.Max(0.0, (arrangeBounds.Height - uIElement.DesiredSize.Height) / 2.0), Math.Min(arrangeBounds.Width, uIElement.DesiredSize.Width), Math.Min(arrangeBounds.Height, uIElement.DesiredSize.Height));
			uIElement.Arrange(finalRect);
			return arrangeBounds;
		}
	}

	public class RibbonAutoHideControl : ContentControl
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsAutoHideActiveProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsRibbonShownProperty;

		private FrameworkElement controlBoxContainer;

		private IRibbonWindow ribbonWindow;

		public bool IsAutoHideActive
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(IsAutoHideActiveProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(IsAutoHideActiveProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public bool IsRibbonShown
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(IsRibbonShownProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(IsRibbonShownProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public ContentPresenter ContentPresenter { get; private set; }

		public BarPopupBase Popup { get; private set; }

		public ContentControl ContentContainer { get; private set; }

		public ToggleButton ShowAutoHidePopupButton { get; set; }

		private IRibbonWindow RibbonWindow
		{
			get
			{
				return ribbonWindow;
			}
			set
			{
				if (ribbonWindow != value)
				{
					ribbonWindow = value;
					OnRibbonWindowChanged(value);
				}
			}
		}

		private FrameworkElement ControlBoxContainer
		{
			get
			{
				return controlBoxContainer;
			}
			set
			{
				if (controlBoxContainer != value)
				{
					FrameworkElement oldValue = controlBoxContainer;
					controlBoxContainer = value;
					OnControlBoxContainerChanged(oldValue);
				}
			}
		}

		static RibbonAutoHideControl()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(RibbonAutoHideControl);
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<RibbonAutoHideControl>();
			IsAutoHideActiveProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("IsAutoHideActive", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(false, OnIsAutoHideActivePropertyChanged));
			IsRibbonShownProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("IsRibbonShown", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(false, OnIsRibbonShownPropertyChanged, OnCoerceIsRibbonShownProperty));
		}

		private static object OnCoerceIsRibbonShownProperty(DependencyObject d, object baseValue)
		{
			return ((RibbonAutoHideControl)d).OnIsRibbonShownCoerce((bool)baseValue);
		}

		private static void OnIsRibbonShownPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((RibbonAutoHideControl)d).OnIsRibbonShownChanged((bool)e.OldValue);
		}

		private static void OnIsAutoHideActivePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((RibbonAutoHideControl)d).OnIsAutoHidePropertyChanged((bool)e.OldValue);
		}

		public RibbonAutoHideControl()
		{
			base.Loaded += OnLoaded;
			base.Unloaded += OnUnloaded;
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			ContentPresenter = GetTemplateChild("PART_ContentPresenter") as ContentPresenter;
			ContentContainer = GetTemplateChild("PART_ContainerControl") as ContentControl;
			DependencyObject templateChild = GetTemplateChild("PART_RibbonAutoHidePopup");
			Popup = (BarPopupBase)(object)((templateChild is BarPopupBase) ? templateChild : null);
			ShowAutoHidePopupButton = GetTemplateChild("PART_ShowAutoHidePopupButton") as ToggleButton;
			SetCurrentValue(IsRibbonShownProperty, false);
			UpdateContentPlacement();
			UpdateControlBoxContainer();
		}

		protected virtual void OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			Window window = Window.GetWindow(this);
			RibbonWindow = (IRibbonWindow)(object)((window is IRibbonWindow) ? window : null);
		}

		protected virtual void OnUnloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			RibbonWindow = null;
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsAutoHidePropertyChanged(bool oldValue)
		{
			if (!IsAutoHideActive)
			{
				SetCurrentValue(IsRibbonShownProperty, false);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsRibbonShownChanged(bool oldValue)
		{
			UpdateContentPlacement();
		}

		protected virtual void OnRibbonWindowChanged(IRibbonWindow oldValue)
		{
			UpdateControlBoxContainer();
		}

		protected virtual void OnControlBoxContainerChanged(FrameworkElement oldValue)
		{
			oldValue.Do(delegate(FrameworkElement container)
			{
				container.SizeChanged -= OnControlBoxContainerSizeChanged;
			});
			ControlBoxContainer.Do(delegate(FrameworkElement container)
			{
				container.SizeChanged += OnControlBoxContainerSizeChanged;
			});
			base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(new Action(UpdateShowPopupButtonMargin), DispatcherPriority.Loaded);
		}

		protected virtual void OnControlBoxContainerSizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(new Action(UpdateShowPopupButtonMargin), DispatcherPriority.Loaded);
		}

		protected virtual object OnIsRibbonShownCoerce(bool baseValue)
		{
			if (!IsAutoHideActive)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return baseValue;
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateContentPlacement()
		{
			if (ContentContainer != null && Popup != null)
			{
				if (IsRibbonShown)
				{
					ContentContainer.SetCurrentValue(ContentControl.ContentProperty, null);
					((DependencyObject)(object)Popup).SetCurrentValue(PopupBase.PopupContentProperty, (object)ContentPresenter);
				}
				else
				{
					((DependencyObject)(object)Popup).ClearValue(PopupBase.PopupContentProperty);
					ContentContainer.ClearValue(ContentControl.ContentProperty);
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateControlBoxContainer()
		{
			ControlBoxContainer = RibbonWindow.With((IRibbonWindow window) => window.GetControlBoxContainer());
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateShowPopupButtonMargin()
		{
			if (ShowAutoHidePopupButton != null)
			{
				if (ControlBoxContainer != null)
				{
					Point point = ControlBoxContainer.TranslatePoint(default(Point), (UIElement)(object)RibbonWindow);
					double right = ((base.FlowDirection == FlowDirection.RightToLeft) ? point.X : (((Window)(object)RibbonWindow).ActualWidth - point.X));
					Thickness margin = ShowAutoHidePopupButton.Margin;
					margin.Right = right;
					ShowAutoHidePopupButton.Margin = margin;
				}
				else
				{
					ShowAutoHidePopupButton.ClearValue(FrameworkElement.MarginProperty);
				}
			}
		}
	}

		protected override void OnIsLeftButtonPressedChanged(bool oldValue)

			if (base.IsLeftButtonPressed)
			{
				if (base.IsChecked == false)
				{
					ShowOverflowMenu();
				}
				else
				{
					CloseOverflowMenu();
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnPageGroupsControlChanged(RibbonPageGroupsControl oldValue)
		{
			if (PageGroupsControl == null)
			{
				((Collection<IBarItem>)(object)OverflowMenu.Items).Clear();
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool InitOverflowMenu()
		{
			if (PageGroupsControl == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			CancelEventArgs e = new CancelEventArgs();
			PageGroupsControl.InitOverflowMenu(OverflowMenu, e);
			return !e.Cancel;
		}

		protected virtual void ShowOverflowMenu()
		{
			if (InitOverflowMenu())
			{
				base.IsChecked = true;
				((Popup)(object)OverflowMenu).IsOpen = true;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void CloseOverflowMenu()
		{
			((Popup)(object)OverflowMenu).IsOpen = false;
			base.IsChecked = false;
			((Collection<IBarItem>)(object)OverflowMenu.Items).Clear();
		}

		private void OnOverflowMenuClosed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			((Collection<IBarItem>)(object)OverflowMenu.Items).Clear();
			base.IsChecked = false;
		}

		bool INavigationElement.ProcessKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Key == Key.Return || e.Key == Key.Space)
			{
				((IKeyTipNavigationElement)this).Select();
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		bool IKeyTipNavigationElement.Select()
		{
			ShowOverflowMenu();
			return true;
		}

		object IMultipleElementRegistratorSupport.GetName(object registratorKey)
		{
			return string.Empty;
		}

		bool IEventListenerClient.ReceiveEvent(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			return base.IsMouseOver;
		}

		[SpecialName]
		bool IKeyTipNavigationElement.get_IsVisible()
		{
			return base.IsVisible;
		}
	}
