	public static class RibbonSpacingModeHelper
	{
		private const string TouchThemeNameSuffix = ";Touch";

		public static bool GetIsTouchSupported(CommonThemeTreeWalker themeTreeWalker)
		{
			if (themeTreeWalker == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			string touchThemeName = themeTreeWalker.ThemeName + ";Touch";
			if (!themeTreeWalker.IsTouch)
			{
				return Theme.Themes.Any((Theme theme) => theme.Name.Equals(touchThemeName));
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static void UpdateThemeName(CommonThemeTreeWalker themeTreeWalker, SpacingMode spacingMode)
		{
			//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!CommonThemeHelper.UseLightweightThemes && ((themeTreeWalker != null) ? themeTreeWalker.TreeWalker : null) != null)
			{
				string actualThemeName = GetActualThemeName(themeTreeWalker);
				string actualSpaceModeThemeName = GetActualSpaceModeThemeName(actualThemeName, spacingMode);
				if (!actualThemeName.Equals(actualSpaceModeThemeName))
				{
					FrameworkElement topLevelVisual = LayoutHelper.GetTopLevelVisual(themeTreeWalker.TreeWalker.Owner);
					topLevelVisual.SetCurrentValue(ThemeManager.ThemeNameProperty, actualSpaceModeThemeName);
				}
			}
		}

		private static string GetActualSpaceModeThemeName(string currentThemeName, SpacingMode spacingMode)
		{
			//IL_000a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000c: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(currentThemeName))
			{
				return currentThemeName;
			}
			if ((int)spacingMode != 1)
			{
				return GetThemeName(currentThemeName);
			}
			return GetTouchThemeName(currentThemeName);
		}

		private static string GetActualThemeName(CommonThemeTreeWalker themeTreeWalker)
		{
			string text = themeTreeWalker.ThemeName;
			if (themeTreeWalker.IsTouch)
			{
				text += ";Touch";
			}
			return text;
		}

		private static string GetThemeName(string currentThemeName)
		{
			return currentThemeName.Replace(";Touch", "");
		}

		private static string GetTouchThemeName(string currentThemeName)
		{
			if (currentThemeName.EndsWith(";Touch"))
			{
				return currentThemeName;
			}
			return currentThemeName + ";Touch";
		}
	}
	public interface IRibbonItem
	{
		bool IsInItems { get; set; }
	}
	public abstract class BaseRibbonItem : FrameworkContentElement, IRibbonItem
	{
		bool IRibbonItem.IsInItems { get; set; }
	}
	public class RibbonItemCollection : ObservableCollection<IRibbonItem>
	{
		protected override void OnCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset)
			{
				using IEnumerator<IRibbonItem> enumerator = GetEnumerator();
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					IRibbonItem current = enumerator.Current;
					current.IsInItems = true;
				}
			}
			if (e.NewItems != null)
			{
				foreach (IRibbonItem newItem in e.NewItems)
				{
					newItem.IsInItems = true;
				}
			}
			base.OnCollectionChanged(e);
			if (e.OldItems == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (IRibbonItem oldItem in e.OldItems)
			{
				oldItem.IsInItems = false;
			}
		}
	}
	public class PageToCategoryBinder
	{
		private readonly Locker locker;

		public Dictionary<string, RibbonPageCategoryBase> Categories { get; set; }

		public List<RibbonPage> UnboundPages { get; set; }

		public List<RibbonPage> BoundPages { get; set; }

		public PageToCategoryBinder()
		{
			//IL_0028: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0032: Expected O, but got Unknown
			UnboundPages = new List<RibbonPage>();
			BoundPages = new List<RibbonPage>();
			Categories = new Dictionary<string, RibbonPageCategoryBase>();
			locker = new Locker();
			locker.Unlocked += OnUnlocked;
		}

		public void AddCategory(RibbonPageCategoryBase category)
		{
			if (category == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			using (Lock())
			{
				string name = category.Name;
				if (category is RibbonDefaultPageCategory)
				{
					Categories.Add(string.Empty, category);
				}
				else
				{
					if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))
					{
						return;
					}
					Categories.Add(name, category);
				}
			}
			BindItems();
		}

		public void RemoveCategory(RibbonPageCategoryBase category, string name = null)
		{
			if (category == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			using (Lock())
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))
				{
					name = category.Name;
				}
				if (category is RibbonDefaultPageCategory)
				{
					name = string.Empty;
				}
				else if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))
				{
					return;
				}
				Categories.Remove(name);
				for (int num = category.Pages.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					if (((IRibbonItem)category.Pages[num]).IsInItems)
					{
						UnboundPages.Add(category.Pages[num]);
						category.Pages.RemoveAt(num);
					}
				}
			}
			BindItems();
		}

		public void NameChanged(RibbonPageCategoryBase category, string oldName, string newName)
		{
			using (Lock())
			{
				RemoveCategory(category, oldName);
				AddCategory(category);
			}
		}

		public void AddPage(RibbonPage page)
		{
			UnboundPages.Add(page);
			BindItems();
		}

		public void RemovePage(RibbonPage page, string categoryName)
		{
			UnboundPages.Remove(page);
			BoundPages.Remove(page);
			if (Categories.ContainsKey(categoryName) && Categories[categoryName] != null)
			{
				Categories[categoryName].Pages.Remove(page);
			}
		}

		public void CategoryNameChanged(RibbonPage page, string oldValue, string newValue)
		{
			using (Lock())
			{
				RemovePage(page, oldValue);
				AddPage(page);
			}
		}

		public void ClearPages()
		{
			UnboundPages.Clear();
			while (BoundPages.Count > 0)
			{
				RemovePage(BoundPages[0], BoundPages[0].CategoryName);
			}
		}

		public IDisposable Lock()
		{
			return (IDisposable)locker.Lock();
		}

		public void Unlock()
		{
			locker.Unlock();
		}

		private void OnUnlocked(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			BindItems();
		}

		private void BindItems()
		{
			if (locker.IsLocked)
			{
				return;
			}
			RibbonPage[] array = UnboundPages.ToArray();
			foreach (RibbonPage ribbonPage in array)
			{
				if (Categories.Count <= 0)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(ribbonPage.CategoryName) && ((IRibbonItem)ribbonPage).IsInItems)
				{
					Categories.Values.First((RibbonPageCategoryBase c) => c is RibbonDefaultPageCategory).Pages.Add(ribbonPage);
					BoundPages.Add(ribbonPage);
					UnboundPages.Remove(ribbonPage);
				}
				else if (Categories.ContainsKey(ribbonPage.CategoryName))
				{
					Categories[ribbonPage.CategoryName].Pages.Add(ribbonPage);
					BoundPages.Add(ribbonPage);
					UnboundPages.Remove(ribbonPage);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class SelfCategoriesCollection : ObservableCollection<RibbonPageCategoryBase>
	{
		private readonly RibbonControl ribbon;

		private RibbonDefaultPageCategory defaultPageCategory;

		private RibbonDefaultPageCategory autoGeneratedCategory;

		public RibbonPageCategoryBase this[string name]
		{
			get
			{
				using (IEnumerator<RibbonPageCategoryBase> enumerator = GetEnumerator())
				{
					while (enumerator.MoveNext())
					{
						RibbonPageCategoryBase current = enumerator.Current;
						if (current.Name == name)
						{
							return current;
						}
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public SelfCategoriesCollection(RibbonControl ribbon)
		{
			this.ribbon = ribbon;
			ribbon.Items.CollectionChanged += OnItemsCollectionChanged;
			ribbon.Categories.CollectionChanged += OnCategoriesCollectionChanged;
		}

		public bool CheckDefaultCategoryOnRemoveItem(IRibbonItem item)
		{
			if (object.Equals(defaultPageCategory, item))
			{
				defaultPageCategory = null;
			}
			if (defaultPageCategory == null)
			{
				RibbonDefaultPageCategory ribbonDefaultPageCategory = autoGeneratedCategory;
				if (ribbonDefaultPageCategory == null)
				{
					RibbonDefaultPageCategory obj = new RibbonDefaultPageCategory
					{
						IsAutogenerated = true
					};
					RibbonDefaultPageCategory ribbonDefaultPageCategory2 = obj;
					autoGeneratedCategory = obj;
					ribbonDefaultPageCategory = ribbonDefaultPageCategory2;
				}
				defaultPageCategory = ribbonDefaultPageCategory;
				ribbon.PageToCategoryBinder.AddCategory(defaultPageCategory);
				Add(defaultPageCategory);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool CheckDefaultCategoryOnAddItem(IRibbonItem item)
		{
			bool result = false;
			if (item is RibbonDefaultPageCategory)
			{
				result = Remove(defaultPageCategory);
				ribbon.PageToCategoryBinder.RemoveCategory(defaultPageCategory);
				defaultPageCategory = item as RibbonDefaultPageCategory;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public bool CheckDefaultCategory()
		{
			return CheckDefaultCategoryOnRemoveItem(null);
		}

		private void OnCategoriesCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add)
			{
				foreach (RibbonPageCategoryBase newItem in e.NewItems)
				{
					CheckDefaultCategoryOnAddItem(newItem);
					Add(newItem);
					ribbon.PageToCategoryBinder.AddCategory(newItem);
				}
			}
			if (e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove)
			{
				foreach (RibbonPageCategoryBase oldItem in e.OldItems)
				{
					ribbon.PageToCategoryBinder.RemoveCategory(oldItem);
					Remove(oldItem);
					CheckDefaultCategoryOnRemoveItem(oldItem);
				}
			}
			if (e.Action != NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset && e.Action != NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Move && e.Action != NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace)
			{
				return;
			}
			using (ribbon.PageToCategoryBinder.Lock())
			{
				for (int num = base.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					RibbonPageCategoryBase ribbonPageCategoryBase3 = base[num];
					if (ribbon.Items.IndexOf(ribbonPageCategoryBase3) == -1 && (ribbonPageCategoryBase3 != defaultPageCategory || defaultPageCategory.IsAutogenerated))
					{
						ribbon.PageToCategoryBinder.RemoveCategory(ribbonPageCategoryBase3);
						RemoveAt(num);
					}
				}
				foreach (RibbonPageCategoryBase category in ribbon.Categories)
				{
					CheckDefaultCategoryOnAddItem(category);
					ribbon.PageToCategoryBinder.AddCategory(category);
					Add(category);
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnItemsCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add)
			{
				int num = -1;
				foreach (object newItem in e.NewItems)
				{
					if (newItem is RibbonPageCategoryBase)
					{
						CheckDefaultCategoryOnAddItem(newItem as IRibbonItem);
						RibbonPageCategoryBase ribbonPageCategoryBase = (RibbonPageCategoryBase)newItem;
						if (num == -1)
						{
							int num2 = -1;
							for (int num3 = e.NewStartingIndex - 1; num3 >= 0; num3--)
							{
								if (ribbon.Items[num3] is RibbonPageCategoryBase)
								{
									num2 = num3;
									break;
								}
							}
							if (num2 != -1)
							{
								IRibbonItem ribbonItem = ribbon.Items[num2];
								num = IndexOf((RibbonPageCategoryBase)ribbonItem);
							}
							num++;
						}
						Insert(num, ribbonPageCategoryBase);
						num++;
						ribbon.PageToCategoryBinder.AddCategory(ribbonPageCategoryBase);
					}
					if (newItem is RibbonPage)
					{
						((ILogicalChildrenContainer)ribbon).AddLogicalChild(newItem);
						CheckDefaultCategory();
						ribbon.PageToCategoryBinder.AddPage(newItem as RibbonPage);
					}
				}
			}
			if (e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove)
			{
				using (ribbon.PageToCategoryBinder.Lock())
				{
					foreach (object oldItem in e.OldItems)
					{
						if (oldItem is RibbonPageCategoryBase)
						{
							ribbon.PageToCategoryBinder.RemoveCategory(oldItem as RibbonPageCategoryBase);
							Remove(oldItem as RibbonPageCategoryBase);
							CheckDefaultCategoryOnRemoveItem(oldItem as IRibbonItem);
						}
						if (oldItem is RibbonPage)
						{
							((ILogicalChildrenContainer)ribbon).RemoveLogicalChild(oldItem);
							ribbon.PageToCategoryBinder.RemovePage(oldItem as RibbonPage, (oldItem as RibbonPage).CategoryName);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (e.Action != NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset && e.Action != NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Move && e.Action != NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num4 = -1;
			for (int num5 = base.Count - 1; num5 >= 0; num5--)
			{
				RibbonPageCategoryBase item = base[num5];
				if (ribbon.Categories.IndexOf(item) == -1)
				{
					num4 = num5;
					break;
				}
			}
			using (ribbon.PageToCategoryBinder.Lock())
			{
				foreach (RibbonPage boundPage in ribbon.PageToCategoryBinder.BoundPages)
				{
					((ILogicalChildrenContainer)ribbon).RemoveLogicalChild((object)boundPage);
				}
				foreach (RibbonPage unboundPage in ribbon.PageToCategoryBinder.UnboundPages)
				{
					((ILogicalChildrenContainer)ribbon).RemoveLogicalChild((object)unboundPage);
				}
				ribbon.PageToCategoryBinder.ClearPages();
				for (int num6 = num4; num6 >= 0; num6--)
				{
					if (base[num6] != defaultPageCategory || !defaultPageCategory.IsAutogenerated)
					{
						ribbon.PageToCategoryBinder.RemoveCategory(base[num6]);
						RemoveAt(num6);
					}
				}
				for (int num7 = ribbon.Items.Count - 1; num7 >= 0; num7--)
				{
					if (ribbon.Items[num7] is RibbonPageCategory ribbonPageCategory)
					{
						CheckDefaultCategoryOnAddItem(ribbonPageCategory);
						Insert(0, ribbonPageCategory);
						ribbon.PageToCategoryBinder.AddCategory(ribbonPageCategory);
					}
					else
					{
						ribbon.PageToCategoryBinder.AddPage(ribbon.Items[num7] as RibbonPage);
					}
				}
				foreach (RibbonPage boundPage2 in ribbon.PageToCategoryBinder.BoundPages)
				{
					((ILogicalChildrenContainer)ribbon).AddLogicalChild((object)boundPage2);
				}
				foreach (RibbonPage unboundPage2 in ribbon.PageToCategoryBinder.UnboundPages)
				{
					((ILogicalChildrenContainer)ribbon).AddLogicalChild((object)unboundPage2);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void InsertItem(int index, RibbonPageCategoryBase category)
		{
			if (!Contains(category))
			{
				base.InsertItem(index, category);
				OnInsertItem(category, index);
			}
		}

		protected override void RemoveItem(int index)
		{
			RibbonPageCategoryBase category = base[index];
			base.RemoveItem(index);
			OnRemoveItem(category, index);
		}

		protected override void SetItem(int index, RibbonPageCategoryBase item)
		{
			RibbonPageCategoryBase category = base[index];
			base.SetItem(index, item);
			OnRemoveItem(category, index);
			OnInsertItem(item, index);
		}

		protected override void ClearItems()
		{
			List<RibbonPageCategoryBase> list = new List<RibbonPageCategoryBase>();
			using (IEnumerator<RibbonPageCategoryBase> enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					RibbonPageCategoryBase current = enumerator.Current;
					list.Add(current);
				}
			}
			base.ClearItems();
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				OnRemoveItem(list[i], i);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnRemoveItem(RibbonPageCategoryBase category, int index)
		{
			if (ribbon != null)
			{
				ribbon.OnPageCategoryRemoved(category, index);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnInsertItem(RibbonPageCategoryBase category, int index)
		{
			if (ribbon != null)
			{
				ribbon.OnPageCategoryInserted(category, index);
			}
		}
	}

	public class PageGroupsPanelSimplifiedLayoutCalculator
	{
		private class SizeInfo
		{
			public Size DesiredSize;

			public RibbonPageGroupControl PageGroup;

			public RibbonPageGroupItemsPanel PageGroupPanel;

			public SizeInfo(RibbonPageGroupControl pageGroup)
			{
				PageGroup = pageGroup;
				PageGroupPanel = VisualTreeExtensions.VisualChildren((DependencyObject)(object)pageGroup, false).OfType<RibbonPageGroupItemsPanel>().First();
				DesiredSize = ((UIElement)(object)PageGroup).DesiredSize;
			}
		}

		private class ElementInfo
		{
			public BarItemLinkInfo LinkInfo;

			public BarItemLinkInfo Separator;

			public ElementInfo(BarItemLinkInfo linkInfo, BarItemLinkInfo separator)
			{
				LinkInfo = linkInfo;
				Separator = separator;
			}
		}

		public RibbonPageGroupsItemsPanel Panel { get; private set; }

		public IEnumerable<SimplifiedRibbonOverflowMenuItemInfo> OverflowMenuItems
		{
			get
			{
				foreach (RibbonPageGroupControl item in Panel.EnumerateChildrenCore())
				{
					if (!CanAddPageGroupToOverflowMenu(item))
					{
						continue;
					}
					RibbonPageGroupItemsPanel ribbonPageGroupItemsPanel = VisualTreeExtensions.VisualChildren((DependencyObject)(object)item, false).OfType<RibbonPageGroupItemsPanel>().FirstOrDefault();
					IEnumerable<SimplifiedRibbonOverflowMenuItemInfo> enumerable = ((ribbonPageGroupItemsPanel == null) ? NonLoadedPageGroupOverflowMenuItemsEnumerator(item) : PageGroupOverflowMenuItemsEnumerator(item, ribbonPageGroupItemsPanel));
					foreach (SimplifiedRibbonOverflowMenuItemInfo item2 in enumerable)
					{
						yield return item2;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public PageGroupsPanelSimplifiedLayoutCalculator(RibbonPageGroupsItemsPanel panel)
		{
			Panel = panel;
		}

		public Size MeasureOverride(Size availableSize)
		{
			List<SizeInfo> groupSizes = new List<SizeInfo>();
			Size result = MeasurePass(availableSize, groupSizes, initLayout: true);
			if (Panel.IsOrigin)
			{
				return result;
			}
			if (result.Width > availableSize.Width)
			{
				if (!Reduce(availableSize, groupSizes))
				{
					Collapse(availableSize, groupSizes);
				}
				result = MeasurePass(availableSize, null, initLayout: false);
			}
			return new Size(result.Width, Math.Max(result.Height, (Panel.Ribbon == null) ? 0.0 : Panel.Ribbon.OriginPageGroupHeight));
		}

		private Size MeasurePass(Size availableSize, List<SizeInfo> groupSizes, bool initLayout)
		{
			Size result = new Size(0.0, 0.0);
			foreach (RibbonPageGroupControl item in Panel.EnumerateChildrenCore())
			{
				if (item.IsOrigin)
				{
					MeasureChild((UIElement)(object)item, SizeHelper.Infinite, MeasureType.Default);
					return ((UIElement)(object)item).DesiredSize;
				}
				if (((UIElement)(object)item).IsVisible)
				{
					if (initLayout)
					{
						InitLayout(item);
					}
					MeasureChild((UIElement)(object)item, SizeHelper.Infinite, MeasureType.Default);
					groupSizes?.Add(new SizeInfo(item));
					result.Width += ((UIElement)(object)item).DesiredSize.Width;
					result.Height = Math.Max(result.Height, ((UIElement)(object)item).DesiredSize.Height);
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public void ResetRibbonStyleAndCollapsedState(RibbonPageGroupControl pageGroup)
		{
			foreach (BarItemLinkInfo item in EnumeratePageGroupLinkInfos(pageGroup))

				flag = SetDesiredRibbonStyle(item, null);

				}
			}
		}

		private bool IsPageGroupOverflowButton(RibbonPageGroupControl pageGroup, BarItemLinkInfo linkInfo)
		{

		private bool IsNeverMeasured(RibbonPageGroupControl pageGroup)
		{
			return VisualTreeExtensions.VisualChildren((DependencyObject)(object)pageGroup, false).FirstOrDefault() == null;
		}

		private void InitLayout(RibbonPageGroupControl pageGroup)
		{
			//IL_0051: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0057: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			pageGroup.IsCollapsed = false;
			if (IsNeverMeasured(pageGroup))
			{
				MeasureChild((UIElement)(object)pageGroup, SizeHelper.Infinite, MeasureType.Default);
			}
			foreach (BarItemLinkInfo item in EnumeratePageGroupLinkInfos(pageGroup, includeOverflowButton: true))
			{
				bool flag = false;
				if (IsPageGroupOverflowButton(pageGroup, item))
				{
					flag = SetIsItemCollapsed(item, value: true);
				}
				else
				{
					if ((int)item.LinkControl.ContainerType != 7)
					{
						flag = ((!SupportRibbonStyle(item.LinkControl, (RibbonItemStyles)3)) ? (flag | SetDesiredRibbonStyle(item, (RibbonItemStyles)4)) : (flag | SetDesiredRibbonStyle(item, (RibbonItemStyles)2)));
					}
					flag |= SetIsItemCollapsed(item, value: false);
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					InvalidateLinkInfoMeasureTree(item);
				}
			}
			if (pageGroup.AllItemsAreCollapsed())
			{
				pageGroup.IsCollapsed = true;
			}
		}

		private bool SetIsItemCollapsed(BarItemLinkInfo linkInfo, bool value)
		{
			if (RibbonControlLayoutHelper.GetIsItemCollapsed((DependencyObject)(object)linkInfo) == value)
			{
				return false;
			}
			RibbonControlLayoutHelper.SetIsItemCollapsed((DependencyObject)(object)linkInfo, value);
			return true;
		}

		}

		private void InvalidateLinkInfoMeasureTree(BarItemLinkInfo linkInfo)

			});
			foreach (UIElement item in VisualTreeExtensions.VisualParents((DependencyObject)(object)linkInfo, true).OfType<UIElement>())
			{
				if ((object)item == Panel)
				{
					break;
				}
				InvalidateUIElementMeasure(item);
			}
		}

			}
			element.InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		private bool Reduce(Size availableSize, List<SizeInfo> groupSizes)
		{
			double num = groupSizes.Sum((SizeInfo x) => x.DesiredSize.Width);
			while (num > availableSize.Width)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				foreach (SizeInfo item in groupSizes.OrderByDescending((SizeInfo x) => x.DesiredSize.Width))
				{
					foreach (BarItemLinkInfo item2 in (from x in EnumeratePageGroupLinkInfos(item.PageGroup)
						where CanReduce(x)
						select x).Reverse())
					{
						if (item2 != null)
						{
							double width = ((UIElement)(object)item2).DesiredSize.Width;
							SetDesiredRibbonStyle(item2, (RibbonItemStyles)4);
							InvalidateLinkInfoMeasureTree(item2);
							((UIElement)(object)item2).Measure(SizeHelper.Infinite);
							double num2 = width - ((UIElement)(object)item2).DesiredSize.Width;
							if (num2 != 0.0)
							{
								num -= num2;
								item.DesiredSize.Width -= num2;
								flag = true;
								break;
							}
						}
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool CanReduce(BarItemLinkInfo li)
		{
			//IL_003c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0042: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (li.LinkControl is BarButtonGroupLinkControl)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (li == null || li.LinkControl == null || !li.LinkControl.ActualShowGlyph || !li.LinkControl.ActualShowContent)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if ((int)li.LinkControl.CurrentRibbonStyle == 2)
			{
				return SupportRibbonStyle(li.LinkControl, (RibbonItemStyles)4);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool SupportRibbonStyle(IBarItemLinkControl linkControl, RibbonItemStyles style)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000a: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			return (GetAvailableStyles(linkControl) & style) > 0;
		}

		private RibbonItemStyles GetAvailableStyles(IBarItemLinkControl linkControl)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0061: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0062: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0063: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0053: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0057: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0059: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			RibbonItemStyles val = (RibbonItemStyles)0;
			RibbonItemStyles userRibbonStyle = linkControl.Strategy.UserRibbonStyle;
			if ((int)userRibbonStyle == 0)
			{
				bool flag = linkControl.Strategy.GetGlyph() != null || linkControl.Strategy.GetMediumGlyph() != null;
				if (linkControl.Strategy.GetContent() != null || linkControl.Strategy.GetContentTemplate() != null)
				{
					val = (RibbonItemStyles)2;
					if (flag)
					{
						val = (RibbonItemStyles)(val | 4);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					val = (RibbonItemStyles)4;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				val = userRibbonStyle;
			}
			return val;
		}

		private ElementInfo GetLastVisibleElement(RibbonPageGroupControl pageGroup)
		{
			List<BarItemLinkInfo> list = (from x in EnumeratePageGroupLinkInfos(pageGroup).Reverse()
				where !RibbonControlLayoutHelper.GetIsItemCollapsed((DependencyObject)(object)x)
				select x).Take(2).ToList();
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (list.Count == 1 || BarItemLinkControlChecker.Is<IBarItemLinkSeparatorControl>(list[0].LinkControl))
			{
				return new ElementInfo(list[0], null);
			}
			return new ElementInfo(list[0], BarItemLinkControlChecker.Is<IBarItemLinkSeparatorControl>(list[1].LinkControl) ? list[1] : null);
		}

		private bool Collapse(Size availableSize, List<SizeInfo> groupSizes)
		{
			double num = groupSizes.Sum((SizeInfo x) => x.DesiredSize.Width);
			while (num > availableSize.Width)
			{
				SizeInfo sizeInfo = groupSizes.OrderByDescending((SizeInfo x) => x.DesiredSize.Width).First();
				ElementInfo lastVisibleElement = GetLastVisibleElement(sizeInfo.PageGroup);
				if (lastVisibleElement == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				double num2 = CollapseLinkInfo(lastVisibleElement.LinkInfo);
				if (lastVisibleElement.Separator != null)
				{
					num2 += CollapseLinkInfo(lastVisibleElement.Separator);
				}
				num -= num2;
				sizeInfo.DesiredSize.Width -= num2;
				if (sizeInfo.PageGroup.AllItemsAreCollapsed())
				{
					sizeInfo.PageGroup.IsCollapsed = true;
					num -= sizeInfo.DesiredSize.Width;
					sizeInfo.DesiredSize.Width = 0.0;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private double CollapseLinkInfo(BarItemLinkInfo linkInfo)
		{
			double width = ((UIElement)(object)linkInfo).DesiredSize.Width;
			SetIsItemCollapsed(linkInfo, value: true);
			InvalidateLinkInfoMeasureTree(linkInfo);
			((UIElement)(object)linkInfo).Measure(SizeHelper.Infinite);
			return width;
		}

		private IEnumerable<BarItemLinkInfo> EnumeratePageGroupLinkInfos(RibbonPageGroupControl pageGroupControl, bool includeOverflowButton = false)
		{
			RibbonPageGroupItemsPanel ribbonPageGroupItemsPanel = VisualTreeExtensions.VisualChildren((DependencyObject)(object)pageGroupControl, false).OfType<RibbonPageGroupItemsPanel>().FirstOrDefault();
			if (ribbonPageGroupItemsPanel == null)
			{
				yield break;
			}
			foreach (BarItemLinkInfo item in ribbonPageGroupItemsPanel.EnumerateLinkInfos())
			{
				if (!IsPageGroupOverflowButton(pageGroupControl, item) || includeOverflowButton)
				{
					yield return item;
				}
			}
		}

		protected void MeasureChild(UIElement child, Size availableSize, MeasureType measureType)
		{
			RibbonPageGroupsItemsPanel.SetMeasureType(child, measureType);
			child.Measure(availableSize);
		}

		private Size GetDropDownButtonSize()
		{
			return VisualTreeExtensions.VisualParents((DependencyObject)(object)Panel, false).OfType<RibbonPageGroupsControl>().FirstOrDefault()
				.With((RibbonPageGroupsControl x) => x.OverflowButton)
				.Return((RibbonOverflowButton x) => x.DesiredSize, () => new Size(0.0, 0.0));
		}

		}

	public class RibbonPageCategoryCornerRadiusConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			CornerRadius cornerRadius = (value as CornerRadius?) ?? default(CornerRadius);
			if ((string)parameter == "Top")
			{
				return new CornerRadius
				{
					TopLeft = cornerRadius.TopLeft,
					TopRight = cornerRadius.TopRight,
					BottomLeft = 0.0,
					BottomRight = 0.0
				};
			}
			if ((string)parameter == "Bottom")
			{
				return new CornerRadius
				{
					TopLeft = 0.0,
					TopRight = 0.0,
					BottomLeft = cornerRadius.BottomLeft,
					BottomRight = cornerRadius.BottomRight
				};
			}
			return value;
		}

			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}
